b4-027-s002.gloss: 因为某种进步正在我们身边发生，并越来越明显。
b4-027-s002.whyLearn: because 分句单独作答，两个进行时用 and 并列推进，progress 的限定语可随话题替换。

b4-027-s012.skeleton: The problem now facing humanity is

modifiers.text: What is going to be done with all this knowledge ?

b4-027-s012.gloss: 人类当前面对的问题是：这些知识将如何处置？
b4-027-s012.whyLearn: 分词短语后置修饰 problem，冒号后接疑问句作表语，problem 与 knowledge 可换成任意议题。

b4-027-s016.skeleton: We have to ask ourselves very seriously what will happen

modifiers.text: what will happen if this twofold use of knowledge, with its ever-increasing power, continues
if this twofold use of knowledge, with its ever-increasing power, continues

b4-027-s016.gloss: 我们得认真自问：若知识的双重用途继续下去会怎样。
b4-027-s016.whyLearn: 主句 have to ask 后接宾语从句，从句里再嵌 if 条件句，主将从现的分工可直接套用。

b4-029-s003.skeleton: do they convey a hint of beauty and serenity

modifiers.text: though the gleams blind and dazzle
greater than we have known or imagined

b4-029-s003.gloss: 微光虽刺眼，却仍透出我们未曾知晓的美与宁静。
b4-029-s003.whyLearn: though 让步后用 yet 加 do they 倒装，再以 greater than 接完成时比较，层层递进可仿写。

modifiers.text: because noise abatement really is a good cause

b4-031-s003.gloss: 这很可惜，因为减少噪音本来就是好事。
b4-031-s003.whyLearn: because 分句补充理由，really 插在 is 前加重语气，主句评价词与原因都可替换。

modifiers.text: which lived in or near water

b4-032-s001.gloss: 正是生活在水中或水边的动植物，其遗体最易保存。
b4-032-s001.whyLearn: It is 后接 which 与 whose 两个关系词叠加限定，强调对象 animals and plants 可随时替换。

modifiers.text: although our faith in many of the things in which o

b4-034-s001.gloss: 这是个怀疑的时代，尽管我们的信念已经动摇。
b4-034-s001.whyLearn: but 转折后接 although 让步，再用 in which 引定语从句，修饰 age 的形容词可替换。

b4-037-s005.skeleton: Victorian optimism appears to me to have been the most cowardly and the most damaging.

modifiers.text: Of all forms of arrant untruthfulness
to have been the most cowardly and the most damaging
the most cowardly and the most damaging

b4-037-s005.gloss: 在种种弥天大谎中，维多利亚式乐观最怯懦也最有害。
b4-037-s005.whyLearn: Of all 开头划定比较范围，appears to have been 表推测性完成，两个最高级并列可换评价词。

b4-037-s013.skeleton: we can approach to some relative approximation.
b4-037-s013.gloss: 我们最多只能接近某种相对的近似。
b4-037-s013.whyLearn: At best 限定程度，can approach to 表有限的可能性，状语与宾语都可按语境替换。

b4-038-s015.skeleton: he can go on to appreciate more complex forms of combinations of several forms.

modifiers.text: to appreciate more complex forms of combinations of several forms

b4-038-s015.gloss: 由此他可以进而欣赏由几种形式组合成的复杂形式。
b4-038-s015.whyLearn: can go on to do 表接着做某事，后面 of 短语层层限定 forms，宾语链条可按主题替换。

b4-040-s006.skeleton: An unfavourable relationship between numbers and resources tends to make the earning of a living almost intolerably difficult.

modifiers.text: to make the earning of a living almost intolerably difficult

b4-040-s006.gloss: 人口与资源关系不佳，谋生几乎艰难得难以忍受。
b4-040-s006.whyLearn: tends to make 加宾语再加形容词补足语，中间嵌入 of 短语与副词，可照此写因果判断。

b4-042-s012.skeleton: we tend to go to the other extreme

modifiers.text: but on the whole this is a healthier attitude both for the child and the parent
to go to the other extreme
both for the child and the parent
for the child and the parent

b4-042-s012.gloss: 如今我们走向另一极端，但总体这对孩子和父母都更健康。
b4-042-s012.whyLearn: but 连接两个独立分句，on the whole 插入表态，both...and 并列对象，态度句可套用。

modifiers.text: that the three main sources of power are coal, oil and water power

b4-043-s006.gloss: 目前的状况是，三大动力来源为煤、石油和水力。
b4-043-s006.whyLearn: that 从句作表语说明 position 的具体内容，从句内并列列举，三种能源可替换成别项。

b4-055-s019.skeleton: any scientific study requires that there be no preferential weighting

modifiers.text: that there be no preferential weighting of one or another of the items in the series it selects for its consideration
of one or another of the items
in the series it selects for its consideration

b4-055-s019.gloss: 科学研究要求对所选项目一视同仁
b4-055-s019.whyLearn: requires that 后用动词原形 be，构成虚拟语气，是学术英语提出要求的典型句式。

modifiers.text: that we know of the laws of astronomy, or of the habits of the social insects
or of the habits of the social insects

b4-055-s021.gloss: 我们由此认识了天文规律与社会性昆虫习性
b4-055-s021.whyLearn: all that 引导定语从句，现在完成时把零散认知说成积累的成果。

modifiers.text: as long as these distinctions between ourselves and the primitive, ourselves and the barbarian, ourselves and the pagan, held sway over people's minds
between ourselves and the primitive, ourselves and the barbarian, ourselves and the pagan

b4-055-s023.gloss: 只要人我之别仍主导人心，人类学就无从成立
b4-055-s023.whyLearn: as long as 引导条件状语从句，与 impossible 搭配可论述一门学科成立的前提。

b4-055-s024.skeleton: It was necessary first to arrive at that degree

modifiers.text: where we no longer set our own belief over against our neighbour's superstition

b4-055-s024.gloss: 必须先达到不再以己见压人迷信的成熟度
b4-055-s024.whyLearn: It was necessary to do 形式主语句，where 从句具体说明 degree 的内涵。

b4-056-s001.skeleton: Science and technology have come to pervade every aspect of our lives

modifiers.text: to pervade every aspect of our lives

b4-056-s001.gloss: 科技已渗透到我们生活的方方面面
b4-056-s001.whyLearn: come to do 表示逐渐达到某种状态，现在完成时强调渗透已经完成。

b4-056-s006.skeleton: millions of humanbeings each year die
b4-056-s006.gloss: 初步努力中每年仍有数百万人死于饥荒疾病
b4-056-s006.whyLearn: even in 让步状语开头，millions of 表概数，from 引出死亡的多种原因。

b4-056-s009.skeleton: We have considerably extended our expectation
b4-056-s009.gloss: 我们已大幅延长了预期寿命
b4-056-s009.whyLearn: have extended 表已取得的成果，expectation of life 是寿命的地道说法。

b4-056-s011.skeleton: we are now thrusting forward to the stars

modifiers.text: and the conquest o space no longer strikes us as Wellsian or Jules Vernian

b4-056-s011.gloss: 我们正向星空推进，征服太空已不再稀奇
b4-056-s011.whyLearn: Not content with 作状语表让步，no longer strikes us as 说某事物已不再令人惊讶。

modifiers.text: And with the advent of the new phase of technology we call automation
both of greater leisure and of even greater material and intellectual riches

b4-056-s012.gloss: 自动化带来更多闲暇与更丰富的物质精神财富
b4-056-s012.whyLearn: both of ... and of ... 并列两个 of 短语，具体说明 promise 包含什么。

b4-056-s014.skeleton: It depends on automation being adequately exploited
b4-056-s014.gloss: 这取决于自动化能否得到充分利用
b4-056-s014.whyLearn: depend on 后接动名词复合结构 automation being done，最值得记住的搭配。

b4-056-s015.skeleton: We shall need to apply our scientific and technological resources

modifiers.text: to apply our scientific and technological resources
to literally every aspect of our society
to our commerce, our industry, our medicine, our agriculture, our transportation

b4-056-s015.gloss: 我们须把科技资源用于社会的方方面面
b4-056-s015.whyLearn: need to do 表必要性，后接一串并列 to 短语把应用范围一路铺开。

b4-056-s017.gloss: 在他新的技术成就中，这一点尤其明显
b4-056-s017.whyLearn: appear + 形容词表似乎，句首 In ... successes 限定判断适用的范围。

b4-056-s018.skeleton: He is extending his eyes with radar

modifiers.text: his tongue and his ear through telecommunication
his muscle and body structure through mechanization

b4-056-s018.gloss: 他用雷达延伸眼睛，用通信延伸耳目，用机械化延伸肌体
b4-056-s018.whyLearn: 分号并列三个现在进行时的分句，后两个省略 is extending，句式紧凑有力。

modifiers.text: by the generation and transmission of power
and his nervous system and his thinking and decision-making faculties through automation

b4-056-s019.gloss: 他借发电输电延伸体能，借自动化延伸神经与思维
b4-056-s019.whyLearn: 一个 extends 带两个宾语，分别用 by 与 through 引出方式，省略结构很清晰。

b4-056-s021.skeleton: It might be reasonable to conclude

modifiers.text: that the direction of modern science and technology is towards the creation of a series of machine-systems based on man as a model
towards the creation of a series of machine-systems
based on man as a model

b4-056-s021.gloss: 或可断定现代科技趋向于以人为模型造机器系统
b4-056-s021.whyLearn: It might be reasonable to conclude that 是学术写作中稳妥提出结论的句型。

b4-057-s001.skeleton: competition with other creatures must have been critical
b4-057-s001.gloss: 人类早期与其他生物的竞争必定十分严峻
b4-057-s001.whyLearn: must have been 表示对过去情况的肯定推测，是推断语气的典型用法。

b4-043-s014.skeleton: It is not always realized that the owners of pipelines can handle the oil of different customers

modifiers.text: sending it through at different, periods.

b4-043-s014.gloss: 人们常没意识到管道能为不同客户分批输油
b4-043-s014.whyLearn: It is not always realized that… 让“人们没意识到”显得客观，that 从句随主题整段替换。

b4-044-s005.skeleton: An enterprise has to incur certain costs and expenses

modifiers.text: in order to stay in business

b4-044-s005.gloss: 企业为维持经营必须承担一定成本与费用
b4-044-s005.whyLearn: has to 表客观必须，in order to 引出目的；incur costs 换成任何动词短语都能用。

b4-045-s008.skeleton: Normal people tend to forget this process

modifiers.text: unless and until they are reminded of it

b4-045-s008.gloss: 普通人若非被提醒，常会忘记这一过程
b4-045-s008.whyLearn: tend to 弱化语气，unless and until 把条件与时间合成一句；主语宾语都可替换。

b4-045-s014.skeleton: But a watch could never repair itself

modifiers.text: it does not consist of living parts, only of metal

b4-045-s014.gloss: 手表无法自修，因其由金属构成且会磨损
b4-045-s014.whyLearn: could never 把可能说死，后面补原因，which 从句再解释磨损；可换 parts 与 metal。

b4-046-s014.skeleton: It makes them believe they can spend Sunday in Brighton, but makes it impossible for them to return

modifiers.text: they can spend Sunday in Brighton
before, say, two in the morning

b4-046-s014.gloss: 这让他们以为能玩一天，却赶不回清晨
b4-046-s014.whyLearn: make sb believe 与 make it impossible for sb to do 对照，it 是形式宾语，值得整句背。

b4-047-s005.skeleton: He knows that if they trust him, he can give them the happiness
b4-047-s005.gloss: 他知道只要被信任，就能给他们渴望的快乐
b4-047-s005.whyLearn: 宾语从句里再嵌 if 条件与 which 定语从句，换掉 trust 与 give 就是万能模板。

b4-048-s003.skeleton: I never heard of anyone making a 'skeleton'

modifiers.text: as we were taught at school

b4-048-s003.gloss: 我从没听说谁做过“骨架”，学校却这么教
b4-048-s003.whyLearn: hear of sb doing 表听说某人做过，as 从句意为“正如”，两处都可替换。

b4-051-s010.skeleton: But animals of this age do not easily become subservient to man, and a very firm hand must be employed in the early stages
b4-051-s010.gloss: 这年龄的动物难驯服，早期须严加管束
b4-051-s010.whyLearn: do not easily become 与 must be employed 一主动一被动，中间 and 并列，主语可换。

b4-052-s002.skeleton: It was necessary, therefore, to invent instruments
b4-052-s002.gloss: 因此必须造出昼夜不眠的仪器
b4-052-s002.whyLearn: it 作形式主语把不定式后置，that 从句里 neither…nor 并列动词，换 instruments 即成新句。

b4-052-s006.skeleton: only the more unstable rods fell
b4-052-s006.gloss: 若力度轻，只有不稳的杆会倒下
b4-052-s006.whyLearn: 虚拟 if it were 配过去时结果，写实验条件最实用；只换 gentle 一词结果就变。

b4-052-s007.gloss: 若力度猛，所有杆都被震倒
b4-052-s007.whyLearn: 与上句只差一个形容词，构成对照实验，可模仿它用 if 从句控制变量。

b4-052-s011.skeleton: my pen moves, but the paper keeps still
b4-052-s011.gloss: 我写字时笔在动，纸却静止不动
b4-052-s011.whyLearn: while 引导同时动作，moves 与 keeps still 反义对照，换 pen 与 paper 可写相对运动。

b4-052-s012.skeleton: I could in time learn to write by holding the still
b4-052-s012.gloss: 多练之后，我或许能学会让纸动而笔不动
b4-052-s012.whyLearn: could 表可能，by + -ing 说方式，while 从句给参照；with practice 等插入语可换。

b4-052-s014.skeleton: how is it possible to write legibly

modifiers.text: when table, penholder and paper are all moving

b4-052-s014.gloss: 桌、笔、纸都在动，怎么可能写清楚字
b4-052-s014.whyLearn: when 从句先铺场景，how is it possible to… 反问收尾；三个并列名词可随意替换。

b4-052-s016.skeleton: Why does a person standing in a bus or train tend to fall

modifiers.text: standing in a bus or train
when a sudden start is made

b4-052-s016.gloss: 车突然启动时，站着的人为何会摔倒
b4-052-s016.whyLearn: 现在分词 standing 后置作定语，比 who 从句更紧凑；when 从句用被动，换场景即用。

b4-052-s017.skeleton: It is because his feet move on
b4-052-s017.gloss: 因为他的脚随车前移，头却停在原处
b4-052-s017.whyLearn: It is because… 是自问自答式解释，but 表转折；换 feet 与 head 可讲任何惯性现象。

b4-058-s011.skeleton: It is no use starting late in life to say

modifiers.text: to say: 'I will take an interest in this or that.'

b4-058-s011.gloss: 上了年纪才说对某事物感兴趣，没有用。
b4-058-s011.whyLearn: 范句：It is no use doing 是高频否定评价句型，后接不定式说明具体内容。可换 It is no use complaining。

modifiers.text: and during this time, my wife suffered terribly

b2-078-s003.gloss: 戒烟一周，妻子受尽折磨。
b2-078-s003.whyLearn: 否定句用at all加强语气，并列表并列前后境况，可练转折语境。

b2-078-s004.skeleton: I had all the usual symptoms

modifiers.text: a bad temper and an enormous appetite

b2-078-s004.gloss: 我出现戒烟后的各种典型症状。
b2-078-s004.whyLearn: 冒号列举把抽象症状具体化，of someone doing结构简洁表意。

b2-078-s005.skeleton: My friends kept on offering me
b2-078-s005.whyLearn: keep on doing表示反复不断，offering后接双宾语位置清晰。

modifiers.text: whenever I produced a packet of sweets from my pocket

b2-078-s006.gloss: 他们毫不掩饰，每见我掏糖就发笑。
b2-078-s006.whyLearn: make no effort to do是固定搭配，whenever引出时间状语从句。

b2-078-s007.gloss: 七天之后，我去参加一个聚会。
b2-078-s007.whyLearn: After加名词短语作时间状语，简洁交代起点，叙事过渡自然。

b2-078-s008.gloss: 周围人都在抽烟，我感到极不自在。
b2-078-s008.whyLearn: 过去进行时铺背景，一般过去时写反应，两时态对照写场景。

b2-078-s010.skeleton: I took one guiltily, lit it and smoked with satisfaction
b2-078-s010.gloss: 我内疚地接过一支，点上后满足地抽起来。
b2-078-s010.whyLearn: 三个并列谓语连成一气，guiltily与with satisfaction形成反差。

modifiers.text: that things had returned to normal once more

b2-078-s011.gloss: 妻子高兴的是，一切又恢复正常。
b2-078-s011.whyLearn: be delighted that接从句，had returned说明先于当时已恢复。

b2-078-s012.gloss: 照布赖恩说，戒烟是世上最容易的事。
b2-078-s012.whyLearn: as sb pointed out作插入语，it is...to do把真主语后置。

b2-078-s013.gloss: 他本人已经这么干过好多回了！
b2-078-s013.whyLearn: himself强调主语，lots of times作频率状语，感叹收尾有力。

b2-079-s005.skeleton: we were flying low over the city and slowly gaining height

modifiers.text: when the plane suddenly turned round and flew back to the airport

b2-079-s005.gloss: 起飞后我们低空掠过城市，飞机突然折返。
b2-079-s005.whyLearn: 过去进行时写进行中动作，when从句插入突发转折，张力强。

modifiers.text: While we were waiting to land
to keep calm and to get off the plane quietly
as soon as it had touched down

b2-079-s006.gloss: 等待降落时，空姐让我们保持镇静，着陆后安静下机。
b2-079-s006.whyLearn: told sb to do并列两个不定式，as soon as引出后发生的动作。

b2-079-s007.skeleton: Everybody on board was worried and we were curious

modifiers.text: to find out what had happened

b2-079-s007.gloss: 机上人人担心，我们急于弄清发生了什么。
b2-079-s007.whyLearn: be curious to do表急切心理，what had happened回指更早事件。

modifiers.text: that a bomb had been planted on the plane

b2-079-s009.gloss: 警方已接到通知：飞机上被安放了炸弹。
b2-079-s009.whyLearn: 被动语态套宾语从句，两级过去完成时点明事件先后顺序。

b2-079-s010.gloss: 我们着陆后，飞机被彻底搜查。
b2-079-s010.whyLearn: After从句用过去完成时点明先后，主句被动语态省施动者。

modifiers.text: and five hours later we were able to take off again

b2-079-s011.gloss: 幸运的是没发现炸弹，五小时后我们再次起飞。
b2-079-s011.whyLearn: 被动语态与be able to并列，Fortunately插入语，推进自然。

b3-045-s016.skeleton: The rise to fame was swift.
b3-045-s016.whyLearn: rise to fame 是固定搭配，was swift 系表结构干脆，适合写突然走红。

b3-045-s017.skeleton: Television cameras and newspapers carried the news
b3-045-s017.gloss: 电视和报纸把消息传遍全国。
b3-045-s017.whyLearn: carry sth to sb 用介词短语交代传播对象，并列主语自然有力。

b3-045-s018.skeleton: Newspapers and magazines offered the family huge sums

modifiers.text: for the exclusive rights to publish stories and photographs

b3-045-s018.gloss: 报刊出巨款买断独家报道权。
b3-045-s018.whyLearn: offer sb sth 双宾语加 for 引出代价，to publish 说明买的是什么权。

b3-045-s020.skeleton: The old farmhouse the family lived in was to be replaced
b3-045-s020.gloss: 老农舍将被十万美元新宅取代。
b3-045-s020.whyLearn: 定语从句插在主语后，was to be replaced 表被动加将来，信息很密。

modifiers.text: so lawyers had to be employed to act as spokesmen for the family at press conferences
to act as spokesmen for the family at press conferences

b3-045-s021.gloss: 记者追问，只好雇律师当发言人。
b3-045-s021.whyLearn: so 引出结果，had to be employed 被动加情态，to act as 说明目的身份。

b3-045-s022.skeleton: The event brought serious changes to the town itself.
b3-045-s022.gloss: 这件事给小镇本身带来巨变。
b3-045-s022.whyLearn: bring changes to 是常用搭配，itself 强调被改变的正是小镇本身。

modifiers.text: to build a huge new highway
as Aberdeen was now likely to attract thousands of tourists
likely to attract thousands of tourists

b3-045-s023.gloss: 计划修新公路，因阿伯丁会引来游客。
b3-045-s023.whyLearn: Plans were announced 后用不定式展开内容，as 从句补出原因。

b3-045-s024.skeleton: Signposts erected on the outskirts of the town directed tourists

modifiers.text: erected on the outskirts of the town
on the outskirts of the town
not to Aberdeen, but to 'Quint-City U.

b3-045-s024.gloss: 路牌把游客引向别处，不指阿伯丁。
b3-045-s024.whyLearn: not...but... 对比清晰，erected 分词后置修饰 signposts 很典型。

b3-045-s027.skeleton: The local authorities discussed the possibility

modifiers.text: to satisfy the curiosity of the public and to protect the family from inquisitive tourists

b4-060-s008.whyLearn: since 从句的主语是 what 主语从句，used to 与现在完成对照

b4-060-s010.skeleton: it is a claim that can be sustained

modifiers.text: if compassion animates those who urge the abolition of the death penalty
who urge the abolition of the death penalty
it is not a sentimental compassion for the mental agony inflicted upon a condemned man but a dread of destroying the miracle of life

b4-060-s010.gloss: 这主张站得住，怜悯不是感伤而是怕毁掉生命奇迹
b4-060-s010.whyLearn: not...but 对照中嵌入 if 条件从句和两个定语从句，主干极短

b4-060-s011.skeleton: the severity of the penal code had no serious effect on the prevalence of crime

modifiers.text: When in the eighteenth century offences against the law that today would no earn a month in prison were punished with the death penalty
that today would no earn a month in prison

b4-060-s011.gloss: 十八世纪连小罪也判死，重典却未减少犯罪
b4-060-s011.whyLearn: when 时间从句内含 that 定语从句，主干被推到句末，需分层读

b4-060-s012.skeleton: there were no more murders then than there were

modifiers.text: When it made no difference to the fate of a highwayman whether he had killed his victim or merely robbed him of a few pieces of silver
whether he had killed his victim or merely robbed him of a few pieces of silver
when men like Sir Fraricis Burdett succeeded in lightening the excessive severity of the penal laws
in lightening the excessive severity of the penal laws

b4-060-s012.gloss: 当时杀不杀人都一样，死刑并未减少谋杀
b4-060-s012.whyLearn: 形式主语 it 引出 whether 主语从句，than 比较从句再带 when 从句

b4-060-s013.skeleton: the sacredness of life on earth was not greatly regarded

modifiers.text: because a life in the world to come was taken for granted except by a comparatively small minotity of philosophers
except by a comparatively small minotity of philosophers

b4-060-s013.gloss: 那时来世被视作当然，今世生命便不受重视
b4-060-s013.whyLearn: 被动语态加 because 原因从句，except by 表例外，注意否定辖域

b4-060-s015.skeleton: Those who believe in capital punishment may have arguments for its retention, but surely no reasonable argument can be found for retention of the sickening mumbo-jumbo

modifiers.text: from the moment that the judge dons the black cap with what looks like a pen-wiper balanced on the top of his wig, to the reading of the burial service over the condemned man before he is dead
that the judge dons the black cap with what looks like a pen-wiper balanced on the top of his wig
with what looks like a pen-wiper balanced on the top of his wig
balanced on the top of his wig

b4-060-s015.gloss: 支持死刑或有理由，但这套仪式毫无合理依据
b4-060-s015.whyLearn: from...to... 框架里叠了三个定语从句与分词短语，层次极密

b4-060-s016.skeleton: it was more merciful to launch the condemned man into eternity twenty-four hours after he was sentenced

modifiers.text: to launch the condemned man into eternity twenty-four hours after he was sentenced
than to keep him shivering on the brink of that dread gulf for nearly three weeks
to keep him shivering on the brink of that dread gulf for nearly three weeks
shivering on the brink of that dread gulf for nearly three weeks

b4-060-s016.gloss: 判后隔天处死，比拖三周更仁慈
b4-060-s016.whyLearn: it 作形式主语，more...than 比较两个不定式，内含分词与时间从句

b4-060-s018.skeleton: The administration of a strong sleeping draught to the condemned man every night from which one night he does hot awake, seems a more civilized alternative to our present barbarous procedure

modifiers.text: from which one night he does hot awake
if capital punishment through the influence of backward minds be retained

b4-060-s018.gloss: 每晚安眠药让人不再醒来，或比现行程序文明
b4-060-s018.whyLearn: 主语是长名词短语加 from which 定语从句，谓语 seems 被推到最后

b3-018-s006.skeleton: Some so-called 'modern' pieces have been on display
b3-018-s006.gloss: 有些所谓现代作品已展出近五十年。
b3-018-s006.whyLearn: have been on display 用现在完成时配 for+时段表持续；so-called 加引号暗示名不副实。

b3-018-s007.skeleton: some people--including myself--were surprised by a recent exhibition of modern sculpture
b3-018-s007.gloss: 尽管如此，有人对现代雕塑展感到惊讶。
b3-018-s007.whyLearn: In spite of this 置句首作让步；were surprised by 是被动语态，by 引出施动者。

b3-018-s010.skeleton: The objects on display were pieces
b3-018-s010.gloss: 展品是活动的雕塑作品。
b3-018-s010.whyLearn: on display 后置修饰 objects；of moving sculpture 中 moving 是介词后的 -ing。

b3-018-s011.skeleton: Oddly shaped forms that are suspended from the ceiling and move in response to a gust of wind are quite familiar to everybody

modifiers.text: that are suspended from the ceiling and move in response to a gust of wind
in response to a gust of wind

b3-018-s011.gloss: 悬挂着随风摆动的怪形雕塑人人熟悉。
b3-018-s011.whyLearn: that 定语从句把主谓隔开，从句内被动与主动并列；注意 suspended from 的搭配。

b3-018-s014.skeleton: The spheres had been magnetized and attracted or repelled each other
b3-018-s014.gloss: 球体被磁化，一直互相吸引或排斥。
b3-018-s014.whyLearn: had been magnetized 是过去完成时的被动；each other 作互指宾语，all the time 表持续。

modifiers.text: like traffic lights which have gone mad

b3-018-s016.gloss: 这些灯不停闪烁，活像失控的红绿灯。
b3-018-s016.whyLearn: which 引导定语从句修饰 traffic lights；like 短语作方式状语，比喻写法生动具体。

b3-018-s017.skeleton: Sparks were emitted from small black boxes

modifiers.text: and red lamps flashed on and off angrily

b3-018-s017.gloss: 小黑盒迸出火花，红灯愤怒地忽明忽暗。
b3-018-s017.whyLearn: 被动句与主动句用 and 并列，节奏对仗；on and off 生动写出灯光闪烁。

b3-018-s018.skeleton: It was rather like an exhibition
b3-018-s018.gloss: 它倒像史前电子设备的展览。
b3-018-s018.whyLearn: rather 修饰 like 表示颇有点；of 短语后置限定 exhibition，是比喻式评价句。

b3-019-s001.skeleton: Kidnappers are rarely interested in Animals
b3-019-s001.gloss: 绑匪很少对动物感兴趣，但最近他们却……
b3-019-s001.whyLearn: are rarely interested in 是 be+形容词+介词结构，rarely 置中位表频率否定。

b3-019-s002.skeleton: Mrs Eleanor Ramsay, a very wealthy old lady, has shared a flat with her cat
b3-019-s002.gloss: 富有的老妇人与她的猫同住多年。
b3-019-s002.whyLearn: 两个同位语插入说明身份和猫名；has shared 配 for+时段表持续到现在。

b3-019-s004.skeleton: He usually takes a short walk

modifiers.text: and is always home by seven o'clock

b3-019-s004.gloss: 他傍晚散步，七点前总在家。
b3-019-s004.whyLearn: usually 与一般现在时搭配表习惯；and 连接并列谓语，第二谓语省略主语。

b3-019-s005.gloss: 然而有一天晚上，他没有回来。
b3-019-s005.whyLearn: fail to do 表示未能做某事，是不定式作宾语；however 插在句中表转折。

b3-019-s007.gloss: 她到处找他，但没能找到。
b3-019-s007.whyLearn: look for 的宾语被 everywhere 隔开；but 后用 could not 表过去能力否定。

b3-019-s008.skeleton: Mrs Ramsay received an anonymous letter
b3-019-s008.gloss: 猫失踪三天后，拉姆齐太太收到匿名信。
b3-019-s008.whyLearn: 时间状语前置用逗号与主句隔开；Rastus' 是专有名词加撇号表所有格。

b3-019-s009.skeleton: The writer stated that Rastus was in safe hands

modifiers.text: that Rastus was in safe hands and would be returned immediately if Mrs Ramsay paid a ransom of &1000
if Mrs Ramsay paid a ransom of &1000

b3-019-s009.gloss: 写信人称猫安好，付赎金就归还。
b3-019-s009.whyLearn: that 宾语从句内含并列谓语和 if 条件句；would be returned 是过去将来时被动。

modifiers.text: to place the money in a cardboard box and to leave it outside her door

b3-019-s010.gloss: 拉姆齐太太被要求把钱放箱里留在门外。
b3-019-s010.whyLearn: be instructed to do 是表示被要求做的被动加不定式，两个 to 由 and 并列。

b4-005-s009.skeleton: But even he was unable to discover

modifiers.text: how long the gorilla lives, or how or why it dies
nor was he able to define the exact social pattern of the family groups, or indicate the final extent of their intelligence

b4-005-s009.gloss: 连他也无法弄清大猩猩的寿命、死因与群体结构。
b4-005-s009.whyLearn: nor 置于句首引起倒装：助动词 was 提到主语前，其后并列动词用原形，可替代 and not，是写作高分句式。

b4-005-s010.skeleton: All this and many other things remain

modifiers.text: almost as much a mystery as they were
when the French explorer Du Chaillu first described the animal to the civilized world a century ago

b4-005-s010.gloss: 这一切至今几乎仍如百年前一样是谜。
b4-005-s010.whyLearn: as much a mystery as 保留完整比较从句，remain 是系动词后接名词；省略与指代让句子更紧凑，值得模仿。

b4-006-s002.skeleton: it is older people who create it

modifiers.text: which I take leave to doubt

b4-006-s002.gloss: 若有代沟，制造它的也是老年人而非年轻人。
b4-006-s002.whyLearn: which I take leave to doubt 作插入语表示保留，主句 it is...who 是强调句，议论文中很实用。

b4-053-s007.skeleton: It was clearly both expedient and desirable

modifiers.text: to re-move these dangers as far away from the capital as possible

b4-053-s007.gloss: 把这些危险尽量远远移出首都，既方便又合意。
b4-053-s007.whyLearn: It 作形式主语，真主语是后置不定式；both...and 并列形容词，as far away as possible 表示尽量远。

b4-053-s008.skeleton: the Algerian adventure had begun, and it appeared

modifiers.text: that this might prove expensive in lives

b4-053-s008.gloss: 阿尔及利亚战事已开始，恐怕要付出生命代价。
b4-053-s008.whyLearn: 并列句把背景与预判分开：had begun 表示更早发生，it appeared that 引出委婉推测，might 留有余地。

b4-055-s018.skeleton: The study of custom can be profitable

modifiers.text: only after certain preliminary propositions have been accepted
and some of these propositions have been violently opposed

b4-055-s018.gloss: 研究习俗须先接受前提，而这些前提曾被激烈反对。
b4-055-s018.whyLearn: only after 引导的时间状语从句把条件压在主句之后，第二个 and 分句用被动语态补充反例，展现学术论证的严密。

b4-058-s014.skeleton: It is no use doing what you like

modifiers.text: you have got to like what you do

b4-058-s014.gloss: 光做喜欢的事没用，你得喜欢自己做的事。
b4-058-s014.whyLearn: It is no use doing 是固定句型，have got to 比 must 更口语，两个 what 从句一正一反很工整。

b4-058-s027.skeleton: the working hours are never long enough
b4-058-s027.gloss: 对他们来说，工作时间永远不够长。
b4-058-s027.whyLearn: For them 前置点明立场，never long enough 用否定加 enough 表示怎么都不够，简短有力。

b4-059-s021.skeleton: Holiday hotels tend to cater for one nationality of visitors
b4-059-s021.gloss: 度假酒店往往专门接待某一国的游客。
b4-059-s021.whyLearn: tend to 表示惯常倾向，cater for 是招待、迎合的地道搭配，句尾两个副词逐层加强专属之意。

b4-059-s031.skeleton: Only good scouting is likely to preserve the freedoms

modifiers.text: so dear to the heart of the eternal Boy Scout
to the heart of the eternal Boy Scout

b4-059-s031.gloss: 只有良好的侦察才能守住童子军珍视的自由。
b4-059-s031.whyLearn: be likely to 比 will 更谨慎；so dear to... 是后置形容词短语作定语，值得模仿。

b2-044-s005.skeleton: She was soon out of breath
b2-044-s005.gloss: 她很快气喘吁吁，但仍继续跑。
b2-044-s005.whyLearn: but连接两个并列分句，跑得上气不接下气却仍坚持，可学out of breath与continue to do。

b2-044-s008.gloss: 斯特林太太后来说，肩带要修补，但东西没丢。
b2-044-s008.whyLearn: 引语被said Mrs Sterling later从中切开，可学英语引述语序及needs mending的主动表被动。

modifiers.text: that a large sum of money had been lost.

b2-045-s001.gloss: 全村很快得知一大笔钱丢失了。
b2-045-s001.whyLearn: learnt后接that从句，从句用过去完成时被动had been lost，表示早于learned发生。

b2-045-s002.skeleton: Sam Benton, the local butcher, had lost his wallet

modifiers.text: while taking his savings to the post-office.

b2-045-s002.gloss: 屠夫萨姆·本顿去邮局存钱的路上丢了钱包。
b2-045-s002.whyLearn: 同位语the local butcher补充身份，while taking把时间从句压缩成分词，注意savings常用复数。

b2-045-s004.gloss: 三个月后的一天早上，萨姆在前门找到了钱包。
b2-045-s004.whyLearn: and连接先后发生的两个动作，时间状语then one morning插在中间，可练叙事节奏。

b2-045-s006.skeleton: some more money was sent to Sam

modifiers.text: ' Only 25 per cent a thief now!'

b2-045-s006.gloss: 两个月后，又有人给萨姆送钱并附来一张纸条。
b2-045-s006.whyLearn: 被动was sent突出钱的去向而非送钱人，note后用引语给出per cent的说法，很地道。

b2-045-s007.skeleton: all Sam's money was paid back
b2-045-s007.gloss: 最后，萨姆的钱就这样全部被还了回来。
b2-045-s007.whyLearn: In time与in this way一前一后限定时间与方式，was paid back是pay back的被动式。

modifiers.text: ' I am 100 per cent honest now!

b2-045-s008.gloss: 最后一张纸条写着：我现在百分之百诚实。
b2-045-s008.whyLearn: 主句用过去时said，引语内却用am，直接引语保留原话时态，可体会时态呼应的例外。

b2-046-s004.gloss: 他对自己看到的东西大为吃惊。
b2-046-s004.whyLearn: be astonished at后接what引导的从句作介词宾语，介词后面可以带整个从句。

modifiers.text: on top of a pile of woollen goods.

b2-046-s005.gloss: 一个男人躺在箱子里的一堆毛织品上。
b2-046-s005.whyLearn: was lying定格当时画面，两个介词短语由大到小层层定位，是描写场景的常用写法。

b2-046-s007.skeleton: the man admitted hiding in the box
b2-046-s007.gloss: 被捕后，那人承认飞机离开伦敦前藏在箱子里。
b2-046-s007.whyLearn: After从句用被动was arrested，admitted后接动名词hiding，before从句点明更早的动作。

b2-046-s008.skeleton: He had had a long and uncomfortable trip

modifiers.text: for he had been confined to the wooden box for over ten hours.

b2-046-s008.gloss: 他这趟旅行又长又难受，被关在木箱里十多小时。
b2-046-s008.whyLearn: had had是have的过去完成时，for引出原因，had been confined说明他一直脱不了身。

modifiers.text: to pay &345 for the cost of the trip.
for the cost of the trip.

b2-046-s009.gloss: 那人被判支付345英镑作为这趟行程的费用。
b2-046-s009.whyLearn: be ordered to do是常见的被动加不定式结构，for引出这笔钱的用途。

b2-046-s010.skeleton: The normal price of a ticket is &230 !
b2-046-s010.gloss: 一张票的正常价格是230英镑！
b2-046-s010.whyLearn: of a ticket后置修饰price，感叹号带出惊讶语气，可对比a与the的泛指特指之别。

b2-047-s001.skeleton: A public house which was recently bought by Mr Ian Thompson is up for sale.

modifiers.text: which was recently bought by Mr Ian Thompson

b2-047-s001.gloss: 一家最近被买下的酒馆现在挂牌出售。
b2-047-s001.whyLearn: 定语从句插在主语和谓语之间，主干被拉长，可练抓is up for sale这个固定说法。

modifiers.text: that the doors had been blocked by chairs and the furniture had been moved.

b2-047-s004.gloss: 第二天早上，他发现门被椅子堵住，家具也被搬动了。
b2-047-s004.whyLearn: that从句内并列两个过去完成时被动句，by chairs点明施动者，可练长宾语从句的断句。

b3-055-s024.skeleton: A single picture would tell us more than thousands of words.
b3-055-s024.gloss: 一张图片胜过千言万语。
b3-055-s024.whyLearn: would 在此表虚拟推测，more than 引出比较对象，一句话学会“一图胜千言”的比较说法。

modifiers.text: which forms the eastern boundary of our farm

b3-056-s001.gloss: 这条河是我们农场的东界。
b3-056-s001.whyLearn: 名词后紧跟 which 定语从句交代身份，of our farm 用所有格点明归属，是拆长句的基本功。

b3-056-s004.skeleton: We tell the river all our secrets.
b3-056-s004.gloss: 我们把所有秘密都告诉这条河。
b3-056-s004.whyLearn: tell sb sth 双宾语结构，our secrets 用物主代词表所属，把河写成可以倾诉的朋友。

b3-056-s006.skeleton: We have special river birthday parties
b3-056-s006.gloss: 夏天我们为河办特别的生日会。
b3-056-s006.whyLearn: 一般现在时表每年重复的习惯，in the summer 点明季节，注意名词 river 直接修饰 parties。

b3-056-s008.skeleton: we choose a midnight birthday party

modifiers.text: and that is the most exciting of all

b3-056-s008.gloss: 热浪时我们选午夜办生日会，最令人兴奋。
b3-056-s008.whyLearn: and 并列两个一般现在时的分句，the most exciting of all 示范最高级加范围的用法。

b3-056-s010.skeleton: the river may overflow its banks

modifiers.text: After a long period of rain

b3-056-s010.gloss: 久雨之后河水可能漫过河岸。
b3-056-s010.whyLearn: may 表客观可能性，After 短语置句首作时间状语，overflow 在此用作及物动词，很地道。

b3-056-s013.skeleton: we watched the river creep up the lower meadows
b3-056-s013.gloss: 有个寒冬，我们看着河水漫上低地草场。
b3-056-s013.whyLearn: watch sth do 强调看见全过程，时间名词短语 One bad winter 直接作状语，简洁又有画面。

b3-056-s014.skeleton: All the cattle had been moved into stalls

modifiers.text: and we stood to lose little

b3-056-s014.gloss: 牛已全被赶进棚里，我们没什么可损失的。
b3-056-s014.whyLearn: 过去完成时被动交代更早的动作，stood to lose 用不定式说处境，一句汇集四个常考语法点。

b3-056-s017.skeleton: we could get a sweeping view of the river

modifiers.text: and at the most critical juncture we took turns in watching that point

b3-056-s017.gloss: 从阁楼窗可望见两家的地界，关键时刻我们轮流守望。
b3-056-s017.whyLearn: 介词短语开头、where 从句修饰 river、and 并列第二分句，长句如何分层推进看这一句就够。

b3-056-s018.skeleton: The first sign of disaster was a dead sheep
b3-056-s018.gloss: 灾祸的第一迹象是一头漂下来的死羊。
b3-056-s018.whyLearn: 现在分词 floating down 作后置定语补充动态画面，比定语从句更简洁，值得模仿。

modifiers.text: but we were afraid that the strength of the current would prevent its landing anywhere before it became exhausted
that the strength of the current would prevent its landing anywhere before it became exhausted

b3-056-s019.gloss: 接着一匹马奋力游来，我们怕它力竭前被水流冲走。
b3-056-s019.whyLearn: Next came 倒装先声夺人，分词 swimming 作状语，afraid that 从句里再套 before 时间从句，层层递进。

modifiers.text: carrying the whole family, a few hens, the dogs, a cat, and a bird in a cage
the whole family, a few hens, the dogs, a cat, and a bird in a cage

b3-056-s020.gloss: 突然漂来一只木筏，载着全家、几只鸡和猫狗鸟。
b3-056-s020.whyLearn: 两个分词短语先后铺陈木筏的样子与载物，名词并列靠逗号和 and 收尾，画面全由分词撑起。

b3-056-s023.skeleton: We still think it a miracle

modifiers.text: that they were able to do so

b3-056-s023.gloss: 我们仍觉得他们能做到真是奇迹。
b3-056-s023.whyLearn: think it + 名词 + that 从句，用 it 作形式宾语把长从句后置，写作中很实用的句式。

modifiers.text: to let the car cool off

b3-057-s001.gloss: 我停车让车冷却，并查看地图。
b3-057-s001.whyLearn: stop to do 表停下来去做某事，两个并列不定式说明停车目的，正好与 stop doing 对照记。

b3-057-s002.skeleton: I had expected to be near my objective by now

modifiers.text: but everything still seemed alien to me

b3-057-s002.gloss: 我本以为现在已接近目标，但一切仍很陌生。
b3-057-s002.whyLearn: had expected 表落空的预期，but 转折对照现实，seem alien to sb 生动写出陌生感。

b3-057-s005.skeleton: Everything around him was full of her presence
b3-057-s005.gloss: 他周围的一切都充满她的气息，不断揭开伤口。
b3-057-s005.whyLearn: 句尾分词短语作状语表伴随结果，把抽象情绪写成一个动作，比 and 并列更凝练。

b4-059-s027.skeleton: Whether the remarkable growth of organized camping means the eventual death of the more independent kind is hard to say
b4-059-s027.gloss: 有组织露营的壮大是否意味着独立露营终将消亡，难说。
b4-059-s027.whyLearn: Whether 从句占据主语位置，谓语 is hard to say 压尾，是英语避免头重脚轻的典型安排。

modifiers.text: to secure the campers' site fees and other custom
the campers' site fees and other custom

b4-059-s028.gloss: 市政府自然想稳拿露营者的场地费和其他生意收入。
b4-059-s028.whyLearn: want 后接不定式 to secure 作宾语，再用 and 并列 site fees 与 other custom 两个名词短语。

modifiers.text: who cannot be traced to a recognized camp boundary or to four walls
to a recognized camp boundary or to four walls

b4-059-s029.gloss: 警方警惕流民，因为无法将其归入某个营地或四面墙。
b4-059-s029.whyLearn: who 定语从句后置修饰 itinerants，从句用被动 be traced to 并列出两种归宿，交代警察警惕的缘由。

b4-060-s001.skeleton: truth and justice may be the most powerful impulses to show moral coura
b4-060-s001.gloss: 虽然真相与正义可能是彰显道德勇气的最大动力……
b4-060-s001.whyLearn: Although 让步分句内用 may be 表推测，最高级后接不定式 to show 作后置定语。

modifiers.text: that this is the main influence upon those who urge the abolition of capital punishment
upon those who urge the abolition of capital punishment
who urge the abolition of capital punishment

b4-060-s003.gloss: 初步可以说，这正是促使人们主张废除死刑的主要原因。
b4-060-s003.whyLearn: it 作形式主语，真正主语是 that 从句，谓语用 can be suggested 的被动式，语气显得谨慎。

b4-060-s004.skeleton: It is recognition of compassion's part that leads the upholders of capital punishment to accuse the abolitionists of sentimentality

modifiers.text: to accuse the abolitionists of sentimentality
in being more sorry for the murderer than for his victim
more sorry for the murderer than for his victim

b4-060-s004.gloss: 正是承认同情心，使死刑支持者指责废死刑派感情用事。
b4-060-s004.whyLearn: It is...that 强调主语，谓语 lead sb. to do，且套用 accuse sb. of 与 in being。

modifiers.text: how flimsy is the argument that capital punishment is a deterrent to murder
that capital punishment is a deterrent to murder

b4-060-s006.gloss: 不合逻辑的限制说明，死刑能震慑谋杀之说多么站不住脚。
b4-060-s006.whyLearn: how 引导的宾语从句把表语 flimsy 提前形成倒装，后面又用 that 同位语从句解释 the argument。

b4-060-s009.skeleton: This may seem a paradoxical claim

modifiers.text: when mankind is so much preoccupied with weapons of destruction

b4-060-s009.gloss: 在人人都忙于毁灭性武器的时代，提出这一点似乎很矛盾。
b4-060-s009.whyLearn: may seem 后接名词表语，to make 作后置定语，at a time when 引入时间背景，说明提出主张的语境。

b4-060-s014.skeleton: Nor was the long-drawn ordeal of the condemned cell inflicted

modifiers.text: upon the condemned man or his gaolers
either upon the condemned man or his gaolers

b4-060-s014.gloss: 从前，死囚牢房那种漫长的折磨并非加于死囚或狱吏身上。
b4-060-s014.whyLearn: Nor 置于句首引起部分倒装，was inflicted 为被动，either...or 并列两个受折磨的对象。

b4-060-s017.skeleton: Hanging is an atrociously archaic way of killing a human being

modifiers.text: and the self-satisfied modernity of the electric chair is just as atrocious

b4-060-s017.gloss: 绞刑是古老残暴的杀人方式，电椅自诩的现代性也残暴。
b4-060-s017.whyLearn: 两个分句用 and 并列，都由 is 加形容词表语，just as atrocious 与前面形成对比。

b1-033-s006.gloss: 询问能否拿到前门的钥匙
b1-033-s006.whyLearn: can 开头的请求句，please 收尾更礼貌，借东西时直接用。

b1-035-s001.gloss: 我们镇附近每年都有赛车比赛
b1-035-s001.whyLearn: there be 句型加地点和时间状语，看清存在句信息摆放顺序。

b1-035-s002.skeleton: there was a very big race
b1-035-s002.whyLearn: 时间状语提前加逗号，was 配单数名词，讲故事开头常用。

b1-035-s003.whyLearn: hundreds of 表示模糊数量，were 呼应复数，说人多的常用搭配。

b1-035-s008.whyLearn: 用 in the race 限定范围，把存在句收窄到具体场合。

modifiers.text: French cars, German cars, Italian cars, American cars and Japanese cars

b1-035-s009.whyLearn: 逗号并列加 and 收尾，一口气罗列多国车辆，节奏清楚不啰嗦。

b1-036-s008.whyLearn: can't 表示当下不能，后接动词原形，替人挡话时很实用。

b1-037-s007.skeleton: Can you tell me the way
b1-037-s007.whyLearn: 问路经典句式 tell me the way to，句尾加 please 更礼貌。

b1-038-s013.whyLearn: get sth for sb 结构，请人帮忙拿东西时直接套用。

b1-038-s014.whyLearn: I'm afraid 委婉拒绝，that 从句里省略重复的动词，自然又客气。

b1-039-s011.gloss: 你24日周一上午10点能来吗
b1-039-s011.whyLearn: at 接钟点、on 接日期，约时间的时间介词一次记牢。

b1-039-s014.whyLearn: 最简练的约时间问句，at 后直接跟钟点，换时间只改数字。

b1-039-s017.gloss: 克劳夫特先生，他恐怕不能来
b1-039-s017.whyLearn: 替第三人称转述拒绝，只改从句主语，称呼放句尾很口语。

b1-040-s007.whyLearn: What about 接名词，用来提新话题或建议，接话时很好用。

modifiers.text: that this house is for sale

b1-045-s002.gloss: 我相信这房子正在出售
b1-045-s002.whyLearn: believe 加 that 宾语从句，主干和从句各自都能独立成句。

b1-045-s004.whyLearn: May I 比 Can I 更正式，have a look at 是看一眼的固定说法。

b3-002-s009.skeleton: I'm trying to repair the bell
b3-002-s009.whyLearn: 复习现在进行时与不定式作宾语，注意引语后 answered Bill 的倒装报语序。

b3-002-s010.gloss: 他连续数周每夜都来这里
b3-002-s010.whyLearn: 现在完成进行时＋night after night 叠词，描述持续反复动作的高频搭配。

b3-002-s014.gloss: 你恐怕把全村人都吵醒了
b3-002-s014.whyLearn: 现在完成时＋as well 收尾，学把抱怨说得完整又不失礼貌。

b3-002-s015.whyLearn: glad 后接宾语从句，Still 作插入语，学口语话轮中的短句衔接。

b3-002-s016.gloss: 比尔回答：这就是问题所在
b3-002-s016.whyLearn: 无语法点，但含称呼语与倒装报语序，学对话中插入 vicar 这类称呼。

modifiers.text: on the Aegean island of Kea

b3-003-s001.gloss: 考古学家在基亚岛有发现
b3-003-s001.whyLearn: 被动语态＋by 施动者，时间状语 Some time ago 置于句首，新闻式开头。

b3-003-s002.skeleton: An American team explored a temple

modifiers.text: which stands in an ancient city on the promontory of Ayia Irini
on the promontory of Ayia Irini

b3-003-s002.gloss: 美国团队考察了古城的庙宇
b3-003-s002.whyLearn: 定语从句 which stands 描述地点，in/on 多层介词短语层层定位。

b3-003-s003.skeleton: The city at one time must have been prosperous

modifiers.text: for it enjoyed a high level of civilization

b3-003-s003.gloss: 该城曾因文明程度高而繁荣
b3-003-s003.whyLearn: must have been 表对过去的推测，for 引出理由，学推测＋解释的句式。

b3-003-s004.skeleton: Houses--often three storeys high--were built of stone
b3-003-s004.gloss: 石造房屋有三层高，房间宽大
b3-003-s004.whyLearn: 插入语用双破折号隔开，be built of 表材料，学描写建筑的并列句。

b3-003-s005.skeleton: The city was even equipped with a drainage system

modifiers.text: for a great many clay pipes were found beneath the narrow streets

b3-003-s005.gloss: 该城有排水系统，街道下有陶管
b3-003-s005.whyLearn: be equipped with 表配备，for 引出证据，a great many 修饰可数名词。

b3-003-s006.skeleton: The temple which the archaeologists explored was used as a place of worship

modifiers.text: from the fifteenth century B.C.until Roman times

b3-003-s006.gloss: 神庙被用作礼拜场所数百年
b3-003-s006.whyLearn: 定语从句分隔主语与谓语，be used as 表用途，from...until 表时间跨度。

b3-003-s007.skeleton: clay fragments of fifteen statues were found

modifiers.text: In the most sacred room of the temple,

b3-003-s007.gloss: 圣室里发现十五尊雕像的碎片
b3-003-s007.whyLearn: 地点状语前置，被动语态把新信息 clay fragments 放到句尾焦点位置。

b3-003-s008.skeleton: Each of these represented a goddess

modifiers.text: and had, at one time, been painted

b3-003-s008.gloss: 每尊雕像代表女神，曾上过色
b3-003-s008.whyLearn: and 连接两个谓语，had been painted 过去完成被动，中间插入 at one time。

b3-003-s009.skeleton: The body of one statue was found

modifiers.text: among remains dating from the fifteenth century B.C.
dating from the fifteenth century B.C.

b3-003-s009.gloss: 一尊雕像的身体出土于遗址
b3-003-s009.whyLearn: dating from 现在分词作后置定语，比定语从句更简洁，考古叙述常用。

b3-003-s010.skeleton: Its missing head happened to be

modifiers.text: to be among remains of the fifth century B.C.
among remains of the fifth century B.C.

b3-003-s010.gloss: 它失踪的头在五世纪遗址中
b3-003-s010.whyLearn: happen to be 表碰巧，不定式＋介词短语层层定位，属考古叙述句式。

b3-003-s011.skeleton: This head must have been found
b3-003-s011.gloss: 这个头应是在古典时期保存的
b3-003-s011.whyLearn: must have been found 表推测的被动，and 后省略了重复的 must have been。

b3-038-s008.skeleton: Even seemingly insignificant remains can shed interesting light

modifiers.text: on the history of early man

b3-038-s008.gloss: 即使微不足道的遗物也能揭示早期人类历史
b3-038-s008.whyLearn: 情态动词 can 使断言留有余地，shed light on 是学术写作中表示“提供线索”的固定搭配，值得整块记住。

modifiers.text: that calendars came into being with the advent of agriculture
for then man was faced with a real need to understand something about the seasons
to understand something about the seasons

b3-038-s009.gloss: 史学家长期认为历法随农业出现，因当时人们需了解季节
b3-038-s009.whyLearn: 一句里完成时叙事、宾语从句、for 引导的原因状语从句和不定式后置定语层层嵌套，可看清英语偏重右向扩展。

modifiers.text: which have been engraved on walls, bones, and the ivory tusk of mammoths

b3-038-s011.gloss: 史学家长期困惑于墙骨与象牙上的刻痕
b3-038-s011.whyLearn: 主句与定语从句同时使用被动完成时，可比较 be puzzled by 与 have been engraved on 两种被动语态的语义差别。

b3-038-s012.skeleton: The nomads who made these markings lived
b3-038-s012.gloss: 这些游牧者靠狩猎捕鱼度过末次冰期
b3-038-s012.whyLearn: 主语后紧跟限定性定语从句，把主谓隔开，是英语长主语的典型；live by doing 也值得整块记。

b3-038-s014.skeleton: historians have been able to read this difficult code

modifiers.text: By correlating markings made in various parts of the world
made in various parts of the world

b3-038-s014.gloss: 通过比对各地刻痕，史学家读懂了这套难解符号
b3-038-s014.whyLearn: 句首 By + 动名词短语交代手段，再以完成时加 be able to 说结果，可学“手段前置、结果后置”的信息安排。

modifiers.text: that it is connected with the passage of days and the phases of the moon
with the passage of days and the phases of the moon
the passage of days and the phases of the moon

b3-038-s015.gloss: 他们发现它与昼夜更替和月相变化有关
b3-038-s015.whyLearn: 主句用完成时引出发现，宾语从句用一般现在时陈述事实，是转述研究结论时的标准时态搭配。

b3-038-s016.skeleton: It is, in fact, a, primitive type of calendar
b3-038-s016.gloss: 这实际上是一种原始的历法
b3-038-s016.whyLearn: 插入语 in fact 把主语和表语短语隔开，可学单个逗号插入时前后停顿的位置与语气作用。

modifiers.text: that the hunting scenes depicted on walls were not simply a form of artistic expression

b3-038-s017.gloss: 人们早已知道，墙上的狩猎图不只是艺术表现
b3-038-s017.whyLearn: 形式主语 It 加被动完成时，把长从句整个后置；从句内再用过去分词短语限定 scenes，两个后置手段连用。

modifiers.text: that there is a definite relation between these paintings and the markings that sometimes accompany them
between these paintings and the markings that sometimes accompany them

b3-038-s019.gloss: 这些画与伴随它们的刻痕间可能存在确定关系
b3-038-s019.whyLearn: It is possible that 后接 there be 存在句，再由定语从句限定 markings，可学层层后置却层次分明的写法。

modifiers.text: that the next village was a mere twenty miles away

b3-039-s003.gloss: 他瞥了一眼地图，告诉我们下个村庄仅有二十英里
b3-039-s003.whyLearn: 句首现在分词短语与主句主语 he 构成主动关系，用极短结构交代伴随动作，是叙事句压缩信息的常用手法。

b3-039-s004.gloss: 问题并不在于布鲁斯总低估困难
b3-039-s004.whyLearn: It was not that... 是英语常用的“否定归因”框架，先排除一个解释，为下文真正的原因留出对照。

b3-039-s005.skeleton: He simply had no sense of danger at all
b3-039-s005.whyLearn: have no sense of 已是否定，句末再添 at all 加强语气，可看英语如何用词汇手段而非 not 来强化否定。

modifiers.text: As we bumped over the dusty track

b3-039-s007.gloss: 我们在尘土飞扬的小路上颠簸前行，猛打方向避开大石
b3-039-s007.whyLearn: As 引导的从句与主句动作几乎同时发生，to avoid 表目的，一句中可看清时间状语与目的状语的分工。

modifiers.text: which hammered ominously under the car

b3-039-s008.gloss: 车轮卷起石子，在车底发出不祥的敲击声
b3-039-s008.whyLearn: scoop up 与 which 定语从句把连续动作压进一句，hammer 由名词转为动词，画面感与因果链同时给出。

modifiers.text: that sooner or later a stone would rip a hole in our petrol tank or damage the engine
rip a hole in our petrol tank or damage the engine

b3-039-s009.gloss: 我们确信迟早有石子扎破油箱或损坏发动机
b3-039-s009.whyLearn: 形容词 sure 后接 that 从句，从句中用过去将来时 would，并以 or 并列两个谓语，是转述担忧的典型结构。

b3-039-s014.gloss: 面对一再请求，布鲁斯终于停了下来
b3-039-s014.whyLearn: In response to + 名词短语置于句首，把缘由压成短语状语，主句只剩主谓，可见英语因果表达的简省写法。

b3-018-s015.skeleton: there were a number of tall structures

modifiers.text: In the centre of the hall

b3-018-s015.gloss: 大厅中央有许多装彩灯的高大结构
b3-018-s015.whyLearn: there be 主语后接 which 定语从句，是本课描述场景最常用的展开方式。

b3-018-s019.skeleton: These Peculiar forms not only seemed designed

modifiers.text: but to give them electric shocks as well

b3-018-s019.gloss: 这些怪状物似乎专为吓人并给人电击而设计
b3-018-s019.whyLearn: not only...but...as well 并联两个不定式，把双重目的压缩进一句。

b3-019-s011.skeleton: she decided to go to the police

modifiers.text: but fearing that she would never see Rastus again
that she would never see Rastus again
the letter had made that quite clear

b3-019-s011.gloss: 她先去报警，又怕再见不到猫，于是改了主意
b3-019-s011.whyLearn: but 后接分词短语表原因，破折号插入补充，叙事的层次全靠读标点。

modifiers.text: for there were no rules and a prize-fighter could be seriously injured or even killed during a match
and a prize-fighter could be seriously injured or even killed during a match

b3-021-s004.gloss: 当时拳击很粗糙：没有规则，拳手可能重伤丧命
b3-021-s004.whyLearn: for 引出原因并列句，内部再用 there be 与情态被动叠加，说明理由的典型写法。

b3-021-s006.skeleton: The use of gloves was not introduced

modifiers.text: when the Marquis of Queensberry drew up the first set Of rules

b3-021-s006.gloss: 手套直到1860年伯爵订出规则才被采用
b3-021-s006.whyLearn: not...until 配被动语态，再用 when 从句补出年份细节，考点密集。

b3-021-s013.gloss: 门多萨太成功，汉弗莱斯因而与他反目
b3-021-s013.whyLearn: so...that 把因果关系压进一句，比 because 更紧凑，适合叙事推进。

b3-021-s020.skeleton: He earned enormous sums of money

modifiers.text: and was paid as much as &100 for a single appearance

b3-021-s020.gloss: 他赚了大钱，单场出场费就高达一百英镑
b3-021-s020.whyLearn: and 并列主动与被动两种谓语，as much as 落地数额，一句交代两层事实。

modifiers.text: that he was always in debt

b3-021-s021.gloss: 尽管如此，他挥霍无度，总是负债
b3-021-s021.whyLearn: Despite 让步与 so...that 结果叠加，是把两层转折写进一句的范例。

modifiers.text: that they run for years on end

b3-022-s001.gloss: 有些戏太成功，能连演好几年
b3-022-s001.whyLearn: 一般现在时陈述长期事实，so...that 补出结果，句子短而信息完整。

modifiers.text: Even though the noble was expected to read the letter at each performance
to read the letter at each performance
that it should be written out in full

b3-022-s007.gloss: 贵族每场都要念信，他却坚持全文写出
b3-022-s007.whyLearn: Even though 让步从句里套被动和不定式，主句再用 should 宾语从句，结构层层相扣。

b3-022-s008.skeleton: the gaoler decided to play a joke on his colleague

modifiers.text: to play a joke on his colleague
if, after so many performances, he had managed to learn the contents of the letter by heart

b3-022-s008.gloss: 狱卒想捉弄同僚，看他多场后是否背熟了信
b3-022-s008.whyLearn: 两个 to do 连表目的，末尾 if 宾语从句用过去完成时，动作先后一目了然。

modifiers.text: Finding that he could not remember a word of the letter either
that he could not remember a word of the letter either

b3-022-s019.gloss: 狱卒也想不起一个字，只好说灯实在太暗
b3-022-s019.whyLearn: 现在分词作状语交代原因，主句直接引语用一般现在时，叙述与对话衔接自然。

modifiers.text: with a pair of glasses and the usual copy of the letter
and the usual copy of the letter
which he proceeded to read to the prisoner

b3-022-s022.gloss: 狱卒稍后带眼镜和信回来，念给犯人听
b3-022-s022.whyLearn: 介词短语内并列两件物品，再挂 which 定语从句，长句就是这样接长的。

modifiers.text: who, ever since their early years, have learned to associate snails with food

b3-023-s008.gloss: 无数人从小就学会把蜗牛与食物联系起来
b3-023-s008.whyLearn: who 与谓语被 ever since 状语隔开，学会跨过插入成分找主谓是关键。

b3-023-s012.skeleton: The idea never appealed to me

modifiers.text: but one day, after a heavy shower, I happened to be walking in my garden when I noticed a huge number of snails taking a stroll on some of my prize plants
to be walking in my garden
when I noticed a huge number of snails taking a stroll on some of my prize plants
taking a stroll on some of my prize plants
on some of my prize plants

b3-023-s012.gloss: 我本来不喜欢这主意，直到雨后见蜗牛啃花
b3-023-s012.whyLearn: but 后连缀时间状语、be walking 与 when 从句，是叙事长句的完整链条。

modifiers.text: they had escaped from the paper bag and had taken complete possession of the hall
and had taken complete possession of the hall

b3-023-s019.gloss: 我们惊愕地看到蜗牛到处都是，已占领大厅
b3-023-s019.whyLearn: 冒号后并列两个过去完成时动作，交代前句结果的成因，逻辑推进清晰。

b2-003-s007.whyLearn: thought 是一般过去时，Every day 提前仍用正常主谓语序。

b2-007-s002.skeleton: They were expecting a valuable parcel of diamond
b2-007-s002.gloss: 他们一直盼着来自南非的贵重钻石包裹。
b2-007-s002.whyLearn: were expecting 表持续期盼，of diamond 与 from South Africa 层层后置定语。

b2-011-s001.skeleton: I was having dinner at a restaurant
b2-011-s001.gloss: 我在餐馆吃饭时哈里·斯蒂尔进来了。
b2-011-s001.whyLearn: was having 铺背景、came in 打断，过去进行时配 when 的经典叙事。

b2-011-s006.skeleton: I asked him to lend me &2
b2-011-s006.gloss: 他吃饭时我向他借了两英镑。
b2-011-s006.whyLearn: ask sb to do 结构，while 从句用进行时交代同时发生的背景。

b2-014-s005.skeleton: I said good morning to him

modifiers.text: As soon as he had got into the car
and he replied in the same language

b2-014-s005.gloss: 他一上车我就用法语问好，他也用同样的语言回答。
b2-014-s005.whyLearn: as soon as 从句用过去完成时表示先后，主句两个动作并列对照。

b2-016-s009.skeleton: you cannot fail to obey it!

modifiers.text: If you receive a request like this

b2-016-s009.gloss: 收到这样的请求，你不能不服从。
b2-016-s009.whyLearn: 条件从句加 cannot fail to do 双重否定，把语气推到最强。

modifiers.text: As I was looking for it

b2-018-s003.gloss: 我正找它时，客栈老板走了进来。
b2-018-s003.whyLearn: as 从句用进行时铺背景，主句一般过去时推进情节。

b2-018-s006.gloss: 我道了谢，但说付不起账单。
b2-018-s006.whyLearn: 引号内外语序交错，but 转折加 can't 表无力支付。

b2-019-s004.gloss: 请问我可以买两张票吗？
b2-019-s004.whyLearn: May I 是礼貌请求的固定疑问句式，常与 please 连用。

b2-019-s010.skeleton: Can I return these two tickets
b2-019-s010.whyLearn: Can I 询问许可，疑问语序倒装，return 后直接接宾语。

b2-019-s013.skeleton: Could I have those two tickets
b2-019-s013.gloss: 请问能给我那两张票吗？
b2-019-s013.whyLearn: Could I 比 Can I 更委婉，是礼貌请求的升级说法。

b2-020-s012.skeleton: they don't realize one important thing
b2-020-s012.gloss: 可他们没意识到一件要紧的事。
b2-020-s012.whyLearn: don't realize 是一般现在时否定式，But 承接上文转折。

b2-021-s007.skeleton: I think this house will be knocked down

modifiers.text: this house will be knocked down

b2-021-s007.gloss: 我有时觉得这房子会被飞过的飞机撞倒。
b2-021-s007.whyLearn: I think 后接宾语从句，will be knocked down 是将来时被动语态。

b2-022-s002.skeleton: we were travelling across the Channel

modifiers.text: and Jane put a piece of paper with her name and address on it into a bottle
with her name and address on it

b2-022-s002.gloss: 去年我们正横渡海峡，简把姓名地址纸条塞进瓶子。
b2-022-s002.whyLearn: 过去进行时与一般过去时并列，with 复合结构后置修饰 paper。

b2-023-s009.skeleton: The house has many large rooms

modifiers.text: and there is a lovely garden

b2-023-s009.gloss: 这房子有很多大房间，还有个可爱的花园。
b2-023-s009.whyLearn: has 与 there be 两种存在表达并列，后半句仍用 there is。

b2-024-s010.gloss: 我对经理说，这世上还有正直。
b2-024-s010.whyLearn: said 后插入 Well 与说话人，there be 表抽象事物的存在。

b2-051-s012.skeleton: It contained five large bars of chocolate and three bags of sweets
b2-051-s012.gloss: 它装有五大块巧克力和三袋糖果。
b2-051-s012.whyLearn: 用 contained 说袋子里有什么，five large bars of 与 three bags of 两个数量短语并列，练量词搭配。

b2-052-s001.skeleton: We have just moved into a new house and I have been working hard all morning

modifiers.text: and I have been working hard all morning

b2-052-s001.gloss: 我们刚搬进新家，我一上午都在辛苦忙活。
b2-052-s001.whyLearn: 两个并列分句对比 have just moved 与 have been working：前者重结果，后者重持续。

modifiers.text: to get my new room in order

b2-052-s002.gloss: 我一直在设法把新房间收拾整齐。
b2-052-s002.whyLearn: try to do 表示设法做成，配完成进行时体现持续努力；in order 意为整齐，宜整块记。

b2-052-s004.skeleton: the room is rather small, so I have temporarily put my books on the floor
b2-052-s004.gloss: 更糟的是房间很小，我只好暂时把书放在地板上。
b2-052-s004.whyLearn: 句首 To make matters worse 是实用插入语，so 引出结果，put sth on the floor 语序要记牢。

b2-052-s005.skeleton: they cover every inch of floor space and I actually have to walk on them

modifiers.text: to get in or out of the room

b2-052-s005.gloss: 眼下书铺满地板，我进出房间都得踩在书上。
b2-052-s005.whyLearn: have to 表客观必须，to get in or out 作目的状语，顺便看 in / out of 的介词搭配。

b2-052-s007.skeleton: She went into my room and got a big surprise

modifiers.text: when she saw all those books on the floor

b2-052-s007.gloss: 她走进我房间，看到满地是书，大吃一惊。
b2-052-s007.whyLearn: went、got、saw 三个过去式串成时间链，when 从句交代引发惊讶的场景。

modifiers.text: 'This is the prettiest carpet I have ever seen,'

b2-052-s008.gloss: 她说：这是我见过的最漂亮的地毯。
b2-052-s008.whyLearn: 最高级后接省略 that 的定语从句，have ever seen 用现在完成时，是该结构的固定搭档。

b2-053-s001.skeleton: firemen have put out a big forest fire in California
b2-053-s001.gloss: 消防员终于扑灭了加州一场森林大火。
b2-053-s001.whyLearn: put out 是动副短语，宾语长时后置；At last 配现在完成时表达期盼已久的结果。

modifiers.text: to find out how the fire began

b2-053-s002.gloss: 此后他们一直在设法查明火灾是怎么起的。
b2-053-s002.whyLearn: since then 是完成进行时的标志；try to find out 后接 how 宾语从句，从句须用过去时 began。

b2-053-s003.skeleton: Forest fire are often caused by broken glass or by cigarette ends
b2-053-s003.gloss: 森林大火常由碎玻璃或人们随手扔的烟头引起。
b2-053-s003.whyLearn: be caused by 后并列两个施动者，which 定语从句紧贴 cigarette ends，注意挂靠位置。

b2-053-s004.skeleton: the firemen examined the ground carefully, but were not able to find any broken glass
b2-053-s004.gloss: 昨天消防员仔细检查了地面，但没找到碎玻璃。
b2-053-s004.whyLearn: but 后省略主语 the firemen，直接并列谓语；be not able to do 表未能做到，省略现象很典型。

modifiers.text: that a cigarette end did not start the fire

b2-053-s005.gloss: 他们还相当肯定，火不是烟头引起的。
b2-053-s005.whyLearn: be sure that 后接否定从句，did not start 用助动词否定过去动作，否定落在从句内。

b2-053-s006.skeleton: a fireman accidentally discovered the cause
b2-053-s006.gloss: 但今天早上，一名消防员偶然查明了起因。
b2-053-s006.whyLearn: however 夹在主语前作转折插入语，两侧逗号不能省；时间状语与过去时 discovered 呼应。

b2-053-s007.skeleton: He noticed the remains of a snake

modifiers.text: which was wound round the electric wires of a 16,000-volt power line

b2-053-s007.gloss: 他注意到一条蛇的残骸，蛇缠在高压电线上。
b2-053-s007.whyLearn: which 从句越过 of a snake 修饰 snake；was wound 是被动过去式，注意它在从句中的位置。

b2-053-s008.skeleton: he was able to solve the mystery
b2-053-s008.gloss: 就这样，他解开了这个谜团。
b2-053-s008.whyLearn: In this way 作方式状语置句首；be able to do 强调过去某次成功做到，可与 could 对照。

b2-053-s009.skeleton: The explanation was simple but very unusual
b2-053-s009.gloss: 这个解释很简单，却很不寻常。
b2-053-s009.whyLearn: was 后两个形容词由 but 并列作表语，短短一句就形成简单却不寻常的对比。

modifiers.text: when scientists have learnt a lot more about the atmosphere that surrounds the planet

b3-009-s007.gloss: 只有在科学家更了解火星大气后才可能实现。
b3-009-s007.whyLearn: 主句用一般将来时，when 引出时间状语从句，从句里再嵌 that 定语从句，两层结构一眼看清。

b3-009-s009.skeleton: An interesting suggestion for measuring the atmosphere around Mars has been put forward

modifiers.text: for measuring the atmosphere around Mars

b3-009-s009.gloss: 有人提出一个测量火星大气的有趣建议。
b3-009-s009.whyLearn: 介词 for 后接动名词作后置定语，谓语是现在完成时被动，主语长谓语短，语序值得体会。

b3-009-s011.skeleton: The radio would signal the rate

modifiers.text: which the ball was slowed down
and scientists would be able to calculate how dense the atmosphere is

b3-009-s011.gloss: 无线电测出小球减速的快慢，从而算出大气密度。
b3-009-s011.whyLearn: 两个 would 分句并列，前句套 which 定语从句，后句用 how 宾语从句，长句的从句层次分明。

modifiers.text: to drop a capsule containing scientific instruments on to the planet's surface

b3-009-s012.gloss: 甚至可能向火星表面投放装科学仪器的容器。
b3-009-s012.whyLearn: It 作形式主语，真主语是后面的不定式，capsule 后又用 containing 分词短语作后置定语。

b3-010-s001.skeleton: The great ship, Titanic, sailed for New York from Southampton
b3-010-s001.gloss: 泰坦尼克号从南安普顿启航驶往纽约。
b3-010-s001.whyLearn: 同位语 Titanic 用逗号插入说明船名，sailed for 与 from 两个短语分别交代目的地和出发港。

b3-010-s003.skeleton: the 46,000 ton Titanic was a colossal ship
b3-010-s003.gloss: 即使按现代标准，它也是一艘巨轮。
b3-010-s003.whyLearn: 让步状语 Even by modern standards 置于句首，用逗号与主句隔开，主句是干净的主系表。

b3-010-s006.skeleton: The tragic sinking of this great liner will always be remembered

modifiers.text: for she went down on her first voyage with heavy loss of life

b3-010-s006.gloss: 这艘巨轮沉没将被永远铭记，她首航即沉，死伤惨重。
b3-010-s006.whyLearn: for 引出原因并列分句，主句是将来时被动，she 用来称船，两个分句各有看点。

b3-010-s007.skeleton: a huge iceberg was suddenly spotted by a look-out

modifiers.text: while the Titanic was sailing across the icy waters of the North Atlantic

b3-010-s007.gloss: 出发四天后，泰坦尼克号航行时被瞭望员发现冰山。
b3-010-s007.whyLearn: 两个时间状语接连前置，主句才出现且用被动，after setting out 体现介词后接动名词。

modifiers.text: After the alarm had been given

b3-010-s008.gloss: 警报发出后，巨轮急转以避开正面碰撞。
b3-010-s008.whyLearn: After 从句用过去完成时被动，表示先发生的动作，主句用不定式表目的，时间层次清楚。

b3-010-s009.skeleton: The Titanic turned just in time

modifiers.text: narrowly missing the immense wall of ice which rose over 100 feet out of the water beside her
which rose over 100 feet out of the water beside her
out of the water beside her

b3-010-s009.gloss: 泰坦尼克号及时转向，堪堪擦过身旁的冰墙。
b3-010-s009.whyLearn: 逗号后 missing 分词短语表伴随，其中又嵌 which 定语从句，可练习两者的分工。

modifiers.text: that the Titanic was sinking rapidly
for five of her sixteen water-tight compartments had already been flooded

b3-010-s012.gloss: 船长惊恐地发现船在下沉，十六个水密舱进了五个。
b3-010-s012.whyLearn: realized 后接 that 宾语从句，for 引出原因并列句，从句里过去进行与过去完成形成对照。

b3-010-s013.skeleton: The order to abandon ship was given

modifiers.text: and hundreds of people plunged into the icy water

b3-010-s013.gloss: 弃船令一下，数百人跳入冰冷的海水。
b3-010-s013.whyLearn: and 连接两个过去时并列句，前句被动后句主动，order 后的不定式作定语，结构干净。

b3-011-s001.skeleton: Going through the Customs is a tiresome business
b3-011-s001.gloss: 过海关是件让人心烦的事。
b3-011-s001.whyLearn: 动名词短语作主语，谓语用单数 is，是主语长谓语短的典型，读时要注意主谓一致。

b3-011-s002.skeleton: The strangest thing about it is

modifiers.text: that really honest people are often made to feel guilty

b3-011-s002.gloss: 最奇怪的是，诚实人常被弄得觉得有罪。
b3-011-s002.whyLearn: 最高级作定语，that 引导表语从句，从句中 be made to do 把被动和不定式叠在一起。

b3-011-s003.skeleton: The hardened professional smuggler, on the other hand, is never troubled by such feelings

modifiers.text: even if he has five hundred gold watches hidden in his suitcase

b3-011-s003.gloss: 老练的走私犯不会因此不安，哪怕箱里藏五百块金表。
b3-011-s003.whyLearn: even if 引导让步状语从句，主句用被动否定式，on the other hand 插入语标示前后对比。

b3-011-s006.gloss: 他问着，直视着我的眼睛。
b3-011-s006.whyLearn: looking 分词短语作伴随状语，look sb in the eye 是固定搭配，短句也能体现分词用法。

b3-052-s022.skeleton: Harry then asked for perfumed mud
b3-052-s022.gloss: 哈里得意忘形，又要了香泥。
b3-052-s022.whyLearn: 句首过去分词短语交代得意心理，asked for 接所买之物，一句把情绪加动作连起来。

b3-052-s023.skeleton: He expected the girl to look at him
b3-052-s023.gloss: 他以为姑娘会一脸茫然地看着他。
b3-052-s023.whyLearn: expect sb to do 是最常用的预期句式，句末介词短语写神态，适合表达落空的预判。

b3-052-s024.skeleton: it was his turn to be surprised

modifiers.text: for the girl's eyes immediately lit up and she 'fetched several botties which she placed on the counter for Harry to inspect
which she placed on the counter for Harry to inspect

b3-052-s024.gloss: 轮到他吃惊：姑娘眼睛发亮，取出几瓶泥。
b3-052-s024.whyLearn: for 引出原因、which 接定语从句、to be surprised 表被动，一句串起三种结构，值得拆解模仿。

b3-052-s025.whyLearn: for once 意为难得一次，had to 带出被迫感，七个词就收住了整个窘境。

b3-052-s027.skeleton: He was glad to get away with a mere five guineas

modifiers.text: to get away with a mere five guineas
and he beat a hasty retreat
clutching the precious bottle under his arm

b3-052-s027.gloss: 他只花五几尼就脱身，抱瓶匆匆离去。
b3-052-s027.whyLearn: be glad to 表庆幸，and 并列第二个动作，句尾 clutching 分词补细节，动作链一次学全。

b3-052-s028.skeleton: Harry decided that this little game he had invented might prove to be expensive

modifiers.text: that this little game he had invented might prove to be expensive

b3-052-s028.gloss: 哈里从此认定，自创的游戏可能很费钱。
b3-052-s028.whyLearn: decided 后的 that 宾语从句里再套 he had invented 定语从句，嵌套层次清晰，可以照着练。

b3-052-s029.skeleton: The curious bottle which now adorns the bookcase in his study was his first and last purchase of rare cosmetics

modifiers.text: which now adorns the bookcase in his study

b3-052-s029.gloss: 书架上那只怪瓶，是他唯一一次买化妆品。
b3-052-s029.whyLearn: 定语从句把主语和谓语 was 隔开，读者要跨过从句找谓语，练长距离主谓呼应的好句子。

b3-053-s001.skeleton: The Scandinavian countries are much admired all over the w
b3-053-s001.gloss: 斯堪的纳维亚各国广受赞誉。
b3-053-s001.whyLearn: 被动语态 are much admired 是广受赞赏的现成表达，much 修饰动词，介词短语点出范围。

b3-053-s002.skeleton: Sweden has evolved an excellent system

modifiers.text: for protecting the individual citizen from high-handed or incompetent public officers
protecting the individual citizen from high-handed or incompetent public officers

b3-053-s002.gloss: 瑞典已建立保护公民的优良制度。
b3-053-s002.whyLearn: has evolved 用现在完成时表已建成，for 加动名词说明制度用途，介词后接 -ing 的写法很典型。

b3-053-s003.skeleton: The system has worked so well

modifiers.text: that it has been adopted in other countries like Denmark, Norway, Finland, and New Zealand
in other countries like Denmark, Norway, Finland, and New Zealand
Denmark, Norway, Finland, and New Zealand

b3-053-s003.gloss: 该制度成效极好，已被他国采用。
b3-053-s003.whyLearn: so that 结果状语从句配现在完成时被动 has been adopted，把效果好所以被效仿一次说清。

b3-053-s004.skeleton: Even countries with large populations like Britain and the United States are seriously considering imitating the Swedes

modifiers.text: like Britain and the United States

b3-053-s004.gloss: 连英美等人口大国也在认真考虑效仿瑞典。
b3-053-s004.whyLearn: 主语被 with 短语和 like 举例拉长后仍接 are considering，练长主语后找谓语，imitate 用法也一并记住。

b3-053-s006.skeleton: the Swedish Parliament introduced a scheme

modifiers.text: to safeguard the interest of the individual

b3-053-s006.gloss: 早在1809年，瑞典议会就设制保护个人权益。
b3-053-s006.whyLearn: as long ago as 强调时间之早，introduced a scheme to do 是设立某制以做某事的实用搭配。

b3-053-s007.skeleton: A parliamentary committee representing all political parties appoints a person

modifiers.text: who is suitably qualified to investigate private grievances against the State
to investigate private grievances against the State

b3-053-s007.gloss: 议会委员会任命专人调查民众对国家的申诉。
b3-053-s007.whyLearn: 主语后接 representing 分词短语，宾语后接 who 定语从句，两个后置修饰同现，示范性强。

b3-053-s008.skeleton: The official title of the person is 'Justiteombudsman'

modifiers.text: but the Swedes commonly refer to him as the 'J

b3-053-s008.gloss: 他的正式头衔很长，瑞典人另有简称。
b3-053-s008.whyLearn: but 连接两个对等分句，refer to him as 是称他为的固定说法，介绍官职头衔时可直接套用。

b3-053-s011.skeleton: The Ombudsman is not subject to political pressure
b3-053-s011.gloss: 监察专员不受政治压力牵制。
b3-053-s011.whyLearn: be not subject to 是表示不受某事支配的正式说法，否定词位置固定，适合写制度与规则。

b3-053-s012.skeleton: He investigates complaints large and small

modifiers.text: that come to him from all levels of society

b3-053-s012.gloss: 他受理来自社会各阶层的大小投诉。
b3-053-s012.whyLearn: 形容词后置 large and small 与 that 定语从句一起修饰 complaints，名词后多重修饰的典型句。

b2-095-s007.skeleton: University students set the Embassy on fire
b2-095-s007.gloss: 学生今晨放火烧了大使馆。
b2-095-s007.whyLearn: set sth on fire 是“放火”的地道搭配，宾语夹在 set 与 on fire 中间，比 burn 更有新闻语体感。

b2-095-s010.skeleton: where were you at the time
b2-095-s010.whyLearn: And 用来承接上一句继续追问，at the time 指案发那一刻，是过去时盘问句的标准问法。

modifiers.text: 'I was in my office as usual,'

b2-095-s011.gloss: 大使答说他照常在办公室。
b2-095-s011.whyLearn: 引语在前、answered the Ambassador 在后的倒装式报道语序；as usual 是“照常”的高频简短状语。

b2-095-s012.whyLearn: break out 专指火灾、战争等突然爆发，是不及物动词短语，不能说 be broken out，地点用 in 引出。

b2-095-s014.skeleton: that fool, Horst, aimed a fire-extinguisher at me
b2-095-s014.gloss: 那蠢货霍斯特朝我喷灭火器。
b2-095-s014.whyLearn: aim sth at sb 的介词搭配；Horst 作同位语被逗号夹在名词后，of course 轻读成插入成分。

b2-095-s015.whyLearn: thought 后接省略 that 的宾语从句，从句时态与主句呼应；be on fire 表状态而非动作。

b2-095-s016.skeleton: I must definitely get that fellow
b2-095-s016.gloss: 我非得把那个家伙调走不可。
b2-095-s016.whyLearn: get sb posted 是“把某人调职”的使役结构，posted 作宾补表结果，must 加 definitely 双重强调决心。

b2-095-s017.skeleton: The Ambassador's wife went on asking questions

modifiers.text: when she suddenly noticed a big hole in her husband's hat

b2-095-s017.gloss: 大使夫人追问不停，忽然发现丈夫帽上有个洞。
b2-095-s017.whyLearn: go on doing 表示继续做同一件事，此处 when 是“就在这时”的突发义，两个所有格形成层层归属。

b2-095-s021.gloss: 有人朝我办公室窗户开了一枪。
b2-095-s021.whyLearn: fire a shot 是“开枪”的动宾搭配，through 强调从内部穿过，与 across 的横向方向感不同。

b2-095-s023.whyLearn: Fortunately 置句首用逗号隔开作评注性状语；过去进行时否定式 wasn't wearing 描写当时的持续状态。

b2-096-s001.skeleton: A Festival for the Dead is held
b2-096-s001.gloss: 日本每年为亡者举办一次节庆。
b2-096-s001.whyLearn: 被动 is held 让节日成为话题，for the Dead 作后置定语，once a year 与 in Japan 按频率、地点排列。

b2-096-s002.skeleton: This festival is a cheerful occasion

modifiers.text: for on this day, the dead are said to return to their homes and they are welcomed by the living

b2-096-s002.gloss: 这是欢乐的节日，亡者据说会回家。
b2-096-s002.whyLearn: for 作并列连词引出原因分句，are said to 是“据说”的被动加不定式结构，两个被动小句由 and 并列。

modifiers.text: As they are expected to be hungry after their long journey

b2-096-s003.gloss: 料想亡者长途归来会饿，便摆上食物。
b2-096-s003.whyLearn: As 从句交代缘由，be expected to 与 is laid out 两个被动连用，把动作执行者完全隐去。

modifiers.text: to help the dead to find their way

b2-096-s004.gloss: 特制灯笼挂在屋外，为亡者引路。
b2-096-s004.whyLearn: are hung 是被动的一般现在时表习俗；不定式 to help 表目的，help sb (to) do 中的 to 可省略。

b2-096-s005.whyLearn: All night long 是“整夜”的时间状语，可置句首并用逗号隔开；dance and sing 并列谓语显得轻快口语。

modifiers.text: guiding the dead on their return journey to the other world

b2-096-s008.gloss: 万千灯笼缓缓漂向大海，为亡者引路。
b2-096-s008.whyLearn: 现在分词 guiding 作伴随状语，逻辑主语仍是 lanterns；Thousands of 后接可数名词复数。

b2-061-s005.skeleton: the Astra will stop for a short time and an astronaut will attempt to leave the stationary spaceship and then return to it
b2-061-s005.gloss: 阿斯特拉号将短暂停留，宇航员试着出舱再返回。
b2-061-s005.whyLearn: 两个并列的将来时谓语共用一个时间状语，再用不定式串起连续动作，写计划流程可直接套用。

b2-061-s007.skeleton: The first message is expected to arrive

modifiers.text: to arrive at 7 o'clock this evening

b2-061-s007.gloss: 预计第一条信息今晚七点到达。
b2-061-s007.whyLearn: be expected to 是预报事件的常用被动句式，比 people expect 更客观简洁。

b2-061-s008.skeleton: the Astra will have been flying through space for seventeen hours and will have circled the earth a great many times

modifiers.text: and will have circled the earth

b2-061-s008.gloss: 到那时，阿斯特拉号已在太空飞了十七小时，绕地球多圈。
b2-061-s008.whyLearn: 同一主语后接两个将来完成结构，进行与完成两种形态并置，适合练习时态呼应。

b2-062-s002.skeleton: great trees had covered the countryside
b2-062-s002.gloss: 不久前，大树曾覆盖周围数英里的乡村。
b2-062-s002.whyLearn: 过去完成时配 before 与 for miles around，写出今昔对比的背景句，叙事开头很好用。

b2-062-s003.gloss: 此刻焦土山丘上，仍有烟从温热地面升起。
b2-062-s003.whyLearn: 全句无复杂语法，靠 still 和两个介词短语层层定位画面，学景物描写的简洁句。

b2-062-s004.skeleton: Winter was coming on and the hills threatened the surrounding villages with destruction

modifiers.text: for heavy rain would not only wash away the soil but would cause serious floods as well
not only wash away the soil but would cause serious floods as well

b2-062-s004.gloss: 冬天将至，山丘威胁村庄，大雨会冲走土壤并引发洪水。
b2-062-s004.whyLearn: and 并列两分句，for 引出原因，not only...but...as well 递进，多重逻辑衔接的范本。

b2-062-s006.gloss: 飞机把大量种子喷洒在地面上。
b2-062-s006.whyLearn: 典型被动句：受事作主语，by 引出施事，两个介词短语分别说明范围与数量。

b2-062-s007.skeleton: The planes had been planting seed
b2-062-s007.gloss: 飞机播种近一个月时，才开始下雨。
b2-062-s007.whyLearn: 过去完成进行时加 when 从句，表现动作持续到某一点，叙事交代背景很有用。

b2-062-s008.skeleton: the grass had already taken root
b2-062-s008.gloss: 然而到那时，许多地方的草已扎根。
b2-062-s008.whyLearn: 时间、转折、地点三个状语依次排在主语前，是练状语语序的好例子。

b2-062-s009.skeleton: patches of green had begun to appear

modifiers.text: In place of the great trees which had been growing there for centuries
which had been growing there for centuries

b2-062-s009.gloss: 在生长数百年的大树原处，焦土中已长出片片新绿。
b2-062-s009.whyLearn: 介词短语里嵌定语从句，主句仍是简单结构，学会把长信息前置而不乱。

b2-063-s001.skeleton: Geoffrey Hampden has a large circle of friends and is very popular at parties

modifiers.text: and is very popular at parties

b2-063-s001.gloss: 杰弗里交友广泛，在聚会上很受欢迎。
b2-063-s001.whyLearn: 第二个并列谓语承前省略主语，has 与 is 共用同一主语，是简洁描述人物的模板。

modifiers.text: for his fine sense of humor
--everybody, that is, except his six-year-old daughter, Jenny

b2-063-s002.gloss: 人人都因他幽默感强而钦佩他，只有他六岁女儿除外。
b2-063-s002.whyLearn: 破折号后重复 everybody 再补例外，还插入 that is，学口语化的补充与转折。

b2-063-s003.skeleton: one of Geoffrey's closest friends asked him to make a speech
b2-063-s003.gloss: 最近杰弗里一位好友请他在婚宴上致辞。
b2-063-s003.whyLearn: ask sb to do sth 的宾语补足结构配 one of 的表达，日常叙事里高频出现。

b2-063-s004.skeleton: This is the sort of thing
b2-063-s004.gloss: 这正是杰弗里喜欢的那类事。
b2-063-s004.whyLearn: the sort of thing that... 是口语常用的定语从句框架，比单说 the thing 更自然。

b2-063-s005.skeleton: He prepared the speech carefully and went to the wedding with Jenny
b2-063-s005.gloss: 他认真准备讲稿，和珍妮一起去了婚礼。
b2-063-s005.whyLearn: 两个过去式谓语并列，副词与介词短语各归其位，是最基础的叙事句骨架。

b2-063-s006.skeleton: He had included a large number of funny stories in the speech and, of course, it was a great success

modifiers.text: and, of course, it was a great success

b2-063-s006.gloss: 他在讲稿里加了许多趣事，演讲自然大获成功。
b2-063-s006.whyLearn: 过去完成时交代先前动作，再并列一个过去时结果，插入语 of course 让语气自然。

b2-055-s008.skeleton: They finally found a small gold coin
b2-055-s008.gloss: 他们最终找到一枚几乎一文不值的小金币。
b2-055-s008.whyLearn: 定语从句用 which 修饰物并紧跟 coin；先抓主干 They found a coin，句子立刻变短。

b2-055-s009.skeleton: The party then searched the whole cave thoroughly

modifiers.text: but did not find anything except an empty tin trunk

b2-055-s009.gloss: 一行人搜遍洞穴，只找到一只空铁皮箱。
b2-055-s009.whyLearn: but 并列两个过去式谓语，否定靠 did not find；except 排除其余可能，只留下空箱子。

modifiers.text: that 'The Revealer' may reveal something of value fairly soon

b2-055-s010.gloss: 尽管如此，很多人相信揭秘者不久会有发现。
b2-055-s010.whyLearn: In spite of 后只能接名词，与 although 分工不同；be confident that 引出从句，may 表推测。

b2-056-s001.skeleton: a race is held for old cars
b2-056-s001.gloss: 每年为老爷车举办一次比赛。
b2-056-s001.whyLearn: is held 是一般现在时被动，讲惯例性安排；Once a year 放句首点频率，主谓才三词。

b2-056-s004.skeleton: The most unusual car was a Benz
b2-056-s004.gloss: 最奇特的车是一辆只有三个轮子的奔驰。
b2-056-s004.whyLearn: 最高级 most unusual 定对比焦点；which 从句补说 Benz 的特征，谓语 had 表当时状态。

b2-056-s005.gloss: 它造于1885年，是参赛车中最老的。
b2-056-s005.whyLearn: 过去分词短语置句首作状语，逻辑主语就是 it；taking part 后置限定 car，信息极密。

modifiers.text: After a great many loud explosions

b2-056-s006.gloss: 在一连串巨大的爆炸声之后，比赛开始了。
b2-056-s006.whyLearn: a great many 直接修饰可数复数，比 a lot of 书面；After 加名词短语即可作时间状语。

b2-056-s007.skeleton: Many of the cars broke down on the course

modifiers.text: and some drivers spent more time under their cars than in them !

b2-056-s007.gloss: 许多车半路抛锚，有的司机修车比开车还久。
b2-056-s007.whyLearn: and 并列两个过去式句子；more time under their cars than in them 用比较造出幽默。

b2-056-s008.skeleton: A few cars, however, completed the race
b2-056-s008.gloss: 不过，有几辆车跑完了全程。
b2-056-s008.whyLearn: however 插在主语后，前后逗号隔开；a few 后接可数复数，与带否定意味的 few 要分清。

b2-056-s009.skeleton: The winning car reached a speed of forty miles an hour

modifiers.text: --much faster than any of its rivals

b2-056-s009.gloss: 获胜车时速四十英里，远远快于所有对手。
b2-056-s009.whyLearn: a speed of 加数字单位表示速度；破折号后 much faster than 补充比较，much 加强比较级。

b2-056-s010.skeleton: It sped downhill at the end of the race

modifiers.text: at the end of the race
and its driver had a lot of trouble trying to stop it

b2-056-s010.gloss: 它下坡飞驰，司机费了好大劲才把它停住。
b2-056-s010.whyLearn: have trouble doing 是固定搭配，trying 不能换成 to try；a lot of 修饰不可数 trouble。

b2-056-s011.skeleton: The race gave everyone a great deal of pleasure
b2-056-s011.gloss: 这场比赛给每个人带来了极大的乐趣。
b2-056-s011.whyLearn: give sb sth 双宾语结构；a great deal of 修饰不可数名词，是数量表达的高频书面说法。

b2-056-s012.skeleton: It was very different from modern car races
b2-056-s012.gloss: 它与现代赛车不同，却同样激动人心。
b2-056-s012.whyLearn: be different from 是固定搭配；no less exciting 表示不比谁逊色，语气比 not less 肯定。

b2-057-s001.skeleton: A woman in blue jeans stood

modifiers.text: at the window of an expensive shop

b2-057-s001.gloss: 一位穿蓝色牛仔裤的女子站在一家昂贵商店的橱窗前。
b2-057-s001.whyLearn: 主干 A woman stood 只有三词，in blue jeans 后置修饰 woman，at 短语说明站位。

b2-057-s002.skeleton: she finally went in and asked to see a dress

modifiers.text: Though she hesitated for a moment
to see a dress that was in the window

b2-057-s002.gloss: 她犹豫了一会儿，还是进去要求看橱窗里的那条裙子。
b2-057-s002.whyLearn: Though 从句与主句形成让步对比；ask to see 用不定式说请求内容，dress 后从句补位置。

b2-057-s003.skeleton: The assistant who served her did not like the way
b2-057-s003.gloss: 接待她的店员不喜欢她的穿着打扮。
b2-057-s003.whyLearn: who served her 紧跟先行词 assistant；the way she was dressed 是省略关系词的定语从句。

b3-017-s001.gloss: 介绍韦拉扎诺，一个生平少有人知的意大利人。
b3-017-s001.whyLearn: 同位语后紧跟“介词+whom”定语从句，是介绍人物身份时常见的压缩写法。

modifiers.text: 'a very agreeable situation located within two small hills in the midst of which flowed a great river.'
located within two small hills in the midst of which flowed a great river
in the midst of which flowed a great river

grammarRefs: 倒装 · 地点状语前置
b3-017-s002.gloss: 他说那是两座小山之间一片宜人的地方。
b3-017-s002.whyLearn: as后接名词性成分，句尾用“介词+which”引出主语倒装的定语从句，值得模仿。

b3-017-s004.skeleton: The Verrazano Bridge, which was designed by Othmar Ammann, joins Brooklyn to Staten Island.

modifiers.text: which was designed by Othmar Ammann

b3-017-s004.gloss: 韦拉扎诺桥由阿曼设计，连接布鲁克林与斯塔滕岛。
b3-017-s004.whyLearn: 非限制性定语从句插在主语和谓语之间，抓主干时先跳过它再读joins。

b3-017-s005.skeleton: It has a span of 4260 feet.
b3-017-s005.whyLearn: “have a span of + 数字”是说明桥梁跨度的固定说法，可直接套用。

b3-017-s007.skeleton: Two great towers support four huge cables.
b3-017-s007.gloss: 两座巨塔支撑着四根粗大的钢缆。
b3-017-s007.whyLearn: 最干净的“主语+谓语+宾语”简单句，是描述结构时的基本句式模板。

b3-017-s008.skeleton: The towers are built on immense underwater platforms

modifiers.text: on immense underwater platforms made of steel and concrete

b3-017-s008.gloss: 塔建在钢与混凝土造的巨型水下平台上。
b3-017-s008.whyLearn: 过去分词短语made of作后置定语，等于省略的which are made of。

b3-017-s009.skeleton: The platforms extend to a depth of over 100 feet under the sea.

modifiers.text: to a depth of over 100 feet under the sea

b3-017-s009.gloss: 这些平台延伸到海面下100多英尺深。
b3-017-s009.whyLearn: 用“extend to a depth of”精确交代深度，比只说deep更专业。

b3-017-s010.gloss: 仅这些平台就花了十六个月才建成。
b3-017-s010.whyLearn: “take + 时间 + to do”说明耗时，注意主语是被建造的对象而非施工者。

b3-017-s011.skeleton: the towers rise to a height of nearly 700 feet.

modifiers.text: Above the surface of the water
to a height of nearly 700 feet

b3-017-s011.gloss: 在水面之上，塔升高到近700英尺。
b3-017-s011.whyLearn: 句首介词短语交代参照位置，与上句的extend to a depth形成一升一降的对照。

modifiers.text: from which the bridge has been suspended

b3-017-s012.gloss: 它们支撑着桥身悬挂其上的钢缆。
b3-017-s012.whyLearn: “介词+which”定语从句加现在完成被动，一句话交代桥的悬吊方式。

b3-017-s013.skeleton: Each of the four cables contains 26,108 lengths of wire.
b3-017-s013.gloss: 四根钢缆每根含26108股钢丝。
b3-017-s013.whyLearn: “each of + 复数名词”作主语，谓语必须用单数contains，是常见考点。

b3-017-s015.skeleton: size and strength are not the only important things about this bridge.
b3-017-s015.gloss: 然而，这座桥的重要性不只在规模和强度。
b3-017-s015.whyLearn: However转折另起话题，not the only为下文要说的事留出空间。

b3-018-s001.skeleton: Modern sculpture rarely surprises us any more
b3-018-s001.gloss: 现代雕塑如今很难再让人惊讶了。
b3-018-s001.whyLearn: rarely与any more连用，用肯定形式表达“不再”的否定含义。

b3-018-s002.skeleton: The idea that modern art can only be seen in museums is mistaken.

modifiers.text: that modern art can only be seen in museums

b3-018-s002.gloss: 认为现代艺术只能在博物馆看到的想法是错的。
b3-018-s002.whyLearn: 同位语从句把主语和谓语隔开，先抓The idea is mistaken再回头看从句。

b3-018-s003.skeleton: Even people who take no interest in art cannot have failed to notice examples of modern sculpture on display in public places.

modifiers.text: who take no interest in art

b3-018-s003.gloss: 即使不关心艺术的人也见过公共场所的现代雕塑。
b3-018-s003.whyLearn: cannot have failed to do是双重否定表强烈肯定，语气比must更含蓄有力。

b3-018-s004.gloss: 奇怪的形体立在花园里、楼外和店铺外。
b3-018-s004.whyLearn: 并列结构省略重复的stand，and后只剩介词短语，读时要把谓语补出来。

b4-020-s001.skeleton: the influence of the factory upon the phy

modifiers.text: In the organization of industrial life

b4-020-s001.gloss: 工厂影响了工业生活中的居住条件。
b4-020-s001.whyLearn: 原文截断，但可练地点状语前置后主语及其后置定语的识别

b4-020-s002.skeleton: Modern industry is based on the conception of the maximum production at lowest cost

modifiers.text: in order that an individual or a group of individuals may earn as much money as possible

b4-020-s002.gloss: 现代工业以低成本、最大产量为信条。
b4-020-s002.whyLearn: in order that 引导目的状语从句，说明 is based on 背后的动机

b4-020-s004.skeleton: The great cities have been built
b4-020-s004.gloss: 这些大城市建造时根本没考虑我们。
b4-020-s004.whyLearn: 现在完成被动 have been built 加 with no regard for 表“不顾及”

b4-020-s006.skeleton: This caused the construction of gigantic buildings

modifiers.text: where too large masses of human beings are crowded together

b4-020-s006.gloss: 这导致建起人们极度拥挤的巨型建筑。
b4-020-s006.whyLearn: where 定语从句修饰地点名词，从句内用被动 be crowded together

b4-020-s007.skeleton: Civilized men like such a way
b4-020-s007.gloss: 文明人喜欢这样的生活方式。
b4-020-s007.whyLearn: 名词 way 后接 of doing，练介词后动名词作后置定语

modifiers.text: for the good of its inhabitants

b4-020-s010.gloss: 显然它不是为居民利益规划的。
b4-020-s010.whyLearn: 原文有笔误，仍可学 for the good of 与现在完成被动结构

modifiers.text: In the early days of the settlement of Australia

b4-021-s001.gloss: 澳大利亚殖民初期，有胆识的移民不明智地……
b4-021-s001.whyLearn: 句子未完，但可看状语前置与 enterprising settlers 的定语语序

modifiers.text: which might have maintained millions of sheep and cattle

b4-021-s004.gloss: 它挖洞、啃食牧草，造成毁灭性破坏。
b4-021-s004.whyLearn: 两个 by doing 并列表方式，再加 might have done 定语从句

modifiers.text: that this particular variety of rabbit (and apparently no other animal) was susceptible to a fatal virus disease, myxomatosis

b4-021-s005.gloss: 科学家发现这种兔子易感致命病毒病。
b4-021-s005.whyLearn: 宾语从句中插括号补充，句末同位语解释病名，层次清晰

b4-021-s006.skeleton: local epidemics of this disease could be created

modifiers.text: letting them loose in the burrows

b4-021-s006.gloss: 把病兔放进洞穴即可造成局部疫病。
b4-021-s006.whyLearn: 两个 by 短语并列表手段，主句用 could be created 被动

modifiers.text: while the rest of the world was trying to get rid of mosquitoes

b4-021-s008.gloss: 别国在灭蚊时，澳大利亚却在养蚊子。
b4-021-s008.whyLearn: while 引导时间对比从句，主从句皆用过去进行时

b4-021-s009.skeleton: It effectively spread the disease all over the continent and drastically reduced the rabbit population
b4-021-s009.gloss: 它把疾病传遍大陆，大幅削减了兔群。
b4-021-s009.whyLearn: 两个并列的过去式谓语 spread 与 reduced 共用一个主语

b4-021-s012.skeleton: Europe, which had bequeathed the rabbit as a pest to Australia acquired this man-made disease as a pestilence

modifiers.text: which had bequeathed the rabbit as a pest to Australia

b4-021-s012.gloss: 把兔子传给澳洲的欧洲反遭兔病之害。
b4-021-s012.whyLearn: 非限定定语从句用过去完成时，交代主句之前已发生的事

b4-021-s013.skeleton: A French physician decided to get rid of the wild rabbits on his own estate and introduced myxomatosis

modifiers.text: to get rid of the wild rabbits on his own estate

b4-021-s013.gloss: 一位法国医生决定清除自家庄园的野兔并引入兔病毒。
b4-021-s013.whyLearn: decided to do 接不定式，再与 introduced 并列共用主语

b4-021-s014.skeleton: It did not, however, remain within the confines of his estate

modifiers.text: within the confines of his estate

b4-021-s014.gloss: 然而它并未局限在自家庄园范围里。
b4-021-s014.whyLearn: 插入语 however 置于句中的写法，及否定式 did not remain

b4-021-s016.skeleton: The question became one of whether Man could control the disease

modifiers.text: whether Man could control the disease

b4-021-s016.gloss: 问题变成人类能否控制自己造出的疾病。
b4-021-s016.whyLearn: whether 从句作介词 of 的宾语，后接定语从句省略关系词

b4-045-s007.skeleton: the chances are against it, and there is a virtual limit

modifiers.text: on how long we can hope to remain alive
how long we can hope to remain alive
however lucky and robust we are

b4-045-s007.gloss: 人终有一死，寿命存在极限。
b4-045-s007.whyLearn: there be 句与 however 让步从句连用，can hope to remain alive 展示情态动词接不定式。

modifiers.text: that all animals, and probably other organisms such as trees, or even the universe itself, must in the nature of things 'wear out'
and probably other organisms such as trees, or even the universe itself

b4-045-s010.gloss: 他们认为万物终会衰老损耗。
b4-045-s010.whyLearn: have assumed that 接长宾语从句，主语用 such as、or even 层层追加，must wear out 收尾。

b4-045-s012.skeleton: these are not analogous to what happens when man ages

modifiers.text: A run-down watch is still a watch and can be rewound

b4-045-s012.gloss: 衰老不同于手表磨损，表可再上弦。
b4-045-s012.whyLearn: be analogous to 后接 what 从句，when man ages 点明比较对象，watch 与 rewound 对比。

b4-045-s015.skeleton: We could, at one time, repair ourselves well enough

modifiers.text: to overcome all but the most instantly fatal illnesses an accidents

b4-045-s015.gloss: 从前我们能自我修复，除非病来立毙。
b4-045-s015.whyLearn: could 后插 at one time 与 at least，to overcome 表结果，all but 加最高级表例外。

modifiers.text: which at twelve would knock us over

b4-045-s016.gloss: 年纪渐长，小病也能致命。
b4-045-s016.whyLearn: which 从句把同一 illness 放到十二岁与八十岁，would 与 can 对照，并递进到 grave。

b4-046-s003.skeleton: Athens today grows by three dwellings And 100 square metres of road every hour

modifiers.text: To give only one example of almost visible acceleration
by three dwellings And 100 square metres of road

b4-046-s003.gloss: 以雅典为例，城市扩张快得惊人。
b4-046-s003.whyLearn: To give only one example 置句首作目的状语，主干用 grows by... every hour 呈现具体增量。

b4-046-s007.skeleton: We are heading towards an urban world.
b4-046-s007.whyLearn: are heading towards 用进行时表示正在发生的趋势，短句干净，适合描述大势。

b4-046-s008.skeleton: This enormous increase will go ahead

modifiers.text: and we have to remember that the new cities devour space
that the new cities devour space

b4-046-s008.gloss: 增长不可挡，新城市吞占空间。
b4-046-s008.whyLearn: whatever 让步从句紧跟 will go ahead，and 引出 have to remember that 从句。

b4-046-s009.skeleton: People now acquire far more goods and things.
b4-046-s009.gloss: 如今人们拥有的物品多得多。
b4-046-s009.whyLearn: 短句用 now 与 far more 构成今昔对比，acquire 比 buy 书面，谈消费增长很实用。

b4-046-s012.skeleton: The car also has a curious ambivalence

modifiers.text: it creates and then it destroys mobility

b4-046-s012.gloss: 汽车既创造又摧毁流动性。
b4-046-s012.whyLearn: 冒号后并列句解释 ambivalence，creates 与 destroys 正反对照，是下定义加举例的写法。

b4-046-s013.skeleton: The car tempts people further out and then gives them the appalling problem

modifiers.text: and then gives them the appalling problem of getting back

b4-046-s013.gloss: 汽车把人带远，却让他们难回。
b4-046-s013.whyLearn: tempts...and then gives... 并列谓语写反差，of getting back 是介词后接 -ing。

modifiers.text: when exposed to more than a certain degree of density, frustration, and noise
exposed to more than a certain degree of density, frustration, and noise
and the mice just became deranged

b4-046-s016.gloss: 实验显示，鼠群过密会发疯。
b4-046-s016.whyLearn: were made 用被动保持客观，when exposed to 是状语从句省略，三项并列堆出压力源。

b4-046-s018.skeleton: This combination of very high density of population, goods and services, and machines

modifiers.text: of very high density of population, goods and services, and machines
all increasing with almost bruta1 speed
does account for some really antisocial tendencies in modern urban growth

b4-046-s018.gloss: 高密度叠加导致城市反社会倾向。
b4-046-s018.whyLearn: 主语后 of 短语与三项并列，all increasing 用分词补充，does account for 靠 do 强调谓语。

b4-047-s001.skeleton: The modern Plato, like his ancient counterpart, has an unbounded contempt
b4-047-s001.gloss: 现代柏拉图鄙视普通民众。
b4-047-s001.whyLearn: like his ancient counterpart 插入语并置古今，has an unbounded contempt 表轻蔑。

b4-047-s004.skeleton: He has never mixed with them or spoken to them on equal terms

modifiers.text: or spoken to them on equal terms
but has demanded and generally received a respect due to his position and superior intelligence
due to his position and superior intelligence
