b3-047-s022.skeleton: A tall steel tower rising to a height of nearly 200 feet will rest on the platform.

modifiers.text: rising to a height of nearly 200 feet
to a height of nearly 200 feet

b3-047-s022.gloss: 一座高近两百英尺的钢塔将立在平台上。
b3-047-s022.whyLearn: rising分词短语插在主语和谓语之间作后置定语，要学会隔开主语与will rest的干扰。

b2-025-s004.skeleton: I not only spoke English very carefully
b2-025-s004.gloss: 我不仅说英语很仔细，还说得非常清楚。
b2-025-s004.whyLearn: not only…but…as well 并列两个状语，but 后省略了 spoke English，容易误读成转折。

modifiers.text: but I could not understand him

b2-025-s008.gloss: 他说得很慢，可我还是听不懂。
b2-025-s008.whyLearn: but 前后时态对比：前半实义动词过去式，后半 could not 表过去能力，情态动词否定很典型。

modifiers.text: that young children often appreciate modern pictures better than anyone else

b2-026-s007.gloss: 我认为小孩子往往比别人更懂现代画。
b2-026-s007.whyLearn: that 宾语从句里套 better than anyone else 比较级，appreciate 意为“欣赏”，主句用现在时表看法。

modifiers.text: As soon as this was done

b2-027-s002.gloss: 这事一做完，他们就在明火上做了饭。
b2-027-s002.whyLearn: As soon as 时间从句用被动 was done，主句 cooked 用过去式，“一……就……”的复制句型。

modifiers.text: and there were some people rowing on the river

b2-030-s004.gloss: 孩子们在岸边做游戏，河上还有人在划船。
b2-030-s004.whyLearn: and 并列过去进行时与 there be 句，rowing 作后置定语，一次学会“有人正在……”的两种说法。

modifiers.text: so hard that he nearly fell into the water

b2-030-s007.gloss: 球重重打在他身上，他差点掉进水里。
b2-030-s007.whyLearn: so…that 表结果，so 后接副词 hard 而非 such；nearly fell into 描写差一点发生的动作。

b2-031-s002.skeleton: Frank is now the head of a very large business company

modifiers.text: but as a boy he used to work in a small shop
to work in a small shop

b2-031-s002.gloss: 弗兰克现在是大公司老板，小时候在小店干活。
b2-031-s002.whyLearn: 前半现在时讲现状、后半 used to 讲过去，今昔对比是复述人物经历的经典写法。

modifiers.text: and at that time he used to work fourteen hours a day

b2-031-s003.gloss: 修自行车是他的活儿，那时他每天干十四小时。
b2-031-s003.whyLearn: It was his job to do…用 it 作形式主语把不定式后置，后半再用 used to 补背景，重点与细节分层。

b2-031-s005.skeleton: Frank used to make spare parts
b2-031-s005.gloss: 战时弗兰克常为飞机制造零件。
b2-031-s005.whyLearn: used to 后必须接动词原形 make，配合 During the war 时间状语，一句话交代过去的生活状态。

modifiers.text: when the door opened and his wife came in

b2-031-s009.gloss: 门开了，妻子走进来时他还笑着。
b2-031-s009.whyLearn: when 从句用 and 并列两个过去动作，主句用过去进行时铺垫“正笑着”的背景，时态配合典型。

b2-035-s001.skeleton: Rov Trenton used to drive a taxi
b2-035-s001.gloss: 罗夫·特伦顿过去开出租车。
b2-035-s001.whyLearn: 最短的 used to 例句：主语+used to+动词原形，注意后接 drive 而非 drove，用来对比今昔。

modifiers.text: When he was driving along Catford Street recently
and run towards a waiting car

b2-035-s004.gloss: 他最近开车时看见两个贼从店里冲出来。
b2-035-s004.whyLearn: see sb do sth 用省略 to 的不定式，配合 when 过去进行时从句，把目击动作连成一条链。

b2-035-s007.skeleton: The one with the money got such a fright
b2-035-s007.gloss: 拿钱那个吓得把包都掉了。
b2-035-s007.whyLearn: such a+名词+that 引导结果从句，与 so…that 的分工是 such 修饰名词短语，注意 a fright 语序。

modifiers.text: than he bought a fine house

b2-038-s003.gloss: 他刚回来就买下好房子住了进去。
b2-038-s003.whyLearn: no sooner…than 时间句型，主句用过去完成时、than 后接过去式，比 as soon as 更书面。

b2-038-s008.skeleton: He had hardly had time to settle down

modifiers.text: when he sold the house and left the country

b2-038-s008.gloss: 他还没安顿下来就卖了房子出国。
b2-038-s008.whyLearn: hardly…when 表示“还没来得及……就……”，主句过去完成时配 when 从句过去式，写作中很出彩。

b2-039-s001.skeleton: he asked his doctor to tell him

modifiers.text: While John Gilbert was in hospital
to tell him whether his operation had been successful
whether his operation had been successful
but the doctor refused to do so

b2-039-s001.gloss: 住院时他问医生手术是否成功，医生不肯说。
b2-039-s001.whyLearn: 一句含 while 状语、ask sb to do 与 whether 间接疑问，末尾 but 转折并省略重复动词。

b4-023-s005.skeleton: a basic amount of movement occurs

modifiers.text: which is specifically concerned with preventing muscle inactivity

b4-023-s005.gloss: 事实上，睡眠中也发生基本运动，以防肌肉不活动。
b4-023-s005.whyLearn: which 从句被 during sleep 隔开，练会跨过状语找回先行词 movement，句子才读得通。

b4-023-s007.skeleton: This might be a plausible hypothesis

modifiers.text: were it not for two factors

b4-023-s007.gloss: 若不是有两个因素，这或许是个合理的假设。
b4-023-s007.whyLearn: were it not for 是省略 if 的倒装虚拟条件，认出倒装就能立刻断定全句是假设语气。

b4-023-s009.gloss: 第二个因素更有趣，也更根本。
b4-023-s009.whyLearn: 两个比较级用 and 并列作表语，一次递进两层意思，论述时可直接套用这种升级写法。

b4-023-s010.skeleton: an American psychiatrist named William Dement published experiments

modifiers.text: dealing with the recording of eye-movements during sleep

b4-023-s010.whyLearn: 过去分词与现在分词各带一个后置定语，练会在同一句里分清两种分词修饰的对象。

modifiers.text: that the average individual's sleep cycle is punctuated with peculiar bursts of eye-movements

b4-023-s011.gloss: 他发现睡眠周期中夹杂着奇怪的眼动爆发。
b4-023-s011.whyLearn: 宾语从句里套被动语态，后面再用两个独立主格补充眼动类型，句法层次很值得拆。

b4-023-s012.skeleton: People woken during these periods of eye-movements generally reported

modifiers.text: woken during these periods of eye-movements

b4-023-s012.gloss: 眼动期间被唤醒的人多半报告说正在做梦。
b4-023-s012.whyLearn: 过去分词短语后置修饰 People，宾语从句用过去完成进行时交代醒来前已开始的梦。

b4-023-s013.gloss: 在别的时间被叫醒，他们就报告没有做梦。
b4-023-s013.whyLearn: 时间状语从句省略了 they were，只剩 When woken，练会补出省略成分再理解句意。

b4-023-s015.skeleton: The implications of all this were

modifiers.text: that it was not the disturbance of sleep that mattered, but the disturbance of dreaming
it was not the disturbance of sleep that mattered

b4-023-s015.gloss: 这一切意味着：要紧的不是睡眠受扰，而是做梦被打断。
b4-023-s015.whyLearn: that 从句里嵌 it was...that 强调结构，再配 not...but 对比，一句叠加两种句式。

b4-024-s001.skeleton: Walking for walking' s sake may be

modifiers.text: as highly laudable and exemplary a thing as i

b4-024-s001.gloss: 为走路而走路，本身或许就是值得称赞的事。
b4-024-s001.whyLearn: as + 形容词 + a thing as 的比较结构，动名词 Walking 作主语，是地道的抽象表达。

b4-024-s002.gloss: 我反对它，因为它让大脑停转。
b4-024-s002.whyLearn: My 物主代词加 that 引导的表语从句说明反对的理由，是表明立场最省力的句式。

b4-024-s006.gloss: 他举重若轻的那份渊博学识，如今哪里去了？
b4-024-s006.whyLearn: 省略系动词的疑问句加 which 定语从句，练会在残缺句里找到被修饰的名词。

modifiers.text: that played like summer lightning over any topic that was started

b4-024-s007.gloss: 那份曾像夏日闪电般点亮任何话题的才思，如今何在？
b4-024-s007.whyLearn: 两个 that 各引一个定语从句，一个修饰 fancy 一个修饰 topic，练会分层断句。

b4-024-s008.skeleton: The man's face that was so mobile is set now

modifiers.text: gone is the light from his fine eyes

b4-024-s008.gloss: 他从前表情丰富的脸如今僵住了，眼里的光也熄了。
b4-024-s008.whyLearn: 被动 is set 与倒装 gone is 连用写人物衰老，句式与内容贴合，值得模仿。

modifiers.text: that A (our host) is a thoroughly good fellow

b4-024-s009.gloss: 他说A（我们的东道主）是个十足的好人。
b4-024-s009.whyLearn: 宾语从句中间插进括号补充说明，练会跳过插入成分，抓住从句主干。

modifiers.text: that she is one of the most charming women he has ever known
of the most charming women he has ever known

b4-024-s012.gloss: 接着他又说，她是他见过的最迷人的女性之一。
b4-024-s012.whyLearn: one of the + 最高级 + 省略关系词的定语从句，是评价人物常用的高级句式。

b4-024-s014.gloss: 他对着我大声念道：“国王的纹章”。
b4-024-s014.whyLearn: read aloud to sb 后接冒号引出的直接引语，练会朗读动词带引语的常见说法。

b3-047-s023.skeleton: The drill will be stored in the towerand will have to be lowered
b3-047-s023.gloss: 钻头存塔内，须下放一万五千英尺水下才能开工
b3-047-s023.whyLearn: 一句里叠了一般将来时、被动语态、have to 和 before 从句，是科技说明文压缩长句的典型样本。

b3-047-s024.skeleton: there will be a laboratory, living accommodation and a helicopter landing station

modifiers.text: a laboratory, living accommodation and a helicopter landing station

b3-047-s024.gloss: 塔内将设有实验室、生活舱和直升机停机坪
b3-047-s024.whyLearn: there be 的将来时接三项并列名词，可顺带记住并列项只在最后一项前加 and，以及地点状语前置。

b3-047-s025.skeleton: Keeping the platform in position at sea will give rise to further problems

modifiers.text: Keeping the platform in position at sea

b3-047-s025.gloss: 让平台在海上保持定位将带来更多难题
b3-047-s025.whyLearn: 动名词短语充当主语，谓语用 give rise to 这一正式搭配；主语长谓语短的句法平衡值得留意。

b3-047-s026.skeleton: scientists will have to devise methods
b3-047-s026.gloss: 为此科学家须设计出用雷达和水下电视的方法
b3-047-s026.whyLearn: 句首不定式表目的，句末分词短语后置修饰 methods，两个非谓语同现是科技文的常见压缩手段。

b3-047-s027.skeleton: it must be possible to re-insert it

modifiers.text: If, during the operations the drill has to be withdrawn

b3-047-s027.gloss: 若作业中钻头须取出，就必须能重新放回
b3-047-s027.whyLearn: 真实条件从句被 during the operations 插入打断，主句用 must be possible to 结构，练从句与主句的切分。

modifiers.text: that villagers in remote places are friendly and hospitable

b3-048-s002.gloss: 我们总以为偏远地方的村民友善又好客
b3-048-s002.whyLearn: assume that 从句是表达成见的常用句式，in remote places 后置修饰 villagers，别误当成谓语。

b3-048-s004.skeleton: Visits to really remote villages are seldom enjoyable

modifiers.text: --as my wife and I discovered during a tour through the Balkans
during a tour through the Balkans

b3-048-s004.gloss: 去极偏远村庄的旅行很少愉快，巴尔干之行便是证明
b3-048-s004.whyLearn: to 短语作后置定语，破折号后 as 从句补充亲历证据，可学先下判断再给佐证的行文节奏。

b3-048-s005.skeleton: We had spent several days in a small town and visited a number of old churches

modifiers.text: and visited a number of old churches in the vicinity

b3-048-s005.gloss: 我们在小镇待了几天，参观了附近不少老教堂
b3-048-s005.whyLearn: 两个并列谓语共用一个主语，and 后省略 had，可看清过去完成时与一般过去时的搭配与省略。

b3-048-s007.skeleton: several bus loads of tourists descended on the town

modifiers.text: On the day before our departure

b3-048-s007.gloss: 我们离开前一天，几车游客涌进了小镇
b3-048-s007.whyLearn: the day before 加名词所有格表示时间点，descend on 生动写出人群涌入，可整块用于叙事开头。

modifiers.text: Taking a path which led out of the town
which led out of the town
until we came to a dense wood

b3-048-s009.gloss: 我们沿出镇的小路走过几片田野，直到一片密林
b3-048-s009.whyLearn: 分词短语前置作状语，中间嵌定语从句，结尾接 until 从句，一句串起三种修饰结构。

b3-048-s010.skeleton: We expected the path to end abruptly, but we found

modifiers.text: but we found that it traced its way through the trees
that it traced its way through the trees

b3-048-s010.gloss: 我们本以为小路会突然到头，却发现它穿过树林延伸
b3-048-s010.whyLearn: expect 加宾语加不定式，与 find 加 that 从句形成预期和发现的对照，but 连接两种不同句型。

b3-048-s011.skeleton: We tramped through the wood for over two hours

modifiers.text: until we arrived at a deep stream

b3-048-s011.gloss: 我们在林中跋涉两个多小时，来到一条深溪边
b3-048-s011.whyLearn: for 加时长与 until 从句并用，同时交代持续时间和终点，是叙事推进路线的标准组合。

b3-048-s013.skeleton: Suddenly my wife spotted a boat
b3-048-s013.gloss: 突然，我妻子发现一条拴在岸边的小船
b3-048-s013.whyLearn: spot 后接名词加过去分词短语作后置定语，相当于省略 which was，学名词后置修饰的压缩写法。

b3-048-s015.skeleton: We gently woke him up and asked him to ferry us

modifiers.text: and asked him to ferry us to the other side
to ferry us to the other side

b3-048-s015.gloss: 我们轻轻唤醒他，请他摆渡到对岸去
b3-048-s015.whyLearn: wake up 的代词宾语必须夹在中间，ask sb to do 接不定式，两个动词短语的用法可一并记住。

b3-048-s016.skeleton: we eventually persuaded him to take us

modifiers.text: Though he was reluctant to do so at first

b3-048-s016.gloss: 尽管他起初不情愿，我们最终说服他载我们
b3-048-s016.whyLearn: Though 让步从句配 persuade sb to do，其中 reluctant to do so 回指前文动作，是避免重复的好办法。

b3-048-s017.skeleton: The path led to a tiny village

modifiers.text: perched on the steep sides of a mountain
on the steep sides of a mountain

b3-048-s017.gloss: 小路通向一座坐落在陡峭山坡上的小村庄
b3-048-s017.whyLearn: 过去分词短语 perched 后置修饰 village，几个词就补出村庄的高险位置，写景很省笔墨。

b2-079-s001.skeleton: I used to travel by air a great deal
b2-079-s001.gloss: 我小时候常坐飞机出行。
b2-079-s001.whyLearn: used to 加动词原形表过去习惯，when 从句交代时间背景，是讲童年往事的典型句式。

b2-079-s002.skeleton: My parents, used to live in South America

modifiers.text: and I used to fly there from Europe in the holidays

b2-079-s002.gloss: 父母住南美，我假期从欧洲飞去看他们。
b2-079-s002.whyLearn: 两个 used to 由 and 并列，说明过去反复发生的动作，注意前后分句结构对称。

modifiers.text: that there was a very important person on board

b2-079-s008.gloss: 后来我们得知机上有一位要人。
b2-079-s008.whyLearn: learn that 引出宾语从句，从句用 there be 存在句交代情况，是转述消息的常用组合。

b2-080-s005.skeleton: There was also a great deal of machinery
b2-080-s005.whyLearn: a great deal of 修饰不可数名词 machinery，与 there be 结构配合描写展品数量。

b2-080-s007.skeleton: steam boats carried thousands of visitors

modifiers.text: Though in those days, travelling was not as easy as it is today

b2-080-s007.gloss: 当年渡船仍把成千上万欧洲游客送过海峡。
b2-080-s007.whyLearn: Though 让步从句用 not as easy as it is today 对比今昔，主句再用一般过去时陈述事实。

b2-080-s009.skeleton: There were six million visitors in all

modifiers.text: and the profits from the exhibition were used to build museums and colleges

b2-080-s009.gloss: 共六百万参观者，展览收益用于建馆办学。
b2-080-s009.whyLearn: be used to build 是被动语态加不定式，表资金被用于某事，别与 used to do 过去习惯混淆。

b2-081-s011.skeleton: The prisoner felt sorry for him

modifiers.text: but there was nothing else he could do

b2-081-s011.gloss: 囚犯替他难过，却也无可奈何。
b2-081-s011.whyLearn: nothing else he could do 是省略关系词的定语从句，配合 but 分句表达无能为力。

b2-081-s013.whyLearn: 句首现在分词短语作伴随状语，主句用 as quickly as he could 表示尽全力开快。

modifiers.text: Though people have often laughed at stories told by seamen
that many of these 'monsters' which have at times been sighted are simply strange fish
which have at times been sighted

b2-082-s002.gloss: 如今已知所谓海怪不过是怪鱼。
b2-082-s002.whyLearn: Though 让步从句加 it is known that 被动结构，中间再套 which 定语从句，层层包裹。

b2-082-s007.skeleton: it was found to be over thirteen feet long

modifiers.text: When it was eventually brought to shore
to be over thirteen feet long

b2-082-s007.gloss: 它被拖上岸后，发现身长超过十三英尺。
b2-082-s007.whyLearn: When 从句用被动语态，主句 be found to be 后接不定式说明测量结果。

b2-082-s008.skeleton: It had a head like a horse, big blue eyes, shining silver skin, and a bright red tail

modifiers.text: big blue eyes, shining silver skin, and a bright red tail
The fish, which has since been sent to a museum where it is being examined by a scientist, is called an oarfish
which has since been sent to a museum where it is being examined by a scientist

b2-082-s008.gloss: 它形似马，蓝眼银皮红尾，名叫桨鱼。
b2-082-s008.whyLearn: 先并列铺陈外形，再用非限定定语从句补叙鱼的去向，最后点出名称与学名。

b2-083-s005.skeleton: the policeman on duty told him

modifiers.text: When he asked if Mr Lane lived there
that since his defeat, the ex-Prime Minister had gone abroad

b2-083-s005.gloss: 值班警员告诉他，前首相落选后已出国。
b2-083-s005.whyLearn: ask if 的间接疑问句作宾语，主句用 that 从句配过去完成时交代更早发生的事。

b2-084-s006.skeleton: Many owners of private cars are going to offer 'free rides'

modifiers.text: to people on their way to work

b2-084-s006.gloss: 许多私家车主将向上班族提供免费搭车。
b2-084-s006.whyLearn: be going to 表计划，of private cars 与 on their way to work 分别限定车主和乘客。

b2-084-s011.skeleton: people are going to find it difficult to get to work
b2-084-s011.gloss: 即便如此，人们上班仍会很困难。
b2-084-s011.whyLearn: find it difficult to do 用 it 作形式宾语、不定式后置，Even so 承接上文表示转折。

b2-085-s003.skeleton: All those who have contributed towards the gift will sign their names

modifiers.text: who have contributed towards the gift
which will be sent to the headmaster's home

b2-085-s003.gloss: 所有送礼者将在纪念册上签名，册子寄往校长家。
b2-085-s003.whyLearn: who 从句限定 All those，which 从句修饰 album，一句话里前后两处后置修饰。

modifiers.text: for, as he has often remarked, one is never too old to learn

b2-085-s009.gloss: 但这无妨，正如他所言，学无止境。
b2-085-s009.whyLearn: for 引出原因分句，as 从句插入其中作补充，never too old to learn 是名言式表达。

b1-061-s001.gloss: 顾客说自己在这儿买了两本贵词典。
b1-061-s001.whyLearn: bought 是 buy 的不规则过去式，后接 two+名词复数；expensive 作定语放在名词前修饰 dictionaries。

modifiers.text: who is standing behind the counter

b1-061-s003.gloss: 指柜台后面站着的那位女士。
b1-061-s003.whyLearn: 先行词是人，用 who 引导定语从句；is standing 是现在进行时，说出此刻正站着的状态。

b1-061-s005.gloss: 指柜台上放着的那几本书。
b1-061-s005.whyLearn: 先行词是物，关系代词用 which 而不是 who；复数 books 配 are，be on 表示“在……上面”。

modifiers.text: he's the man who bought these books

b1-061-s007.gloss: 他说他就是买下这些书的人。
b1-061-s007.whyLearn: says 后是宾语从句，连接词 that 被省略；从句里又套一个 who 引导的定语从句，都用过去时 bought。

b1-061-s009.skeleton: The man whom I served was wearing a hat.
b1-061-s009.gloss: 我招待过的那位男士当时戴着帽子。
b1-061-s009.whyLearn: 先行词 the man 作 served 的宾语，关系代词用 whom 且不省略；主句用过去进行时描摹当时的穿着。

b1-062-s003.gloss: 鲍勃让比尔把东西给他看看。
b1-062-s003.whyLearn: 祈使句以动词原形开头，省略主语 you；let me see 是“让我看看”的固定说法，称呼 Bill 放句末。

b1-062-s006.gloss: 他们是我旅行途中认识的人。
b1-062-s006.whyLearn: 定语从句省略了关系代词 whom/that，先行词 people 后直接接 I met；during the trip 交代认识的场合。

b1-062-s007.gloss: 那就是我们乘过的那条船。
b1-062-s007.whyLearn: 关系代词被省略，介词 on 留在从句末尾，形成“介词后置”的定语从句；travel on a ship 是固定搭配。

b1-062-s010.gloss: 那就是我跟你提过的那个人。
b1-062-s010.whyLearn: tell sb about sb 的介词 about 留在句尾，关系代词省略；told 是 tell 的过去式，双宾语语序要记牢。

modifiers.text: who offered you a job in Australia

b1-062-s013.gloss: 就是那个在澳大利亚给你工作的人。
b1-062-s013.whyLearn: 先行词 the one 指人，用 who 引导；offer sb a job 是双宾搭配，in Australia 在从句里补充地点。

b1-062-s017.whyLearn: 陈述部分否定，附加问句就用肯定形式 is it；主语用代词 it，回指前文谈到的人或物。

b1-062-s019.skeleton: I grew a beard during the trip, but I shaved it off
b1-062-s019.gloss: 我旅行时留了胡子，回家就刮了。
b1-062-s019.whyLearn: but 连接两个并列的过去时句子，构成前后对比；when 引导时间状语从句，shave off 是“刮掉”的动词短语。

b1-062-s021.whyLearn: didn’t 后接动词原形 like，不能再用过去式；My 是形容词性物主代词，直接放在名词前表示所属。

b1-063-s001.skeleton: Can't you come in and have tea now
b1-063-s001.gloss: 苏珊问彼得现在能不能进来喝茶。
b1-063-s001.whyLearn: 否定形式的 can’t 提问语气更像邀请；come in 与 have tea 由 and 并列，共用前面的情态动词 can。

b1-063-s003.whyLearn: must 后接动词原形，water 在这里是动词“浇水”而不是名词；first 作副词说明做事次序。

b1-063-s009.skeleton: Last summer it was very dry
b1-063-s009.gloss: 去年夏天天气也非常干旱。
b1-063-s009.whyLearn: was 是 is 的过去式，主语 it 指天气；句末 too 表示“也”，只用于肯定句，位置固定在句尾。

b4-039-s001.skeleton: In his own lifetime Galileo was the centre of violent controversy;
b4-039-s001.gloss: 伽利略生前深陷激烈争论之中。
b4-039-s001.whyLearn: In his own lifetime 是时间状语，his own 用所有格强调“他本人”，换主语时只需改 his。

b4-039-s002.skeleton: it is only in modern times that Galileo has become a problem child for historians of science.
b4-039-s002.gloss: 到了现代，伽利略反倒成了科学史家的难题。
b4-039-s002.whyLearn: it is ... that 强调时间状语，去掉后仍是完整句；problem child 是比喻义，比 problem 更形象。

b4-039-s003.skeleton: The old view of Galileo was delightfully uncomplicated.
b4-039-s003.gloss: 过去人们对伽利略的看法简单得令人愉快。
b4-039-s003.whyLearn: delightfully 修饰形容词而非动词，这种副词用法能让评价句更简洁，可换成 refreshingly、surprisingly。

b4-039-s008.skeleton: among historians of science a new and more sophisticated picture has emerged.

modifiers.text: although the old Galileo lives on in many popular writings,

b4-039-s008.gloss: 通俗读物里旧的伽利略形象仍在，但学界已有新看法。
b4-039-s008.whyLearn: although 从句放主句前形成让步对比；live on 指“继续存在”，主语与主句的 picture 并不一致，对比意味强。

b4-039-s009.skeleton: our sympathy for Balileo' s opponents has grown somewhat.
b4-039-s009.gloss: 同时我们对伽利略对手的同情增加了一些。
b4-039-s009.whyLearn: at the same time 是连接性状语；somewhat 为程度副词，置于句末，可换 slightly。

b4-040-s002.skeleton: the relation between population and resources is already unfavourable and will probably become even more unfavourable in the future.

modifiers.text: In most parts of the world,

b4-040-s002.gloss: 多数地区人口与资源的关系已很不利，将来可能更糟。
b4-040-s002.whyLearn: 一个主语带 is 与 will become 两个谓语，形成现在到将来的递进；even more 叠加比较级，语气层层加重。

b4-040-s003.skeleton: This growing poverty in the midst of growing poverty constitutes a permanent menace to peace.

modifiers.text: in the midst of growing poverty

b4-040-s003.gloss: 在普遍贫困之中日益加深的贫困，长期威胁和平。
b4-040-s003.whyLearn: growing 两次出现，一次作定语一次作介词宾语，重复中见修辞；constitute 比 be 更正式，适合议论性写作。

b4-040-s005.skeleton: overpopulation is not compatib1e with freedom.
b4-040-s005.gloss: 因为人口过剩与自由无法并存。
b4-040-s005.whyLearn: For 居句首引出原因，比 because 更书面；be compatible with 是固定搭配，注意原文拼写用数字 1。

b4-040-s007.skeleton: Labour is more abundant than goods, and the individual is compelled to work long hours for little pay.

modifiers.text: to work long hours for little pay

b4-040-s007.gloss: 劳动力比货物更充裕，个人被迫长时间低薪工作。
b4-040-s007.whyLearn: 前半用比较级对比，后半用被动加不定式说明被迫的结果，两分句形成经济状况的因果链。

b4-040-s008.skeleton: No surplus of accumulated purchasing power stands between him and the tyrannies of unfriendly nature or of the equally unfriendly wielders of political and economic power.

modifiers.text: between him and the tyrannies of unfriendly nature or of the equally unfriendly wielders of political and economic power
the equally unfriendly wielders of political and economic power

b4-040-s008.gloss: 他没有积蓄可依靠，只能直接面对自然与权势的压迫。
b4-040-s008.whyLearn: 否定词 No 置于句首主语位置构成全句否定；stand between A and B 形象写出毫无缓冲的处境。

b4-040-s009.skeleton: Democracy is, among other things, the ability to say 'no' to the boss.
b4-040-s009.gloss: 民主的一个含义就是敢于对上司说不。
b4-040-s009.whyLearn: 插入语 among other things 表示“除此之外还有”；用不定式给抽象名词下定义，是典型的定义句式。

b4-040-s012.skeleton: In an overcrowded country, very few people own enough to make them financially independent;

modifiers.text: very few are in a position to accumulate purchasing power;
and there is no free land.

b4-040-s012.gloss: 人口过密的国家里几乎无人能经济独立，也没有空地。
b4-040-s012.whyLearn: 三个分句用分号加 and 并列，层层递进说明贫困的成因；there is no free land 用存在句收尾，干净有力。

b4-041-s001.skeleton: Education is one of the key words of our time

modifiers.text: of the key words of our time

b4-041-s001.gloss: 教育是当今时代的关键词之一。
b4-041-s001.whyLearn: one of the + 复数名词 是高频结构，谓语仍用单数 is；of our time 用所有格式的 of 短语限定范围。

b4-041-s002.skeleton: A man without an education, many of us believe, is an unfortunate victim of adverse circumstances deprived of one of the greatest twentieth-century opportunities.

modifiers.text: deprived of one of the greatest twentieth-century opportunities

b4-041-s002.gloss: 没受教育的人是不利环境的牺牲品，错失良机。
b4-041-s002.whyLearn: 插入语 many of us believe 插在主语和谓语之间，先陈述观点再给判断；过去分词短语后置作定语补充说明受害之处。

modifiers.text: with its cycles of instruction so carefully worked out, punctuated by text-books
what would civilization be like without its benefits ?

b4-041-s004.gloss: 教育有精心设计的课程和课本，没有它文明会是什么样？
b4-041-s004.whyLearn: 长插入语把 Education 与后面的问句隔开，读时要注意主干；破折号内是同位语，给 text-books 一个比喻。

b4-041-s006.skeleton: We would lay less stress on 'facts and figures'

modifiers.text: and more on a good memory, on applied psychology, and on the capacity of a man to get along with his fellow-citizens.
of a man to get along with his fellow-citizens

b4-041-s006.gloss: 我们会更看重记忆力、应用心理学和与人相处的能力。
b4-041-s006.whyLearn: less ... and more ... 是成对的比较结构，四个 on 短语层层并列；lay stress on 是“强调”的固定搭配。

b1-072-s006.gloss: 上周三我去树林里散步。
b1-072-s006.whyLearn: 时间状语Last Wednesday置于句首用逗号隔开，went后接for a walk，是叙述过去经历的典型开头。

b1-072-s007.skeleton: What I saw made me very sad
b1-072-s007.gloss: 我看到的景象让我十分难过。
b1-072-s007.whyLearn: 主语由What I saw这一从句充当，谓语made后接宾语me和形容词补语very sad，是make接复合宾语的典型。

modifiers.text: seven old cars and three old refrigerators

b1-072-s008.gloss: 我数到七辆旧车和三台旧冰箱。
b1-072-s008.whyLearn: 宾语由and连接的两个并列名词短语构成，用数词加形容词加复数名词清点事物，结构对称好模仿。

modifiers.text: and the ground was covered with pieces of paper, cigarette-ends, old tyres, empty bottles and rusty tins
with pieces of paper, cigarette-ends, old tyres, empty bottles and rusty tins

b1-072-s009.gloss: 垃圾桶是空的，地面却满是垃圾。
b1-072-s009.whyLearn: 两个分句用and并列形成对比：前句were empty，后句用被动was covered with，再接一长串名词铺陈垃圾之多。

modifiers.text: " Anyone who leaves litter in these woods will be prosecuted.
who leaves litter in these woods

b1-072-s010.gloss: 在垃圾堆里我发现一块牌子，上面写着警告。
b1-072-s010.whyLearn: 主句I found a sign后接which定语从句，引语中who从句限定Anyone，谓语用将来时被动。

b2-001-s001.whyLearn: 时间状语Last week直接置于句首不加逗号，go to the theatre是固定搭配，theatre是英式拼写。

b2-001-s002.skeleton: I had a very good seat
b2-001-s002.whyLearn: have a good seat表示座位好，seat是可数名词前加a，副词very修饰good，had说明当时的情况。

b2-001-s005.skeleton: A young man and a young woman were sitting

modifiers.text: A young man and a young woman

b2-001-s005.gloss: 一男一女两个年轻人坐在我后面。
b2-001-s005.whyLearn: 主语是and连接的两个并列名词短语，谓语用过去进行时were sitting，表示当时正在发生的动作。

modifiers.text: at the man and the woman

b2-001-s010.gloss: 我生气地看了看那一男一女。
b2-001-s010.whyLearn: look是不及物动词，必须说look at再加宾语；副词angrily放句末修饰looked，是状语的常见落点。

b2-001-s011.skeleton: They did not pay any attention
b2-001-s011.whyLearn: 过去时否定用did not加动词原形pay，肯定句中的some在否定句里换成any，pay attention是固定搭配。

b2-001-s016.gloss: 年轻人粗鲁地说这不关我的事。
b2-001-s016.whyLearn: 直接引语在前、转述主句在后，用逗号隔开；none of your business是与你无关的固定说法，rudely修饰said。

b2-002-s003.gloss: 我有时在床上躺到午饭时间。
b2-002-s003.whyLearn: 一般现在时配sometimes表示习惯，in bed不加冠词指卧床，until lunch time点出动作持续到的时间终点。

b2-002-s004.whyLearn: 时间状语Last Sunday置于句首，get up的过去式是got up，very late放句末说明起床晚的程度。

b2-002-s005.whyLearn: look out of the window表示朝窗外看，out of是复合介词，不能省略成look out the window。

b2-002-s012.whyLearn: 引语用现在完成时I've just arrived强调刚到，转述动词said用过去时，by train前不加冠词。

b2-002-s014.whyLearn: 引语中现在进行时am having breakfast配still强调动作仍在继续，转述主句I said用过去时，时态不必一致。

b3-037-s004.skeleton: an exceptionally heavy snow fall might temporarily dislocate railway services
b3-037-s004.gloss: 只有特大暴雪才会暂时打乱铁路运行。
b3-037-s004.whyLearn: only 置于名词主语前起限定作用，might 表可能性较低，比 can 更弱，适合练习情态动词的推测用法。

b3-037-s008.skeleton: It went direct from my local station and the journey lasted a mere hour and seventeen minutes

modifiers.text: and the journey lasted a mere hour and seventeen minutes

b3-037-s008.gloss: 这趟车从我本地小站直达，全程只用了一小时十七分钟。
b3-037-s008.whyLearn: and 连接两个一般过去时的并列分句；direct 在此作副词表“直达”，a mere 强调耗时之短。

b3-037-s010.skeleton: this did not strike me as odd
b3-037-s010.gloss: 当时我并没觉得这有什么奇怪。
b3-037-s010.whyLearn: strike sb as + 形容词表“给人某种印象”，否定用 did not，注意 strike 的过去式与原形同形。

modifiers.text: that there must be a great many people besides myself who wished to take advantage of this excellent service
who wished to take advantage of this excellent service
to take advantage of this excellent service

b3-037-s011.gloss: 我想到，除我之外想利用这趟优质列车的人一定很多。
b3-037-s011.whyLearn: reflect that 引出间接陈述；must be 表肯定推测，a great many 后接复数名词，who 从句修饰 people。

b3-037-s013.skeleton: a mighty express train can be held up by signals
b3-037-s013.gloss: 即便是动力强大的特快列车，也可能被信号拦下。
b3-037-s013.whyLearn: can be + 过去分词构成情态动词的被动式，hold up 意为“阻滞、耽误”，even 加强让步语气。

modifiers.text: that this express was not roaring down the line at ninety miles an hour, but barely chugging along at thirty
not roaring down the line at ninety miles an hour, but barely chugging along at thirty

b3-037-s015.gloss: 我这才明白车不是飞驰九十英里，而是三十英里慢行。
b3-037-s015.whyLearn: It dawned on me that 表“我渐渐明白”，that 从句是真正主语；not...but 并列两个分词短语对比速度。

b3-037-s016.skeleton: One hour and seventeen minutes passed and we had not even covered half the distance
b3-037-s016.gloss: 一小时十七分钟过去，我们连一半路程都没走完。
b3-037-s016.whyLearn: and 连接两个并列分句，not even 加强否定，had not covered 用过去完成时强调到那时仍未完成。

b3-037-s022.skeleton: he told me to look again
b3-037-s022.gloss: 他匆匆瞥了一眼，就让我再看一遍。
b3-037-s022.whyLearn: 句首现在分词短语作时间状语，逻辑主语与主句主语 he 一致；tell sb to do sth 用不定式作宾补。

b3-037-s023.skeleton: A tiny asterisk conducted me to a footnote

modifiers.text: at the bottom of the page

b3-037-s023.gloss: 一个小小的星号把我引到页脚的注释。
b3-037-s023.whyLearn: conduct sb to sth 本指“引导某人去某处”，这里用于无生命的星号，形成拟人化表达，at the bottom of 表方位。

b3-037-s024.gloss: 上面写着：本服务已暂停。
b3-037-s024.whyLearn: said 后直接跟引语，省略了连词；has been suspended 是现在完成时的被动语态，强调持续到现在的状态。

b3-038-s001.skeleton: Future historians will be in a unique position
b3-038-s001.gloss: 未来的历史学家将处于一种独特的地位。
b3-038-s001.whyLearn: will be 后接介词短语作表语；when 引导时间状语从句，主句用一般将来时，从句用一般现在时表将来。

modifiers.text: which facts to select from the great mass of evidence that steadily accumulates
from the great mass of evidence that steadily accumulates

b3-038-s002.gloss: 他们很难从不断累积的海量证据中挑出该选哪些事实。
b3-038-s002.whyLearn: hardly 表否定；疑问词 which 加不定式作 know 的宾语，that 从句修饰 evidence，从句用一般现在时。

b3-038-s003.skeleton: they will not have to rely solely on the written word
b3-038-s003.gloss: 而且，他们不必只依赖书面文字。
b3-038-s003.whyLearn: What is more 作插入语表递进；have to 的否定将来式为 will not have to，rely on 后接名词作宾语。

b3-038-s004.skeleton: Films, gramophone records, and magnetic tapes will provide them with a bewildering amount of information

modifiers.text: with a bewildering amount of information

b3-038-s004.gloss: 电影、唱片和磁带将为他们提供海量信息。
b3-038-s004.whyLearn: 三个名词并列作主语，注意并列项之间的逗号与 and；provide sb with sth 是固定搭配，amount 修饰不可数名词。

modifiers.text: to see and hear us in action

b3-038-s005.gloss: 可以说，他们能够看到并听到我们活动的情形。
b3-038-s005.whyLearn: as it were 是插入语，意为“可以说”，不充当句子成分；be able to 后接 see 和 hear 两个并列不定式。

b2-082-s004.gloss: 不久前，一条奇特的鱼在马达加斯加附近被捕获
b2-082-s004.whyLearn: however 插在主语前表转折，被动语态省去施动者，near 短语交代地点，叙事开头三件套

modifiers.text: as it pulled on the line

b2-082-s005.gloss: 小船被大鱼拖到数英里外的海上
b2-082-s005.whyLearn: 被动语态说船被拖走，by 引出施动者，as 从句补充同时发生的动作，miles 直接量化距离

modifiers.text: Realizing that this was no ordinary fish
not to damage it in any way

b2-082-s006.gloss: 渔夫看出此鱼不寻常，尽力不伤到它
b2-082-s006.whyLearn: 现在分词短语前置交代原因，effort 后接否定不定式，in any way 把不伤害推到极致

b2-082-s009.skeleton: Such creatures have rarely been seen

modifiers.text: as they live at a depth of six hundred feet
at a depth of six hundred feet

b2-082-s009.gloss: 此类生物栖于六百英尺深处，人难见活体
b2-082-s009.whyLearn: rarely 配完成时被动表示罕见，alive 作主语补足语，as 从句用现在时说明常态原因

b2-083-s001.skeleton: The former Prime Minister, Mr Wentworth Lane, was defeated
b2-083-s001.gloss: 前首相温特沃思·莱恩在最近选举中落败
b2-083-s001.whyLearn: 同位语用逗号插入补充人名，被动语态加 in the recent elections 交代落败场合

b2-083-s002.skeleton: He is now retiring from political life and has gone abroad
b2-083-s002.gloss: 他正退出政坛，现在已经出国
b2-083-s002.whyLearn: 同一主语用 and 并列进行时与完成时，前句写正在退出，后句写已经离境

b2-083-s003.skeleton: My friend, Crawley, has always been a fanatical opponent

modifiers.text: of Mr Lane's Radical Progressive Party

b2-083-s003.gloss: 我的朋友克劳利一向激烈反对莱恩的激进进步党
b2-083-s003.whyLearn: 同位语点出姓名，always 配现在完成时强调长期立场，of 所有格串起党派全称

modifiers.text: to the former Prime Minister's house

b2-083-s004.gloss: 选举过后，克劳利去了前首相的住所
b2-083-s004.whyLearn: after 短语置句首交代时间，所有格表示住所，主干只剩 went 的简洁叙事

b2-083-s006.gloss: 第二天，克劳利又去了那所房子
b2-083-s006.whyLearn: On the following day 是 next day 的书面说法，again 暗示动作反复发生

b2-083-s007.skeleton: The same policeman was just walking

modifiers.text: when Crawley asked the same question

b2-083-s007.gloss: 同一警察正慢慢走过门口，克劳利又发问
b2-083-s007.whyLearn: 过去进行时铺背景动作，when 表这时突然发生，past 作介词表示从旁经过

b2-083-s008.skeleton: the policeman gave him the same answer

modifiers.text: Though a little suspicious this time

b2-083-s008.gloss: 警察这次虽有些怀疑，仍给了相同回答
b2-083-s008.whyLearn: though 引导让步状语并省略主语和 be，主句用过去时交代结果，a little 弱化怀疑程度

modifiers.text: and asked exactly the same question

b2-083-s009.gloss: 隔天克劳利又去那房子，问了相同问题
b2-083-s009.whyLearn: the day after 与 once more 双重表达又一次，and 并列第二个谓语 asked，叙事紧密

b2-083-s010.gloss: 这一次，警察终于发火了
b2-083-s010.whyLearn: lose one's temper 是发脾气的固定说法，This time 与前文重复形成对照并收束情节

modifiers.text: yesterday and the day before yesterday
Mr Lane was defeated in the elections

b2-083-s011.gloss: 他吼道，我昨天前天都告诉过你，莱恩落选了
b2-083-s011.whyLearn: he shouted 把引语从中打断，the day before yesterday 表前天，从句用被动加过去时

b2-083-s012.gloss: 他已退出政坛，出国生活去了
b2-083-s012.whyLearn: has 后并列 retired 与 gone 共用完成时，gone to live 用不定式说明出国后的生活

modifiers.text: but I love to hear you say it

b2-083-s013.gloss: 克劳利答我知道，可我就爱听你说这句
b2-083-s013.whyLearn: 引语分置主语前后并构成倒装，but 引出真正笑点，love to do 表乐于听到

b2-041-s008.gloss: 妻子说我不该说那句话。
b2-041-s008.whyLearn: needn't have said 表示“本不必说却说了”，是情态动词对过去的责备，与 didn't need to 语气不同。

b2-041-s010.whyLearn: find + 宾语 + 形容词，表示“觉得某物如何”，如 find it beautiful；引语用现在时，转述动词用过去时。

b2-041-s013.gloss: 十分钟后我们一起走出了那家店。
b2-041-s013.whyLearn: out of 强调从内部向外的移动，不能换成 out；Ten minutes later 置句首是叙事中推进时间的常用写法。

b2-041-s014.skeleton: My wife was wearing a hat
b2-041-s014.gloss: 我妻子戴着一顶像灯塔的帽子。
b2-041-s014.whyLearn: look like 是“看起来像”的固定搭配；过去进行时描绘当时持续的装扮，从句用一般过去时，时态搭配典型。

modifiers.text: at the other side of the square
so we went to have a look at him
to have a look at him

b2-042-s002.gloss: 过了一会儿我们注意到广场对面的耍蛇人，便去看他。
b2-042-s002.whyLearn: so 连接并列分句表结果，避免只用 and；with 短语与 at the other side of 层层后置修饰，值得模仿其信息铺排。

b2-042-s005.skeleton: It rose out of the basket

modifiers.text: and began to follow the movements of the pipe

b2-042-s005.gloss: 蛇从篮子里升起，开始随笛声摆动。
b2-042-s005.whyLearn: begin to do 后接不定式表示开始做某事；and 并列两个过去时谓语，后一分句承前省略主语 It。

modifiers.text: when the snake charmer suddenly began to play jazz tunes and modern pop songs
to play jazz tunes and modern pop songs

b2-042-s006.gloss: 耍蛇人突然吹起爵士和流行曲，我们很吃惊。
b2-042-s006.whyLearn: be very much surprised 用 much 加强而非 very 单独修饰；when 从句点明吃惊的时点，主句与从句都用过去时。

b2-042-s007.skeleton: The snake, however, continued to 'dance' slowly
b2-042-s007.gloss: 然而那条蛇仍继续缓缓“舞动”。
b2-042-s007.whyLearn: however 插在主语和谓语之间、两侧加逗号，是书面语常见的转折插入语，位置与 but 完全不同。

b2-042-s008.skeleton: It obviously could not tell the difference
b2-042-s008.gloss: 它显然分不清印度音乐和爵士乐。
b2-042-s008.whyLearn: tell the difference between A and B 是“分辨两者”的实用句型，tell 在此意为“辨别”而非“告诉”。

modifiers.text: three years after his flight over the North Pole

b2-043-s001.gloss: 1929年，飞越北极三年后，这位美国探险家R。
b2-043-s001.whyLearn: 传记式叙述常把时间状语层层前置，再给出主语；explorer 后用同位语补出人名，是典型的新闻体写法。

b2-043-s007.skeleton: Byrd at once ordered his men

modifiers.text: to throw out two heavy food sacks

b2-043-s007.gloss: 伯德立刻命令手下扔出两袋重食物。
b2-043-s007.whyLearn: order sb to do sth 是“命令某人做某事”的必备句型，必须用不定式，不能接 that 从句。

b2-043-s008.skeleton: The plane was then able to rise

modifiers.text: and it cleared the mountains by 400 feet

b2-043-s008.gloss: 飞机得以升空，并以400英尺越过群山。
b2-043-s008.whyLearn: be able to 强调过去某一次成功做到，此处不能换成 could；by 400 feet 表示“以…之差”的度量说法。

b2-043-s010.skeleton: The aircraft was able to fly

modifiers.text: to fly over the endless white plains without difficulty

b2-043-s010.gloss: 飞机能毫不费力地飞越无垠雪原。
b2-043-s010.whyLearn: was able to 表过去某次真正做成的事；without + 抽象名词是简洁的状语，比 easily 更正式。

b2-044-s002.skeleton: They had rushed up to her

modifiers.text: while she was having a picnic at the edge of a forest with her children
and tried to steal her handbag
at the edge of a forest

b2-044-s002.gloss: 她带孩子野餐时，他们冲上来想抢包。
b2-044-s002.whyLearn: while 从句用过去进行时铺背景，主句 had rushed 与 tried 并列，展示叙事中过去完成时与一般过去时的分工。

modifiers.text: and, with the bag in their possession, both men started running through the trees
with the bag in their possession

b2-044-s003.gloss: 争夺中带子断了，两人拿着包跑进树林。
b2-044-s003.whyLearn: with + 宾语 + 介词短语构成 with 复合结构作伴随状语；and 前逗号位置决定第二个分句的读法，值得留意。

b3-007-s018.skeleton: The child looked around for a moment and said
b3-007-s018.gloss: 孩子环顾片刻，说他们都疯了。
b3-007-s018.whyLearn: looked、said 用过去时叙述动作，引号里的 they're 用现在时，一句里两种时态各管一层。

b3-008-s006.skeleton: the Pass is less dangerous, but each year, the dogs are still sent out into the snow

modifiers.text: Now that a tunnel has been built through the mountains
whenever a traveller is in difficulty

b3-008-s006.gloss: 隧道修通后山路仍险，雪中救援照常出动。
b3-008-s006.whyLearn: Now that 表原因、whenever 表随时；has been built 是完成被动，are sent 是一般现在被动。

b3-008-s007.skeleton: there are still a few people

modifiers.text: who rashly attempt to cross the Pass on foot

b3-008-s007.gloss: 虽有新隧道，仍有人冒失地徒步翻越山口。
b3-008-s007.whyLearn: Despite 后只接名词就表让步，who 定语从句修饰 people，a few 与 there be 搭配出『仍有少数』的语气。

modifiers.text: for it is visited by thousands of people who cross the Pass in cars
who cross the Pass in cars
As there are so many people about
the dogs have to be kept in a special enclosure

b3-008-s008.gloss: 夏季僧院很忙，人多时狗得关进专门的围栏。
b3-008-s008.whyLearn: for 引并列的原因分句，As 引原因状语从句，who 是定语从句；三种原因表达和被动 be kept 同现。

b3-009-s005.skeleton: they may solve a number of problems about Mars and provide information about the markings on its surface

modifiers.text: about the markings on its surface
which, nearly 100 years ago, the astronomer, Schiaparelli, thought to be canals

b3-009-s005.gloss: 照片若拍成功，或能解开火星斑纹之谜。
b3-009-s005.whyLearn: 主句 may 后并列两个动词；which 从句里夹着同位语和时间状语，thought to be 表过去时的判断。

b3-010-s002.skeleton: She was carrying 1316 passengers and a crew of 89l.
b3-010-s002.gloss: 她当时载着 1316 名乘客和 89 名船员。
b3-010-s002.whyLearn: 过去进行时交代当时船上的状态，数字后接 and 并列的宾语，crew 是另一个中心词。

b3-010-s004.skeleton: she was not only the largest ship

modifiers.text: for she had sixteen water- tight compartments

b3-010-s004.gloss: 当时它最大、被誉为不沉，且有十六个防水舱。
b3-010-s004.whyLearn: not only...but 连接两个谓语，that had ever been built 用过去完成被动，for 再补一层原因。

b3-010-s010.skeleton: there was a slight trembling sound from below, and the captain went down
b3-010-s010.gloss: 突然下方传来轻微震动声，船长下去查看。
b3-010-s010.whyLearn: and 并列存在句与动作句，went down to see 用不定式表目的，what 从句里用过去完成时。

b3-010-s011.skeleton: The noise had been so faint

modifiers.text: that no one thought that the ship had been damaged
that the ship had been damaged

b3-010-s011.gloss: 声响太轻，没人想到船已经受损。
b3-010-s011.whyLearn: so...that 引出结果，主句 had been 与 thought 后用过去完成被动，语气层层减弱。

modifiers.text: As there were not enough life-boats for everybody

b3-010-s014.gloss: 救生艇不够所有人用，一千五百人丧生。
b3-010-s014.whyLearn: As 引原因状语从句，从句是 there be 的否定式，主句用被动 were lost，损失由谁承受一目了然。

b3-011-s008.skeleton: 'Would you mind unlocking this suitcase please ?'
b3-011-s008.gloss: 请问您介意打开这个手提箱吗？
b3-011-s008.whyLearn: Would you mind 后接动名词是礼貌请求的固定句式，句末 please 让语气更缓和。

b3-011-s026.skeleton: He was greeted by an unpleasant smell

modifiers.text: which convinced him that I was telling the truth
that I was telling the truth

b3-011-s026.gloss: 一股难闻的气味让他相信我说的是真话。
b3-011-s026.whyLearn: was greeted by 是被动，which 定语从句里再套 that 宾语从句，was telling 用过去进行时。

b3-012-s003.skeleton: Life there is simple and good.
b3-012-s003.gloss: 那里的生活简单而美好。
b3-012-s003.whyLearn: there 紧跟名词作后置修饰，说明是哪里的生活；表语用 and 并列两个形容词。

b3-012-s008.skeleton: there is an element of truth in both these pictures

modifiers.text: but few of us have had the opportunity to find out

b3-012-s008.gloss: 两种说法也许各有一点道理，但少有人去验证。
b3-012-s008.whyLearn: there is 引存在句，but 后 few of us 加现在完成时，to find out 作后置定语，一句读出探究语气。

b3-012-s010.skeleton: They were taking a badly damaged boat
b3-012-s010.gloss: 他们正把损坏的船从维尔京群岛运往迈阿密修。
b3-012-s010.whyLearn: were taking 表当时正在进行，from...to 表航线，to have it repaired 是使役不定式表目的。

b3-012-s013.skeleton: There were hardly any trees on the island and there was no water, but this did not prove to be a problem
b3-012-s013.gloss: 岛上几乎没有树，也没有水，但这不算问题。
b3-012-s013.whyLearn: 两个 there be 句由 and 并列，hardly 与 no 双重否定，but 后用 prove to be 表达结果。

b2-065-s009.skeleton: we should arrest him, but as he has a good record, we shall let him off this time

modifiers.text: as he has a good record

b2-065-s009.gloss: 他记录良好，这次我们就放他一马。
b2-065-s009.whyLearn: but 连接两个并列分句，as 引导的原因状语从句插在中间，可学插入式原因从句与 shall 表将来。

b2-066-s001.skeleton: The Hatheld Puffin is a modern aero-plane, but its designer, Mr John Wimpenny, is finding it difficult to get it off the ground

modifiers.text: to get it off the ground

b2-066-s001.gloss: 这架飞机虽现代，却难以离地起飞。
b2-066-s001.whyLearn: 主语后插入同位语不影响主谓一致，find it difficult to do 用 it 作形式宾语，值得模仿。

b2-066-s002.skeleton: The reason for this is that this plane is also a bicycle

modifiers.text: that this plane is also a bicycle

b2-066-s002.gloss: 原因是这架飞机同时也是自行车。
b2-066-s002.whyLearn: The reason … is that … 是说明原因的固定句式，that 引导表语从句，不能用 because 替换。

b2-066-s003.skeleton: Its pilot has to pedal hard

modifiers.text: to get it into the air

b2-066-s003.gloss: 飞行员必须用力蹬踏才能升空。
b2-066-s003.whyLearn: have to 表客观必要，to get it into the air 作目的状语，可学 get + 宾语 + 介词短语的搭配。

b2-066-s005.skeleton: it was the first man-powered aircraft to fly half a mile
b2-066-s005.gloss: 它是1961年首架飞过半英里的人力飞机。
b2-066-s005.whyLearn: the first + 名词 + to do 表示第一件做到某事的事物，不定式作后置定语，是高频考点。

b2-066-s007.skeleton: Mr Wimpenny has had it rebuilt
b2-066-s007.gloss: 此后温彭尼先生请人把它重建了。
b2-066-s007.whyLearn: have sth done 表示请人做某事，与 since then 连用须用现在完成时，一句兼得两个重点。

b2-066-s009.skeleton: Many people have shown interest in this new and unusual sport

modifiers.text: in this new and unusual sport

b2-066-s009.gloss: 许多人对这项新奇运动产生了兴趣。
b2-066-s009.whyLearn: show interest in 是固定搭配，interest 后只能接 in 不能接 on，可用来表达兴趣类意思。

b2-067-s001.skeleton: Haroun Tazieff the Polish scientist, has spent his life-time studying active volcanoes and deep caves in all parts of the world

modifiers.text: studying active volcanoes and deep caves
in all parts of the world

b2-067-s001.gloss: 塔齐耶夫毕生研究世界各地的活火山与深洞。
b2-067-s001.whyLearn: 同位语紧接人名用逗号隔开，spend one's life doing sth 是 spend 的典型句型，可一并记牢。

b2-067-s002.skeleton: he went to lake Kivu in the Congo to observe a new volcano
b2-067-s002.gloss: 1948年他到刚果基伍湖观察一座新火山。
b2-067-s002.whyLearn: 不定式 to observe 表目的，which 引导定语从句修饰 volcano，一句连用两种后置修饰。

b2-067-s003.skeleton: Tazieff was able to set up his camp very close to the volcano
b2-067-s003.gloss: 他在火山猛烈喷发时把营地扎得很近。
b2-067-s003.whyLearn: be able to 表某一次具体的能力，while 从句用过去进行时描写背景动作，时态对比很清楚。

modifiers.text: that a river of liquid rock was coming towards him

b2-067-s005.gloss: 他注意到一股液态岩石朝他涌来。
b2-067-s005.whyLearn: noticed 后接 that 宾语从句，从句用过去进行时写正在发生的动作，主从句时态呼应是重点。

b2-067-s006.skeleton: It threatened to surround him completely, but Tazieff managed to escape just in time
b2-067-s006.gloss: 岩浆险些把他围住，他及时逃脱。
b2-067-s006.whyLearn: threaten to do 表示有某种危险，manage to do 表示设法做成，两个不定式含义相反值得对比。

modifiers.text: until the volcano became quiet and he was able to return two days later

b2-067-s007.gloss: 他等到火山平静，两天后才返回。
b2-067-s007.whyLearn: until 引导时间状语从句，从句内并列两个谓语，注意 waited 与 became 的时态保持一致。

b2-067-s009.skeleton: Tazieff has often risked his life
b2-067-s009.gloss: 塔齐耶夫常常这样冒生命危险。
b2-067-s009.whyLearn: risk one's life 是固定搭配，in this way 作方式状语，现在完成时说明至今有过的经历。

b2-067-s010.skeleton: He has been able to tell us more about active volcanoes

modifiers.text: to tell us more about active volcanoes

b2-067-s010.gloss: 他比任何在世者更了解活火山。
b2-067-s010.whyLearn: be able to 与现在完成时连用表示一直以来的能力，than any man alive 是省略谓语的比较状语。

b2-068-s001.skeleton: I crossed the street to avoid meeting him, but he saw me and came running towards me

modifiers.text: but he saw me and came running towards me

b2-068-s001.gloss: 我过街想避开他，他却看见我跑了过来。
b2-068-s001.whyLearn: to avoid meeting him 用动名词作 avoid 的宾语，came running 用现在分词作方式状语，对比鲜明。

b3-041-s021.skeleton: Shopping, too, is always a pleasure.
b3-041-s021.whyLearn: 逗号夹住的 too 插在主语与系动词之间，主干仍是主系表，学会不被插入语打断。

modifiers.text: when they go shopping in the city
and stagger home loaded with as many of the necessities of life as they can carry
loaded with as many of the necessities of life as they can carry

b3-041-s023.gloss: 乡下人进城购物就撒欢，满载而归。
b3-041-s023.whyLearn: 一个 when 从句、两个并列谓语、再加 loaded 分词短语，是练主干分层的典型句子。

b3-041-s024.skeleton: Nor is the city without its moments of beauty.
b3-041-s024.gloss: 城市也并非没有它的美的时刻。
b3-041-s024.whyLearn: Nor 置于句首引起倒装，主语 the city 后移到 is 之后，是识别否定倒装的小样本。

b3-042-s001.skeleton: Cave exploration, or potholing, as it has come to be known, is a r

modifiers.text: as it has come to be known

b3-042-s001.gloss: 洞穴探险，又称 potholing，是一项运动。
b3-042-s001.whyLearn: 同位语和 as 从句把主语与系动词隔开，能练长距离找回主干的能力。

b3-042-s002.skeleton: it is the desire for solitude or the chance of making an unexpected discovery that lures men down to the depths of the earth

modifiers.text: that lures men down to the depths of the earth
down to the depths of the earth

b3-042-s002.gloss: 也许是求独处或偶遇新发现的机会把人引向地底。
b3-042-s002.whyLearn: it is...that 强调句把长名词短语夹在中间，先剥框架再找谓语是实用技巧。

b3-042-s004.skeleton: caves have the same peculiar fascination

modifiers.text: which high mountains have for the climber

b3-042-s004.gloss: 对他而言，洞穴如高山对登山者般有吸引力。
b3-042-s004.whyLearn: the same...which 用定语从句补出比较对象，比 the same as 更书面，值得模仿。

modifiers.text: which can only be dimly understood

b3-042-s005.gloss: 它们唤起的本能只能被模糊地理解。
b3-042-s005.whyLearn: 主句极短，被动定语从句里 can only be dimly understood 的副词词序值得整块记。

b3-042-s006.skeleton: Exploring really deep caves is not a task
b3-042-s006.gloss: 探索真正的深洞不是周末闲逛者能做的事。
b3-042-s006.whyLearn: 动名词短语作主语配单数 is，否定表语后接 for 短语，是定义类句式的样板。

b3-042-s007.skeleton: Such undertakings require the precise planning and foresight
b3-042-s007.gloss: 这类行动需要军事行动般的精确筹划与远见。
b3-042-s007.whyLearn: 整句无从句，靠 of 短语后置修饰两个并列名词，主干一目了然，适合模仿写作。

b3-042-s008.skeleton: It can take as long as eight days

modifiers.text: to rig up rope ladders and to establish supply bases
before a descent can be made into a very deep cave

b3-042-s008.gloss: 深入极深的洞穴前，可能要花八天搭绳梯建补给站。
b3-042-s008.whyLearn: it 作形式主语，两个不定式真主语并列，before 从句又用被动，层次多而不乱。

b3-042-s010.skeleton: The deepest known cave in the world is the Gouffre Berger
b3-042-s010.gloss: 世界最深的洞穴是格勒诺布尔附近的贝尔热洞。
b3-042-s010.whyLearn: 最高级作定语加 in the world 后置，主语很长而谓语只是 is，先定位 is 再读。

b3-042-s011.whyLearn: extend to a depth of 是表达延伸深度的固定搭配，可整块背下来直接用。

b3-042-s012.skeleton: This immense chasm has been formed by an underground stream

modifiers.text: which has tunnelled a course through a flaw in the rocks
through a flaw in the rocks

b3-042-s012.gloss: 巨大裂隙由地下水流沿岩石裂缝冲凿而成。
b3-042-s012.whyLearn: 现在完成被动 has been formed 与定语从句里的现在完成连用，时态呼应值得体会。

b3-042-s013.skeleton: The entrance to the cave is on a plateau
b3-042-s013.gloss: 洞口位于多菲内阿尔卑斯山的一处高原上。
b3-042-s013.whyLearn: 两个介词短语一限定主语名词、一说明表语位置，学会给不同成分挂状语。

modifiers.text: As it is only six feet across

b3-042-s014.gloss: 因为它只有六英尺宽，所以很难被注意到。
b3-042-s014.whyLearn: As 引导的原因从句在前，主句极短，barely 的半否定语气是理解重点。

b3-042-s016.skeleton: it has become a sort of potholers' Everest
b3-042-s016.gloss: 自被发现以来，它成了探洞者的珠穆朗玛峰。
b3-042-s016.whyLearn: since 加名词短语作时间状语时主句用现在完成时，是最典型的搭配之一。

modifiers.text: Though Mrs Bussman was fully acquainted with this story
that there was a chance in a million

b3-036-s011.gloss: 布思曼太太虽知情，却认为他可能是对的
b3-036-s011.whyLearn: 一句里同时挤进让步状语从句、宾语从句和同位语从句，两个 that 功能完全不同，是练从句分层的绝佳范例。

b3-036-s012.skeleton: she sent a boy to the workman

modifiers.text: to ask him if his name was Hans Bussman
if his name was Hans Bussman
the man's name was Hans Bussman and he really was Franz's long-lost brother

b3-036-s012.gloss: 她派人去问那人是否叫汉斯·布思曼
b3-036-s012.whyLearn: 一句先用不定式表目的、if 引宾语从句，再由插入语 Needless to say 抖出结果，叙事节奏很值得模仿。

b3-037-s005.gloss: 出了事就一味怪铁路当局太容易了
b3-037-s005.whyLearn: It is + adj + to do 的经典评价句型，后面跟 when 从句点出场景，does 的强调用法也藏在这里。

modifiers.text: that there was an express train to Westhaven

b3-037-s007.gloss: 查完时刻表，我满意地发现有快车去西黑文
b3-037-s007.whyLearn: after + doing 把先后两个动作压进一句，note 后接 that 从句再套 there be，是旅行叙述的高频组合。

modifiers.text: that a great many local people got on as well

b3-037-s009.gloss: 上车后我发现许多本地人也上了这趟车
b3-037-s009.whyLearn: can't help doing 是极常用的口语说法，a great many 修饰复数名词，一句里学到两个实用搭配。

b3-037-s018.gloss: 我打定主意，一到就投诉
b3-037-s018.whyLearn: determine to do 表示当场下定决心，as soon as 从句让决心和到达两个动作衔接得紧凑有力。

b3-037-s019.skeleton: I was talking angrily to the station-master at Westhaven
b3-037-s019.gloss: 两小时后，我正愤怒地跟站长交涉
b3-037-s019.whyLearn: 过去进行时把当时的场面拉成一个镜头，angrily 与两个介词短语一次交代情绪、对象和地点。

modifiers.text: When he denied the train's existence

b3-037-s020.gloss: 他否认有这趟车，我便借来他的时刻表
b3-037-s020.whyLearn: when 从句先摆出冲突，主句用 borrowed 稳稳反击；train's 与 of the time-table 两种所有格同句对比。

b3-037-s021.skeleton: There was a note of triumph

modifiers.text: when I told him that it was there in black and white
that it was there in black and white

b3-037-s021.gloss: 我得意地告诉他，白纸黑字写着呢
b3-037-s021.whyLearn: there be 配上抽象名词 note of triumph 写神情，when 从句里再嵌宾语从句，层层推进很有表现力。

modifiers.text: for they were as near as early man could get to writing
as early man could get to writing

b3-038-s018.gloss: 这些符号含义明确，是早期人类最接近文字的东西
b3-038-s018.whyLearn: for 引出原因分句，as ... as ... could 的比较结构把“最接近文字”说得既有分寸又准确。

b3-039-s001.skeleton: The rough road across the plain soon became so bad
b3-039-s001.gloss: 土路很快烂得我们……（原句在此未完）
b3-039-s001.whyLearn: so ... that ... 结果句型的开头，so 后必须接形容词或副词，that 从句用来交代后果。

modifiers.text: No matter what the conditions were
that a car should be driven as fast as it could possibly go
as fast as it could possibly go

b3-039-s006.gloss: 无论路况如何，他都认为车该开得尽可能快
b3-039-s006.whyLearn: no matter what 让步开篇，宾语从句里再嵌被动语态和 as ... as 比较，三种结构串得干净利落。

modifiers.text: wondering if we were leaving a trail of oil and petrol behind us
if we were leaving a trail of oil and petrol behind us

b3-039-s010.gloss: 因此我们不断回头，担心身后漏下油迹
b3-039-s010.whyLearn: keep doing 表示持续动作，现在分词 wondering 顺带补充心理活动，一句写出边走边担心的画面。

modifiers.text: giving way to a stretch of plain where the only obstacles were clumps of bushes
where the only obstacles were clumps of bushes

b3-039-s011.gloss: 巨石突然消失，眼前豁然变成一片平原
b3-039-s011.whyLearn: 感叹句 What a relief 搭配 when 从句，再加分词与 where 从句层层展开，是写“松一口气”的好句式。

b3-039-s012.whyLearn: there be 加不定式 to come 的固定说法，短短一句却能制造悬念，适合学叙事的转折收尾。

modifiers.text: he's a member of the Y.

b1-051-s006.whyLearn: know后接省略that的宾语从句，是口语里转述他人身份最省力的说法。

b1-051-s016.gloss: 玛丽说很快会写一封信。
b1-051-s016.whyLearn: will加动词原形表将来，soon限定时间，是预告动作最典型的说法。

b1-051-s017.whyLearn: hope接完整从句用一般现在时表祝愿，是英文信件收尾的固定套路。

b1-051-s021.whyLearn: 转述承诺时主句says用现在时，从句照样用将来时，不受时态影响。

b1-051-s022.whyLearn: 与上句只换主语和从句人称，可对照练熟hope接从句的转述格式。

b1-051-s025.whyLearn: 前否后肯的反意疑问句，用助动词does回指主语he，语气是求确认。

b1-052-s001.whyLearn: 问过去的经历用was提前，句尾加称呼语，是口语寒暄的常见收尾。

b1-052-s006.skeleton: The English and Maths papers weren't easy enough
b1-052-s006.gloss: 英语和数学卷子对我来说不够容易。
b1-052-s006.whyLearn: enough修饰形容词必须后置，再用for sb.交代对谁而言，语序不能颠倒。

b1-052-s012.whyLearn: too加形容词加for sb.表示超出某人能力，正好与上句enough形成反义对照。

b1-052-s013.gloss: 智力测验真糟糕，不是吗？
b1-052-s013.whyLearn: 前肯后否的反意疑问句，与前面前否后肯那句对照，语气是拉对方认同。

b1-052-s015.whyLearn: be sure后接省略that的从句，have got强调眼下已有的状态，很口语。

b1-052-s018.gloss: 也许我们考得还不算太差。
b1-052-s018.whyLearn: Perhaps放句首弱化语气，not与too连用表达其实没那么糟，是典型的委婉否定。

b1-052-s019.skeleton: The guy next to me wrote his name

modifiers.text: at the top of the paper

b1-052-s019.gloss: 我旁边那人把名字写在卷子顶端。
b1-052-s019.whyLearn: next to me紧贴the guy作后置定语，与句末方位介词短语各管一段，位置分明。

b1-052-s021.gloss: 然后他坐那儿盯着它看了三个小时。
b1-052-s021.whyLearn: and连接两个并列谓语，sat there加for three hours把无聊等待写得很有画面感。

b1-053-s001.gloss: 老板问：辛普森小姐在哪儿，鲍勃？
b1-053-s001.whyLearn: Where's是Where is的缩写，疑问词加be动词构成对位置的直接提问。

b1-053-s005.whyLearn: want sb. to do用宾格her作逻辑主语，是英语里指派他人做事的核心句式。

b1-027-s015.gloss: 这是我们最爱聊的话题。
b1-027-s015.whyLearn: our 表所属，of 短语后置修饰 subject，是名词短语作表语的高频搭配。

b1-028-s001.gloss: 索耶一家住在国王街87号。
b1-028-s001.whyLearn: 姓氏加 s 表示一家人，at 加门牌号说居住地点，是地址表达的高频组合。

modifiers.text: and the children go to school

b1-028-s002.gloss: 早上索耶太太去上班，孩子们去上学。
b1-028-s002.whyLearn: and 连接两个主谓结构，go to work 与 go to school 对照，可练并列句的语序。

b1-028-s003.gloss: 他们的父亲每天送他们上学。
b1-028-s003.whyLearn: take sb to 地点 表送去，注意 their 与 them 的所属格和宾格对比。

b1-028-s004.gloss: 索耶太太每天待在家里。
b1-028-s004.whyLearn: stay at home 是固定搭配，every day 置于句末表频率，可与上句的 take 对比。

b1-028-s006.whyLearn: 频率副词 always 放在实义动词前，her 表所属，at noon 说明时间点。

b1-028-s007.whyLearn: usually 位于实义动词前，时间状语 In the afternoon 前置且要加逗号。

b1-028-s009.whyLearn: come home 中 home 是副词不再加 to，与下句 from work 结构对称可并记。

b1-028-s011.whyLearn: come home from work 是固定说法，可对照上句 come home from school 记忆。

b1-028-s013.skeleton: the children always do their homework
b1-028-s013.gloss: 晚上孩子们总是做作业。
b1-028-s013.whyLearn: do one's homework 是固定搭配，their 随主语变化，always 置于实义动词前。

b1-028-s015.skeleton: Mr Sawyer usually reads his newspaper

modifiers.text: but sometimes he and his wife watch television

b1-028-s015.gloss: 索耶先生通常看报，有时和妻子看电视。
b1-028-s015.whyLearn: but 连接两个主谓结构，usually 与 sometimes 对照，练一般现在时第三人称形式。

modifiers.text: but this afternoon, she is drinking tea in the garden

b1-029-s006.gloss: 下午太太通常在客厅喝茶，今天却在花园喝。
b1-029-s006.whyLearn: but 前后用一般现在时与现在进行时对照，突出通常情况与此刻的差别。

b1-029-s008.skeleton: the children usually do their homework

modifiers.text: but this evening, they are not doing their homework

b1-029-s008.gloss: 晚上孩子通常做作业，今晚却没做。
b1-029-s008.whyLearn: be not doing 练现在进行时否定，their 表所属，与上句结构平行可对比。

b1-029-s009.gloss: 此刻他们正在花园里玩。
b1-029-s009.whyLearn: At the moment 是现在进行时的标志词，in the garden 补充说明地点。

modifiers.text: but he is not reading his newspaper tonight

b1-029-s011.gloss: 索耶通常晚上看报，今晚却没看。
b1-029-s011.whyLearn: at night 与 tonight 时间对照，一般现在时与进行时否定式并置，练时态对比。

b1-029-s012.skeleton: he is reading an interesting book
b1-029-s012.gloss: 此刻他正在读一本有趣的书。
b1-029-s012.whyLearn: 现在进行时描述此刻动作，an interesting book 练冠词加形容词修饰名词。

b3-042-s017.skeleton: much of it still remains to be explored

modifiers.text: Though a number of descents have been made

b3-042-s017.gloss: 尽管已多次下探，洞中大部分仍待探索
b3-042-s017.whyLearn: 让步从句交代已有成果，主句用 remain to be explored 表示尚待探索，进展与余量一句写清

b3-042-s018.skeleton: A team of potholers recently went down the Gouffre Berger
b3-042-s018.gloss: 一支探洞队最近下到贝热深渊
b3-042-s018.whyLearn: go down 直接接专有地名，recently 置于实义动词前，是叙述探险行动最简捷的起句

b3-042-s019.skeleton: they climbed down the steep sides of the cave

modifiers.text: After entering the narrow gap on the plateau
until they came to a narrow corridor

b3-042-s019.gloss: 穿过窄缝后他们沿洞壁下爬，直到抵达窄廊
b3-042-s019.whyLearn: after 加动名词作前置时间状语，until 从句标记终点，动作按先后顺序推进，适合写行程

b3-042-s020.skeleton: They had to edge their way along this

modifiers.text: sometimes wading across shallow streams, or swimming across deep pools

b3-042-s020.gloss: 他们只能侧身挪行，时而涉溪时而游过深潭
b3-042-s020.whyLearn: edge one's way 写缓慢前行，句尾分词短语补充交替方式，主干加伴随细节的叙事范式

b3-042-s021.skeleton: Suddenly they came to a waterfall

modifiers.text: which dropped into an underground lake at the bottom of the cave
at the bottom of the cave

b3-042-s021.gloss: 他们忽然遇到瀑布，水落入洞底的地下湖
b3-042-s021.whyLearn: 定语从句紧接 waterfall 补充去向，末尾介词短语层层定位，让新景物自然登场

modifiers.text: and after loading their gear on an inflatable rubber dinghy, let the current carry them to the other side
after loading their gear on an inflatable rubber dinghy

b3-042-s022.gloss: 他们跳进湖，把装备装上橡皮艇后顺流到对岸
b3-042-s022.whyLearn: and 连接两个谓语，中间插入 after 加动名词状语，主干不被状语打断的并列写法

b3-042-s023.skeleton: they had to wear special rubber suits

modifiers.text: To protect themselves from the icy water

b3-042-s023.gloss: 为防冰水，他们只得穿特制橡胶服
b3-042-s023.whyLearn: 目的不定式置于句首，had to 表客观被迫，目的与对策一句写清的因果型句子

b3-042-s024.skeleton: they came to huge piles of rubble

modifiers.text: At the far end of the lake
which had been washed up by the water

b3-042-s024.gloss: 在湖的尽头，他们见到被水冲来的碎石堆
b3-042-s024.whyLearn: 定语从句用过去完成时被动式，说明碎石先被水冲积，时间层次靠时态而非连词

b3-042-s026.skeleton: the potholers arrived at an enormous cavern

modifiers.text: Squeezing through a cleft in the rocks
the size of a huge concert hall

b3-042-s026.gloss: 探洞者挤过岩缝，进入音乐厅般的大洞窟
b3-042-s026.whyLearn: 分词短语前置写动作，句尾同位语借熟悉事物给尺度，抽象尺寸立刻可感

modifiers.text: After switching on powerful arc lights
some of them over forty feet high
rising up like tree-trunks to meet the stalactites suspended from the roof
to meet the stalactites suspended from the roof

b3-042-s027.gloss: 开灯后他们见石笋如树干升起，与石钟乳相接
b3-042-s027.whyLearn: 主干极短，靠分词状语、破折号插入语和不定式层层叠加，长修饰全挂在简单谓语上

modifiers.text: in all the colours of the rainbow

b3-042-s028.gloss: 四周石堆闪出彩虹般的各色光泽
b3-042-s028.whyLearn: 地点状语前置、介词短语收尾，是描写景象最省力的框架，可套用到任何场景

b3-043-s001.gloss: 保险公司通常愿意承保任何东西
b3-043-s001.whyLearn: be willing to do 是表达意愿的高频句式，normally 插在 be 与形容词之间，语序可仿

b3-043-s002.skeleton: Insuring public or private property is a standard practice

modifiers.text: in most countries in the world

b3-043-s002.gloss: 为公私财产投保是世界多数国家的常规做法
b3-043-s002.whyLearn: 动名词短语直接作主语，说明一件事如何被普遍看待，比从句主语更简洁紧凑

b3-043-s003.skeleton: it would be equally possible to insure yourself

modifiers.text: If, however, you were holding an open air garden party or a fete
in the event of bad weather

b3-043-s003.gloss: 若正办露天游园会，坏天气也能投保
b3-043-s003.whyLearn: if 从句用过去进行时设想临场情景，however 插在连接词后，形式主语 it 收尾，结构讲究

b3-043-s006.skeleton: But the claim made by a local authority to recover the cost of salvaging a sunken pie dish must surely be unique

modifiers.text: to recover the cost of salvaging a sunken pie dish
of salvaging a sunken pie dish

b3-043-s006.gloss: 某地方当局索赔打捞一只沉馅饼盘的费用，堪称独一无二
b3-043-s006.whyLearn: 主语后叠过去分词定语、不定式与 of 加动名词三层修饰，must 表判断，长主语范例

b3-043-s007.skeleton: it was an unusual pie dish

modifiers.text: for it was eighteen feet long and six feet wide

b3-043-s007.gloss: 这只馅饼盘确实特别，长十八英尺宽六英尺
b3-043-s007.whyLearn: Admittedly 先退一步承认，for 引出原因并补尺寸，一句话完成承认与解释的衔接

b3-054-s009.skeleton: Most of our fears are unreasonable

modifiers.text: but they are impossible to erase

b3-054-s009.gloss: 多数恐惧并不合理，却又无法消除。
b3-054-s009.whyLearn: 'most of' 把范围限定在'我们'的恐惧上，'be impossible to do' 用主动形式表被动含义，是英语常见习惯。

b3-054-s010.gloss: 但与此同时，昆虫又有奇特的魅力。
b3-054-s010.whyLearn: 'however' 用逗号独立插在句中，与 'at the same time' 叠用，让转折不那么生硬，值得模仿。

modifiers.text: as they go about their business

b3-054-s012.gloss: 我们看得出神，但愿它们没察觉到我们。
b3-054-s012.whyLearn: 'entranced' 与 'unaware of' 作伴随状语，'as' 引导时间从句，层层修饰却不显冗长。

b3-054-s013.skeleton: Who has not stood in awe

modifiers.text: at the sight of a spider pouncing on a fly, or a column of ants triumphantly bearing home an enormous dead beetle ?
or a column of ants triumphantly bearing home an enormous dead beetle ?
bearing home an enormous dead beetle

b3-054-s013.gloss: 谁不曾惊叹蜘蛛扑蝇、蚁群扛虫的景象？
b3-054-s013.whyLearn: 反问句 'Who has not...' 说人人如此，'at the sight of' 后接两个并列的复合动名词结构，画面感极强。

b3-054-s014.skeleton: I spent days in the garden

modifiers.text: watching thousands of ants crawling up the trunk of my prize peach tree
crawling up the trunk of my prize peach tree

b3-054-s014.gloss: 去年夏天我连日蹲在园里看蚂蚁爬树。
b3-054-s014.whyLearn: 'spend + 时间 + doing' 是高频结构，watching 后接复合宾语，名词 prize 作定语表珍视。

modifiers.text: on a sheltered side of the house

b3-054-s015.gloss: 这棵树靠着暖墙，长在房屋避风的一侧。
b3-054-s015.whyLearn: 'has grown' 现在完成时强调长成的结果，两个介词短语由近及远定位，是描写位置最省力的写法。

modifiers.text: that the leaves of the tree were beginning to wither

b3-054-s017.gloss: 那年夏天，我注意到树叶开始枯萎。
b3-054-s017.whyLearn: 'noticed' 后接 that 宾语从句，从句用过去进行时 'were beginning' 表现渐变的开始，时态搭配很讲究。

b3-054-s018.skeleton: Clusters of tiny insects called aphides were to be found

modifiers.text: on the underside of the leaves

b3-054-s018.gloss: 叶片背面能找到一种叫蚜虫的小虫群。
b3-054-s018.whyLearn: 'were to be found' 用不定式被动表示'可以找到'，'called aphides' 是过去分词作后置定语，都很书面。

modifiers.text: by a laop colony of ants
which obtained a sort of honey from them

b3-054-s019.gloss: 一大群蚂蚁来访，从它们身上获取蜜露。
b3-054-s019.whyLearn: 被动语态 'were visited by' 引出施动者，再用 'which' 定语从句补充蚂蚁的行动，是典型组合。

b3-054-s021.skeleton: I bound the base of the tree

modifiers.text: making it impossible for the ants to reach the aphides
for the ants to reach the aphides

b3-054-s021.gloss: 我用黏胶带缠住树干，让蚂蚁够不到蚜虫。
b3-054-s021.whyLearn: 'making' 分词短语表结果，'it' 作形式宾语，真正的宾语是 'for the ants to reach' 的不定式复合结构。

modifiers.text: scurrying around the base of the tree in bewilderment
around the base of the tree

b3-054-s023.gloss: 我久久看着它们困惑地绕着树根打转。
b3-054-s023.whyLearn: 'watch' 后接现在分词作宾补，呈现持续画面；'in bewilderment' 把蚂蚁的茫然写得十分传神。

b3-054-s025.skeleton: I got up early next morning

modifiers.text: hoping to find that the ants had given up in despair
to find that the ants had given up in despair
that the ants had given up in despair

b3-054-s025.gloss: 次日清晨我早早起身，盼着蚂蚁已绝望放弃。
b3-054-s025.whyLearn: 'hoping' 分词短语表伴随的心情，'to find' 后接 that 从句，从句用过去完成时表示更早发生。

modifiers.text: that they had discovered a new route

b3-054-s026.gloss: 相反，我发现它们已经找到一条新路。
b3-054-s026.whyLearn: 'saw' 后接 that 宾语从句，'had discovered' 过去完成时说明发现先于看见，'Instead' 转折干脆。

modifiers.text: that I had been completely defeated by their ingenuity

b3-054-s028.gloss: 我难过地意识到，自己已被它们的机灵彻底打败。
b3-054-s028.whyLearn: 'realized' 带 that 宾语从句，从句用过去完成时被动 'had been defeated'，'by' 点明施动者，结构完整。

modifiers.text: to find an answer to my thoroughly unscientific methods

b3-054-s029.gloss: 蚂蚁很快对我的土办法做出了回应。
b3-054-s029.whyLearn: 'be quick to do' 是常用搭配，主语用 ants 拟人；'an answer to' 介词固定用 to，容易记也容易用错。

b3-055-s001.skeleton: Radio astronomy has greatly increased our understanding
b3-055-s001.gloss: 射电天文学大大增进了我们的认识。
b3-055-s001.whyLearn: 'has increased' 现在完成时表影响延续至今，'our understanding' 是所属与所有格的典型用例。

b2-057-s004.gloss: 他轻蔑地瞥了她一眼，说裙子已售出。
b2-057-s004.whyLearn: 现在分词 glancing 作状语表伴随，主句用 told；宾语从句里 was sold 是被动，可换成 is sold 讲现在。

b2-057-s005.skeleton: The woman walked out of the shop angrily and decided to punish the assistant
b2-057-s005.gloss: 那女人气冲冲地走出店，决定第二天惩罚店员。
b2-057-s005.whyLearn: walked 与 decided 并列共用主语；out of the shop 表方向，to punish 是不定式作宾语。

b2-057-s006.skeleton: She returned to the shop the following morning

modifiers.text: with a handbag in one hand and a long umbrella in the other

b2-057-s006.gloss: 第二天早上她穿皮大衣回店，一手提包一手长伞。
b2-057-s006.whyLearn: dressed in 是过去分词短语补充穿着，with 复合结构并列出两样东西，写人物出场时很好用。

b2-057-s007.skeleton: she asked for the same dress

modifiers.text: After seeking out the rude assistant

b2-057-s007.gloss: 她找到那个无礼的店员后，要了同一条裙子。
b2-057-s007.whyLearn: after 后接动名词 seeking，可改写为 after she sought out；ask for 表示要某样东西。

b2-057-s008.skeleton: the assistant was eager to serve her this time

modifiers.text: he climbed into the shop window to get the dress

b2-057-s008.gloss: 助理没认出她，这次殷勤招待，还费力爬进橱窗取裙。
b2-057-s008.whyLearn: 否定式分词 Not realizing 作状语；be eager to do 表急于做；原文逗号粘连两句，别照抄。

modifiers.text: making the assistant bring almost everything in the window

b2-057-s010.gloss: 她让助理把橱窗东西几乎拿遍，最后才买下最初那条。
b2-057-s010.whyLearn: enjoy oneself doing 表自得其乐；make sb do 不带 to；before buying 后接动名词。

b2-058-s001.skeleton: The tiny village of Frinley is said to possess a 'cursed tree'
b2-058-s001.gloss: 据说弗林利小村里有一棵被诅咒的树。
b2-058-s001.whyLearn: is said to do 是“据说”的固定被动式；of Frinley 作后置定语，可换成 of 加地名。

b2-058-s003.skeleton: The tree was planted near a church fifty years ago

modifiers.text: but it is only in recent years that it has gained an evil reputation
that it has gained an evil reputation

b2-058-s003.gloss: 这树五十年前种在教堂旁，近年才落下坏名声。
b2-058-s003.whyLearn: is only in recent years that 是强调句，突出时间；was planted 被动；but 后转现在完成时。

modifiers.text: that the tree has already claimed a number of victims

b2-058-s005.gloss: 许多村民相信这树已夺去多条人命。
b2-058-s005.whyLearn: believe that 引出宾语从句；claim 此处意为夺去；a number of 后接可数名词复数。

modifiers.text: that the tree is a useful source of income
as tourists have been coming from all parts of the country to see it
from all parts of the country

b2-058-s007.gloss: 他指出，各地游客来看树，这树是收入来源。
b2-058-s007.whyLearn: point out that 引宾语从句；as 引导原因状语从句；have been coming 强调一直不断。

b2-058-s008.skeleton: the tourists-have been picking leaves and cutting their names on the tree-trunk

modifiers.text: In spite of all that has been said,
picking leaves and cutting their names

b2-058-s008.gloss: 尽管有那些说法，游客仍一直摘叶、在树干刻名字。
b2-058-s008.whyLearn: in spite of 加名词短语表让步，后接 that 定语从句；have been doing 表反复持续的行为。

b2-058-s009.skeleton: not one of them has been struck down by sudden death
b2-058-s009.gloss: 到目前为止，他们中没有一个人突然暴毙。
b2-058-s009.whyLearn: so far 常与现在完成时连用；not one of them 作主语时谓语用单数；strike down 是被动。

modifiers.text: Every time he wanted to come into the garden

b2-059-s002.gloss: 每次它想进花园，就狂吠直到有人开大门。
b2-059-s002.whyLearn: every time 直接当连词引导时间状语从句；would 表过去习惯；until 从句点出动作终点。

b2-059-s003.skeleton: my husband spent weeks training him

modifiers.text: As the neighbours complained of the noise
to press his paw on the latch

b2-059-s003.gloss: 邻居抱怨吵，丈夫花几周训练它按门闩自己进门。
b2-059-s003.whyLearn: spend weeks doing 用动名词；as 引导原因；两个不定式 to press、to let 说明训练目的。

b2-059-s004.gloss: 雷克斯很快成了开门的行家。
b2-059-s004.whyLearn: become an expert at doing 是固定搭配，at 后必须用动名词，可替换成别的技能。

b2-059-s007.skeleton: he has developed another bad habit
b2-059-s007.gloss: 从那以后，它又养成了另一个坏习惯。
b2-059-s007.whyLearn: since then 与现在完成时搭配，表示从那时起延续到现在；develop 在此是逐渐养成。

b4-037-s010.skeleton: Convenience is, however, in all affairs of life, an execrable test of value.
b4-037-s010.gloss: 便利在生活中绝不是衡量价值的好标准
b4-037-s010.whyLearn: 插入语however与介词短语把主语和表语分开，考查找回Convenience is ... test of value主干的能力。

b4-037-s011.skeleton: One should have the courage to think uncomfortably

modifiers.text: since it is only by rejecting the convenient that one can come to think the truth

b4-037-s011.gloss: 要敢于不自在地思考，拒绝便利才能抵达真理
b4-037-s011.whyLearn: since原因从句内嵌only by ... that强调结构，情态动词与不定式连用，适合练复杂说理句。

b4-037-s017.skeleton: one has thrust aside an inconvenient thought and slid into its place another thought

modifiers.text: when one has thrust aside an inconvenient thought and slid into its place another thought which is convenient.

b4-037-s017.gloss: 把不便的想法推开，换进一个方便的想法
b4-037-s017.whyLearn: when从句内用and并列两个完成动作，which定语从句修饰后置宾语another thought，是抓从句内层次的样板。

modifiers.text: which is the more vicious of the two

b4-037-s019.gloss: 其实不真实的想法才是两者中更恶的
b4-037-s019.whyLearn: 两个插入语先声夺人，it is ... which把焦点落在untruthful thought上，可练信息重心的判断。

b4-037-s020.gloss: 说出口的谎言总是令人厌烦，甚至可能不诚实
b4-037-s020.whyLearn: 过去分词Spoken作前置定语，and并列系表结构与情态谓语，可比较be与may在语气上的强弱差别。

b4-037-s021.skeleton: But continuous lying in the mind, a disease to which the Anglo-Saxon is peculiarly exposed, spells the destruction of human thought and character.

modifiers.text: a disease to which the Anglo-Saxon is peculiarly exposed
to which the Anglo-Saxon is peculiarly exposed

b4-037-s021.gloss: 心中持续说谎会毁掉人的思想与品格
b4-037-s021.whyLearn: 同位语加to which定语从句把主语与谓语spells隔开很远，专练隔开成分后找回主句谓语。

b4-038-s001.skeleton: Appreciation of sculpture depends upon the abi8lity

modifiers.text: to respond to form in three

b4-038-s001.gloss: 欣赏雕塑靠的是对立体形态作出反应的能力
b4-038-s001.whyLearn: ability后接不定式作定语，depends upon与respond to两个搭配同句出现，适合连起来一起记。

b4-038-s003.gloss: 不懂形式的人比色盲多得多
b4-038-s003.whyLearn: more ... than比较结构与引号自造的form-blind配合，说明抽象感知缺陷也能用一句说明白。

b4-038-s004.skeleton: The child learning to see, first distinguishes only two-dimensional shape; it cannot judge distances, depths.
b4-038-s004.gloss: 学看的孩子先只辨平面形状，还不会判断远近
b4-038-s004.whyLearn: 现在分词短语作后置定语紧跟主语，分号后另起一个主句，可练分词定语与长句切分。

b4-038-s005.skeleton: it has to develop(partly by means of touch) the ability to judge roughly three-dimensional distances.

modifiers.text: for its personal safety and practical needs

b4-038-s005.gloss: 为自身安全和需要，人得学会判断三维距离
b4-038-s005.whyLearn: 插入语把develop与宾语the ability分开，has to表客观需要，考查找回动宾搭配的能力。

modifiers.text: having satisfied the requirements of practical necessity

b4-038-s006.gloss: 满足了实际需要后，多数人便不再前进
b4-038-s006.whyLearn: 完成式分词having done作时间状语放在句首，主句很短，适合练分词状语与主语的识别。

b4-038-s007.skeleton: they do not make the further intellectual and emotional effort needed to comprehend form in its full spatial existence.

modifiers.text: Though they may attain considerable accuracy in the perception of flat form
needed to comprehend form in its full spatial existence
to comprehend form in its full spatial existence

b4-038-s007.gloss: 即使能准确感知平面，人们也不肯再费力理解立体
b4-038-s007.whyLearn: Though让步从句配do not否定主句，过去分词needed后置作定语，一句里叠了三种结构。

b4-038-s008.skeleton: This is what the sculptor must do.
b4-038-s008.gloss: 这正是雕塑家必须做的事
b4-038-s008.whyLearn: what引导名词性从句作表语，同时又在从句内作do的宾语，短句看清连接词的双重身份。

b4-038-s009.skeleton: He must strive continually to think of , and use, form in its full spatial completeness.

modifiers.text: to think of , and use, form in its full spatial completeness

b4-038-s009.gloss: 他必须不断思考并运用完整的空间形态
b4-038-s009.whyLearn: and把think of与use并列并共用宾语form，逗号位置提示并列范围，是容易读错的一处。

b4-038-s012.skeleton: the sensitive observer of sculpture must also learn to feel shape simply as shape, not as description or reminiscence.

modifiers.text: to feel shape simply as shape, not as description or reminiscence

b4-038-s012.gloss: 敏感的观赏者要把形状只当形状来感受
b4-038-s012.whyLearn: learn to do后接as短语，not as再并列另一种看待方式，示范用介词短语界定抽象感受。

b4-038-s013.skeleton: He must, for example, perceive an egg as a simple single solid shape

modifiers.text: as a simple single solid shape
quite apart from its significance as food, or from the literary idea that it will become a bird
that it will become a bird

b4-038-s013.gloss: 他要把鸡蛋只看成一个单纯的立体形状
b4-038-s013.whyLearn: apart from引出对比背景，that同位语从句解释idea，说明抽象名词如何用从句展开。

modifiers.text: anxious to see if his fellow-actor had at last learnt his lines
if his fellow-actor had at last learnt his lines

b3-022-s014.gloss: 狱吏在旁热切看着，急于知道同伴是否记住了台词
b3-022-s014.whyLearn: 形容词短语补足主语状态，再用if从句说明急切原因，把旁观者心理写活了

b3-022-s015.skeleton: The noble stared at the blank sheet of paper
b3-022-s015.gloss: 贵族盯着那张空白纸看了几秒钟
b3-022-s015.whyLearn: stare at后接具体宾语，用for a few seconds交代持续时间，描写停顿很常用

b3-022-s016.gloss: 他眯起眼睛说光线太暗
b3-022-s016.whyLearn: 分词短语插在主语和谓语之间，表示说话时同时做的小动作，叙事更有画面感

b3-022-s018.skeleton: he promptly handed the sheet of paper to the gaoler
b3-022-s018.gloss: 他随即把纸递给了狱吏
b3-022-s018.whyLearn: hand sth to sb的双宾结构，配promptly表现动作干脆，适合写交接场面

b3-022-s021.whyLearn: With this承接上文收束对话，hurry off简洁交代离场动作，是收尾常用写法

b3-023-s001.gloss: 一谈到这类事，人们就变得很不讲逻辑
b3-023-s001.whyLearn: when引导时间状语从句常含条件意味，主干加从句是表达普遍规律的基本句式

b3-023-s003.skeleton: You would not be able to understand

modifiers.text: why some people find it repulsive

b3-023-s003.gloss: 你无法理解为什么有人觉得它恶心
b3-023-s003.whyLearn: be able to前用would not表推测否定，why从句作understand的宾语，层层递进

modifiers.text: at the idea of frying potatoes in animal fat
the normally accepted practice in many northern countries

b3-023-s004.gloss: 一想到用动物油炸土豆，你的胃就会翻腾
b3-023-s004.whyLearn: 同位语给前面做法下定义，介词of后接动名词，一句练两种高频结构

modifiers.text: that most of us have been brought up to eat certain foods and we stick to them all our lives
and we stick to them all our lives

b3-023-s005.gloss: 可悲的是，我们从小被训练只吃某些食物，终生不改
b3-023-s005.whyLearn: 表语从句给出结论，被动加不定式说明养成过程，and并列到现实习惯

b3-023-s006.skeleton: No creature has received more praise and abuse
b3-023-s006.gloss: 再没有哪种生物比花园蜗牛受到更多褒贬
b3-023-s006.whyLearn: 否定主语加比较级，比any other更强调，适合写争议极大的事物

modifiers.text: in various parts of the world

b3-023-s007.gloss: 用葡萄酒烹制的蜗牛在各地是珍贵美味
b3-023-s007.whyLearn: 过去分词短语置于句首作状语，主语与分词是被动关系，精读常考这一点

b3-023-s009.skeleton: My friend, Robert, lives in a country
b3-023-s009.gloss: 我朋友罗伯特住在一个鄙视蜗牛的国家
b3-023-s009.whyLearn: 同位语插在主语后补充人名，where定语从句修饰地点名词，同句两种修饰

b3-023-s010.skeleton: he has no garden of his own

modifiers.text: As his flat is in a large town,

b3-023-s010.gloss: 因为公寓在大镇上，他自己没有花园
b3-023-s010.whyLearn: As引导原因状语从句放句首，主句用of his own强调所属，语序值得模仿

modifiers.text: to collect snails from my garden and take them to him

b3-023-s011.gloss: 多年来他一直请我去花园捡蜗牛带给他
b3-023-s011.whyLearn: 现在完成进行时强调反复请求，ask sb to do后并列两个不定式动作

modifiers.text: put them in a paper bag

b3-023-s013.gloss: 一时冲动，我捡了几十只蜗牛装袋送给罗伯特
b3-023-s013.whyLearn: 现在分词短语交代动机，三个过去式动词并列铺开连续动作，节奏紧凑

modifiers.text: and equally pleased with my little gift

b3-023-s014.gloss: 罗伯特见到我很高兴，也很喜欢我的小礼物
b3-023-s014.whyLearn: was delighted to do与pleased with并列，展示表达高兴的两种搭配

b1-057-s012.skeleton: Can you change this pound note
b1-057-s012.gloss: 问女士能否把这张一英镑钞票换开
b1-057-s012.whyLearn: 换零钱的礼貌问句 Can you...?，句尾加称呼 madam，银行购物场景常用。

b1-057-s013.gloss: 乘客委婉地表示自己换不开
b1-057-s013.whyLearn: I'm afraid 是委婉拒绝的固定开场，后面 I can't 省去了重复的动词。

b1-058-s004.whyLearn: sure 后接 there be 存在句，用来推断某处没有某人，比直接否定更自然。

b1-058-s008.gloss: 问对方能不能看见什么东西
b1-058-s008.whyLearn: anything 用于疑问句而非 something，这是疑问句里最容易出错的一点。

b1-058-s019.skeleton: May I have a glass of bear
b1-058-s019.whyLearn: May I...? 比 Can I 更正式客气，please 放句尾缓和请求语气。

b1-059-s002.whyLearn: There were 加复数名词再加地点副词，是描述过去场景的存在句基本式。

modifiers.text: but we could not find them all

b1-059-s003.gloss: 我们找了硬币但没能全部找到
b1-059-s003.whyLearn: but 连接两个过去动作，could not 表达努力之后的遗憾结果。

b1-059-s004.skeleton: our little boy, Tommy, found two small coins
b1-059-s004.gloss: 吃早饭时小儿子在地板上找到两枚硬币
b1-059-s004.whyLearn: While 从句用过去进行时铺垫背景，主句用一般过去时叙事，是时态搭配的范例。

b1-059-s008.skeleton: my husband telephoned me from the office

modifiers.text: when I was doing the housework

b1-059-s008.gloss: 那天上午我做家务时丈夫从办公室来电
b1-059-s008.whyLearn: when 从句插在主句中间，前后用逗号隔开，可练习长句的停顿和信息层次。

b1-060-s011.gloss: 小偷扔下手电筒尽快逃走了
b1-060-s011.whyLearn: as quickly as they could 表示尽可能快地，是动作描写里的高频比较结构。

b1-060-s013.gloss: 他打开灯却看不到任何人
b1-060-s013.whyLearn: but 对比两个过去动作，否定句中要用 anyone 而不是 someone。

b1-061-s008.gloss: 罗伯茨小姐说她想不起来了
b1-061-s008.whyLearn: can't remember 表示一时想不起，句尾 sir 体现对上级的礼貌称呼。

b1-061-s012.gloss: 经理请对方把它试穿一下
b1-061-s012.whyLearn: Would you...? 比 Will you 更客气，put it on 里代词必须放在中间。

b1-063-s005.gloss: 彼得说自己必须这么做
b1-063-s005.whyLearn: 用 must 收尾并省掉重复的动词，是英语口语里常见的省略答法。

b1-064-s002.gloss: 米莉对凯特说自己能做到
b1-064-s002.whyLearn: I think 后接省略形式的宾语从句，句尾加称呼 Kate，口语感很强。

b1-064-s004.gloss: 凯特说自己也这么认为
b1-064-s004.whyLearn: I thought so 用过去时表示我那时也是这么想的，so 代替前面整句话。

modifiers.text: that the best way to transport the dish would be by canal
so they insured it for the trip

b3-043-s009.gloss: 馅饼委员会决定走运河并给盘子投保。
b3-043-s009.whyLearn: decide that + would be 表过去将来，so 引出结果并列句，练宾语从句。

b3-043-s010.skeleton: the pie committee went to a local inn
b3-043-s010.gloss: 下水不久，委员会去当地酒馆庆祝。
b3-043-s010.whyLearn: 时间状语从句前置加被动 was launched，主干简短，适合练从句在句首的断句。

b3-043-s011.skeleton: a number of teenagers climbed on to the dish

modifiers.text: and held a little party of their own

b3-043-s011.gloss: 同时一群少年爬上盘子自办小派对。
b3-043-s011.whyLearn: a number of 接复数谓语，of their own 表自己的，两个易混结构同现。

b3-043-s012.skeleton: Modern dances proved to be more than the disk could bear

modifiers.text: for during the party it capsized and sank in seven feet of water

b3-043-s012.gloss: 现代舞超出盘子承受力，派对中它沉了。
b3-043-s012.whyLearn: prove to be 后接比较从句，for 作并列连词表原因，可对比 because 的用法。

b3-043-s013.skeleton: The pie committee telephoned a local garage owner

modifiers.text: who arrived in a recovery truck to salvage the pie dish

b3-043-s013.gloss: 委员会电话叫来修车厂老板抢救盘子。
b3-043-s013.whyLearn: who 从句紧跟先行词 owner，从句内再嵌目的不定式，是典型的主从嵌套。

modifiers.text: while three men dived repeatedly into the water to locate the dish

b3-043-s014.gloss: 少年们穿湿衣旁观，三人潜水找盘子。
b3-043-s014.whyLearn: 现在分词短语作状语表伴随，while 从句给同时背景，练分词与从句分工。

b3-043-s015.skeleton: They had little difficulty in finding it

modifiers.text: but hauling it out of the water proved to be a serious problem

b3-043-s015.gloss: 找到盘子不难，吊它出水才是大问题。
b3-043-s015.whyLearn: have difficulty in doing 与动名词主语 hauling 对照，but 连两个不同主语的分句。

b3-043-s017.skeleton: chains were fixed to one end of the dish

modifiers.text: and a powerful winch was put into operation
to one end of the dish

b3-043-s017.gloss: 链条固定到盘子一端，绞盘投入运转。
b3-043-s017.whyLearn: 两个并列被动句 was fixed / was put，练被动语态在流程描述中的连用。

b3-043-s018.skeleton: The dish rose to the surface

modifiers.text: and was gently drawn towards the canal bank

b3-043-s018.gloss: 盘子浮出水面，被轻轻拖向运河岸边。
b3-043-s018.whyLearn: 主动 rose 与被动 was drawn 并列切换，练语态对比和 to/towards 的区别。

b3-043-s019.skeleton: the dish was perched precariously on the bank of the canal

modifiers.text: but it suddenly overbalanced and slid back into the water
on the bank of the canal

b3-043-s019.gloss: 盘子险险搁在岸边，又失衡滑回水里。
b3-043-s019.whyLearn: For one agonizing moment 营造悬念，but 后主动动词与前面被动形成对照。

b3-043-s020.skeleton: The men were now obliged to try
b3-043-s020.gloss: 这些人此刻不得不再试一次。
b3-043-s020.whyLearn: be obliged to do 是不得不的正式说法，可替换 have to，now 强调此刻。

b3-043-s023.skeleton: The winch was again put into operation

modifiers.text: and one of the men started up the truck

b3-043-s023.gloss: 绞盘再次启用，一人发动了卡车。
b3-043-s023.whyLearn: put into operation 复用，与短语动词 start up 并列，适合记动副搭配。

b3-043-s024.skeleton: the dish was successfully hauled above the surface of the water

modifiers.text: above the surface of the water

b3-043-s024.gloss: 几分钟后，盘子被成功吊出水面。
b3-043-s024.whyLearn: Several minutes later 作衔接状语，successfully 插在被动中间，是叙事收尾写法。

b3-043-s027.skeleton: the men managed to get the dish on to dry land
b3-043-s027.gloss: 众人飞速作业，赶在浪来前把盘子弄上岸。
b3-043-s027.whyLearn: By doing 表方式，manage to do 表设法做成，before 从句限定时限。

b3-044-s001.skeleton: People travelling long distances frequently have to decide
b3-044-s001.gloss: 长途旅行者常得决定是否……
b3-044-s001.whyLearn: 现在分词 travelling 后置修饰主语，have to 表客观必要；原句在本批数据中被截断。

b3-044-s002.skeleton: Hardly anyone can positively enjoy sitting in a train

modifiers.text: for more than a few hours

b3-044-s002.gloss: 几乎没人能真心享受坐火车超过几小时。
b3-044-s002.whyLearn: hardly anyone 表几乎无人，positively 此处意为真正地，more than a few 表不止几个。

b1-064-s010.whyLearn: 用 I think 引出看法是英语最常用的委婉表态句型，说出观点前先降调，日常对话直接可用。

b1-065-s007.whyLearn: can't have done 表示对过去的否定推测，语气比 didn't 更笃定，是本课情态动词表推测的核心。

b1-065-s008.gloss: 我追上你的时候正开到时速八十。
b1-065-s008.whyLearn: when 从句配过去进行时，一个交代持续背景动作，一个交代突然发生的动作，是叙事的基本节奏。

b1-065-s010.whyLearn: I'm afraid 后接省略的否定回答，礼貌地承认没做到，句尾加上称呼 officer 是英语对话的传神之处。

b1-065-s013.gloss: 我当时一直在叫他开慢点。
b1-065-s013.whyLearn: tell sb to do 的复合结构，配上过去进行时表示当时反复叮嘱，很能表达委屈的辩解语气。

b1-066-s006.skeleton: We can't make up our minds.
b1-066-s006.whyLearn: make up one's mind 是高频习语，这里同时复习情态动词否定和物主代词 our 的搭配。

b1-067-s013.skeleton: She was wearing a blue dress and a mink coat.

modifiers.text: a blue dress and a mink coat

b1-067-s013.gloss: 她穿着蓝色连衣裙和貂皮大衣。
b1-067-s013.whyLearn: 用过去进行时描写当时的穿着，两个并列宾语由具体到贵重，人物形象一下就立起来了。

modifiers.text: she was not going to make another

b1-067-s015.gloss: 她说她不打算再养一只了。
b1-067-s015.whyLearn: 间接引语把 be going to 后移成过去式再加否定，末尾 another 省略名词，转述一举练到三处。

b1-067-s016.whyLearn: 主句 said 决定从句时态后移，be going to 变 was going to，是转述别人计划的标准写法。

b1-068-s003.skeleton: I can't make up my mind.
b1-068-s003.whyLearn: 同一习语把 our 换成 my，提醒 make up one's mind 里的物主代词必须跟着主语走。

modifiers.text: she couldn't make up her mind

b1-068-s015.whyLearn: can't 在间接引语里变 couldn't，物主代词同时变 her，一句练到情态、时态、所有格三处。

b1-070-s004.whyLearn: I'm afraid 后面接否定宾语从句，是打断对方、承认听不懂时最得体的说法。

b2-001-s006.whyLearn: 过去进行时加方式副词 loudly 一笔交代背景噪音，为下文抱怨听不见做铺垫。

b2-001-s008.skeleton: I could not hear the actors.
b2-001-s008.whyLearn: could 的否定式在这里不表能力而表当时做不到，是解释处境、引出抱怨的常用句式。

b2-001-s012.gloss: 最后我实在忍不下去了。
b2-001-s012.whyLearn: In the end 放在句首点出结局，配上 could not bear it，把忍耐到极限的情绪交代清楚。

b2-001-s014.whyLearn: can't hear a word 用否定加 a word 把听不见强调到极致，口语里情绪强烈又自然。

b3-031-s014.skeleton: The assistant asked him to leave, but Dickie paid no attention to him and requested to see the manager
b3-031-s014.gloss: 助理请他离开，迪基不理会，却要见经理。
b3-031-s014.whyLearn: 三个过去式动作并列，两个不定式分别作宾补和宾语，可见 ask sb to do 与 request to do 的差别。

b3-031-s015.skeleton: the manager was most apologetic and 'reprimanded the assistant severely
b3-031-s015.gloss: 认出顾客身份后，经理连连道歉并痛斥助理。
b3-031-s015.whyLearn: 句首现在分词先说明原因，主干用 and 连两个过去式谓语，交代道歉与斥责的先后。

b3-031-s018.skeleton: He insisted on the assistant's counting the money

modifiers.text: before he left 72,000 pennies in all

b3-031-s018.gloss: 他坚持要助理把钱数清，共计七万二千枚便士。
b3-031-s018.whyLearn: insist on 后接所有格加动名词，点明数钱的人；before 从句交代离开前的动作。

b3-031-s019.skeleton: he invited a number of important critics

modifiers.text: to see his private collection of modern paintings

b3-031-s019.gloss: 另一次他请多位评论家参观他的现代画收藏。
b3-031-s019.whyLearn: a number of 修饰可数名词复数，不定式作目的状语，介词短语补出收藏内容。

b3-032-s001.skeleton: The salvage operation had been a complete failure
b3-032-s001.whyLearn: 最短的主系表句，用过去完成时把失败放在叙事开头，适合记 failure 的搭配。

b3-032-s002.skeleton: The small ship, Elkor, which had been searching the Barents Sea for weeks, was on its way home

modifiers.text: which had been searching the Barents Sea for weeks

b3-032-s002.gloss: 搜了数周后，小船埃尔科号正在返航。
b3-032-s002.whyLearn: 同位语加非限制性定语从句插在主语后，交代船名与搜寻时长，主干被拉开仍清晰。

b3-032-s003.skeleton: A radio message from the mainland had been received by the ship's captain

modifiers.text: instructing him to give up the search

b3-032-s003.gloss: 船长收到大陆来电，命令他放弃搜寻。
b3-032-s003.whyLearn: 过去完成时被动语态加现在分词结果状语，一句交代消息来源、接收者与后果。

modifiers.text: that another attempt would be made later
for the sunken ship he was trying to find had been carrying a precious cargo of gold bullion

b3-032-s004.gloss: 船长知道还会再试，因为沉船载着黄金。
b3-032-s004.whyLearn: that 宾语从句给判断，for 分句给理由，中间还嵌省略关系词的定语从句，层次多而有序。

b3-032-s005.skeleton: the captain of the Elkor decided to try once more
b3-032-s005.gloss: 尽管收到电报，船长仍决定再试一次。
b3-032-s005.whyLearn: despite 后只接名词就表让步，比让步从句省字；decide to do 是高频搭配。

b3-032-s008.skeleton: What they had in fact found was a ship

modifiers.text: which had been sunk many years before

b3-032-s008.gloss: 他们实际找到的是一艘多年前沉没的船。
b3-032-s008.whyLearn: what 从句作主语，后接 which 定语从句补充沉船时间，两个从句衔接自然。

b3-032-s009.skeleton: The chest contained the personal belongings
b3-032-s009.gloss: 箱里装着海员艾伦·菲尔丁的私人物品。
b3-032-s009.whyLearn: 人名紧跟名词作同位语，只用逗号隔开，是英文交代身份最省力的写法。

b3-032-s012.skeleton: Nothing of value was found, but the numerous items which were brought to the surface proved to be of great interest

modifiers.text: which were brought to the surface

b3-032-s012.gloss: 没找到值钱的东西，但打捞物很受关注。
b3-032-s012.whyLearn: but 连接两个被动句，定语从句后置修饰 items，prove to be 表结果，多层结构交错。

modifiers.text: From a heavy gun that was raised
that the ship must have been a cruiser

b3-032-s013.gloss: 从打捞的重炮，船长断定这是艘巡洋舰。
b3-032-s013.whyLearn: 介词短语置句首作依据，宾语从句里用 must have been 表对过去的推测，逻辑清晰。

modifiers.text: that the name of the lost ship was the Karen

b3-032-s015.gloss: 船长从信中得知，沉船叫卡伦号。
b3-032-s015.whyLearn: learnt from 加 that 宾语从句，用介词短语交代信息来源，是转述信息的基本框架。

b3-032-s016.skeleton: The most valuable find of all was the ship's log book

modifiers.text: parts of which it was still possible to read

b3-032-s016.gloss: 最有价值的发现是船上日志，部分仍可辨读。
b3-032-s016.whyLearn: 最高级主语加 parts of which 定语从句，把日志的可读性补上，学 which 前带名词的用法。

b3-032-s017.skeleton: the captain was able to piece together all the information

modifiers.text: to piece together all the information

b3-032-s017.gloss: 船长据此把已披露的信息拼合起来。
b3-032-s017.whyLearn: be able to 后接动词短语，再加 that 定语从句限定 information，适合练信息整合类表达。

b2-024-s005.gloss: 他说，如今人人都在亏钱。
b2-024-s005.whyLearn: 同一句里引语用现在进行时描述当下处境，转述部分用一般过去时，能对比两种时态的分工。

modifiers.text: to complain about this wicked world
but was interrupted by a knock at the door
by a knock at the door

b2-024-s006.gloss: 他开始抱怨这个邪恶的世界，却被敲门声打断。
b2-024-s006.whyLearn: start 后接不定式，was interrupted by 点出打断者，but 连接共享主语的第二个谓语，一句覆盖三个考点。

b2-024-s007.skeleton: A girl came in and put an envelope
b2-024-s007.gloss: 一个女孩进来，把一只信封放在他桌上。
b2-024-s007.whyLearn: came 与 put 用 and 并列共享一个主语，put 后是宾语加地点介词短语，his 是形容词性物主代词。

b2-024-s009.gloss: 她说，我是在这位先生房门外捡到的。
b2-024-s009.whyLearn: found 后接宾语再跟地点介词短语，引语末尾的逗号放在引号内，是英文引述的书写细节。

b2-025-s001.whyLearn: arrive in 后接大地点，at last 作时间状语置于句尾，很短一句就能记住到达类动词的搭配。

b2-025-s002.gloss: 火车站又大又黑，一片昏暗。
b2-025-s002.whyLearn: was 后接三个并列形容词作表语，and 只出现在最后两项之间，可体会逗号加 and 的并列规则。

b2-025-s003.skeleton: I did not know the way to my hotel
b2-025-s003.gloss: 我不认识去旅馆的路，就问了一个搬运工。
b2-025-s003.whyLearn: did not 构成过去否定，so 引出结果状语从句，the way to 是表达路线的固定搭配。

b2-025-s005.skeleton: The porter, however, could not understand me

modifiers.text: I repeated my question several times

b2-025-s005.gloss: 搬运工听不懂我的话，我重复几遍他才明白。
b2-025-s005.whyLearn: could not 表过去能力的否定，however 插在主语后要用逗号隔开，分号连接三个并列句，可学书面停顿。
