b2-025-s007.whyLearn: 引语用一般现在时陈述身份，转述动词 said 用过去时，一句话看清两种时态的搭配。

b2-025-s010.skeleton: The porter and I looked at each other and smiled
b2-025-s010.gloss: 搬运工和我对视一眼，都笑了。
b2-025-s010.whyLearn: 并列主语接两个并列谓语，look at 后用 each other 表互相，这里不能换成 themselves。

b2-025-s011.gloss: 然后他说了句什么，我听懂了。
b2-025-s011.whyLearn: 两个过去时小句由 and 连成并列句，it 回指前句的 something，可练代词回指与时序。

b2-025-s015.skeleton: each man speaks a different language
b2-025-s015.gloss: 在英格兰，每个人说的语言都不一样。
b2-025-s015.whyLearn: 地点状语 In England 置于句首并用逗号隔开，each man 作单数主语，谓语用 speaks。

modifiers.text: and I paint a lot of pictures

b2-026-s001.gloss: 我是学美术的，画很多画。
b2-026-s001.whyLearn: and 连接两个主语相同的现在时句子，a lot of 后接可数名词复数，是常用的数量表达。

b2-026-s002.gloss: 许多人假装自己懂现代艺术。
b2-026-s002.whyLearn: pretend 后接 that 引导的宾语从句，从句用一般现在时，可整句记下 pretend 的句型。

b2-026-s003.gloss: 他们总要告诉你一幅画在表达什么。
b2-026-s003.whyLearn: tell 后接双宾语再跟 what 引导的宾语从句，介词 about 留在从句末尾，是这类从句的常见语序。

b2-026-s004.gloss: 当然，许多画并不表达任何东西。
b2-026-s004.whyLearn: Of course 作插入语置于句首用逗号隔开，否定用 not ... anything 代替 nothing，语气更口语。

b3-053-s013.skeleton: the Ombudsman receives an average of 1200 letters a year

modifiers.text: As complaints must be made in writing

b3-053-s013.gloss: 投诉须书面提出，监察员一年收到约1200封信。
b3-053-s013.whyLearn: As 引导的原因状语从句放在句首，主句仍用一般现在时叙述常态，适合模仿“前置理由+主句结论”的说明文句式。

b3-053-s014.skeleton: He has eight lawyer assistants to help him and he examines every single letter in detail

modifiers.text: and he examines every single letter in detail

b3-053-s014.gloss: 他有八名律师助手，每封信都细看。
b3-053-s014.whyLearn: and 连接两个一般现在时的分句，交代“人手配置+本人做法”，是写人物职责时最省力的并列推进方式。

b3-053-s017.skeleton: The action he takes varies according to the nature of the complaint

modifiers.text: according to the nature of the complaint

b3-053-s017.gloss: 他采取什么行动，取决于投诉的性质。
b3-053-s017.whyLearn: he takes 是省略关系代词的定语从句，紧贴 The action；vary according to 表示“因人而异”。

b3-053-s018.skeleton: He may gently reprimand an official or even suggest to parliament that a law be altered
b3-053-s018.gloss: 他可温和批评官员，或建议议会修改法律。
b3-053-s018.whyLearn: suggest that ... be altered 用虚拟语气原形动词，是被动与虚拟语气叠加的高频书面表达，值得整块记住。

b3-053-s019.skeleton: The following case is a typical example of the Ombudsman's work
b3-053-s019.gloss: 下面这个案例典型反映了监察员的工作。
b3-053-s019.whyLearn: The following case is a typical example of... 是引出实例的现成框架，写案例报告可直接套用。

b3-053-s021.skeleton: The Ombudsman immediately wrote to the Chief of Police in the district

modifiers.text: asking him to send a record of the case

b3-053-s021.gloss: 监察员立即致信当地警察局长，要求送交案件记录。
b3-053-s021.whyLearn: 主句后接现在分词 asking 表伴随动作，避免再起一个 and 分句，是英语叙事里最常见的收尾方式。

modifiers.text: that a policeman had indeed dealt roughly with foreigners on several occasions

b3-053-s024.gloss: 律师查明，有警察确曾多次粗暴对待外国人。
b3-053-s024.whyLearn: 主句一般过去时配从句过去完成时，清晰排出“先查后发生”的时间层次，是转述调查结论的典型句式。

b3-053-s025.skeleton: The fact that the policeman was prejudiced against foreigners could not be recorded in he official files

modifiers.text: that the policeman was prejudiced against foreigners

b3-053-s025.gloss: 警察对外国人怀有偏见一事无法记入档案。
b3-053-s025.whyLearn: The fact that... 把整句事实压成主语，再用被动语态收束，是学术写作常用的抽象名词句式。

b3-053-s026.skeleton: It was only possible for the Ombudsman to find this out

modifiers.text: by sending one of his representatives to check the facts

b3-053-s026.gloss: 监察员只能派人前往核实，才弄清此事。
b3-053-s026.whyLearn: It was only possible for sb. to do... 把重点后置，by doing 说明唯一手段，可表达“别无他法”。

b3-053-s028.skeleton: The Ombudsman's prompt action at once put an end to an unpleasant practice
b3-053-s028.gloss: 监察员的迅速行动终结了这种不良做法。
b3-053-s028.whyLearn: put an end to 表“终结”，which might have gone unnoticed 用情态动词加完成式推测后果。

b3-054-s001.skeleton: We have been brought up to fear insects
b3-054-s001.gloss: 我们从小被教育要害怕昆虫。
b3-054-s001.whyLearn: bring up 的被动完成式 have been brought up 加不定式，一句话交代“从小被灌输的观念”，可用于写文化成见。

b3-054-s002.skeleton: We regard them as unnecessary creatures

modifiers.text: that do more harm than good

b3-054-s002.gloss: 我们视它们为害多益少的无用生物。
b3-054-s002.whyLearn: regard A as B 是“把……看作”的标准句式，后接 that 定语从句与 do more harm than good 比较结构。

b3-054-s003.skeleton: Man continually wages war on item

modifiers.text: for they contaminate his food, carry diseases, or devour his crops

b3-054-s003.gloss: 人类不断与昆虫为敌，因为它们污染食物、传播疾病。
b3-054-s003.whyLearn: wage war on 是“对……开战”的地道搭配，for 引出三个并列谓语的状语从句，一口气列出理由。

b3-054-s004.skeleton: They sting or bite without provocation; they fly uninvited into our rooms on summer nights, or beat against our lighted windows
b3-054-s004.gloss: 它们无故蜇咬，夏夜不请自来，扑撞亮着的窗。
b3-054-s004.whyLearn: 分号连接两个并列画面，用 sting、fly、beat 等具体动词堆出画面感，是描写式段落扩句的好范本。

b3-054-s006.skeleton: Reading about them increases our understanding with out dispelling our fears
b3-054-s006.gloss: 读它们的书增进了理解，却没消除恐惧。
b3-054-s006.whyLearn: 动名词短语 Reading about them 作主语，with out dispelling 形成“增进理解却不消除恐惧”的反差。

b3-054-s008.skeleton: we have a horror of being stung

modifiers.text: No matter how much we like honey, or how much we have read about the uncanny sense of direction which bees possess

b3-054-s008.gloss: 无论多爱蜂蜜、多了解蜜蜂的方向感，我们还是怕被蜇。
b3-054-s008.whyLearn: No matter how much... 并列两个让步分句，中间再套 which 定语从句，层层让步后亮出真实态度。

b3-033-s021.gloss: 与此同时，后面的车越堵越多。
b3-033-s021.whyLearn: Meanwhile 一词切换镜头，把堵车画面与前方事故并置，学它就能一句写出双线叙述。

b3-033-s023.skeleton: the lorry- driver had to sweep up hundreds of broken bottles

modifiers.text: to sweep up hundreds of broken bottles

b3-033-s023.gloss: 与此同时，卡车司机只好扫起几百个碎瓶子。
b3-033-s023.whyLearn: have to 表示客观被迫，sweep up 是清扫碎物的地道搭配，一句里同时学到被迫与清扫表达。

b3-033-s024.skeleton: Only two stray dogs benefited from all this confusion

modifiers.text: for they greedily devoured what was left of the cake
what was left of the cake

b3-033-s024.gloss: 只有两只野狗从这场混乱中受益，吃掉了剩蛋糕。
b3-033-s024.whyLearn: for 引导原因分句比 because 更书面，what was left 用名词性从句省去重复，值得仿写。

b3-033-s025.skeleton: It was just one of those days
b3-033-s025.gloss: 那真是倒霉透顶的一天。
b3-033-s025.whyLearn: one of those days 是口语习语，用来总述事事不顺的一天，可让叙事收尾更地道。

b3-034-s001.skeleton: Antique shops exert a peculiar fascination
b3-034-s001.gloss: 古董店对很多人有着奇特的吸引力。
b3-034-s001.whyLearn: exert a fascination on sb 是“对某人有吸引力”的高级说法，a great many 后直接接复数名词。

b3-034-s002.skeleton: The more expensive kind of antique shop

modifiers.text: where rare objects are beautifully displayed in glass cases to keep them free from dust
to keep them free from dust

b3-034-s002.gloss: 摆满玻璃柜的高档古董店总让人望而却步。
b3-034-s002.whyLearn: 定语从句插在主语与谓语之间，须先读到 is 才见到主干，练它可适应长间隔的主谓呼应。

b3-034-s003.skeleton: no one has to muster up courage

modifiers.text: to enter a less pretentious antique shop

b3-034-s003.gloss: 但走进一家不太张扬的古董店无需勇气。
b3-034-s003.whyLearn: no one has to 用否定主语表达“没人需要”，比 needn't 更强调没有必要，语气也更书面。

b3-034-s005.gloss: 没人能靠运气发现珍品。
b3-034-s005.whyLearn: by chance 表偶然，与否定主语连用常用来否定侥幸，句子极短却适合做格言式表达。

b3-034-s006.skeleton: A truly dedicated searcher for art treasures must have patience

modifiers.text: and above all, the ability to recognize the worth of something when he sees it
to recognize the worth of something when he sees it

b3-034-s006.gloss: 真正专注的寻宝者必须有耐心，更要有识货的眼力。
b3-034-s006.whyLearn: above all 插入并列成分，把“眼力”提到最高权重；ability 后接不定式而非 of doing，可整体仿写。

modifiers.text: Like a scientist bent on making a discovery,
that one day he will be amply rewarded

b3-034-s008.gloss: 像痴迷探索的科学家，他必须心怀终得厚报的希望。
b3-034-s008.whyLearn: hope 后接 that 同位语从句说明希望内容，bent on doing 作后置定语，两个结构叠加紧凑而专业。

b3-034-s009.gloss: 我的老朋友弗兰克·哈利迪就是这样的人。
b3-034-s009.whyLearn: 同位语紧贴人名，用两个逗号插入身份说明，是介绍人物出场最省笔墨的写法。

b3-034-s010.skeleton: He has often described to me

modifiers.text: how he picked up a masterpiece for a mere &5

b3-034-s010.gloss: 他常向我讲他如何花五英镑淘到一幅名画。
b3-034-s010.whyLearn: describe 后接 how 宾语从句，不能再加 that；现在完成时配 often 说明至今仍常提起。

b3-034-s011.gloss: 某个周六早上，弗兰克逛了我家附近一家古董店。
b3-034-s011.whyLearn: 时间名词短语直接作状语不加介词，与 in my neighbourhood 一前一后框定时间与地点。

b3-034-s015.skeleton: Frank begged him to do so

modifiers.text: and the dealer reluctantly prised it open

b3-034-s015.gloss: 弗兰克求他打开，店主才勉强撬开。
b3-034-s015.whyLearn: beg sb to do so 里 so 代替前文动作避免重复；and 后分句用 prised it open 的补语结构收尾。

b3-034-s017.skeleton: the box was full of crockery

modifiers.text: Apart from an interesting-looking carved dagger,

b3-034-s017.gloss: 除了雕花匕首，箱子里全是陶器，大多已碎。
b3-034-s017.whyLearn: Apart from 引出唯一的例外，much of it broken 是独立主格，用极短结构补出陶器的状态。

modifiers.text: and suddenly noticed a miniature Painting at the bottom of the packing-case
at the bottom of the packing-case

b3-034-s018.gloss: 弗兰克取出陶器，忽然发现箱底有一幅微型画。
b3-034-s018.whyLearn: lift...out of 表取出，and 连接两个并列谓语推进动作，at the bottom of 精准定位发现之处。

modifiers.text: if you win a lot of money

b1-069-s006.gloss: 问对方赢了大钱会做什么
b1-069-s006.whyLearn: 主句用 will，if 从句用一般现在时，是真实条件句最经典的时态搭配。

b1-069-s009.skeleton: I want to see the world
b1-069-s009.whyLearn: want 后接 to do 作宾语，是最常用的不定式搭配，see the world 意为周游世界。

b1-069-s012.gloss: 以后要回家乡买大房子
b1-069-s012.whyLearn: shall 用于第一人称表将来；return 与 buy 两个并列谓语共用 we shall，in the country 指乡下。

b1-069-s013.skeleton: We shall have a beautiful garden
b1-069-s013.gloss: 我们将拥有一个漂亮花园
b1-069-s013.whyLearn: shall have 表将来拥有；原句在 and 后中断，正好看出并列结构两端要成分对等。

modifiers.text: if we spend all that money

b1-069-s014.gloss: 若把钱花光，我们又会变穷
b1-069-s014.whyLearn: if 从句用 spend 一般现在时、主句用 shall be，条件句时态搭配一目了然。

b1-069-s017.gloss: 梦虽美好，但一切取决于如果
b1-069-s017.whyLearn: but 连接两个并列分句表转折；depend on 后把 if 当名词用，收尾俏皮。

b1-070-s001.whyLearn: 电话用语用 Is that you? 指对方；逗号后的 John 是独立呼语，不进主干。

modifiers.text: we shall be late for dinner this evening

b1-070-s003.gloss: 让玛丽知道我们晚饭会迟到
b1-070-s003.whyLearn: 祈使句 Tell 后省 that 直接接宾语从句；be late for 是固定搭配。

b1-070-s005.whyLearn: 否定疑问式 Hasn't Mary told you? 带惊讶语气，told 后省略间接宾语 you。

b1-070-s006.skeleton: She invited betty and me to dinner
b1-070-s006.gloss: 她请我和贝蒂今晚吃饭
b1-070-s006.whyLearn: invite sb to sth 结构；to dinner 是介词短语而非不定式，初学最易混淆。

modifiers.text: I would be at your house at six o'clock
but the boss wants me to do some extra work

b1-070-s007.gloss: 我说六点到，老板却要我加班
b1-070-s007.whyLearn: said 后从句用 would 表过去将来；but 连接并列分句，wants me to do 为宾补不定式。

b1-070-s008.skeleton: I'll have to stay at the office
b1-070-s008.whyLearn: have to 表客观上的不得不；I'll 后接 to 不定式，stay at 是固定搭配。

b1-070-s010.gloss: 妻子想知道玛丽是否需要帮忙
b1-070-s010.whyLearn: wants to know 后接 if 宾语从句，此处 if 意为是否；by the way 作插入语。

b1-070-s012.whyLearn: 前肯后否的反意疑问句：陈述用 is，附加问句用 isn't it 向对方求证。

b1-070-s013.gloss: 是的，我就是约翰·史密斯
b1-070-s013.whyLearn: Yes 独立作答，后接完整主系表 I'm John Smith，是最直白的确认方式。

b1-070-s014.gloss: 你是工程师约翰·史密斯，对吧？
b1-070-s014.whyLearn: 同位语 the engineer 补充身份，再加反意疑问句 aren't you 求证，语气更客气。

b2-066-s008.skeleton: He has had the length of the wings increased

modifiers.text: so that they now measure 93 feet--almost as long as those of a Dakota

b2-066-s008.gloss: 他把机翼加长到九十三英尺。
b2-066-s008.whyLearn: 使役结构加 so that 引结果，measure 说测得长度，as long as 比较达科他机翼。

modifiers.text: though air cyclists may learn how to fly over short distances, and may, eventually, even get across the English Channel
whether they will ever cycle across the Atlantic

b2-066-s010.gloss: 人力飞行器能否飞越大西洋令人怀疑。
b2-066-s010.whyLearn: 让步从句带 and 并列，主句只剩 it is doubtful；whether 从句后置，ever 与 will 指向将来。

b2-067-s004.skeleton: he could not stay near the volcano for very long

modifiers.text: Though he managed to take a number of brilliant photographs

b2-067-s004.gloss: 他拍到好照片，却无法久留火山旁。
b2-067-s004.whyLearn: though 只让一步：managed to take 肯定成绩，could not stay 才是重点。

b2-067-s008.skeleton: he managed to climb into the mouth of Kituro

modifiers.text: so that he could take photographs and measure temperatures

b2-067-s008.gloss: 他爬进火山口以便拍照测温。
b2-067-s008.whyLearn: so that 加 could 表目的，take 与 measure 并列共用 could，不必重复情态动词。

modifiers.text: It was no use pretending that I had not seen him
pretending that I had not seen him
that I had not seen him

b2-068-s002.gloss: 装没看见没用，我只好向他挥手。
b2-068-s002.whyLearn: 动名词后置作真主语；had not seen 是过去完成时，说明挥手前早已看见。

b2-068-s003.skeleton: I never enjoy meeting Bert Dykes
b2-068-s003.gloss: 我从不喜欢见到伯特·戴克斯。
b2-068-s003.whyLearn: never 直接否定 enjoy，比 do not 更绝对；enjoy 后只能接动名词 meeting。

b2-068-s004.skeleton: He never has anything to do
b2-068-s004.whyLearn: never 与 anything 连用构成全部否定；to do 作后置定语，说无事可做。

b2-068-s005.skeleton: he always insists on coming with you

modifiers.text: No matter how busy you are

b2-068-s005.gloss: 无论你多忙他都要跟着你。
b2-068-s005.whyLearn: no matter how 表让步，主句用 always 写固定习惯；insist on 后必须接动名词。

b2-068-s014.skeleton: Would you mind my coming with you ?
b2-068-s014.gloss: 问对方介不介意自己同行。
b2-068-s014.whyLearn: Would you mind 后接动名词，加 my 点明动作者是自己，问句更客气。

modifiers.text: but I'm going to the dentist.

b2-068-s016.whyLearn: 直接引语被 I lied 从中间切开；but 补出编造的借口，语气由真转假。

b2-068-s018.gloss: 候诊室里总有东西可读。
b2-068-s018.whyLearn: there be 配 always 表随时都有；不定式 to read 作 plenty 的后置定语。

b2-069-s001.gloss: 我第三次参加驾照考试。
b2-069-s001.whyLearn: was being tested 叠用过去进行时与被动语态；for the third time 说第三次。

modifiers.text: that a child suddenly crosses the road in front of you

b2-069-s006.gloss: 设想有孩子突然跑到你车前。
b2-069-s006.whyLearn: Let us suppose that 是引出假设的固定说法；从句用一般现在时表突发。

b2-069-s007.skeleton: I want the car to be stopped immediately

modifiers.text: As soon as I tap on the window

b2-069-s007.gloss: 我一敲窗你就得马上停车。
b2-069-s007.whyLearn: as soon as 从句用一般现在时代将来；want sth to be done 表要求车被停下。

b2-069-s009.skeleton: it took me a long time to react

modifiers.text: Though the sound could be heard clearly

b2-069-s009.gloss: 声音听得清，我却反应了很久。
b2-069-s009.whyLearn: though 从句用被动式承认声音清楚，主句是 it took me a long time to react。

b2-071-s001.skeleton: one of the first things you will see is Big Ben

modifiers.text: the famous clock which can be heard all over the world on the B.

b2-071-s001.gloss: 到伦敦先看到的就是大本钟。
b2-071-s001.whyLearn: one of the first things you will see 套了省略 that 的定语从句，后面接同位语。

b2-088-s010.skeleton: the men are cheerful and confident that they will get out soon

modifiers.text: Though they are running out of food and drink,
running out of food and drink

b2-088-s010.gloss: 尽管快断粮断水，大家仍乐观自信。
b2-088-s010.whyLearn: 让步从句用进行时写困境，主句 be confident that 引出信念，一抑一扬的对比句式值得背。

modifiers.text: that rescue operations are progressing smoothly

b2-088-s011.gloss: 他们被告知救援进展顺利。
b2-088-s011.whyLearn: have been told 是完成时被动，后接 that 宾语从句、从句再用进行时，转述消息的典型三层句式。

modifiers.text: If they knew how difficult it was to drill through the hard rock,
how difficult it was to drill through the hard rock
to drill through the hard rock

b2-088-s012.gloss: 若知道钻岩多难，他们就会泄气。
b2-088-s012.whyLearn: 虚拟条件句 If 加过去时配 would，从句里再嵌 how difficult 间接疑问和不定式，层层套叠的练手句。

modifiers.text: When the news got round that a variety show would be presented at our local cinema by the P.
that a variety show would be presented at our local cinema by the P.

b2-089-s002.gloss: 消息传开：本地影院要上演综艺节目。
b2-089-s002.whyLearn: news 后的 that 同位语从句被谓语隔开，还要认出 when 时间从句和被动语态，主干辨认可练手。

b2-089-s004.skeleton: we all rushed to see it
b2-089-s004.gloss: 我们全赶去看这场演出。
b2-089-s004.whyLearn: to see it 表目的，还承接上句被逗号切开的同位语，练跨句拼接与不定式作目的状语。

b2-089-s005.skeleton: We had to queue for hours

modifiers.text: there must have been several hundred people present just be- fore the show began
just be- fore the show began

b2-089-s005.gloss: 我们排队数小时才进场，开场前已有数百人。
b2-089-s005.whyLearn: had to 表客观必须，must have been 表对过去的推测，两个分句并列铺陈入场盛况，对比很典型。

b2-089-s006.skeleton: the show was one of the dullest we have ever seen
b2-089-s006.gloss: 可惜演出是我们看过最乏味的之一。
b2-089-s006.whyLearn: one of the 加最高级再加 we have ever seen 是评价事物的固定框，省略关系词，考试常考。

b2-089-s008.skeleton: The only funny things we heard that evening came from the advertiser

modifiers.text: at the beginning of the programme

b2-089-s008.gloss: 当晚唯一好笑的是节目开头的广告员。
b2-089-s008.whyLearn: 定语从句 we heard 省了关系词，主语被拉长后谓语 came 才出现，专治找不准主干。

modifiers.text: and for some minutes stood awkwardly before the microphone

b2-089-s009.gloss: 他很紧张，在麦克风前局促地站了几分钟。
b2-089-s009.whyLearn: and 连接第二个谓语 stood，两个状语一前一后分开摆放，可体会英语状语位置的灵活。

b2-089-s011.skeleton: We all know what the poor man should have said

modifiers.text: what the poor man should have said
but what he actually said was: 'This is the Poo and Ee Seed Bird Company.

b2-089-s011.gloss: 我们知他该说什么，他实际却说错公司名。
b2-089-s011.whyLearn: what 从句一作宾语一作主语，should have said 表本该而未做的责备，口语对比句式的范本。

b2-090-s003.skeleton: the new city, Brasilia, replaced Rio de Janeiro as the capital of Brazif in 1960

modifiers.text: Designed by the great architect Lucio Costa,

b2-090-s003.gloss: 巴西利亚1960年取代里约成为首都。
b2-090-s003.whyLearn: 句首过去分词短语作状语表被动，中间又插同位语 Brasilia，是训练抓主干的经典排列。

b2-090-s004.gloss: 巴西利亚为现代生活做了精心规划。
b2-090-s004.whyLearn: have been done 完成时被动，副词 carefully 插在助动词与过去分词之间，语序位置值得记牢。

b2-090-s005.skeleton: Its wide roads, which can take fourteen lanes of traffic, have been keptaway from living areas

modifiers.text: which can take fourteen lanes of traffic,

b2-090-s005.gloss: 宽阔道路可容十四车道，还远离生活区。
b2-090-s005.whyLearn: 非限制性定语从句把主语和谓语劈开，必须跨过 which 从句才能找到 have been kept 这个谓语。

b2-090-s007.skeleton: Housewives can visit-shopping centres on foot

modifiers.text: for in these specially designed living areas, cars are unnecessary.
in these specially designed living areas

b2-090-s007.gloss: 主妇步行就能购物，因这些生活区不必开车。
b2-090-s007.whyLearn: for 作并列连词引出原因，前后各带一个介词短语，可练因果连接与状语位置的安排。

b2-090-s008.skeleton: the government had great difficulty in persuading people

modifiers.text: in persuading people to leave Rio and to settle in Brasilia
to leave Rio and to settle in Brasilia

b2-090-s008.gloss: 起初政府很难说服人们离开里约。
b2-090-s008.whyLearn: have difficulty in doing 是高频搭配，介词后接动名词，后面再接两个并列不定式，环环相扣。

b2-090-s009.skeleton: the population has been growing all the time
b2-090-s009.gloss: 自1960年起人口一直在持续增长。
b2-090-s009.whyLearn: since 加时间点须配完成进行时，however 插在主语前，可看时间状语与完成时态如何互相呼应。

b1-063-s011.gloss: 过去每天都必须给它浇水。
b1-063-s011.whyLearn: had to 是 have to 的过去式，表示过去客观上的必须，后接动词原形。

b1-063-s012.gloss: 苏珊说自己一个人喝茶。
b1-063-s012.whyLearn: will 加动词原形表临时决定；by myself 意为独自一人，反身代词不能换成 me。

b1-063-s019.gloss: 那意味着你不必给花园浇水。
b1-063-s019.whyLearn: needn't 是 need 作情态动词的否定式，表不必；means 后接省略 that 的宾语从句。

b1-063-s020.gloss: 彼得说那是个令人高兴的惊喜。
b1-063-s020.whyLearn: 用过去时 That was 指刚发生的事；surprise 指一件具体惊喜事时为可数名词。

b1-064-s001.gloss: 凯特问米莉能否认出那位女士。
b1-064-s001.whyLearn: Can 开头的一般疑问句问能力；句末称呼语 Millie 前用逗号隔开，是口语常见语序。

b1-064-s003.gloss: 那一定是女演员卡伦·马什。
b1-064-s003.whyLearn: must be 表示很有把握的肯定推测；逗号后的 the actress 是同位语，补充说明身份。

b1-064-s006.gloss: 米莉猜那一定是康拉德·里夫斯。
b1-064-s006.whyLearn: That must be 加人名，是简洁的高把握推测句，常用于辨认人物时即时应答。

b1-064-s012.skeleton: He must be her fourth or fifth
b1-064-s012.gloss: 米莉说他一定是她的第四或第五任。
b1-064-s012.whyLearn: must be 表推测；her 是形容词性物主代词，序数词前加它表示她的第几任。

b1-064-s013.gloss: 凯特感叹卡伦·马什显老。
b1-064-s013.whyLearn: 否定疑问句加感叹号，表达惊讶与感叹，语气比陈述句强烈得多。

modifiers.text: but she must be at least forty

b1-064-s015.gloss: 我读到她是二十九，但她肯定至少四十。
b1-064-s015.whyLearn: read 用一般现在时表读到；must be 表推断，but 把两个分句并置形成对比。

modifiers.text: when I was still a schoolgirl

b1-064-s017.gloss: 米莉说她当女学生时对方已是名演员。
b1-064-s017.whyLearn: when 引导时间状语从句，主从句都用一般过去时，表示过去两个状态同时存在。

b1-064-s018.skeleton: That was a long time ago
b1-064-s018.gloss: 凯特说那是很久以前的事，对吧？
b1-064-s018.whyLearn: 反意疑问句前肯后否，wasn't it 与 That was 呼应；ago 只与一般过去时连用。

b1-064-s020.gloss: 我自己也不超过二十九岁。
b1-064-s020.whyLearn: not more than 表示不超过；句末 myself 作强调同位语，突出说话人本人。

b1-065-s006.gloss: 你当时一定在以七十英里时速行驶。
b1-065-s006.whyLearn: must have been doing 是对过去持续动作的高把握推测，情态动词后接完成进行时。

b1-065-s009.skeleton: Didn't you see the speed limit
b1-065-s009.gloss: 警察问他难道没看见限速标志吗？
b1-065-s009.whyLearn: 否定疑问句 Didn't you 用于质问或惊讶；see 在此指看见，宾语是 the speed limit。

b1-065-s014.skeleton: That's why I didn't see the sign

modifiers.text: why I didn't see the sign

b1-065-s014.gloss: 哈里说这就是他没看见标志的原因。
b1-065-s014.whyLearn: That's why 加从句用来交代原因，从句用过去时 didn't see，指已发生的事。

b2-059-s009.gloss: 于是他坐下吠叫，直到有人放他出去。
b2-059-s009.whyLearn: until 引导时间状语从句，说明动作持续到某一刻；从句用一般现在时表将来，sits 与 barks 是并列谓语。

b2-059-s010.skeleton: he immediately lets himself in and begins barking again
b2-059-s010.gloss: 此后他立刻自己进屋，接着又开始叫。
b2-059-s010.whyLearn: After this 作时间状语；let oneself in 用反身代词表示自己进门，begins 后接动名词 barking 作宾语。

b2-059-s011.skeleton: my husband removed the gate and Rex got so annoyed

modifiers.text: we have not seen him since

b2-059-s011.gloss: 昨天丈夫拆掉大门，雷克斯气得不再现身。
b2-059-s011.whyLearn: so...that 结果从句省略了 that；前句用一般过去时讲拆门，结果句用现在完成时加 since，时态对比是难点。

b2-060-s002.skeleton: I went into her tent and she told me to sit down
b2-060-s002.gloss: 我走进她的帐篷，她让我坐下。
b2-060-s002.whyLearn: tell sb to do sth 的复合宾语结构，必须用不定式；and 连接两个一般过去时谓语，叙述连贯动作。

b2-060-s003.skeleton: she looked into a crystal ball and said

modifiers.text: After I had given her some money
'A relation of yours is coming to see you

b2-060-s003.gloss: 我给了她钱后，她看着水晶球说你亲戚要来看你。
b2-060-s003.whyLearn: After 从句用过去完成时表先发生；引语里 is coming 用现在进行时表将来，是口语中常见的安排说法。

b2-060-s004.skeleton: She will be arriving this evening and intends to stay for a few days

modifiers.text: and intends to stay for a few days
to stay for a few days

b2-060-s004.gloss: 她今晚到达，并打算住上几天。
b2-060-s004.whyLearn: will be arriving 是将来进行时，表示已定的安排；and 后换用 intends to do，避免重复又保持并列。

b2-060-s005.skeleton: you will get a big surprise

modifiers.text: The moment you leave this tent

b2-060-s005.gloss: 你一离开这个帐篷就会大吃一惊。
b2-060-s005.whyLearn: The moment 相当于 as soon as，引导时间状语从句；从句用一般现在时，主句用一般将来时。

b2-060-s006.skeleton: A woman you know well will rush towards you
b2-060-s006.gloss: 一个你很熟的女人会朝你冲过来。
b2-060-s006.whyLearn: 定语从句的关系代词作宾语时省略，you know well 直接跟在 a woman 后，是很典型的省略现象。

b2-060-s007.skeleton: She will speak to you and then she will lead you away from this place

modifiers.text: and then she will lead you away from this place

b2-060-s007.gloss: 她会跟你说话，然后带你离开这里。
b2-060-s007.whyLearn: 两个 will 并列预示连续动作；then 表明先后顺序，lead sb away from 的搭配值得整块记住。

b2-060-s014.skeleton: I followed her out of the fair
b2-060-s014.gloss: 她走开时，我跟着她走出了集市。
b2-060-s014.whyLearn: As 引导时间状语从句表示同时；out of the fair 是介词短语作方向状语，follow sb out of 可整体记。

b2-061-s003.skeleton: Scientists are now trying to discover

modifiers.text: to discover if this is possible

b2-061-s003.gloss: 科学家正在努力弄清这是否可能。
b2-061-s003.whyLearn: trying to discover 后接 if 引导的宾语从句，即间接疑问句；此处 if 意为是否，而不是条件。

b2-061-s004.skeleton: The spaceship Astra which left the earth a short time ago, will be travelling three hundred miles into space

modifiers.text: which left the earth a short time ago

b2-061-s004.gloss: 阿斯特拉号不久前离开地球，将深入太空三百英里。
b2-061-s004.whyLearn: which 引导的非限制性定语从句插在主语后，主句用将来进行时；逗号把从句与主句谓语分开，容易读错。

b4-059-s002.skeleton: it is far from being the only one
b4-059-s002.gloss: 它远非唯一，更不是最大的
b4-059-s002.whyLearn: contrary to 作插入语，far from being 表'远非'，or 并列补充否定，是反驳流行观点的句式。

b4-059-s003.skeleton: The man who manoeuvres carelessly into his five shillings worth of space at one of Europe's myriad permanent sites may find himself bumping a Bentley.

modifiers.text: who manoeuvres carelessly into his five shillings worth of space at one of Europe's myriad permanent sites
into his five shillings worth of space
at one of Europe's myriad permanent sites

b4-059-s003.gloss: 停车莽撞的人可能撞上豪车
b4-059-s003.whyLearn: 定语从句把主语和 may find 隔开，find oneself doing 表'发现自己正在做'，是长距离主谓分离。

b4-059-s004.skeleton: Ford Consul will be hub to hub with Renault or Mercedes

modifiers.text: but rarely with bicycles made for two

b4-059-s004.gloss: 停车场多是各国轿车，双人自行车少见
b4-059-s004.whyLearn: will be 表推测，hub to hub 名词并列作表语，but 后省略 will be，是并列省略的典型。

b4-059-s006.skeleton: It also provides--and some student sociologist might care to base his thesis upon the phenomenon--an escape of another kind.

modifiers.text: --and some student sociologist might care to base his thesis upon the phenomenon--
to base his thesis upon the phenomenon

b4-059-s006.gloss: 它还提供另一种逃避方式
b4-059-s006.whyLearn: 双破折号插入语把 provides 与其宾语 escape 隔开，阅读须先跳过插入成分抓主干。

b4-059-s008.skeleton: he is by no means sure

modifiers.text: to tip the doorman or the chambermaid

b4-059-s008.gloss: 他虽有钱，却不知该给多少小费
b4-059-s008.whyLearn: Affluent he may be 是让步倒装，by no means 后接形容词表'绝不'，句式少见。

modifiers.text: of when to say boo to a maitre d'hotel
when to say boo to a maitre d'hotel

b4-059-s009.gloss: 他在家是主人，却不懂餐厅礼节
b4-059-s009.whyLearn: Master in his own house 名词短语作同位语，when to say 是疑问词加不定式作宾语。

b4-059-s010.gloss: 露营让人摆脱这一切恐惧
b4-059-s010.whyLearn: From all such fears 前置，release sb from sth 搭配，主语 camping 用单数谓语。

b4-059-s013.gloss: 除这些动机外，还须再加一个
b4-059-s013.whyLearn: To such motives 前置，must be added 为被动，主语 yet another 后置，是正式语序。

b4-059-s014.skeleton: The contemporary phenomenon of motor-car worship is to be explained

modifiers.text: not least by the sense of independence and freedom

b4-059-s014.gloss: 汽车崇拜源于拥有带来的独立自由感
b4-059-s014.whyLearn: is to be explained 不定式被动表'有待解释'，that ownership entails 从句后置修饰。

b4-059-s015.gloss: 露营为这种乐趣增添了精致
b4-059-s015.whyLearn: 与 s010 同类的'介词短语+主语+谓语'语序，give sth to sb 的 to 提前，可对比记忆。

modifiers.text: From one's own front door to home or foreign hills or sands and back again
home or foreign hills or sands

b4-059-s016.gloss: 从家门到山野海滨，一切近在咫尺
b4-059-s016.whyLearn: From...to...并列举出全程，everything is to hand 中 to hand 是'在手边'的固定表达。

b4-059-s019.skeleton: Insularity and self-containment, it is argued, go hand in hand.
b4-059-s019.gloss: 据说封闭与自守总是相伴而生
b4-059-s019.whyLearn: it is argued 插入主谓之间，go hand in hand 是固定搭配，并列主语用复数 go。

b4-059-s020.skeleton: The opinion does not survive experience

modifiers.text: of a popular Continental camping place

b4-059-s020.gloss: 体验一次欧洲营地，这看法便不成立
b4-059-s020.whyLearn: 否定句 does not survive 后接抽象名词，意为'经不起检验'，比 is not true 更书面。

b4-059-s022.skeleton: Camping sites, by contrast, are highly cosmopolitan.
b4-059-s022.gloss: 相比之下，营地极具国际化色彩
b4-059-s022.whyLearn: 逗号插入 by contrast 承接上文对比，cosmopolitan 作表语，语域十分正式。

b4-059-s025.skeleton: the odour of sauerkraut vies with that of garlic
b4-059-s025.gloss: 吃饭时酸菜味与蒜味相互较劲
b4-059-s025.whyLearn: vie with 意为'与…竞争'，that of garlic 用 that 代替 the odour，避免重复。

b4-059-s026.skeleton: The Frenchman's breakfast coffee competes with the Englishman's bacon and eggs.

modifiers.text: with the Englishman's bacon and eggs

b4-059-s026.gloss: 法国人的咖啡与英国人的培根鸡蛋较量
b4-059-s026.whyLearn: compete with 表'与…不相上下'，两个所有格短语并列对比，写出饮食文化的较量。

b3-023-s015.skeleton: I left the bag in thehall and Robert and I went into the living-room

modifiers.text: where we talked for a couple of hours

b3-023-s015.gloss: 我把包放在门厅，和罗伯特进了起居室，聊了两小时。
b3-023-s015.whyLearn: and 串联两个过去动作，再用 where 从句补出谈话地点，是叙事句最常见的推进方式。

b3-023-s016.skeleton: I had forgotten all about the snails

modifiers.text: when Robert suddenly said that I must stay to dinner
that I must stay to dinner

b3-023-s016.gloss: 我早把蜗牛忘了，罗伯特忽然说我必须留下吃饭。
b3-023-s016.whyLearn: 过去完成时铺垫遗忘，when 引出变化，said that 转述要求，一句里叠了三种常用结构。

b3-023-s017.skeleton: Snails would, of course, be the main dish.
b3-023-s017.whyLearn: would 在此表推测，of course 插在助动词与实义动词之间，可学插入语的位置与逗号用法。

b3-023-s018.skeleton: I did not fancy the idea

modifiers.text: and I reluctantly followed Robert out of the room

b3-023-s018.gloss: 我不喜欢这个主意，勉强跟着罗伯特出了房间。
b3-023-s018.whyLearn: did not 否定与 and 并列相连，reluctantly 一词又点出不情愿，语气与结构都值得模仿。

b3-024-s001.gloss: 我们常在小说里读到看似体面的人怎样……
b3-024-s001.whyLearn: read 后接 how 从句作宾语，用一般现在时泛述书中常见情节，是评述性开篇的简洁句式。

b3-024-s002.skeleton: The English language possesses a vivid saying

modifiers.text: to describe this sort of situation

b3-024-s002.gloss: 英语里有一句生动的俗语来形容这种情况。
b3-024-s002.whyLearn: possess 比 have 正式，后用 to do 作后置定语说明用途，学术写作里很实用。

b3-024-s003.gloss: 这个可怕的秘密被称作“柜中骷髅”。
b3-024-s003.whyLearn: is called 后接引号内的名称，学会用被动语态给事物下定义、起名号的表达。

b3-024-s004.skeleton: the terrible secret becomes known and a reputation is ruined

modifiers.text: At some dramatic moment in the story

b3-024-s004.gloss: 故事高潮处秘密曝光，名声随之被毁。
b3-024-s004.whyLearn: becomes known 与 is ruined 前后并列，两个被动式写出连锁后果，可学戏剧化叙述的骨架。

modifiers.text: for such things to occur in fiction

b3-024-s006.gloss: 这种事发生在小说里倒也无妨。
b3-024-s006.whyLearn: It is all very well for sb to do 是固定让步句式，it 作形式主语，考试与口语都常用。

modifiers.text: which we do not want even our closest friends to learn
but few of us have skeletons in the cupboard

b3-024-s007.gloss: 人人都有秘密，但极少有人有“柜中骷髅”。
b3-024-s007.whyLearn: which 从句内嵌 want sb to do 的否定式，再用 but 对照收束，层次多而不乱。

b3-024-s008.skeleton: The only person I know who has a skeleton in the cupboard is George Carlton

modifiers.text: who has a skeleton in the cupboard
and he is very proud of the fact

b3-024-s008.gloss: 我认识的唯一有“柜中骷髅”的人是乔治·卡尔顿。
b3-024-s008.whyLearn: 同一名词后连跟两个定语从句，一个省略关系词，一个用 who，是定语叠加的典型范例。

b3-024-s009.skeleton: George studied medicine in his youth.
b3-024-s009.gloss: 乔治年轻时学的是医学。
b3-024-s009.whyLearn: studied medicine 是“学医”的固定搭配，in his youth 交代背景，一词一句讲清人物来历。

b3-024-s010.skeleton: he became a successful writer of detective stories
b3-024-s010.gloss: 他后来没当医生，成了侦探小说作家。
b3-024-s010.whyLearn: instead of + doing 置于句首表替代，however 插入其中作转折，句子紧凑又有对比。

b3-024-s012.skeleton: George showed me to the guestroom
b3-024-s012.gloss: 乔治把我领到很少使用的客房。
b3-024-s012.whyLearn: 关系词与从句谓语被 he said 隔开，可学插入语打断定语从句时如何还原句子。

b3-024-s013.skeleton: He told me to unpack my things and then come down to dinner.

modifiers.text: and then come down to dinner

b3-024-s013.gloss: 他让我收拾行李，然后下楼吃晚饭。
b3-024-s013.whyLearn: tell sb to do 后并列第二个不定式常省略 to，这是中国学生容易多写 to 的地方。

b3-024-s014.skeleton: I decided to hang in the cupboard one of the two suits I had brought with me

modifiers.text: After I had stacked my shirts and underclothes in two empty drawers
to hang in the cupboard one of the two suits I had brought with me

b3-024-s014.gloss: 我把衬衫内衣叠进抽屉后，决定把一套西装挂进柜子。
b3-024-s014.whyLearn: after 从句用过去完成时定先后，decide to do 后又把宾语拉到后面，值得拆解模仿。

b3-015-s011.skeleton: he dropped his sixpence and it rolled along the pavement and then disappeared down a drain

modifiers.text: On his way to the sweet shop
and it rolled along the pavement and then disappeared down a drain

b3-015-s011.gloss: 他去糖果店途中掉了六便士，硬币滚进下水道
b3-015-s011.whyLearn: 句首 On his way to... 交代时间地点；and 串起丢钱、滚动、消失三个连贯动作，是叙事句的典型节奏。

b3-015-s012.skeleton: George took offhis jacket, rolled up his sleeves and pushed his right arm
b3-015-s012.gloss: 乔治脱衣卷袖，把右臂伸进下水道盖
b3-015-s012.whyLearn: 三个过去式谓语 took off、rolled up、pushed 并列连用表现一气呵成的动作，his 指代主语自身。

b3-015-s014.skeleton: A crowd of people gathered round him and a lady rubbed his arm with soap and butter
b3-015-s014.gloss: 众人围上来，一位女士用肥皂黄油搓他的手臂
b3-015-s014.whyLearn: and 并列两个场景句后接 but 转折，被动的 stuck 收尾，把徒劳的救援写得很生动。

b3-015-s015.skeleton: The fire-brigade was called and two firemen freed George

modifiers.text: using a special type of grease

b3-015-s015.gloss: 消防队被叫来，用特种油脂救出乔治
b3-015-s015.whyLearn: was called 被动与 freed 主动并列对照，句末 using... 现在分词作方式状语，说明怎么救出来的。

b3-016-s001.skeleton: Mary and her husband Dimitri lived
b3-016-s001.gloss: 玛丽和丈夫迪米特里住在小村庄里
b3-016-s001.whyLearn: live in 是核心搭配，介词短语 in the tiny village of 交代地点；注意原句在 of 处被截断。

b3-016-s002.skeleton: One of Mary's prize possessions was a little white lamb

modifiers.text: which her husband had given her

b3-016-s002.gloss: 玛丽最珍视的东西是丈夫送的小白羊羔
b3-016-s002.whyLearn: One of + 复数名词是数量表达，which 定语从句后置修饰 lamb，had given 用过去完成时表更早动作。

b3-016-s003.skeleton: She kept it tied to a tree in a field during the day and went to fetch it every evening

modifiers.text: tied to a tree in a field

b3-016-s003.gloss: 她白天把小羊拴在田里的树上，晚上牵回来
b3-016-s003.whyLearn: keep it tied 是 keep+宾语+过去分词；to fetch 表目的，白天与傍晚对举写出固定的日常。

b3-016-s004.gloss: 然而一天傍晚，小羊不见了
b3-016-s004.whyLearn: however 作插入语夹在时间状语后；be missing 用进行时形式表示「不见了」，比 absent 更口语。

b3-016-s007.gloss: 迪米特里立刻动身去找偷羊贼
b3-016-s007.whyLearn: set out to do 表示着手去做某事，at once 插在主语和谓语之间，是不停顿行动的简洁写法。

modifiers.text: it would not prove difficult in such a small village

b3-016-s008.gloss: 他知道在这么小的村子里查案不难
b3-016-s008.whyLearn: knew 后接省略 that 的宾语从句；prove 在此表「结果是」，would 表推断，语气比 is 委婉。

modifiers.text: After telling several of his friends about the theft
that his neighbour, Aleko, had suddenly acquired a new lamb

b3-016-s009.gloss: 四处打听后，他得知邻居阿列科新得一只羊
b3-016-s009.whyLearn: After + 动名词作时间状语，found out that 引出宾语从句，had acquired 过去完成时点明更早发生的事。

b3-016-s010.skeleton: Dimitri immediately went to Aleko's house and angrily accused him
b3-016-s010.gloss: 他直奔阿列科家，愤怒指责对方偷羊
b3-016-s010.whyLearn: accuse sb of doing sth 是固定搭配，of 后必须接动名词；and 并列两个过去式谓语推进情节。

b3-016-s012.skeleton: Aleko denied taking it and led Dimitri
b3-016-s012.gloss: 阿列科否认偷羊，把迪米特里领到后院
b3-016-s012.whyLearn: deny doing sth 后只接动名词不接不定式；his back-yard 用所有格标明院子归属。

modifiers.text: that he had just bought a lamb

b3-016-s013.gloss: 他解释说自己确实刚买过羊，但那是黑羊
b3-016-s013.whyLearn: It was true that... 用形式主语强调事实，he explained 插入语带来转述口吻，but 一转给出不在场证据。

modifiers.text: Ashamed of having acted so rashly

b3-016-s014.gloss: 他为自己的莽撞向阿列科道歉
b3-016-s014.whyLearn: 形容词短语置句首作原因状语；apologize for having done 用完成式动名词说明道歉的是更早的错怪。

b3-016-s017.skeleton: Its wool, which had been dyed black, had been washed clean
b3-016-s017.gloss: 羊毛被染成黑色，却被雨水冲回原色
b3-016-s017.whyLearn: 非限制性定语从句插在主谓之间，主句用过去完成时被动；by the rain 指出施动者，真相就此揭开。

b4-015-s004.skeleton: Many of these obligations can give rise to problems and complications

modifiers.text: but a bank customer, unlike, say, a buyer of goods, cannot complain that the law is loaded against him
unlike, say, a buyer of goods

b4-015-s004.gloss: 客户的义务会带来麻烦，但他无法抱怨法律不公。
b4-015-s004.whyLearn: 插入语 unlike, say 把主谓隔开，是练习跳读找主干的典型例句。

b4-015-s005.skeleton: The bank must obey its customer's instructions

modifiers.text: and not those of anyone else

b4-015-s005.gloss: 银行只能听客户的指示，不能听别人的。
b4-015-s005.whyLearn: and not 引导的否定并列省略了动词，须从上文补出 obey，体会英语省略。

b4-015-s006.skeleton: he instructs the bank to debit his account only in respect of cheques drawn by himself

modifiers.text: When, for example, a customer first opens an account

b4-015-s006.gloss: 开户时客户指示银行只兑付他本人签发的支票。
b4-015-s006.whyLearn: when 从句后主句用 instruct sb to do，插入语还割裂了连词与主语。

modifiers.text: that the forgery may have been a very skilful one
the bank must recognize its customer's signature

b4-015-s008.gloss: 伪造得再高明也无所谓，银行必须核对客户签名。
b4-015-s008.whyLearn: It 是形式主语，真主语是 that 从句，冒号后才给出关键结论。

b4-015-s009.skeleton: there is no risk to the customer in the modern practice

modifiers.text: of printing the customer's name on his cheques

b4-015-s009.gloss: 把客户姓名印在支票上，这种做法对客户无风险。
b4-015-s009.whyLearn: practice 与 of doing 被 adopted 分词短语拆开，须跨越修饰找搭配。

modifiers.text: less than a foot in diameter

b4-016-s003.gloss: 这些孔只是钻孔，直径不到一英尺。
b4-016-s003.whyLearn: 逗号后的名词短语补充说明 borings，是书面语常用的后置描述。

b4-016-s004.skeleton: My particular experience is largely in oil

modifiers.text: and the search for oil has done more to improve deep drilling than any other mining activity

b4-016-s004.gloss: 我的经验主要在石油，找油最推动深钻技术。
b4-016-s004.whyLearn: has done more to do than 把完成时、不定式、比较级叠在一句，值得整块记。

b4-016-s007.skeleton: The geologist needs to know what rocks the drill has reached

modifiers.text: what rocks the drill has reached
so every so often a sample is obtained with a coring bit

b4-016-s007.gloss: 地质学家要知道钻头钻到什么岩层，需常取样。
b4-016-s007.whyLearn: what 引导的间接疑问句作 know 的宾语，so 引出取样这一应对措施。

b4-016-s008.skeleton: It cuts a clean cylinder of rock

modifiers.text: from which can be seen he strata the drill has been cutting through
the drill has been cutting through

b4-016-s008.gloss: 它切出干净的岩芯，从中能看清钻过的岩层。
b4-016-s008.whyLearn: from which 定语从句中被动语态的主语被后置，是倒装语序的典型难点。

b4-016-s010.skeleton: This pressure must be under control

modifiers.text: and we control it by means of the mud which we circulate down the drill pipe
which we circulate down the drill pipe

b4-016-s010.gloss: 压力必须受控，靠循环泥浆来调节。
b4-016-s010.whyLearn: and 并列两分句，后半句再用定语从句说明泥浆，主干与修饰层次分明。

b4-016-s011.skeleton: We endeavour to avoid the old, romantic idea of a gusher
b4-016-s011.gloss: 我们要避免旧式浪漫的井喷观念，它浪费油气。
b4-016-s011.whyLearn: endeavour to do 后接名词短语，再用 which 从句补出这种观念的危害。

b4-017-s001.skeleton: The fact that we are not sure what 'intelligence' is, nor what is passed on, doe

modifiers.text: that we are not sure what 'intelligence' is, nor what is passed on

b4-017-s001.gloss: 我们不确定智力是什么，也不确定遗传的是什么。
b4-017-s001.whyLearn: The fact that 引出同位语从句，从句内又套两个 what 从句，层层嵌套。

b4-017-s004.skeleton: some kind of selection had to be made

modifiers.text: Since the number of grammar schools in the country could accommodate at most approximately 25 per cent of the total child population of eleven-plus

b4-017-s004.gloss: 文法学校最多容纳25%，因此必须择优录取。
b4-017-s004.whyLearn: since 原因状语从句很长，主句 had to be made 短而关键，宜先抓主句。

b4-017-s005.skeleton: Narrowly academic examinations and tests were felt

modifiers.text: to be heavily weighted in favour of children who had had the advantage of highly-academic primary schools and academically biased homes
who had had the advantage of highly-academic primary schools and academically biased homes

b4-017-s005.gloss: 人们认为偏学术的考试明显有利于条件好的孩子。
b4-017-s005.whyLearn: 被动后接不定式，插入语 quite rightly 夹在中间，要辨清 to be 才是补语。

b4-017-s006.skeleton: Intelligence tests were devised to counteract this narrow specialization

modifiers.text: by introducing problems which were not based on specifically scholastically-acquired knowledge
which were not based on specifically scholastically-acquired knowledge

b4-017-s006.gloss: 智力测验为抵消狭隘专门化，题目不靠书本知识。
b4-017-s006.whyLearn: 目的不定式后接 by doing，其中再套 which 定语从句，修饰链完整。

b4-018-s001.skeleton: Two factors weigh heavily against the effectiveness of scientific in industry

modifiers.text: against the effectiveness of scientific in industry

b4-018-s001.gloss: 两个因素严重削弱科学在工业中的效用。
b4-018-s001.whyLearn: weigh against 是固定搭配，主语加动词加介词短语即完整主干。

b1-017-s002.skeleton: There are some clouds in the sky, but the sun is shining.

modifiers.text: There are some clouds in the sky

b1-017-s002.gloss: 天上有云，但太阳正照着。
b1-017-s002.whyLearn: 存在句先说有什么，进行时再说正在怎样，but把两种天气接起来，一句话学会两个时态对照。

b1-017-s006.skeleton: There are some boats on the river.
b1-017-s006.whyLearn: river前用on而不是in，这个介词差别专治中式搭配；名词复数也决定be动词用are。

b1-018-s008.skeleton: There is a boy in the water.
b1-018-s008.whyLearn: There is配单数名词的入门样板；in the water点出人在水中，位置表达只需一个介词短语。

b1-022-s001.skeleton: Can you make the tea, Sam?
b1-022-s001.whyLearn: can提出请求而非问能力，是英式日常礼貌的核心；呼语放句尾，说话对象和语气都照顾到了。

b1-022-s007.whyLearn: 把can提前就完成提问；宾语用it指前文提过的东西，这一招能让对话不重复名词。

b1-022-s008.skeleton: I can see the teapot, but I can't see the tea.

modifiers.text: but I can't see the tea

b1-022-s008.gloss: 我能看见茶壶，却看不见茶叶。
b1-022-s008.whyLearn: 两处can一正一反，靠but形成对照；英式拼写can't和重音差别，正好是听辨否定的关键练习。

b1-022-s013.skeleton: There are some in the cupboard（碗橱）.
b1-022-s013.whyLearn: some单独作主语省略已知名词，全靠上下文支撑；这类省略是英语对话听起来自然的关键。

b1-022-s014.whyLearn: find侧重找的结果，跟look for区分开；宾语用them回指复数物品，问句结构照搬can提前。

b1-023-s008.skeleton: Bob: Can you type this letter for the boss please, Miss Jones?
b1-023-s008.gloss: 鲍勃：琼斯小姐，请替老板打这封信好吗？
b1-023-s008.whyLearn: for the boss交代替谁办事，please放句尾仍客气；这是办公室请求的标准说法，实用度极高。

b1-023-s015.skeleton: MISS JONES: I can't type this letter.
b1-023-s015.gloss: 琼斯小姐：我打不了这封信。
b1-023-s015.whyLearn: can't说明能力不足而拒绝，比直接说no委婉；this把拒绝限定在这一封信上，留有余地。

b1-023-s016.skeleton: Miss Jones: I can't read it!
b1-023-s016.whyLearn: it回指前文那封信，避免重复；can't加感叹号，把为难的语气直接传达出来。

b1-025-s005.whyLearn: What about是提建议的固定句式，后接名词即可；比Do you want更轻松，日常购物点菜都能用。

b1-031-s007.skeleton: MR WILLIAMS: Can you remember the doctor's telephone number?
b1-031-s007.gloss: 威廉斯先生：你记得医生的电话号码吗？
b1-031-s007.whyLearn: remember后直接接名词，不用forget式搭配；名词所有格doctor's写出所属，长宾语也不影响can提前。

b1-032-s003.skeleton: DOCTOR: Can I see him please, Mrs Williams?
b1-032-s003.gloss: 医生：威廉斯太太，我可以看看他吗？
b1-032-s003.whyLearn: Can I是征求许可的固定说法；宾格him作see的宾语，人称代词格的变化在这里看得最清楚。

b1-032-s019.whyLearn: please插在句尾问句里照样成立；用宾格him而不是he，是英语代词改格的典型考点。

b1-033-s005.skeleton: BETTY: I can't get home so early, Dad.
b1-033-s005.gloss: 贝蒂：爸爸，我没法那么早到家。
b1-033-s005.whyLearn: get home的home是副词，前面不加to，最易错的搭配之一；so early说明程度，呼语放句尾。

b1-055-s009.skeleton: One and a half teaspoonfuls please.
b1-055-s009.whyLearn: 名词短语独立成句、以 please 收尾，是点单最简洁的说法；注意 a half 后名词仍用复数。

b1-055-s014.whyLearn: too 放句尾表示“也”，比 also 更口语；I'd like 是礼貌提出要求的实用句型。

b1-056-s001.skeleton: I like this record-player very much
b1-056-s001.gloss: 弗里斯先生很喜欢这台录音机。
b1-056-s001.whyLearn: 表达偏好的基本句：like 后直接接名词，very much 放句末加强语气，不能说 very like。

b1-056-s003.skeleton: It's the most expensive model in the shop.
b1-056-s003.whyLearn: 最高级的实用场景句：the most expensive 后接名词，in the shop 限定比较范围。

b1-056-s005.whyLearn: too...for sb 表示“对某人来说太……”，是砍价时最常用的委婉拒绝句式。

b1-056-s007.skeleton: This model's less expensive than that one.
b1-056-s007.whyLearn: 比较级 less expensive than 表示“不如……贵”，than 后用 that one 避免重复名词。

b1-056-s011.gloss: 另一款更贵，但物有所值。
b1-056-s011.whyLearn: but 连接转折并列句，it's worth the money 是评价商品是否划算的高频表达。

b1-056-s012.skeleton: Can we buy it on instalments?
b1-056-s012.gloss: 弗里斯先生问能否分期付款。
b1-056-s012.whyLearn: 情态动词 can 的疑问句谈购买方式，on instalments 是分期付款的地道介词搭配。

b1-056-s018.gloss: 你有时自以为是个百万富翁。
b1-056-s018.whyLearn: think 后接宾语从句可省略 that；句首 Sometimes 加感叹号，是调侃语气的常见组合。

b1-057-s005.skeleton: Haven't you got any small change?
b1-057-s005.whyLearn: 否定疑问句 Haven't you got...? 带惊讶或催促语气，any 用于疑问句代替 some。

b1-057-s006.gloss: 那人说恐怕他没有零钱。
b1-057-s006.whyLearn: have got 表示“有”，逗号后的 I'm afraid 是软化语气的插入语，口语必备。

b1-057-s007.skeleton: I'll ask some of the passengers.
b1-057-s007.gloss: 售票员说要去问一些乘客。
b1-057-s007.whyLearn: will 表临时的决定或承诺，some of the passengers 是部分限定的常用说法。

b1-057-s011.gloss: 第二位乘客说他也没有。
b1-057-s011.whyLearn: either 用于否定句句尾表示“也”，与肯定句中的 too 位置形成对照。

b1-057-s016.skeleton: You must get off the bus.
b1-057-s016.whyLearn: must 表义务或命令，get off the bus 是下车固定搭配，注意 off 不能省略。

b1-057-s017.skeleton: None of our passengers can change this note.
b1-057-s017.gloss: 没有乘客能换开这张钞票。
b1-057-s017.whyLearn: None of 后接复数名词作主语，情态动词 can 表能力，是本课换零钱情节的关键句。

b1-057-s020.gloss: 第一个流浪汉说他有些零钱。
b1-057-s020.whyLearn: I've got some small change 与前面的否定回答对照，可见 some 用于肯定句。

b4-010-s010.skeleton: The twin ideals of our time, organization and quantity, will have won for ever.
b4-010-s010.gloss: 我们时代的两个理想，组织与数量，终将永胜。
b4-010-s010.whyLearn: 主语后接 of 短语，再用同位语 organization and quantity 补名，一词不换就能把抽象主语解释清楚。

b4-011-s001.skeleton: Alfred the Great acted as his own spy, visiting Danish camps disguised as a mins

modifiers.text: visiting Danish camps disguised as a mins

b4-011-s001.gloss: 阿尔弗雷德扮作游吟歌手，潜入丹麦营地当间谍。
b4-011-s001.whyLearn: 主句后连用两个分词 visiting、disguised，动作与身份层层叠加，展示英语靠分词串联细节的经济写法。

b4-011-s002.gloss: 那时流浪的游吟歌手到处都受欢迎。
b4-011-s002.whyLearn: In those days 一开头就把全句钉在过去，were 呼应时间；把时间放到句首是最省力的英语叙述起手式。

b4-011-s004.skeleton: Alfred had learned many of their ballads in his youth, and could vary his programme with acrobatic tricks and simple conjuring.

modifiers.text: and could vary his programme with acrobatic tricks and simple conjuring

b4-011-s004.gloss: 阿尔弗雷德学过许多丹麦歌谣，还会杂耍戏法。
b4-011-s004.whyLearn: had learned 交代更早的准备，could vary 说当时的能力，两个时态加一个并列谓语把“功底+表现”一次讲完。

b4-011-s005.skeleton: the king himself set out to penetrate the camp of Guthrum

modifiers.text: While Alfred's little army slowly began to gather at Athelney
to penetrate the camp of Guthrum
the commander of the Danish invaders

b4-011-s005.gloss: 小军队集结时，国王亲自潜入古思鲁姆营地。
b4-011-s005.whyLearn: while 从句交代背景、不定式说目的、句末同位语点明古思鲁姆是谁，一个句子把时间、行动、身份都补齐。

b4-011-s006.skeleton: These had settled down for the winter at Chippenham: thither Alfred went.
b4-011-s006.gloss: 他们已在奇彭纳姆安顿过冬，阿尔弗雷德就去了那里。
b4-011-s006.whyLearn: 冒号后 thither 前置造成倒装，简短有力地接住上文；过去完成时与一般过去时的先后对比也一目了然。

b4-011-s007.skeleton: He noticed at once that discipline was slack: the Danes had the self-confidence of conquerors, and their security precautions were casual.

modifiers.text: the Danes had the self-confidence of conquerors, and their security precautions were casual

b4-011-s007.gloss: 他立刻发现军纪松弛：丹麦人自负，防备也马虎。
b4-011-s007.whyLearn: noticed 后接 that 宾语从句先给结论，冒号后用两个并列分句给证据，是“判断+依据”最常见的英语组句法。

b4-011-s008.skeleton: They lived well, on the proceeds of raids on neighbouring regions.

modifiers.text: on the proceeds of raids on neighbouring regions

b4-011-s008.gloss: 他们靠劫掠邻近地区的所得过得很滋润。
b4-011-s008.whyLearn: 句末介词短语一路嵌套 proceeds of raids on…，把收入来源交代得清清楚楚；注意介词后一律用动名词。

b4-011-s010.skeleton: Alfred stayed in the camp a week
b4-011-s010.gloss: 阿尔弗雷德在营地待了一周才回阿塞尔尼。
b4-011-s010.whyLearn: before 从句把停留时长和下一步行动连成一句，还顺带译出“才”；时间状语从句是英语最省字的叙事关节。

b4-011-s011.skeleton: The force there assembled was trivial
b4-011-s011.gloss: 在那里集结的兵力与丹麦大军相比微不足道。
b4-011-s011.whyLearn: there assembled 后置修饰 force，compared with 引出比较基准，两个压缩结构让句子短而有对照。

b4-011-s013.skeleton: Alfred did not risk open battle
b4-011-s013.gloss: 阿尔弗雷德不冒险决战，而是袭扰推进的敌人。
b4-011-s013.whyLearn: faced with 分词短语作状语先给处境，did not…but… 的否定加转折把战略选择写得干净利落。

b4-011-s014.skeleton: He was constantly on the move
b4-011-s014.gloss: 他不断转移，引着丹麦人跟在他后面跑。
b4-011-s014.whyLearn: on the move 这一介词短语作表语表示持续状态，后面 drawing 分词补充同时发生的结果，一句写活游击战。

b4-011-s015.skeleton: His patrols halted the raiding parties: hunger assailed the Danish army.
b4-011-s015.gloss: 他的巡逻队拦住劫掠队，饥饿开始袭击丹麦军队。
b4-011-s015.whyLearn: 冒号把军事行动与后果并置，两个短句各自主谓完整；用 hunger 作主语的拟人写法值得模仿。

b4-011-s016.skeleton: Now Alfred began a long series of skirmishes--and within a month the Danes had surrendered.

modifiers.text: and within a month the Danes had surrendered

b4-011-s016.gloss: 阿尔弗雷德开始连番小战，一个月内丹麦人就投降了。
b4-011-s016.whyLearn: now 领起新阶段，破折号后 and 并列句用过去完成时收束结果，展现“过程—结局”的时间层次。

b4-011-s017.skeleton: The episode could reasonably serve as a unique epic of royal espionage!

modifiers.text: as a unique epic of royal espionage

b4-011-s017.gloss: 这段经历完全可以当一部独特的王室间谍史诗。
b4-011-s017.whyLearn: could 加副词 reasonably 使评价既克制又确信，serve as 是“充当”的地道搭配，适合写评论性句子。

b4-012-s001.skeleton: What characterizes almost all Hollywood pictures is their inner emptiness
b4-012-s001.gloss: 几乎所有好莱坞影片的特点就是内容空洞。
b4-012-s001.whyLearn: What 引导主语从句作主语，表语 emptiness 给出论断，是英语下定义、发议论时最常用的强调句式。

modifiers.text: Though he kept throwing up his arms in despair

b3-028-s022.gloss: 他绝望地挥舞双臂，却还是收下我给的一英镑。
b3-028-s022.whyLearn: Though 从句先让一步，主句再落回现实；the pound I gave him 省略了关系代词，是口语里常见的定语从句。

b3-028-s023.skeleton: I felt especially pleased with my wonderful bargain

modifiers.text: until I got back to the ship

b3-028-s023.gloss: 回船之前，我一直为这笔便宜买卖暗自得意。
b3-028-s023.whyLearn: until 从句标出得意情绪的终点；my wonderful bargain 可直接换成 his cheap car 等，句式照搬。

modifiers.text: No matter how hard I tried
to fill this beautiful pen with ink
and to this day it has never written a single word !

b3-028-s024.gloss: 无论怎么试都灌不进墨水，这支笔至今一字未写。
b3-028-s024.whyLearn: it 是形式主语，真主语为 to fill...；no matter how 引导让步，and 后主句用现在完成时补上结果。

b3-029-s001.skeleton: largely depends on where we have been brought up

modifiers.text: Whether we find a joke funny or not
where we have been brought up

b3-029-s001.gloss: 笑话好不好笑，多半取决于我们成长的地方。
b3-029-s001.whyLearn: Whether 从句整体作主语，介词 on 后接 where 从句；have been brought up 用现在完成时被动。

b3-029-s002.skeleton: The sense of humour is mysteriously bound up with national characteristics.
b3-029-s002.gloss: 幽默感与民族特性神秘地绑在一起。
b3-029-s002.whyLearn: be bound up with 是固定搭配，表示密不可分；mysteriously 可换成 closely、inextricably。

b3-029-s004.skeleton: a Russian might fail to see anything amusing in a joke

modifiers.text: which would make an Englishman laugh to tears

b3-029-s004.gloss: 同样地，俄国人可能看不出让英国人笑出泪的笑点。
b3-029-s004.whyLearn: fail to see 表示没能看出；which 从句修饰 joke，would 表过去视角下的结果，可换成 Frenchman 等。

b3-029-s005.skeleton: Most funny stories are based on comic situations.
b3-029-s005.gloss: 多数滑稽故事都以喜剧性情境为基础。
b3-029-s005.whyLearn: be based on 是常用被动短语，主语换成 jokes、films、novels 都能直接套用。

b3-029-s006.skeleton: certain funny situations have a universal appeal
b3-029-s006.gloss: 尽管民族各异，某些滑稽情境仍有普遍吸引力。
b3-029-s006.whyLearn: In spite of 后只接名词短语，区别于 although 从句；have a universal appeal 可直接复用。

b3-029-s008.skeleton: a new type of humour, which stems largely from America, has recently come into fashion.
b3-029-s008.gloss: 一种主要源自美国的新幽默近来开始流行。
b3-029-s008.whyLearn: which 非限定定语从句插在主语后补充来源；has come into fashion 用现在完成时表新近流行。

b3-029-s009.gloss: 这种幽默被称为“病态幽默”。
b3-029-s009.whyLearn: be + 过去分词 + 名称 是给事物命名下定义的句型，主语换成 It、They 都成立。

b3-029-s010.skeleton: Comedians base their jokes on tragic situations

modifiers.text: like violent death or serious accidents

b3-029-s010.gloss: 喜剧演员把玩笑建在惨死等悲剧情境上。
b3-029-s010.whyLearn: base A on B 是“把 A 建立在 B 上”的固定搭配；their jokes 换成 his jokes 即可改写。

b3-029-s011.skeleton: Many people find this sort of joke distasteful
b3-029-s011.gloss: 许多人觉得这类玩笑令人反感。
b3-029-s011.whyLearn: find + 宾语 + 形容词 表示“觉得……如何”，this sort of joke 可换成 that kind of story。

b3-029-s012.skeleton: The following example of 'sick humour' will enable you
b3-029-s012.gloss: 下面这个“病态幽默”的例子会让你自己判断。
b3-029-s012.whyLearn: enable sb to do 是“使某人能做”的搭配；judge for yourself 可换成 see for yourself。

b3-029-s013.skeleton: A man who had broken his right leg was taken to hospital

modifiers.text: who had broken his right leg

b3-029-s013.gloss: 一个摔断右腿的男人在圣诞前几周被送进医院。
b3-029-s013.whyLearn: who 从句用过去完成时交代更早发生的受伤；主句 was taken 用被动，时态先后一目了然。

b3-029-s014.skeleton: he kept on pestering his doctor

modifiers.text: From the moment he arrived there
to tell him when he would be able to go home
when he would be able to go home

b3-029-s014.gloss: 从到那儿起，他就缠着医生问何时能回家。
b3-029-s014.whyLearn: from the moment 引导时间从句，keep on doing 表反复不停；tell sb when... 用陈述语序不倒装。

b3-029-s015.skeleton: He dreaded having to spend Christmas
b3-029-s015.gloss: 他害怕不得不在医院里过圣诞节。
b3-029-s015.whyLearn: dread 后接动名词，having to do 表“不得不做”；in hospital 不加冠词即指住院。

b3-030-s014.skeleton: Eric had been the eldest son
b3-030-s014.whyLearn: 用 had been 交代更早的身份背景，与后文失踪、躲藏形成时间落差；eldest 前加 the 的用法也一并记住。

b3-030-s015.whyLearn: be obliged to do 是被动加不定式的固定搭配，比 must 更强调身不由己，写被迫经历时很好用。

b3-030-s016.skeleton: he decided to desert his regiment
b3-030-s016.gloss: 因厌恶军旅生活，他决定逃离部队。
b3-030-s016.whyLearn: As 引导原因状语从句放在句首，主句用 decide to do 收束结果，是叙事中交代动机的常见顺序。

b3-030-s018.gloss: 因怕当局，战后他仍躲藏着。
b3-030-s018.whyLearn: 现在分词放句首表原因，主语自然与主句一致；remain in hiding 把持续状态说得干净利落。

modifiers.text: that Eric had been killed in action

b3-030-s019.gloss: 父亲告诉所有人埃里克已阵亡。
b3-030-s019.whyLearn: 主句过去时配从句过去完成时，清楚区分“告知”与“更早阵亡”两层时间；be killed in action 可直接背下。

b3-030-s020.skeleton: The only other people who knew the secret were Joe and Bert
b3-030-s020.gloss: 另外只有乔和伯特知道这个秘密。
b3-030-s020.whyLearn: 定语从句紧跟 people 后面，把“知情者”限定到仅剩两人，主语一长照样用 were 带出表语，结构仍清楚。

b3-030-s021.skeleton: They did not even tell their wives
b3-030-s021.whyLearn: even 靠位置发力，放在否定词与动词之间，把保密程度推到极点，短句却很有分量。

b3-030-s023.skeleton: Eric had lived as a recluse

modifiers.text: as a recluse（隐遁者, 寂寞者）

b3-030-s023.gloss: 这些年埃里克一直隐居。
b3-030-s023.whyLearn: 时间短语 All these years 提前点明跨度，had lived 把漫长隐居压成一句背景交代，as 引出身份。

modifiers.text: without being conscious that they are doing anything extraordinary

b3-031-s002.gloss: 他们不顾社会习俗，毫无察觉自己与众不同。
b3-031-s002.whyLearn: without 后接动名词，再接 that 从句，把“无意识”说得很彻底；disregard 后直接跟宾语，无须介词。

b3-031-s003.skeleton: This invariably wins them the love and respect of others

modifiers.text: for they add colour to the dull routine of everyday life

b3-031-s003.gloss: 这总能赢得他人喜爱，因他们给生活添彩。
b3-031-s003.whyLearn: win 可带双宾语（人＋物）；for 作并列连词引出原因，比 because 更书面，适合写评价性句子。

b3-031-s005.skeleton: He was a shrewd and wealthy business-man

modifiers.text: but the ordinary town-folk hardly knew anything about this side of his life

b3-031-s005.gloss: 他精明富有，镇上人却不知他这一面。
b3-031-s005.whyLearn: but 连接两个反差句，hardly 表否定意味，财富与低调的对照是记叙文写人物的常用手法。

b3-031-s006.skeleton: He was known to us all as Dickie
b3-031-s006.gloss: 我们叫他迪基，其怪名早在他去世前就出了名。
b3-031-s006.whyLearn: be known to sb as… 是介绍称呼的固定句式；long before 说明名声早在去世前就已久远。

modifiers.text: Though he owned a large car
preferring always to go on foot

b3-031-s008.gloss: 虽有豪车，他却几乎不用，总爱步行。
b3-031-s008.whyLearn: 让步从句与 hardly ever 前后呼应；句尾分词补充说明习惯，prefer to do 与 go on foot 一起记。

b3-031-s010.skeleton: One day, he walked into an expensive shop
b3-031-s010.gloss: 某天他走进一家高价商店。
b3-031-s010.whyLearn: One day 一开头就把读者带进往事，walk into 比 enter 更口语，是叙事开场的常见写法。

b3-031-s012.skeleton: Dickie left the shop without a word and returned
b3-031-s012.gloss: 迪基一言不发离店，拎着大布袋回来。
b3-031-s012.whyLearn: 一句里用 and 并联两个动作，再用 carrying 补出伴随状态；without a word 极简地写出沉默神态。

b3-031-s013.skeleton: he dumped it on the counter
b3-031-s013.gloss: 因袋子极重，他把它摔在柜台上。
b3-031-s013.whyLearn: As 从句先给出理由，主句用 dump 这个有力的动词承接结果，动作因果一目了然。

modifiers.text: in that only the lower fields, which make up a very small proportion of our farm, are affected by flooding
which make up a very small proportion of our farm
but other farms are less favourably sited
and flooding can sometimes spell disaster for their owners

b3-056-s012.gloss: 我们幸运，只有低处田地遭水淹
b3-056-s012.whyLearn: 一句里 but 和 and 连出三个并列主句，中间嵌 in that 原因从句与 which 定语从句，适合练长句分层断句。

modifiers.text: As the floods had put the telephone out of order

b3-056-s016.gloss: 洪水弄坏电话，我们无法得知他们近况
b3-056-s016.whyLearn: As 原因从句加 how 宾语从句双重嵌套，过去完成与过去进行时对照，是叙事中还原时间层次的范本。

modifiers.text: that they must have become unduly frightened by the rising flood
for their house, which had sound foundations, would have stood stoutly even if it had been almost submerged
even if it had been almost submerged

b3-056-s021.gloss: 我们明白他们被洪水吓坏了，其实房子很结实
b3-056-s021.whyLearn: must have done 表推测与 even if 虚拟条件并用，再用 for 分句和 which 从句嵌进长句，推测加反事实的典型。

b3-056-s022.skeleton: The men of our family waded down

modifiers.text: in the hope of being able to grapple a corner of the raft and pull it out of the current towards our bank
being able to grapple a corner of the raft and pull it out of the current towards our bank
to grapple a corner of the raft and pull it out of the current towards our bank

b3-056-s022.gloss: 全家男人拿钩子涉水去钩木筏拉回岸边
b3-056-s022.whyLearn: 主干只有 waded down，其余靠多个介词短语和 being able to do 交代方式与目的，练英语尾重句的信息铺排。

modifiers.text: a few months before we had planned to go
before we had planned to go
and, when he knew that he was dying, he made me promise to go on my own
when he knew that he was dying

b3-057-s012.gloss: 他病重，临死前要我独自前往
b3-057-s012.whyLearn: and 后面把时间状语从句和宾语从句塞在主语之前，主干被迫后置，练状语前置打乱语序时的断句能力。

modifiers.text: and bought a comprehensive book of maps
which I found most helpful on the cross country journey
but which I did not think I should need on the last stage

b3-057-s013.gloss: 我租车买地图册，前期很有用后期用不上
b3-057-s013.whyLearn: 两个 which 从句由 but 并列修饰同一先行词，从句内又嵌 I did not think，展示定语从句的复杂挂接方式。

b3-057-s015.skeleton: my father had described over and over again

modifiers.text: what we should see at every milestone
so that I was positive I should recognize it as familiar territory
I should recognize it as familiar territory

b3-057-s015.gloss: 父亲反复描述沿途景象，让我确信认得路
b3-057-s015.whyLearn: 过去完成时交代此前的铺垫，what 从句与 so that 结果从句接力推进，体现时态与信息层次如何配合。

modifiers.text: and at this point, according to my father, I should be looking at farms and cottages in a valley
with the spire of the church of our village showing in the far distance

b3-057-s018.gloss: 走了十英里，父亲说该看到山谷村舍了
b3-057-s018.whyLearn: 插入语 according to my father 隔开主语与谓语，末尾 with 复合结构补出远景，练穿插成分与画面式描写。

b3-057-s025.gloss: 仿佛噩梦，周围无人能帮我
b3-057-s025.whyLearn: there be 存在句加插入语 as in a nightmare，再用不定式作后置定语，短句也能拆出三层结构。

b3-057-s026.skeleton: there appeared on the horizon a man on horseback

modifiers.text: as I was wondering what to do next

b3-057-s026.gloss: 我正不知所措，天边出现骑马人
b3-057-s026.whyLearn: there appeared 全倒装让主语后置，配 as 从句与 riding 分词短语，练倒装句与伴随动作的画面铺陈。

modifiers.text: that there was now no village

b3-057-s028.gloss: 他说现在村子已经不存在了
b3-057-s028.whyLearn: 最简宾语从句范例，主句只剩 He said，可体会英语 that 从句与汉语流水句在结构上的差别。

b3-057-s029.gloss: 我觉得他一定是误会我了
b3-057-s029.whyLearn: 省略 that 的宾语从句里用 must have done 表对过去的肯定推测，一句同时掌握推测语气与从句省略。

b3-058-s003.skeleton: her thoughts were on lunch and a good rest

modifiers.text: but when she got out at her own floor, both were forgotten in her sudden discovery that her front door was open
when she got out at her own floor
that her front door was open

b3-058-s003.gloss: 电梯里她想吃饭休息，见门开着全忘了
b3-058-s003.whyLearn: 分号连接两个独立分句，后半句时间状语从句前置、同位语从句后置，适合练长句的对称与嵌套。

modifiers.text: that she must reprimand her daily maid the next morning for such a monstrous piece of negligence
when she remembered that she had gone shopping after the maid had left
that she had gone shopping after the maid had left
and she knew that she had turned both keys in their locks
that she had turned both keys in their locks

b3-058-s004.gloss: 她正想着要责备女佣，忽然记起自己锁了门
b3-058-s004.whyLearn: when 这里意为就在此时，与过去进行时构成经典搭配，层层宾语从句展开她回忆的链条。

b3-058-s007.skeleton: It was as clear as daylight

modifiers.text: that burglars had forced an entry during her absence

b3-058-s007.gloss: 此时已很清楚，她不在时窃贼闯入
b3-058-s007.whyLearn: it 结构把 that 从句后置，主句先用 as clear as daylight 表态，练英语先评论后说事的语序习惯。

modifiers.text: to go round all the rooms
but then she decided that at her age it might be more prudent to have someone with her
that at her age it might be more prudent to have someone with her
so she went to fetch the porter from his basement

b3-058-s008.gloss: 她先想搜房抓贼，又觉年纪大应找人陪
b3-058-s008.whyLearn: but 与 so 串起三个动作，宾语从句里用 it 作形式主语加 might 表委婉，展示叙事句的因果推进。

b3-024-s005.skeleton: The reader's hair stands on end

modifiers.text: when he reads in the final pages of the novel
that the heroine, a dear old lady who had always been so kind to everybody, had, in her youth, poisoned every one of her five husbands
a dear old lady who had always been so kind to everybody
who had always been so kind to everybody
in the final pages of the novel

b3-024-s005.gloss: 读者得知女主人公年轻时毒死五任丈夫，毛骨悚然。
b3-024-s005.whyLearn: 时间状语从句里再套宾语从句和同位语，插入语把 had 和 poisoned 隔开，最能练长句断句。

b3-024-s017.skeleton: The sudden movement of the door made it sway slightly

modifiers.text: and it gave me the impression that it was about to leap out at me
that it was about to leap out at me

b3-024-s017.gloss: 门突然一动，雕像晃了晃，让他觉得它要扑过来。
b3-024-s017.whyLearn: make 后接宾语加动词原形，再用同位语从句解释 impression，一句涵盖两个高频句型。

b3-024-s021.skeleton: 'Oh, that,' he said with a smile

modifiers.text: as if he were talking about an old friend

b3-024-s021.gloss: 他笑着说“哦，那个”，仿佛在谈一位老朋友。
b3-024-s021.whyLearn: as if 后用 were 加进行时表示与事实相反的假设，是虚拟语气最轻巧的用法。

b3-025-s004.skeleton: sailing vessels like the Cutty Sark were used to carry tea from China and wool from Australia

modifiers.text: Before they were replaced by steam-ships
to carry tea from China and wool from Australia

b3-025-s004.gloss: 蒸汽船出现前，卡蒂萨克号专门运中国茶和澳洲羊毛。
b3-025-s004.whyLearn: Before 从句、被动语态和 be used to do 三层叠加，中间还插 like 短语，语序值得模仿。

b3-025-s015.skeleton: This greatly reduced the speed of the ship

modifiers.text: for there was danger that if she travelled too quickly, this rudder would be torn away as well
that if she travelled too quickly, this rudder would be torn away as well

b3-025-s015.gloss: 这大大降低了船速，因为若行船过快，船舵也会被撕掉。
b3-025-s015.whyLearn: for 引出原因并列句，再套 danger 的同位语从句和条件句，是长难句嵌套的典型模板。

b3-025-s018.skeleton: it was impossible for the Cutty Sark to win

modifiers.text: Though the new rudder was fitted at tremendous speed

b3-025-s018.gloss: 尽管新舵很快装好，卡蒂萨克号还是不可能赢。
b3-025-s018.whyLearn: Though 让步从句配 it is impossible for sb to do 的正式说法，写议论文时很好用。

modifiers.text: that if she had not lost her rudder she would have won the race easily
if she had not lost her rudder

b3-025-s021.gloss: 毫无疑问，如果没丢舵，她本会轻松赢得比赛。
b3-025-s021.whyLearn: no doubt 后的同位语从句里包着与过去相反的虚拟条件句，两个句型一次练到。

b3-026-s006.skeleton: advertisers not only offer free samples but free cars, free houses, and free trips round the world as well

modifiers.text: free cars, free houses, and free trips

b3-026-s006.gloss: 如今广告商不光送样品，还送汽车、房子和环球旅行。
b3-026-s006.whyLearn: not only ... but ... as well 的并列示范，注意介词短语 round the world 修饰 trips。

b3-026-s008.skeleton: Radio and television have made it possible

modifiers.text: for advertisers to capture the attention of millions of people in this way
to capture the attention of millions of people

b3-026-s008.gloss: 广播和电视让广告商能借此抓住千万人的注意力。
b3-026-s008.whyLearn: make it possible for sb to do 的 it 作形式宾语结构，是英语最常见的让某事变可能说法。

modifiers.text: that a crane had to be used to remove it from the lorry
to remove it from the lorry

b3-026-s021.gloss: 它太重了，只好用起重机把它从卡车上吊下来。
b3-026-s021.whyLearn: so ... that 结果从句里套被动语态和不定式，还带 had to 的必要性表达，一句三得。

b3-027-s003.skeleton: it is extremely difficult to estimate the true value of the services

modifiers.text: Though it may be possible to measure the value of material goods in terms of money
to estimate the true value of the services
to measure the value of material goods in terms of money

b3-027-s003.gloss: 物质可用钱衡量，服务对人的真正价值却极难估算。
b3-027-s003.whyLearn: Though 让步从句与形式主语 it 的句子对照，还含 in terms of 和定语从句，议论文高频。

b3-027-s005.skeleton: The conditions of society are such

modifiers.text: that skills have to be paid for in the same way that goods are paid for at a shop
in the same way that goods are paid for at a shop
that goods are paid for at a shop

b3-027-s005.gloss: 社会现状如此：技能必须像商店里的商品一样付费购买。
b3-027-s005.whyLearn: such that 结果从句与 the same way that 定语从句叠加，被动和 have to 同时出现。

b3-027-s013.skeleton: He has deliberately chosen to lead the life he leads and is fully aware of the consequences

modifiers.text: He, may never be sure where the next meal is coming from, but he is free from the thousands of anxieties which afflict other people
where the next meal is coming from

b3-027-s013.gloss: 他自愿过这生活，虽不知下顿饭在哪，却免于常人忧虑。
b3-027-s013.whyLearn: 完成时、定语从句、宾语从句和 but 并列挤在一句里，还与后句形成转折对照。

b3-027-s014.skeleton: His few material possession make it possible for him to move from place to place with ease

modifiers.text: for him to move from place to place with ease
to move from place to place
By having to sleep in the open
having to sleep in the open
he gets far closer to the world of nature than most of us ever do
than most of us ever do

b3-027-s014.gloss: 他物少反能轻便迁移；露宿户外，比多数人更亲自然。
b3-027-s014.whyLearn: 形式宾语 it 与比较级 than 从句各占半句，还提示 By doing 表方式，信息密度高。

b3-027-s016.skeleton: We often speak of tramps with contempt and put them in the same class as beggars

modifiers.text: in the same class as beggars
but how many of us can honestly say that we have not felt a little envious of their simple way of life and their freedom from care
that we have not felt a little envious of their simple way of life and their freedom from care
of their simple way of life and their freedom from care

b3-027-s016.gloss: 我们常鄙视流浪汉，可有几人敢说毫不羡慕他们的生活？
b3-027-s016.whyLearn: but 引出反问，宾语从句用否定加 a little 含蓄表达羡慕，语气技巧很值得学。

b3-028-s002.skeleton: the men from the boats had climbed on board and the decks were soon covered

modifiers.text: with colourful rugs from Persia, silks from India, copper coffee pots, and beautiful hand-made silver-ware
colourful rugs from Persia, silks from India, copper coffee pots, and beautiful hand-made silver-ware

b3-028-s002.gloss: 船未抛锚，小船上的人已登船，甲板很快铺满各国货物。
b3-028-s002.whyLearn: Before 从句配过去完成时，后半句用一串并列名词短语铺陈货物，场面描写经典。

b2-005-s003.skeleton: a pigeon carried the first message
b2-005-s003.gloss: 昨天一只鸽子把第一封信从平赫斯特送到锡尔伯里。
b2-005-s003.whyLearn: carried 与 from...to... 搭配，用一般过去时讲一次性事件，Yesterday 置句首带逗号。

b2-005-s004.gloss: 这只鸟用三分钟飞完了这段距离。
b2-005-s004.whyLearn: cover the distance 是「走完某段路程」的地道说法，in + 时段表示用多久完成。

b2-005-s005.skeleton: Mr Scott has sent a great many requests

modifiers.text: for spare parts and other urgent messages
from one garage to the other

b2-005-s005.gloss: 至今他已从一车库向另一车库发去大量索件信。
b2-005-s005.whyLearn: up to now 常配现在完成时，a great many 直接修饰复数可数名词，都是高频考点。

b2-005-s006.skeleton: he has begun his own private telephone service
b2-005-s006.gloss: 他就这样开办了自己的私人电话业务。
b2-005-s006.whyLearn: in this way 用来承上总结手段，his own 强调「属于自己的」，语气比 his 更足。

modifiers.text: to a house in Bridge Street

b2-006-s001.gloss: 我刚搬到布里奇街的一所房子里。
b2-006-s001.whyLearn: have just moved 用现在完成时强调「刚刚」；to a house in + 街名 表示新住址。

b2-006-s002.gloss: 昨天一个乞丐敲了我家的门。
b2-006-s002.whyLearn: knock at the door 是敲门固定搭配，my 表所属，Yesterday 置句首不加逗号。

modifiers.text: for a meal and a glass of beer

b2-006-s003.gloss: 他向我要一顿饭和一杯啤酒。
b2-006-s003.whyLearn: ask sb for sth 是「向某人要某物」的核心句型，for 后并列两个名词。

b2-006-s004.gloss: 作为回报，那乞丐倒立并唱起歌来。
b2-006-s004.whyLearn: in return for 表回报，and 连接 stood 与 sang 两个并列谓语，时态必须一致。

b2-006-s006.whyLearn: and 连接两个过去式谓语，ate 和 drank 均为不规则动词，注意前后时态一致。

b2-006-s007.skeleton: he put a piece of cheese
b2-006-s007.gloss: 然后他把一块奶酪放进衣袋就走了。
b2-006-s007.whyLearn: put sth in + 容器 的语序，his 表所属，and 连接 put 与 went 两个过去动作。

b2-006-s008.gloss: 后来一位邻居跟我讲了他的事。
b2-006-s008.whyLearn: tell sb about sth 是转述信息的基本句型，about 后接人称代词宾格 him。

modifiers.text: and always asks for a meal and a glass of beer

b2-006-s011.gloss: 他每月沿街挨家讨一顿饭和一杯啤酒。
b2-006-s011.whyLearn: 用一般现在时写习惯动作，once a month 表频率，and 连接两个同主语谓语。

b2-007-s001.skeleton: The plane was late and detectives were waiting
b2-007-s001.gloss: 飞机晚点了，侦探们在机场等了一上午。
b2-007-s001.whyLearn: was late 用一般过去时陈述状态，were waiting 用过去进行时写持续动作。

modifiers.text: that thieves would try to steal the diamonds

b2-007-s003.gloss: 几小时前有人告诉警方，窃贼会设法偷钻石。
b2-007-s003.whyLearn: 过去完成时后接 that 宾语从句，从句里用过去将来时；a few 修饰可数名词。

modifiers.text: and carried it into the Customs House

b2-007-s005.gloss: 两名男子把包裹搬下飞机，抬进海关大楼。
b2-007-s005.whyLearn: took...off 与 carried...into 两个方向介词配合 and 并列谓语，动作顺序清晰。

b2-007-s007.gloss: 令他们吃惊的是，那只贵重包裹里全是石头和沙子。
b2-007-s007.whyLearn: to one's surprise 是高频插入语，be full of 表「装满」，their 指代前文侦探。

modifiers.text: whether it would be comfortable to wear.

b3-013-s006.gloss: 她想弄清楚这鞋穿起来是否舒服。
b3-013-s006.whyLearn: whether 引导宾语从句，句末不定式 to wear 的逻辑主语要靠语境补出。

modifiers.text: Just as Mrs Richards was entering the dining-room,

b3-013-s007.gloss: 理查兹太太正进餐厅时，前门响起敲门声。
b3-013-s007.whyLearn: Just as 引出同时发生的背景动作，主句用 there be 句引出新信息。

modifiers.text: when the owners of shop and businesses in Chica

b3-014-s001.whyLearn: There was a time when... 是叙事开篇经典句式，when 从句作定语。

b3-014-s003.skeleton: an Englishman, Sir John Hawkwood, made the remarkable discovery

modifiers.text: As long ago as the fourteenth century,
that people would rather pay large sums of money than have their life work destroyed by gangsters.

b3-014-s003.gloss: 早在十四世纪，霍克伍德发现人们宁愿付钱了事。
b3-014-s003.whyLearn: that 引导同位语从句解释 discovery，would rather...than 是本课核心句型。

b3-014-s007.skeleton: Hawkwood and his men would march into a city-state

modifiers.text: and, after burning down a few farms, would offer to go away
after burning down a few farms,
if protection money was paid to them.

b3-014-s007.gloss: 和平时生意清淡，他就带人进城勒索保护费。
b3-014-s007.whyLearn: 一个句子里叠加时间、条件状语从句和并列谓语，适合练长句切分。

b3-014-s010.skeleton: the Florentines gave him a state funeral and had a picture painted

modifiers.text: When he died at the age of eighty,
which was dedicated to the memory of 'the most valiant soldier and most notable leader, Signor Giovanni Haukodue'.

b3-014-s010.gloss: 他八十岁去世后，佛罗伦萨人为他举行国葬并画像纪念。
b3-014-s010.whyLearn: have sth done 使役结构后接定语从句，被动语态与最高级同现。

b3-015-s013.skeleton: He could not find his sixpence anywhere

modifiers.text: and what is more, he could not get his arm out.

b3-015-s013.gloss: 他找不到那枚六便士，胳膊也拔不出来。
b3-015-s013.whyLearn: what is more 作插入语递进信息，and 连接两个并列的否定分句。

b3-015-s016.skeleton: George was not too upset by his experience

modifiers.text: because the lady who owns the sweet shop heard about his troubles and rewarded him with a large box of chocolates.
with a large box of chocolates

b3-015-s016.gloss: 乔治不太难过，因为糖果店女老板奖了他一盒巧克力。
b3-015-s016.whyLearn: because 从句内再嵌 who 定语从句，注意否定句与多层嵌套的关系。

modifiers.text: so it was obvious that the lamb had been stolen.
that the lamb had been stolen

b3-016-s005.gloss: 绳子被割断了，显然羊羔被人偷走。
b3-016-s005.whyLearn: 过去完成时被动语态加 so 结果分句，用语法形式表达推断结论。

b3-016-s015.skeleton: it began to rain and Dimitri stayed in Aleko's house
b3-016-s015.gloss: 他们说话时下起雨，季米特里在阿列科家待到雨停。
b3-016-s015.whyLearn: while 与 until 两个时间从句同句出现，对比持续动作与终止界限。

b3-017-s003.skeleton: his name will probably remain immortal

modifiers.text: Though Verrazano is by no means considered to be a great explorer,
for on November 21st, 1964, the greatest bridge in the world was named after him.

b3-017-s003.gloss: 维拉扎诺虽算不上伟大探险家，大桥却让他名留青史。
b3-017-s003.whyLearn: 让步从句与 for 引导的原因分句并用，被动语态和最高级同句出现。

modifiers.text: that the shape of the earth had to be taken into account by its designer.

b3-017-s006.gloss: 桥太长，设计者不得不把地球的形状考虑进去。
b3-017-s006.whyLearn: so...that 结果句里用 have to 的被动不定式，说明长度造成的后果。

modifiers.text: that if the bridge were packed with cars, it would still only be carrying a third of its total capacity.
if the bridge were packed with cars,

b3-017-s014.gloss: 据估算，桥即使塞满汽车也只占总运力的三分之一。
b3-017-s014.whyLearn: 虚拟条件句加现在完成时被动，是表达估算与假设的常见句式。

b3-017-s016.skeleton: it is both simple and elegant

modifiers.text: fulfilling its designer's dream to create 'an enormous object drawn as faintly as possible'.
to create 'an enormous object drawn as faintly as possible'

b3-017-s016.gloss: 尽管体量巨大，这座桥简洁优雅，圆了设计者的梦。
b3-017-s016.whyLearn: Despite 让步短语后用分词状语补充评价，句子因此紧凑而有层次。

b3-018-s005.gloss: 我们已经很习惯它们了。
b3-018-s005.whyLearn: be/get used to 后接名词，最容易与 used to do 混淆，此句可作对比。

b3-018-s013.gloss: 靠墙排列着一根根连在金属球上的细长导线。
b3-018-s013.whyLearn: 过去分词短语既作前置状语又作后置定语，there be 描写句范例。

b3-044-s003.skeleton: Train compartments soon get cramped and stuffy.
b3-044-s003.gloss: 火车车厢很快变得又挤又闷。
b3-044-s003.whyLearn: get加形容词表示状态变化，比become口语；cramped与stuffy并列，两个词写尽车厢的闷挤感。

b3-044-s005.skeleton: Reading is only a partial solution

modifiers.text: for the monotonous rhythm of the wheels clicking on the rails soon lulls you to sleep
of the wheels clicking on the rails

b3-044-s005.gloss: 读书只能算部分解决办法。
b3-044-s005.whyLearn: 用for引出原因分句，先扬后抑；clicking作定语描摹车轮声，单调感顺势推出lulls you to sleep。

b3-044-s006.gloss: 白天只能断断续续地睡。
b3-044-s006.whyLearn: in snatches是地道搭配，写睡眠被切碎的状态；时间状语前置，与夜间长睡形成对照。

b3-044-s009.gloss: 到站时你几乎已经累垮。
b3-044-s009.whyLearn: arrive at接目的地是常见搭配；句末almost exhausted补出到站时的状态，比and you are tired紧凑。

b3-044-s010.skeleton: Long car journeys are even less pleasant

modifiers.text: for it is quite impossible even to read

b3-044-s010.gloss: 长途汽车更难受，因为根本没法看书。
b3-044-s010.whyLearn: even less pleasant承接上句比较级，构成递进；impossible even to read用不定式说清想读也读不成。

b3-044-s012.skeleton: trips by sea offer a great variety of civilized comforts
b3-044-s012.gloss: 相比之下，海上旅行舒适多样。
b3-044-s012.whyLearn: By comparison是议论文切换比较对象的好用状语；a great variety of比many更书面，值得整体记。

b3-044-s013.skeleton: You can stretch your legs on the spacious decks, play games, swim, meet interesting people and enjoy good food

modifiers.text: play games, swim, meet interesting people and enjoy good food
always assuming, of course, that the sea is calm

b3-044-s013.gloss: 船上能活动、玩乐、交友、享美食。
b3-044-s013.whyLearn: 一个can后串起五个并列动作，把邮轮的多样享受一口气铺开，是学并列结构省力的好例子。

b3-044-s016.skeleton: Relatively few people are prepared to sacrifice up to a third of their holidays

modifiers.text: up to a third of their holidays
for the pleasure of travelling on a ship

b3-044-s016.gloss: 很少有人肯为坐船搭上三分之一假期。
b3-044-s016.whyLearn: are prepared to表示愿意，比want to正式；sacrifice A for B把拿假期换海上乐趣的取舍写得清楚。

b3-044-s017.skeleton: Aeroplanes have the reputation of being dangerous

modifiers.text: and even hardened travellers are intimidated by them

b3-044-s017.gloss: 飞机以危险闻名，连老手也怕。
b3-044-s017.whyLearn: have the reputation of being意为“有……名声”，比直说is dangerous含蓄；被动句顺便换话题。

b3-044-s018.skeleton: They also have the grave disadvantage

modifiers.text: of being the most expensive form of transport
being the most expensive form of transport

b3-044-s018.gloss: 它们还有个缺点：价格最贵。
b3-044-s018.whyLearn: have the disadvantage of being客观地挑毛病；grave比big更重，最高级把缺点说得无法反驳。

b3-044-s019.skeleton: But nothing can match them for speed and comfort.
b3-044-s019.gloss: 论速度和舒适，它们无人能及。
b3-044-s019.whyLearn: nothing can match是“无可比拟”的地道句式，比is the best更有力；match for的搭配可整体背下来。

b3-044-s020.skeleton: Travelling at a height of 30,000 feet, far above the clouds, and at over 500 miles an hour is an exhilarating experience.
b3-044-s020.gloss: 高空高速飞行是刺激的体验。
b3-044-s020.whyLearn: 动名词Travelling带三个并列介词短语作主语，句子长而重心仍清楚；exhilarating比exciting更精确。

b3-044-s022.skeleton: you settle back in a deep armchair
b3-044-s022.gloss: 几小时里你靠坐扶手椅享受飞行。
b3-044-s022.whyLearn: settle back in把舒服往后靠写得有画面；句末不定式说明靠坐的目的，是目的状语的自然写法。

b3-044-s023.skeleton: The real escapist can watch a free film show and sip champagne

modifiers.text: watch a free film show and sip champagne

b3-044-s023.gloss: 逃避现实者在部分航班可看电影喝香槟。
b3-044-s023.whyLearn: can后并列两个动词短语，写出既能又能的福利；escapist是本文关键词，指借旅行逃离现实的人。

b3-044-s025.skeleton: An aeroplane offers you an unusual and breathtaking view of the world.
b3-044-s025.gloss: 飞机给你壮阔而独特的视野。
b3-044-s025.whyLearn: offer sb sth双宾语写法省力；unusual与breathtaking并列修饰view，比beautiful更有俯瞰的震撼。

b3-044-s026.skeleton: You soar effortlessly over high mountains and deep valleys.

modifiers.text: over high mountains and deep valleys

b3-044-s026.whyLearn: soar比fly更有升腾动感；effortlessly一个副词写尽轻松，over后两个并列名词短语把地面景物一笔带过。

b3-050-s001.skeleton: The New Year is a time
b3-050-s001.whyLearn: 用 a time for + 名词就能给时间点下定义，是介绍节日或节点的万能句式。

b3-050-s002.skeleton: most of us could compile formidable lists
b3-050-s002.gloss: 至少在脑子里，我们大多能列出一长串该做和不该做的事
b3-050-s002.whyLearn: could 在此表示理论上的能力，配合 lists of do's and don'ts 这种地道搭配很有用。

b3-050-s003.gloss: 那些老一套的决心年复一年单调地重复出现
b3-050-s003.whyLearn: year in year out 与 with monotonous regularity 连用，把“年年如此很乏味”写得既短又俏。

modifiers.text: that certain accomplishments are beyond attainment.

b3-050-s005.gloss: 过往经验告诉我们有些事是做不到的
b3-050-s005.whyLearn: has taught us that... 是引出经验教训的常用框架，beyond attainment 也值得整体记住。

b3-050-s009.skeleton: this year I attempted to keep my resolutions to myself.

modifiers.text: to keep my resolutions to myself

b3-050-s009.gloss: 知道这些陷阱后，今年我试着不把决心告诉别人
b3-050-s009.whyLearn: 句首形容词短语 Aware of... 作状语，加上 keep ... to oneself 的结构，一句话写清心态与做法。

b3-050-s010.skeleton: I limited myself to two modest ambitions

modifiers.text: to do physical exercises every morning and to read more of an evening.

b3-050-s010.gloss: 我给自己只定了两个不大的目标：每天晨练和晚上多读书
b3-050-s010.whyLearn: 冒号后两个并列不定式解释 ambitions，学会用不定式给抽象名词补上具体内容。

b3-050-s012.skeleton: The daily exercises lasted only eleven minutes and I proposed to do them early in the morning
b3-050-s012.gloss: 每天锻炼只做了十一分钟，我打算趁没人起床时早早做完
b3-050-s012.whyLearn: and 连接两个分句，before 从句用过去完成时点明先后，是叙事时交代时间的典型手法。

b3-050-s013.skeleton: The self-discipline required to drag myself out of bed eleven minutes earlier than usual was considerable.

modifiers.text: required to drag myself out of bed eleven minutes earlier than usual was

b3-050-s013.gloss: 要每天早起十一分钟所需的意志力相当大
b3-050-s013.whyLearn: 过去分词短语 required to... 后置修饰 self-discipline，主干被拉开却依然清晰，很值得模仿。

b3-050-s014.skeleton: I managed to creep down into the living-room
b3-050-s014.gloss: 尽管如此，我悄悄下楼只坚持了两天就被人发现了
b3-050-s014.whyLearn: manage to do 表示好不容易做成，before 从句则带出“没过多久就”的转折意味。

b3-050-s015.skeleton: I sat down at the breakfast table in an exhausted condition.

modifiers.text: After jumping about on the carpet and twisting the human frame into uncomfortable positions,

b3-050-s015.gloss: 在地毯上一通乱蹦乱扭后，我筋疲力尽地坐到早餐桌旁
b3-050-s015.whyLearn: After + 两个并列动名词结构把一连串动作压进句首状语，介词后接 -ing 的用法一目了然。

b3-050-s016.skeleton: It was this that betrayed me.
b3-050-s016.whyLearn: It was ... that ... 强调句的最简形式，六个词就能把责任焦点推到 this 上。

b3-050-s017.skeleton: The next morning the whole family trooped in
b3-050-s017.gloss: 第二天早上全家人都鱼贯而入看我表演
b3-050-s017.whyLearn: troop in 生动写出成群的动态，后接不定式表目的，是叙事句的常见收尾方式。

b3-050-s020.skeleton: The time I spent at exercises gradually diminished.
b3-050-s020.gloss: 我花在锻炼上的时间渐渐缩短了
b3-050-s020.whyLearn: 定语从句省略关系词 that，主语 The time 被从句拉长后再接谓语，练习长主语的语感。

b3-050-s021.skeleton: the eleven minutes fell to zero.
grammarRefs: 倒装 · 否定词置句首
b3-050-s021.gloss: 十一分钟一点点减到了零
b3-050-s021.whyLearn: Little by little 置于句首描绘渐进过程，与 fall to zero 搭配，简洁而有画面感。

modifiers.text: to where I had started from.

b3-050-s022.gloss: 到一月十日，我又回到了起点
b3-050-s022.whyLearn: be back to where... 用从句作介词宾语，过去完成时交代更早的起点，一句写出轮回感。

b3-050-s025.skeleton: That proved to be my undoing

modifiers.text: for I soon got back to my old bad habit of dozing off in front of the screen.

b3-050-s025.gloss: 这成了我的败因，因为我很快又在屏幕前打起了瞌睡
b3-050-s025.whyLearn: for 引出原因分句，habit of + 动名词补出旧习内容，是书面叙事里很好用的因果长句。

b4-030-s004.skeleton: Better roads and better vehicles at first induced the wealthier classes

modifiers.text: to live on the outskirts of the cities
on the outskirts of the cities

b4-030-s004.gloss: 道路与车辆改善让富人先住到城郊
b4-030-s004.whyLearn: induce sb to do 是复合宾语典型；at first 插在主语与谓语之间，位置值得模仿。

b4-030-s005.skeleton: The urgent need for defence had also vanished.
b4-030-s005.gloss: 防御的急切需求也早已消失
b4-030-s005.whyLearn: had vanished 用过去完成时表示此前已结束的状态，need for 是常见搭配。

b4-030-s006.skeleton: This tendency is now spreading rapidly downwards.
b4-030-s006.gloss: 这种趋势正迅速向下蔓延
b4-030-s006.whyLearn: is spreading 用进行时表现正在蔓延的过程，rapidly downwards 双副词连用很有画面感。

b4-030-s007.skeleton: But a new set of conditions is just showing itself.
b4-030-s007.gloss: 但一套新的条件正在显现
b4-030-s007.whyLearn: a set of 表“一套”，show itself 意为“显现”，of 短语紧接 set 作定语。

b4-030-s009.skeleton: the active lives were spent in the cities

modifiers.text: Apart from the care of children and periods of sheer rest

b4-030-s009.gloss: 除育儿和纯休息外，活动都在城里度过
b4-030-s009.whyLearn: Apart from 引出排除项；lives 作主语，were spent 用被动说“生活被度过”。

b4-030-s010.skeleton: the concentration of such activities was even more emphasized, and the homes were pushed outwards

modifiers.text: at the cost of the discomfort of commuting
and the homes were pushed outwards

b4-030-s010.gloss: 某些方面活动更集中，住宅被推向城外
b4-030-s010.whyLearn: 两个并列被动分句串起结果，at the cost of 引出代价，commuting 是介词后动名词。

b4-030-s011.skeleton: the reasons for this concentration are largely disappearing

modifiers.text: if we examine the trend of technology during the past generation

b4-030-s011.gloss: 但看近一代技术趋势，集中的理由正消失
b4-030-s011.whyLearn: if 条件从句插在主谓之间，主句用进行时表正在消失，双逗号结构清晰。

b4-030-s012.skeleton: the reasons for the choice of sites for cities are also altering

modifiers.text: for the choice of sites for cities

b4-030-s012.gloss: 而且，城市选址的理由也在改变
b4-030-s012.whyLearn: reasons for 后叠of、for 多层介词定语；Still more 作递进，alter 比 change 书面。

b4-030-s014.skeleton: Almost every reason for the growth of the cities, concurrently with the growth of civilization has been profoundly modified.

modifiers.text: for the growth of the cities
concurrently with the growth of civilization

b4-030-s014.gloss: 城市与文明同步增长的理由几乎全被改变
b4-030-s014.whyLearn: has been modified 用现在完成被动；concurrently with 插在主语与谓语之间。

b4-031-s001.skeleton: Many people in industry and the Services

modifiers.text: who have practical experience of noise

b4-031-s001.gloss: 工业与服务业中许多有噪声经验的人
b4-031-s001.whyLearn: who 定语从句用逗号隔开表非限定，修饰前面的人，注意 Services 首字母大写。

b4-031-s002.skeleton: those who dislike noise will sometimes use most inadequate evidence to support their pleas for a quieter society

modifiers.text: to support their pleas for a quieter society

b4-031-s002.gloss: 反对噪声者常用贫乏证据支持诉求
b4-031-s002.whyLearn: those who 是“……的人”的经典结构，their 回指 those，pleas for 后接名词。

b4-031-s005.skeleton: One allegation often made is that noise produces mental illness.
b4-031-s005.gloss: 一种常见指控是噪声导致精神病
b4-031-s005.whyLearn: made 是后置过去分词作定语，that 从句说明 allegation 的具体内容。

b4-031-s008.skeleton: the snag in this sort of anecdote is of course that one cannot distinguish cause and effect

modifiers.text: that one cannot distinguish cause and effect

b4-031-s008.gloss: 这类轶事的症结在于难分因果
b4-031-s008.whyLearn: of course 插在系动词后；that 从句作表语，distinguish A and B 是固定搭配。

b4-031-s009.skeleton: Was the noise a cause of the illness, or were the complaints about noise merely a symptom

modifiers.text: or were the complaints about noise merely a symptom

b4-031-s009.gloss: 噪声是病因，还是抱怨只是症状
b4-031-s009.whyLearn: 选择疑问句用 or 连接两个倒装分句，a cause 与 a symptom 形成对照。

b4-031-s010.skeleton: Another patient might equally well complain

modifiers.text: that her neigh-bours were combining to slander her and persecute her
to slander her and persecute her
and yet one might be cautious about believing this statement

b4-031-s010.gloss: 有病人可能抱怨邻居联手诽谤迫害她
b4-031-s010.whyLearn: might 表推测，were combining to do 用过去进行时说“正联手”，yet 转出谨慎判断。

b4-031-s012.skeleton: The United States Navy, for instance, recently examined a very large number of men working on aircraft carriers

modifiers.text: of men working on aircraft carriers
the study was known as Project Anehin

b4-031-s012.gloss: 美国海军曾大规模调查航母上的人员
b4-031-s012.whyLearn: known as 表“被称为”，working on 作后置定语，for instance 插入主谓之间。

b3-048-s014.gloss: 船里有个船夫，正睡得香。
b3-048-s014.whyLearn: 地点状语提前、形容词短语收尾，一句搭出静态画面，适合模仿写景。

b3-048-s032.gloss: 毫无疑问，我们是不受欢迎的人。
b3-048-s032.whyLearn: no doubt 后用 that 从句说明内容，是表达判断的常用句型。

b3-049-s006.skeleton: aunt Harriet used to entertain lavishly
b3-049-s006.gloss: 哈丽特姑妈上了年纪前常大摆排场待客。
b3-049-s006.whyLearn: used to 与 before 从句配合，一句话写出今昔对比的人物变化。

b3-049-s011.skeleton: she was extremely difficult to please

modifiers.text: She always referred to them as' the shifting population'
for they came and went with such frequency that I never even got a chance to learn their names
