b3-056-s007.skeleton: Sometimes we go up-stream to a favourite backwater, some- times we have our party at the boathouse

modifiers.text: which a predecessor of ours at the farm built in the meadow hard by the deepest pool for swimming and diving
in the meadow hard by the deepest pool for swimming and diving

b3-056-s007.gloss: 有时去上游河湾，有时在船屋聚会，那是先辈所建
b3-056-s007.whyLearn: 两个分句用逗号并列，第二句带which定语从句，从句里介词短语层层叠加。

b3-056-s009.skeleton: We welcome the seasons by the river- side

modifiers.text: crowning the youngest girl with flowers in the spring
holding a summer festival on Midsummer Eve
giving thanks for the harvest in the autumn
and throwing a holly wreath into the current in the winter

b3-056-s009.gloss: 我们在河边迎四季：戴花、节庆、感恩、投花环
b3-056-s009.whyLearn: 四个现在分词短语并列作伴随状语，句式整齐，宜模仿写季节活动。

b2-010-s003.whyLearn: 两个 in 短语分别交代产地和年代，是练习被动语态与地点时间状语的极简模板。

b2-010-s004.gloss: 我们的古钢琴放在客厅里。
b2-010-s004.whyLearn: 物主代词作主语加 be kept，后面接地点，学会说某物被存放在哪里。

b2-010-s005.skeleton: It has belong to our family
b2-010-s005.whyLearn: for a long time 表持续时间，配合 belong to 记住表示归属的动词不用被动。

b2-010-s006.gloss: 这件乐器是多年前我祖父买的。
b2-010-s006.whyLearn: 被动语态用 by 引出施动者，再接时间状语，一次说清由谁在何时买下。

b2-010-s007.gloss: 最近它被一位访客弄坏了。
b2-010-s007.whyLearn: 时间副词提前、by 短语收尾，展示被动句里状语与施动者的自然位置。

b2-010-s008.gloss: 她试着在琴上弹爵士乐。
b2-010-s008.whyLearn: try 后接不定式作宾语，不定式里再带地点状语，短句但结构完整。

b2-010-s009.skeleton: She struck the keys too hard

modifiers.text: and two of the strings were broken

b2-010-s009.gloss: 她用力敲键，两根弦断了。
b2-010-s009.whyLearn: and 连接主动与被动两个分句，同一动作换主语后正好对照施受关系。

b2-010-s011.skeleton: we are not allowed to touch it
b2-010-s011.whyLearn: be allowed to 的否定式，一句话同时练被动、否定和不定式三种结构。

modifiers.text: by a friend of my father's

b2-010-s012.gloss: 它正由我父亲的一位朋友修理。
b2-010-s012.whyLearn: 现在进行时的被动 is being done，再套双重所有格，句式密度高值得仿写。

modifiers.text: but he is now working at a bank

b2-011-s002.gloss: 哈里以前当律师，现在在银行工作。
b2-011-s002.whyLearn: 一个 but 就把过去时与现在进行时并置，轻松说出职业的今昔变化。

modifiers.text: and sat at the same table

b2-011-s004.gloss: 哈里看见我，过来坐同一张桌。
b2-011-s004.whyLearn: 三个过去式动词靠 and 连成连续动作，学会省略重复主语的并列谓语。

b2-011-s007.gloss: 令我惊讶的是，他立刻把钱给了我。
b2-011-s007.whyLearn: 句首 To my surprise 表情绪，gave 后跟双宾语，日常叙事里非常好用。

b2-012-s001.skeleton: Our ncighbour, Captain Charles Alison, will sail
b2-012-s001.gloss: 邻居查尔斯·艾利森船长明天从朴茨茅斯启航。
b2-012-s001.whyLearn: 主谓之间插入同位语说明身份，句子照样通顺，是英文介绍人物的常见手法。

b2-012-s002.gloss: 我们清晨将在港口见他。
b2-012-s002.whyLearn: shall 表将来，后面地点状语加时间状语依次排开，语序一目了然。

b2-012-s003.gloss: 他将在自己的小船顶帆号上。
b2-012-s003.whyLearn: be 加介词短语表位置，句尾同位语补出船名，介绍地点人物的实用句型。

b2-012-s004.skeleton: Tapsail is a famous little boat
b2-012-s004.gloss: 顶帆号是一条著名的小船。
b2-012-s004.whyLearn: 最基础的主系表结构，顺带记住 a famous little boat 的形容词排列顺序。

b2-076-s008.skeleton: Mrs Brabante is talking to the manager
b2-076-s008.gloss: 布拉班特太太正与当地工厂经理交谈。
b2-076-s008.whyLearn: 一句里进行时、where定语从句与被动语态同框，可练多层后置修饰的断句朗读。

modifiers.text: what will happen at the end of the harvest
at the end of the harvest

b2-076-s009.gloss: 最后一个镜头展示收尾的吃通心粉比赛。
b2-076-s009.whyLearn: what从句作shows的宾语，冒号后名词短语补出内容，是新闻解说展开信息的常见方式。

b2-076-s010.skeleton: Signor Fratelli, the present champion, has won it every year
b2-076-s010.gloss: 卫冕冠军自1961年起年年夺冠。
b2-076-s010.whyLearn: 主语后同位语用逗号隔开，现在完成时与since连用表示持续至今，值得模仿。

b2-076-s011.skeleton: And that ends our special bulletin
b2-076-s011.gloss: 本期特别新闻结束，今天是4月1日星期四。
b2-076-s011.whyLearn: 用that指代整档节目收尾，日期层层叠加作同位补充，是播报结束语的典型句式。

b2-076-s012.skeleton: We are now returning you to the studio.
b2-076-s012.gloss: 现在把画面交回演播室。
b2-076-s012.whyLearn: return sb to somewhere搭配现在进行时，是电视直播交接镜头的固定说法。

b2-077-s001.gloss: 公元前800年去世的埃及女子的木乃伊。
b2-077-s001.whyLearn: 名词后先接介词短语再接who定语从句，层层后置修饰，虽是标题片段也要看清主干。

b2-077-s003.skeleton: The mummy is that of Shepenmut

modifiers.text: who was once a singer in the Temple of Thebes

b2-077-s003.gloss: 木乃伊是曾在底比斯神庙当歌手的舍彭穆特。
b2-077-s003.whyLearn: that of sb替代前文名词避免重复，who从句补充身份，是介绍文物归属的实用句式。

b2-077-s004.skeleton: doctors have been trying to find out

modifiers.text: As there were strange marks on the X-ray plates taken of the mummy
on the X-ray plates taken of the mummy
whether the woman died of a rare disease

b2-077-s004.gloss: X光片上有怪痕，医生想查明她是否死于罕见病。
b2-077-s004.whyLearn: As引出原因、taken of为后置分词、whether从句作宾语，一句串三种修饰，适合练长句切分。

b2-077-s005.skeleton: The only way to do this was to operate
b2-077-s005.gloss: 唯一的办法就是动手术。
b2-077-s005.whyLearn: 主语与表语各用一个不定式，way to do sth与be to do搭配一目了然，短句结构最清楚。

b2-077-s007.skeleton: The doctors removed a section of the mummy

modifiers.text: and sent it to a laboratory

b2-077-s007.gloss: 医生切下一块木乃伊并送去做实验。
b2-077-s007.whyLearn: 两个过去式谓语由and连接共用一个主语，it回指section，是叙述连续动作的常见骨架。

modifiers.text: which the X-ray of the god Duamutef

b2-077-s008.gloss: 他们还发现了与杜阿穆特夫神X光有关的东西。
b2-077-s008.whyLearn: which引导的定语从句紧跟在something后，可借这句练关系代词在从句中作何成分的判断。

b2-077-s009.skeleton: This god which has the head of a cow was normally placedinside a mummy

modifiers.text: which has the head of a cow

b2-077-s009.gloss: 这个牛头神像通常被放进木乃伊里。
b2-077-s009.whyLearn: 定语从句插在主语与谓语之间，须跨过它找回was与被动结构，句中placedinside还黏成一词。

b2-077-s010.skeleton: The doctors have not yet decided
b2-077-s010.gloss: 医生们还没确定这位女子是怎么死的。
b2-077-s010.whyLearn: how从句作decided的宾语，yet与现在完成时否定连用表示尚未，是悬而未决的常用表达。

b2-077-s012.skeleton: The mummy successfully survived the operation
b2-077-s012.gloss: 木乃伊顺利挺过了这次手术。
b2-077-s012.whyLearn: 主动语态让木乃伊成为动作发出者，副词放在实义动词前，一句写尽结果，值得模仿。

modifiers.text: After reading an article entitled 'Cigarette Smoking and Your Health'

b2-078-s001.gloss: 读完那篇吸烟与健康的文章，我点烟安神。
b2-078-s001.whyLearn: After加动名词把时间状语前置，entitled分词后置修饰article，主句极短，反差值得注意。

b2-078-s002.skeleton: I smoked with concentration and pleasure

modifiers.text: as I was sure that this would be my last cigarette
that this would be my last cigarette

b2-078-s002.gloss: 我专注而愉快地抽着，确信这是最后一支。
b2-078-s002.whyLearn: as引导原因状语从句，其中sure后还套that宾语从句与情态动词would，练从句嵌套的好材料。

b1-049-s001.gloss: 霍尔先生说前几天把箱子忘在去伦敦的火车上了
b1-049-s001.whyLearn: the other day 指“前几天”，只跟过去时连用；再加上 on the train to London 表“开往伦敦的列车”

b1-049-s003.skeleton: It's a small blue case and it's got a zip.
b1-049-s003.gloss: 他说那是个带拉链的蓝色小箱子
b1-049-s003.whyLearn: 两个分句用 and 并列；have got 在英式口语里等于 have，后一句说“有拉链”比 have a zip 更自然

b1-049-s006.whyLearn: 一句极短的否认：名词性物主代词 mine 独立使用，不必重复 my case；No 后停顿再纠正，正是口语否定的节奏

b1-049-s009.gloss: 霍尔先生要求让他看看那个箱子
b1-049-s009.whyLearn: let me + 动词原形是英语最省力的请求句式，看东西、想一想、试试都能套，比 Can I see 更随口

b1-049-s010.gloss: 服务员问他的姓名和住址
b1-049-s010.whyLearn: 登记、办证件时的固定问法；name and address 用 and 并列，两个信息一次问完

b1-049-s011.gloss: 他报出自己的姓名和住址
b1-049-s011.whyLearn: 英语地址先说门牌号再说街名，和中文顺序相反；信息以顿号、逗号并列铺开，是口头报信息的典型形式

b1-049-s017.skeleton: Three pound and fifty pence please.
b1-049-s017.gloss: 服务员报价三镑五十便士
b1-049-s017.whyLearn: 报价时货币单位用 and 连接整数与零头，句尾加 please 让要钱听起来不生硬

b1-049-s022.skeleton: This case doesn't belong to me!
b1-049-s022.gloss: 他说这个箱子不是他的
b1-049-s022.whyLearn: belong to 表归属，不用被动式；don't/doesn't + 动词原形的否定配上感叹号，强调“真的不是我的”

b1-049-s023.skeleton: You've given me the wrong case!
b1-049-s023.gloss: 他指责对方给错了箱子
b1-049-s023.whyLearn: give 可接双宾语：give sb sth；用现在完成时强调“错已经到手上”这个结果，正是投诉的语气

b1-050-s003.gloss: 泰德说他滑了一跤摔下楼梯
b1-050-s003.whyLearn: 两个过去式动词用 and 串起连续动作，滑倒和摔下去先后清楚；downstairs 表方向，不需要介词

modifiers.text: that he will come at once.

b1-050-s015.gloss: 帕特说医生讲他马上就来
b1-050-s015.whyLearn: 主句现在时 says 后面接 that 宾语从句，从句该用 will 就用 will，不受主句时态牵制；at once 意为“立刻”

b1-050-s016.gloss: 她确信泰德需要拍X光片
b1-050-s016.whyLearn: be sure that 是表达判断的高频句型，后面从句用一般现在时陈述事实；X-ray 冠词 an 也常被忽略

b1-051-s001.gloss: 祖母让玛丽给她念吉米的明信片
b1-051-s001.whyLearn: 祈使句用动词原形开头；read sth to sb 表示“念给某人听”，句尾 please 加称呼 Mary，把命令变成请求

b1-051-s002.skeleton: I have just arrived in Scotland and I'm staying at a Youth Hostel.
b1-051-s002.gloss: 玛丽说刚到苏格兰，正住在青年旅舍
b1-051-s002.whyLearn: 两句时态配合很典型：just 配现在完成时讲刚做完的事，现在进行时讲眼下暂住的状态，一静一动

b1-051-s004.gloss: 玛丽说吉米刚到苏格兰
b1-051-s004.whyLearn: 转述别人的话：直接引语里的 I have 要改成 he's，人称和动词形式都得跟着变，是间接引语的第一课

b1-051-s005.skeleton: he's staying at a Youth Hostel
b1-051-s005.gloss: 她转述他正住在一家青年旅舍
b1-051-s005.whyLearn: 这句省了 that，直接 He says he's staying，口语里最常这样接；进行时说明是临时住，不是长期居住

b3-058-s013.skeleton: She had lived in the flat for thirty years and was a veritable magpie at hoarding

modifiers.text: it seemed as though everything she possessed had been tossed out and turned over and over

b3-058-s013.gloss: 她住了三十年，攒物成癖；东西被翻得七零八落。
b3-058-s013.whyLearn: 过去完成时与被动语态连用，as though领出全句总结，可学两个分句如何各自成篇。

b3-058-s016.skeleton: The inspector began to look for fingerprints

modifiers.text: while the constable checked that the front door locks had not been forced
that the front door locks had not been forced
therebyproving that the burglars had either used skeleton keys or entered over the balcony
that the burglars had either used skeleton keys or entered over the balcony
either used skeleton keys or entered over the balcony

b3-058-s016.gloss: 警长查指纹，警员查门锁，断定贼或撬锁或翻阳台。
b3-058-s016.whyLearn: while并列两线取证，thereby proving把结果压成分词，一句演完侦查推理全过程。

b3-058-s017.skeleton: There was no trace of fingerprints

modifiers.text: but the inspector found a dirty red bundle that contained jewellery which the old lady said was not hers
that contained jewellery which the old lady said was not hers
which the old lady said was not hers

b3-058-s017.gloss: 没有指纹，但警长找到一包首饰，老夫人说不认得。
b3-058-s017.whyLearn: 两个定语从句一环套一环，还夹进said式插入小句，是练嵌套修饰的典型句。

b3-058-s019.skeleton: The inspector then asked the old lady to try to check what was missing by the next day

modifiers.text: to try to check what was missing by the next day
and advised her not to stay alone in the flat for a few nights
not to stay alone in the flat for a few nights

b3-058-s019.gloss: 警长让她次日清点失物，并劝她别独自住几晚。
b3-058-s019.whyLearn: ask sb to do与advise sb not to do连用，一肯定一否定，正好对比不定式作补语的两种式。

b3-058-s020.skeleton: The old lady thought he was a fussy creature

modifiers.text: but since the porter agreed with him, she rang up her daughter and asked for her help in what she described as a little spot of bother
since the porter agreed with him
in what she described as a little spot of bother
what she described as a little spot of bother

b3-058-s020.gloss: 她觉得他小题大做，但门房同意，她便求助女儿。
b3-058-s020.whyLearn: since既表原因又插在句中，后面what从句作介词宾语，多层嵌套却不乱。

modifiers.text: who always cuts out from newspapers sketches of model clothes that she would like to buy, if she had the money
that she would like to buy

b3-059-s010.gloss: 我认识个人，总从报上剪下想买的时装图样。
b3-059-s010.whyLearn: cuts out…sketches宾语后置语序罕见，末尾又接虚拟条件，一句练语序加虚拟两难点。

b3-059-s011.skeleton: the chances that she will ever be able to afford such purchases are remote

modifiers.text: that she will ever be able to afford such purchases
but she is never sufficiently strongrminded to be able to stop the practice
to be able to stop the practice

b3-059-s011.gloss: 她不富裕，买不起；又总没毅力戒掉这习惯。
b3-059-s011.whyLearn: chances后接同位语从句说明内容，分号后but转折，两个难结构在一句里对照。

b3-059-s016.skeleton: there is always something to do in connection with it

modifiers.text: stamps, records, first editions of books, china, glass, antique furniture, pictures, model cars, stuffed birds, toy animals
from finding the right place for the latest addition to verifying facts in reference books
finding the right place for the latest addition

b3-059-s016.gloss: 收藏无论是什么，总有做不完的事要忙。
b3-059-s016.whyLearn: 句首Whatever让步，中间一串同位语列举藏品，末尾from…to收尾，尽显英文列举张力。

modifiers.text: not only in the chosen subject, but also in general matters which have some bearing on it
in general matters which have some bearing on it
which have some bearing on it

b3-059-s017.gloss: 这爱好既教专门知识，也教相关常识。
b3-059-s017.whyLearn: not only…but also连接两个介词短语，第二个还挂定语从句，短句里层次分明。

b3-059-s018.whyLearn: 最短的there be句，示范存在句加also的扩写方式，适合背诵模仿。

b3-059-s021.skeleton: Soon the hobby leads to travel

modifiers.text: perhaps to a meeting in another town, possibly a trip abroad in search of a rare specimen
in search of a rare specimen
for collectors are not confined to any one country

b3-059-s021.gloss: 爱好引你出行、赴会、远游寻珍，藏家不限一国。
b3-059-s021.whyLearn: 几个并列名词短语层层展开出行场景，句末for给出原因，学铺陈加解释的节奏。

b3-059-s022.skeleton: one may well become an authority on one's hobby and will very probably be asked to give informal talks

modifiers.text: to give informal talks to little gatherings and then, if successful, to larger audiences
to little gatherings and then, if successful, to larger audiences

b3-059-s022.gloss: 多年后你会成专家，受邀对小圈子乃至大场合讲话。
b3-059-s022.whyLearn: may well与will be asked并列，两个to短语共享不定式，条件插入语插在中间，结构精巧。

b3-060-s017.skeleton: this will be less than if you miss the train and have to wait an hour or more for the next one

modifiers.text: Although being early may mean wasting a little time
if you miss the train and have to wait an hour or more for the next one
and have to wait an hour or more for the next one
and you avoid the frustration of arriving at the very moment when the train is drawing out of the station and being unable to get onit
of arriving at the very moment when the train is drawing out of the station and being unable to get onit
when the train is drawing out of the station
arriving at the very moment when the train is drawing out of the station

b3-060-s017.gloss: 早到只浪费一点时间，胜过误车干等，也免了眼看车开的懊恼。
b3-060-s017.whyLearn: Although让步与if条件前后呼应，分号后and另起新句，展示长句如何分层推进。

b3-060-s019.skeleton: Such an experience befell a certain young girl

modifiers.text: the first time she was travelling alone

b3-060-s019.gloss: 一位年轻女孩初次独自出行时，就碰上了这种事。
b3-060-s019.whyLearn: the first time直接当连词引导时间从句，比when更地道，值得记住。

modifiers.text: since her parents had impressed upon her that it would be unforgivable to miss it and cause the friends with whom she was going to stay to make two journeys to meet her
that it would be unforgivable to miss it and cause the friends with whom she was going to stay to make two journeys to meet her
to miss it and cause the friends with whom she was going to stay to make two journeys to meet her
with whom she was going to stay
to make two journeys to meet her

b3-060-s020.gloss: 她提前二十分钟到站，因为父母叮嘱误车不可原谅。
b3-060-s020.whyLearn: since从句里宾语从句套定语从句再套不定式，三层嵌套，是拆长句的好范本。

modifiers.text: that a train did come into the station at the time on the paper
at the time on the paper
but only to take on water, not passengers

b3-060-s024.gloss: 他承认确有那班车进站停车，但只加水不载客。
b3-060-s024.whyLearn: 两个that宾语从句并列，did强调谓语，末尾only to道出真相，语气转折干净。

b3-013-s015.skeleton: The man let out a cry and jumped back several paces
b3-013-s015.gloss: 那人喊了一声，向后跳了好几步。
b3-013-s015.whyLearn: let out a cry 是“喊出一声”的固定搭配，and 连接 let 与 jumped 两个过去式，时态和结构一并练到。

b3-014-s002.gloss: 敲诈保护费并非现代才有的罪行。
b3-014-s002.whyLearn: 动名词短语 Obtaining... 整体作主语，谓语用单数 is；is not 的否定位置也是本句最值得记的一处。

b3-014-s004.skeleton: Sir John Hawkwood arrived in Italy
b3-014-s004.gloss: 六百年前霍克伍德带兵到意大利，定居佛罗伦萨附近。
b3-014-s004.whyLearn: 时间状语前置加逗号是叙事常用开局；arrived 与 settled 两个过去式由 and 并列，动作先后分明。

b3-014-s005.skeleton: He soon made a name for himself and came to be known to the Italians as Giovanni Acuto

modifiers.text: to be known to the Italians as Giovanni Acuto

b3-014-s005.gloss: 他很快出了名，被意大利人称作阿库托。
b3-014-s005.whyLearn: make a name for himself 和 come to be known as 都是地道搭配，前者表成名，后者表逐渐为人所知。

b3-014-s006.skeleton: Hawkwood used to hire his soldiers to princes

modifiers.text: Whenever the Italian city-states were at war with each other
who were willing to pay the high price

b3-014-s006.gloss: 城邦交战时他把雇佣兵租给出价高的君主。
b3-014-s006.whyLearn: 一句里嵌了两个定语从句，he demanded 前省略关系代词 that，是理解省略现象的好样本。

b3-014-s008.skeleton: Hawkwood made large sums of money
b3-014-s008.gloss: 霍克伍德靠这种方式赚了大笔钱。
b3-014-s008.whyLearn: make money 中间插 large sums of 表“大笔”，in this way 回指上文做法，是衔接上下文的实用短语。

b3-014-s009.skeleton: the Italians regarded him as a sort of hero
b3-014-s009.gloss: 尽管如此，意大利人还是把他当成某种英雄。
b3-014-s009.whyLearn: regard sb as sth 是“把某人视为”的固定框架，in spite of 引出让步，语气比 although 更书面。

b3-015-s001.skeleton: Children always appreciate small gifts of money
b3-015-s001.gloss: 孩子总是喜欢别人给的一点小钱。
b3-015-s001.whyLearn: appreciate 后直接接名词，不加 for；always 放实义动词前，是最基础却最容易写错的位置。

b3-015-s002.skeleton: Father, of course, provides a regular supply of pocket-money, but uncles and aunts are always a source of extra income

modifiers.text: but uncles and aunts are always a source of extra income

b3-015-s002.gloss: 父亲照例给固定零花钱，叔伯姑姨则常是额外收入。
b3-015-s002.whyLearn: 第一个分句用单数 provides，第二个用复数 are，主语数变化与 but 的对比一起，构成典型的并列长句。

b3-015-s003.skeleton: small sums go a long way
b3-015-s003.gloss: 对有些孩子来说，小钱也能顶大用。
b3-015-s003.whyLearn: go a long way 是“很管用、很经花”的地道说法，With some children 表示“对某些孩子而言”。

b3-015-s005.skeleton: Only very thrifty children manage to fill up a money-box
b3-015-s005.gloss: 只有非常节俭的孩子才能把存钱罐装满。
b3-015-s005.whyLearn: manage to do 强调“设法做成”，Only 置于句首修饰主语，是理解强调位置的入门例子。

b3-015-s006.skeleton: sixpence is a small price to pay for a satisfying bar of chocolate

modifiers.text: to pay for a satisfying bar of chocolate

b3-015-s006.gloss: 对他们多数人来说，六便士换一块好吃的巧克力不算贵。
b3-015-s006.whyLearn: a small price to pay for... 是评价句的常用框架，不定式作定语后置修饰 price，很值得仿写。

b3-015-s007.skeleton: My nephew, George, has a money-box but it is always empty
b3-015-s007.gloss: 我侄子乔治有个存钱罐，可它总是空的。
b3-015-s007.whyLearn: 同位语 George 用逗号夹在主语后补充说明，but 分句用 it 回指 money-box，是口语叙事的标准节奏。

b3-015-s008.skeleton: Very few of the sixpences I have given him have found their way there
b3-015-s008.gloss: 我给他的那些六便士，几乎没有进过存钱罐。
b3-015-s008.whyLearn: 定语从句 I have given him 前省略了 that，主句与从句各用一个现在完成时，时态层次很清楚。

b3-015-s009.skeleton: I gave him sixpence yesterday and advised him to save it
b3-015-s009.gloss: 我昨天给他六便士，还劝他存起来。
b3-015-s009.whyLearn: advise sb to do 是“劝某人做某事”的固定搭配，gave 与 advised 两个过去式共用主语 I，时态一致。

b3-015-s010.skeleton: he bought himself sixpence worth of trouble
b3-015-s010.gloss: 他却给自己买来了六便士的麻烦。
b3-015-s010.whyLearn: buy sb sth 双宾语结构把花钱与惹麻烦并置，Instead 单独作状语转折，是俏皮收尾的写法。

b3-021-s015.skeleton: A match was held at Stilton

modifiers.text: where both men fought for an hour

b3-021-s015.gloss: 比赛在斯蒂尔顿举行，两人打了一小时
b3-021-s015.whyLearn: 被动was held省略施动者，where引导定语从句修饰地点，是比赛叙事的典型句式

b3-021-s016.skeleton: The public bet a great deal of money on Mendoza
b3-021-s016.gloss: 公众在门多萨身上押下重金，他却输了
b3-021-s016.whyLearn: a great deal of接不可数名词表大量，but连接主动下注与被动落败，对比鲜明

b3-021-s017.skeleton: Mendoza met Humphries in the ring on a later occasion

modifiers.text: and he lost for a second time

b3-021-s017.gloss: 门多萨后来再战汉弗莱斯，又输了
b3-021-s017.whyLearn: and连接两个过去时并列句，in the ring与on a later occasion两介词短语叠加表时空，叙事紧凑

b3-021-s018.skeleton: he finally beat Humphries and became Champion of England

modifiers.text: not until his third match in 1790

b3-021-s018.gloss: 直到1790年第三场比赛他才击败对手夺冠
b3-021-s018.whyLearn: It was not until...that强调句是高频难点，还连着两个并列谓语和Champion of England头衔表达

b3-021-s019.skeleton: he founded a highly successful Academy and even Lord Byron became one of his pupils
b3-021-s019.gloss: 其间他创办学院，连拜伦都成了他的学生
b3-021-s019.whyLearn: Meanwhile作衔接插入语，even加强语气，one of his pupils是所属与复数的固定搭配

modifiers.text: After he was defeated by a boxer called Gentleman Jackson

b3-021-s022.gloss: 被杰克逊击败后，他很快被人遗忘
b3-021-s022.whyLearn: after引导时间状语从句且从句本身被动，called Gentleman Jackson作后置定语，一处见三种结构

b3-021-s023.skeleton: He was sent to prison for failing to pay his debts and died in poverty in 1836

modifiers.text: for failing to pay his debts

b3-021-s023.gloss: 他因欠债入狱，1836年在贫困中死去
b3-021-s023.whyLearn: 介词for后接failing to pay，动名词与不定式嵌套，还共享主语并列died，一句练多层非谓语

b3-022-s002.skeleton: this is unfortunate for the poor actors

modifiers.text: who are required to go on repeating the same lines night after night
to go on repeating the same lines night after night

b3-022-s002.gloss: 很多方面这对穷演员很不幸，他们得夜夜重复台词
b3-022-s002.whyLearn: who定语从句里套be required to do再套go on doing，非谓语层层嵌套，night after night表反复

b3-022-s004.skeleton: Yet this is not always the case
b3-022-s004.whyLearn: Yet转折加not always部分否定，this is not always the case是议论文常用的地道反驳句

b3-022-s005.skeleton: A famous actor in a highly successful play was once cast in the role of an aristocrat

modifiers.text: in the role of an aristocrat
who had been imprisoned in the Bastille for twenty years

b3-022-s005.gloss: 一位名演员被派演出被囚二十年的贵族
b3-022-s005.whyLearn: be cast in the role是固定搭配，who从句用过去完成被动交代更早的关押，时态层次清晰

b3-022-s006.skeleton: a gaoler would always come on tothe stage with a letter which he would hand to the prisoner
b3-022-s006.gloss: 最后一幕狱吏总会带信上场交给囚犯
b3-022-s006.whyLearn: would表过去习惯性动作，which定语从句中would hand延续过去视角，with a letter作伴随状语

b3-022-s009.skeleton: The curtain went up on the final act of the play and revealed the aristocrat

modifiers.text: sitting alone behind bars in his dark cell
on the final act of the play

b3-022-s009.gloss: 最后一幕幕布升起，显出独自坐在铁窗后的贵族
b3-022-s009.whyLearn: go up表幕布升起，and后共享主语接revealed，sitting分词短语作宾补，画面感强

b3-022-s010.skeleton: the gaoler appeared with the precious letter in his hands

modifiers.text: with the precious letter in his hands

b3-022-s010.gloss: 就在那时狱吏手拿那封珍贵信件出现
b3-022-s010.whyLearn: with复合结构描述伴随状态，in his hands细化位置，Just then是叙事转场的常用时间插入语

b3-022-s011.skeleton: He entered the cell and presented the letter to the aristocrat
b3-022-s011.gloss: 他进牢房把信呈给贵族
b3-022-s011.whyLearn: and连接两个连续过去动作，present sth to sb是正式递交的固定搭配，动作链叙述清楚

b3-022-s012.skeleton: the copy he gave him had not been written out in full
b3-022-s012.gloss: 但他给他的那份并未照常全文写出
b3-022-s012.whyLearn: 省略关系代词的定语从句插在主语后，过去完成被动had not been written out与as usual搭配，信息密度高

b3-022-s013.skeleton: It was simply a blank sheet of paper
b3-022-s013.whyLearn: 简短有力的主系表句，simply与blank sheet of paper呼应前面的悬念，适合学就地收束叙事

b4-005-s001.skeleton: The gorilla is something of a paradox
b4-005-s001.gloss: 大猩猩在非洲图景中算是个矛盾体
b4-005-s001.whyLearn: something of a 意为“有点儿算是”，后接介词短语限定评价范围，比 very 更含蓄。

b4-005-s002.skeleton: One thinks one knows him very well.
b4-005-s002.gloss: 人们自以为对他非常了解
b4-005-s002.whyLearn: One 泛指人，可替代 people；thinks 后接省略 that 的从句，两层“认为/知道”叠加很地道。

b4-005-s003.skeleton: he has been killed, captured, and imprisoned

modifiers.text: For a hundred years or more

b4-005-s003.gloss: 百年来他被猎杀、捕获并关进动物园
b4-005-s003.whyLearn: for + 时间段配现在完成时被动；三个过去分词共用一个 has been，是压缩并列信息的典型写法。

b4-005-s004.skeleton: His bones have been mounted in natural history museums everywhere, and he has always exerted a strong fascination
b4-005-s004.gloss: 他的骨架被各地博物馆收藏，也一直吸引着科学家和浪漫派
b4-005-s004.whyLearn: 两个现在完成时并列，一个被动 have been mounted、一个主动 has exerted，同句练习语态转换。

b4-005-s005.skeleton: He is the stereotyped monster of the horror films and the adventure books, and an obvious (though not perhaps strictly scientific) linkwith our ancestral past.

modifiers.text: of the horror films and the adventure books

b4-005-s005.gloss: 他是恐怖片里的定型怪物，也是通往祖先的纽带
b4-005-s005.whyLearn: and 连接两个并列表语，中间用括号插入 though 让步，值得模仿：名词短语也能塞进让步信息。

b4-005-s006.skeleton: the fact is we know very little about gorillas.

modifiers.text: we know very little about gorillas

b4-005-s006.gloss: 然而事实是我们对大猩猩知之甚少
b4-005-s006.whyLearn: the fact is (that) 后接表语从句，口语常省略 that；句首 Yet 比 but 更书面，适合转折。

b4-005-s008.skeleton: Carl Akeley, the American naturalist, led two expeditions in the nineteen-twenties, and now lies buried

modifiers.text: among the animals heloved so well

b4-005-s008.gloss: 博物学家阿克利两次考察后长眠于他深爱的动物之间
b4-005-s008.whyLearn: 同位语紧贴人名补充身份；lie buried 用过去分词表持续状态，and 把两段人生压缩进一句。

b4-005-s011.skeleton: The Abominable Snowman who haunts the imagination of climbers in the Himalayas is hardly more elusive.

modifiers.text: who haunts the imagination of climbers in the Himalayas

b4-005-s011.gloss: 喜马拉雅雪人之难觅不亚于大猩猩
b4-005-s011.whyLearn: who 定语从句把主语和谓语隔开，训练读者跨过长修饰抓 is hardly more elusive 的能力。

b4-006-s001.gloss: 人们总在谈论所谓的青年问题
b4-006-s001.whyLearn: always 搭现在进行时，表示反复发生并带抱怨或不耐烦的语气，是高频地道搭配。

b4-006-s008.skeleton: They have an air of freedom, and they have not a dreary commitment

modifiers.text: to mean ambitions or love of comfort

b4-006-s008.gloss: 他们自由自在，不背负卑微野心与安逸的枷锁
b4-006-s008.whyLearn: have not a + 抽象名词 是书面否定式，比 don't have 更冷峻，常用于刻画人物气质。

b4-006-s009.skeleton: They are not anxious social climbers, and they have no devotion

modifiers.text: and they have no devotion to material things

b4-006-s009.gloss: 他们不攀附权贵，也不痴迷于物质
b4-006-s009.whyLearn: not + 名词与 no + 名词 交替否定，避免句式重复，两个分句共享同一主语 They。

b4-006-s012.skeleton: All that is in my mind

modifiers.text: when I meet a young person

b4-006-s012.gloss: 我见到年轻人时脑子里想的就是这些
b4-006-s012.whyLearn: All that 作主语，后接 when 时间状语从句，短短一句把抽象想法和具体场景挂钩。

modifiers.text: when I hear people saying that sport creates goodwill between

b4-007-s001.gloss: 每逢听人说体育能缔造友谊，我总感到惊讶
b4-007-s001.whyLearn: be amazed 用被动表达主观反应；when 从句里再套 hear sb doing 和 that 从句，层级分明。

b4-007-s003.skeleton: Nearly all the sports practised nowadays are competitive.
b4-007-s003.gloss: 如今开展的运动几乎都带竞争性
b4-007-s003.whyLearn: 过去分词短语 practised nowadays 后置作定语，等于 which are practised，可大幅压缩定语从句。

b4-007-s006.skeleton: Anyone who has played even in a school football match knows this.

modifiers.text: who has played even in a school football match
even in a school football match

b4-007-s006.gloss: 连踢过校队比赛的人都明白这一点
b4-007-s006.whyLearn: 定语从句插在主语 Anyone 和谓语 knows 之间；even 把门槛压到最低，让步意味很轻。

b4-007-s007.gloss: 在国际层面上，体育简直是模拟战争
b4-007-s007.whyLearn: frankly 作句子副词插入 be 与表语之间，直白表明说话人态度，语气比 clearly 强得多。

b3-059-s014.skeleton: It provides relaxation for leisure hours

modifiers.text: as just looking at one's treasures is always a joy

b3-059-s014.gloss: 收藏能在闲暇时带来放松。
b3-059-s014.whyLearn: as 引出原因状语从句，动名词短语作主语，说明看藏品本身就是乐趣。

b3-059-s015.skeleton: One does not have to go outside for amusement

modifiers.text: since the collection is housed at home

b3-059-s015.gloss: 藏品在家，娱乐不必出门。
b3-059-s015.whyLearn: have to 的否定表示不必，since 引原因，is housed 为被动语态。

b3-059-s019.skeleton: One wants to meet like-minded collectors

modifiers.text: to get advice, to compare notes, to exchange articles, toshow off the latest find

b3-059-s019.gloss: 收藏者想结交同好、交流切磋。
b3-059-s019.whyLearn: 五个不定式并列铺陈收藏者的动机，语气层层递进，latest 为最高级。

b3-059-s020.skeleton: So one's circle of friends grows.
b3-059-s020.whyLearn: 仅六词收束因果，So 承接上文，circle of friends 是常用搭配。

modifiers.text: then from being able to talk about it

b3-059-s023.whyLearn: first 与 then 分层递进，from 后接动名词说明自信的两个来源。

b3-059-s024.skeleton: Collecting, by occupying spare time so constructively, makes a person contented

modifiers.text: by occupying spare time so constructively

b3-059-s024.gloss: 收藏充实闲暇，使人免于无聊。
b3-059-s024.whyLearn: by 加动名词插入主谓之间作方式状语，with 短语补充说明结果。

b3-060-s001.gloss: 守时是公共事务中的必要习惯。
b3-060-s001.whyLearn: 主系表开头点明主题，in 短语限定适用范围，可学议论文起句。

b3-060-s002.skeleton: nothing could ever be brought to a conclusion

modifiers.text: everything would be in a state of chaos

b3-060-s002.gloss: 不守时则诸事难成、秩序混乱。
b3-060-s002.whyLearn: Without it 引出假设，could be brought 为情态被动，分号并列两个后果。

b3-060-s003.skeleton: is it possible to disregard it

modifiers.text: Only in a sparsely- populated rural community

b3-060-s003.gloss: 唯有偏远乡村才可无视守时。
b3-060-s003.whyLearn: only 状语置于句首引起完全倒装，it 作形式主语，不定式后置。

b3-060-s004.skeleton: there can be some tolerance of unpunctuality
b3-060-s004.gloss: 日常生活中对不守时略有宽容。
b3-060-s004.whyLearn: there be 与情态动词 can 连用表示存在的可能，tolerance of 为固定搭配。

b3-060-s005.skeleton: The intellectual, who is working on some abstruse problem, has everything coordinated and organized

modifiers.text: who is working on some abstruse problem

b3-060-s005.gloss: 专注难题的学者把一切安排有序。
b3-060-s005.whyLearn: 非限制性定语从句插在主语与谓语之间，have sth done 表示安排妥当。

modifiers.text: if late for a dinner party

b3-060-s006.gloss: 若赴宴迟到，他因此可被原谅。
b3-060-s006.whyLearn: if 从句省略主语与 be 动词，被动 forgiven 与 therefore 承接前文逻辑。

b3-060-s007.skeleton: people are often reproached for unpunctuality

modifiers.text: when their only fault is cutting things fine

b3-060-s007.gloss: 人们常因把时间卡得太紧被指责。
b3-060-s007.whyLearn: be reproached for 是常见被动搭配，when 从句交代受责的具体场合。

b3-060-s008.skeleton: It is hard for energetic, quick-minded people to waste time

modifiers.text: so they are often tempted to finish a job before setting out to keep an appointment

b3-060-s008.gloss: 精力充沛者难忍浪费时间，常先完工再赴约。
b3-060-s008.whyLearn: it 作形式主语加 for sb to do，so 引出结果，before 后接动名词。

b3-060-s011.skeleton: The over-punctual can be as much a trial to others as the unpunctual
b3-060-s011.gloss: 过分守时与不守时同样令人难耐。
b3-060-s011.whyLearn: as much A as B 表同级比较，the 加形容词指一类人，对举简洁有力。

b3-060-s012.skeleton: The guest who arrives half an hour too soon is the greatest nuisance

modifiers.text: who arrives half an hour too soon

b3-060-s012.gloss: 早到半小时的客人最令人厌烦。
b3-060-s012.whyLearn: 定语从句紧贴主语限定客人类型，the greatest nuisance 用最高级点明态度。

b2-038-s010.gloss: 哈里森什么都想到了，唯独没想到天气。
b2-038-s010.whyLearn: had thought 表过去的过去，except 引出唯一遗漏项；换成 anything 即变否定。

b2-039-s002.skeleton: the patient asked for a bedside telephone
b2-039-s002.gloss: 第二天病人要了一部床边电话。
b2-039-s002.whyLearn: ask for 是索要某物的固定搭配；The following day 可换成 The next day，结构不变。

modifiers.text: if Mr Gilbert's operation had been successful
and the doctor told him that it had been

b2-039-s005.gloss: 他问吉尔伯特先生手术是否成功，医生说是。
b2-039-s005.whyLearn: if 引出间接疑问句要用陈述语序；答语 that it had been 后省略了 successful。

modifiers.text: if he was a relative of the patient

b2-039-s007.gloss: 米林顿医生接着问来电者是否为病人亲属。
b2-039-s007.whyLearn: ask sb if... 是转述一般疑问句的标准句型，从句用陈述语序；a relative of 用 of 表所属。

b2-039-s008.gloss: 病人回答说自己就是约翰·吉尔伯特。
b2-039-s008.whyLearn: 引语用一般现在时自报身份，the patient answered 用过去时插在中间，引号逗号要成对。

b2-040-s001.skeleton: the hostess asked me to sit
b2-040-s001.gloss: 上周宴会上女主人安排我坐在伦博尔德太太旁边。
b2-040-s001.whyLearn: ask sb to do sth 是请求的固定句型；Last week 与 at a dinner-party 交代时间场合。

b2-040-s002.skeleton: Mrs Rumbold was a large, unsmiling lady
b2-040-s002.gloss: 伦博尔德太太身材高大不苟言笑，穿着紧身黑裙。
b2-040-s002.whyLearn: 两个形容词并列修饰 lady，逗号分隔；in a tight black dress 用介词短语补充衣着。

b2-040-s003.skeleton: She did not even look up

modifiers.text: when I took my seat beside her

b2-040-s003.gloss: 我在她旁边坐下时，她连头都没抬。
b2-040-s003.whyLearn: did not 后接动词原形，even 放在实义动词前加强否定；when 从句与主句同用过去时。

b2-040-s004.skeleton: Her eyes were fixed on her plate

modifiers.text: and in a short time, she was busy eating

b2-040-s004.gloss: 她两眼盯着盘子，不一会儿就忙着吃了起来。
b2-040-s004.whyLearn: be fixed on 用被动表状态，Her 与 her 都是形容词性物主代词；busy doing 表忙于做某事。

b2-040-s006.gloss: 我说新戏马上要在环球剧院上演。
b2-040-s006.whyLearn: 现在进行时 is coming 表即将发生；转述动词 I said 用过去时，注意引号与逗号的书写位置。

b2-040-s009.skeleton: Will you be spending your holidays
b2-040-s009.gloss: 问对方今年是否去国外度假。
b2-040-s009.whyLearn: will be doing 是将来进行时，问句把 will 提前；abroad 是副词，前面不加 to。

b2-040-s012.gloss: 问对方是否打算留在英格兰。
b2-040-s012.whyLearn: 与上句同一句型，只换地点状语；stay in 后接地点，可整套替换操练。

b2-041-s003.skeleton: You needn't be so rude about it

modifiers.text: as she looked at herself in the mirror

b2-041-s003.gloss: 妻子照镜子时说我不必对此这么无礼。
b2-041-s003.whyLearn: needn't 是情态动词否定，后接动词原形；as 从句用过去时，反身代词 herself 指自己。

modifiers.text: on one of those modern chairs with holes in it

b2-041-s004.gloss: 我坐到一把带洞的现代椅子上等着。
b2-041-s004.whyLearn: sat 与 waited 用 and 并列共享主语；one of 后接复数名词，with holes in it 后置修饰。

b2-041-s005.skeleton: We had been in the hat shop

modifiers.text: and my wife was still in front of the mirror.'

b2-041-s005.gloss: 我们在帽店待了半小时，妻子还站在镜子前。
b2-041-s005.whyLearn: had been 与 for half an hour 连用表持续时长；and 连接两个分句，时态由完成转过去。

b2-041-s007.gloss: 话一出口，我几乎立刻就后悔了。
b2-041-s007.whyLearn: regret doing 表后悔做过某事，不能用 regret to do；at once 意为立刻。

b2-003-s002.gloss: 去年夏天我去了一趟意大利。
b2-003-s002.whyLearn: 短短一句教你把过去时间状语放句首再用一般过去时，写游记开头直接可用。

b2-003-s003.gloss: 我参观了博物馆，还坐在公园里。
b2-003-s003.whyLearn: 一个 and 并起两个过去动作，主语只出现一次，是叙事里最省力的并列写法。

b2-003-s004.skeleton: A friendly waiter taught me a few words of Italian.
b2-003-s004.gloss: 一位友好的服务员教了我几个意大利语词。
b2-003-s004.whyLearn: teach 后接双宾语，间宾 me 在前、直宾在后，不用 to 或 for，句型值得记牢。

b2-003-s005.whyLearn: lend 的过去式是 lent，与 teach 一样接双宾语，方向正好相反：借出给我。

modifiers.text: but I did not understand a word.

b2-003-s006.gloss: 我读了几行，却一个字也没看懂。
b2-003-s006.whyLearn: 同一句里 a few 表肯定、not a word 用否定加强语气，两种数量表达对比很典型。

modifiers.text: but I did not send any cards to my friends.

b2-003-s008.gloss: 假期过得很快，我没给朋友寄明信片。
b2-003-s008.whyLearn: 否定句里用 any 而不是 some，send sth to sb 的介词位置也一并练到。

b2-003-s009.gloss: 最后一天我做了个重大决定。
b2-003-s009.whyLearn: 时间状语放句首、主语紧跟其后不加逗号，这种前置位置在叙事文中很常见。

b2-003-s010.gloss: 我起得很早，买了三十七张明信片。
b2-003-s010.whyLearn: get up 的过去式是 got up，再与 bought 并列，两个过去动作共用同一个主语。

b2-003-s011.skeleton: I spent the whole day in my room

modifiers.text: but I did not write a single card

b2-003-s011.gloss: 我在房里待了一整天，却一张没写。
b2-003-s011.whyLearn: the whole day 与 not a single card 一正一反相互对照，反讽效果靠数量词撑起来。

b2-004-s001.skeleton: I have just received a letter
b2-004-s001.gloss: 我刚收到哥哥蒂姆的一封信。
b2-004-s001.whyLearn: 现在完成时配 just 表示刚发生，人名 Tim 直接同位补充 brother，不必另起一句。

b2-004-s003.gloss: 他在那里已经待了六个月。
b2-004-s003.whyLearn: 现在完成时加 for 加时间段，表示从过去持续到现在，不能用一般过去时替换。

b2-004-s005.skeleton: He is working for a big firm

modifiers.text: and he has already visited a great number of different places in Australia.

b2-004-s005.gloss: 他在一家大公司工作，已游遍澳洲许多地方。
b2-004-s005.whyLearn: 一句里现在进行时讲眼下、现在完成时讲已完成的经历，两种时态分工一目了然。

b2-004-s006.skeleton: He has just bought an Australian car

modifiers.text: and has gone to Alice Springs

b2-004-s006.gloss: 他刚买了辆澳洲车，去了艾利斯斯普林斯。
b2-004-s006.whyLearn: 后一个分句承前省略主语 he，再用同位语给地名加上说明，是典型的紧凑写法。

b2-004-s008.whyLearn: will 加动词原形讲下一步行程，From there 承接上文地点，叙事推进很自然。

b2-005-s001.skeleton: Mr James Scott has a garage in Silbury

modifiers.text: and now he has just bought another garage in Pinhurst.

b2-005-s001.gloss: 斯科特先生在锡尔伯里已有车库，又买一个。
b2-005-s001.whyLearn: has 表拥有、has bought 表已完成，同为 has 却功能不同，正好对比着记。

b2-005-s002.skeleton: Pinhurst is only five miles from Silbury

modifiers.text: but Mr Scott cannot get a telephone for his new garage,
so he has just bought twelve pigeons.

b2-005-s002.gloss: 平赫斯特离锡尔伯里仅五英里，他只好买鸽子。
b2-005-s002.whyLearn: but 转折接 so 结果，三层因果串成一句，理清连词层次就抓住了长句脉络。

b3-019-s012.skeleton: She drew &1000 from her bank and followed the kidnapper's instructions.
b3-019-s012.gloss: 她从银行取出一千英镑，按绑匪指示行事。
b3-019-s012.whyLearn: 并列谓语 drew 与 followed 顺接两个动作，draw money from the bank 是高频搭配。

b3-019-s013.skeleton: the box had disappeared but Mrs Ramsay was sure that the kidnapper would keep his word

modifiers.text: that the kidnapper would keep his word

b3-019-s013.gloss: 次晨盒子不见了，但拉姆齐太太确信绑匪会守信。
b3-019-s013.whyLearn: but 连接两个并列分句，that 从句内嵌过去将来时，三种时态同句对照。

b3-019-s014.skeleton: Rastus arrived punctually at seven o'clock that evening
b3-019-s014.gloss: 果然，拉斯塔斯当晚七点准时到达。
b3-019-s014.whyLearn: Sure enough 独立开头表果然，arrive punctually at 搭配可直接套用。

modifiers.text: for he drank half a bottle of milk

b3-019-s015.gloss: 他气色不错，只是很渴，因为他喝了半瓶牛奶。
b3-019-s015.whyLearn: though 让步、for 表原因，两种从句连用，可体会 for 不能置于句首。

modifiers.text: when Mrs Ramsay told them what she haddone

b3-019-s016.gloss: 拉姆齐太太说出实情后，警方大为震惊。
b3-019-s016.whyLearn: be astounded 被动式加 when 时间从句，从句里再套 what 宾语从句。

modifiers.text: that Rastus was very dear to her

b3-019-s017.gloss: 她解释说拉斯塔斯对她非常珍贵。
b3-019-s017.whyLearn: explain 后接 that 宾语从句，be dear to sb 表对某人珍贵，一句两点。

b3-019-s018.skeleton: he was dear in more ways than one!
b3-019-s018.gloss: 就她付的钱而言，他贵得不止一个层面。
b3-019-s018.whyLearn: Considering 分词作状语表考虑到，dear in more ways than one 语带双关。

b3-020-s001.skeleton: Lord Northcliffe offered a prize of &1000 to the first man
b3-020-s001.gloss: 1908年诺思克利夫勋爵悬赏千镑寻第一人。
b3-020-s001.whyLearn: 时间、奖品、对象全用介词短语后置排列，offer sth to sb 结构清晰。

modifiers.text: before the first attempt was made

b3-020-s002.gloss: 一年多后，才有人第一次尝试。
b3-020-s002.whyLearn: before 从句用被动 was made，主语是 attempt，可见中英主被动视角差异。

b3-020-s003.skeleton: Hubert Latham took off from the French coast in his plane the 'Antoinette IV'
b3-020-s003.gloss: 1909年7月19日清晨，拉瑟姆从法国海岸起飞。
b3-020-s003.whyLearn: 时间地点多个介词短语层层前铺，同位语补出飞机名，长句排序范例。

b3-020-s004.skeleton: Hehad travelled only seven miles across the Channel

modifiers.text: when his engine failed and he was forced to land on the sea

b3-020-s004.gloss: 他刚飞越海峡七英里，引擎失灵被迫降落海面。
b3-020-s004.whyLearn: when 从句内并列被动 be forced to do，体会刚…就…的紧凑叙述。

modifiers.text: until Latham was picked up by a ship

b3-020-s005.gloss: 飞机漂在海上，直到拉瑟姆被船救起。
b3-020-s005.whyLearn: until 从句划出持续动作的终点，被动式由 by 点明施动者。

b3-020-s006.skeleton: Louis Bleriot arrived near Calais with a plane called 'No.XI'
b3-020-s006.gloss: 两天后布莱里奥带飞机抵达加来附近。
b3-020-s006.whyLearn: called 过去分词作后置定语修饰 plane，比定语从句更简洁紧凑。

b3-020-s007.skeleton: Bleriot had been making planes since 1905 and this was his latest model
b3-020-s007.gloss: 他从1905年起造飞机，这是最新机型。
b3-020-s007.whyLearn: 过去完成进行时表持续动作，与后半一般过去时构成时间层次对照。

b3-020-s008.skeleton: he had completed a successful overland flight

modifiers.text: during which he covered twenty-six miles

b3-020-s008.gloss: 一周前他完成陆上飞行，航程二十六英里。
b3-020-s008.whyLearn: during which 引出介词加 which 定语从句指代 flight，衔接自然实用。

b3-020-s009.skeleton: Latham, however did not give up easily
b3-020-s009.gloss: 拉瑟姆却没有轻易放弃。
b3-020-s009.whyLearn: however 插在主语后表转折，顺带注意此处逗号省略的非常规写法。

b1-065-s015.skeleton: Let me see your driving-license and your insurance certificate.

modifiers.text: your driving-license and your insurance certificate

b1-065-s015.gloss: 警察要求查看驾照和保险单。
b1-065-s015.whyLearn: 祈使句 Let me see... 是提出要求的高频句型，宾语由两个 your 所有格名词并列，可学并列成分的排列。

b1-065-s016.skeleton: I won't charge you this time.
b1-065-s016.gloss: 警察说这次就不罚款了。
b1-065-s016.whyLearn: won't 表说话人的决定，charge sb 是“向某人收费／罚款”的固定搭配，this time 表范围限定。

b1-065-s020.gloss: 安说早就叫哈里开慢点。
b1-065-s020.whyLearn: tell sb to do sth 是转述提醒的经典句型，to drive slowly 作宾语补足语，过去时说明话早已说过。

b1-065-s021.skeleton: You always tell me to drive slowly
b1-065-s021.gloss: 哈里说安总叫他开慢点。
b1-065-s021.whyLearn: always 与一般现在时连用表示反复出现的情形，tell sb to do 的宾语和不定式位置固定，适合整句模仿。

b1-065-s022.gloss: 安叮嘱哈里下次要听她的劝。
b1-065-s022.whyLearn: had better do 是提建议的常用说法，肯定式后接动词原形；my advice 用所有格表达“我的建议”。

b1-066-s004.skeleton: My wife wants to go to Egypt.
b1-066-s004.whyLearn: want to do sth 是表达意愿最基本的句型，to go to Egypt 整体作宾语，My 用所有格点明关系。

b1-066-s005.skeleton: I'd like to go there, too.
b1-066-s005.whyLearn: would like to do 是委婉表达“想要”的礼貌说法，比 want 更客气，too 放句末表示“也”。

b1-066-s007.skeleton: Will you travel by sea or by air?
b1-066-s007.gloss: 罗伊问对方坐船还是坐飞机。
b1-066-s007.whyLearn: by + 交通工具表示出行方式，搭配 or 构成选择疑问句，是询问出行安排的实用句型。

b1-066-s008.gloss: 哈里说他们可能坐船去。
b1-066-s008.whyLearn: may 表可能性而非许可，语气比 will 弱；by sea 与 by air 相对，可成对记忆交通方式表达。

b1-066-s010.skeleton: It may be cheaper, but it takes a long time.
b1-066-s010.gloss: 坐船可能更便宜，但很费时间。
b1-066-s010.whyLearn: but 连接两个并列分句表示取舍，take a long time 是描述耗时的固定说法，may be 表推测。

b1-066-s011.skeleton: I'm sure you will enjoy yourselves.
b1-066-s011.gloss: 罗伊确信他们会玩得开心。
b1-066-s011.whyLearn: be sure 后接完整从句说明确信的内容，enjoy oneself 是“玩得开心”的固定搭配，注意反身代词。

b1-066-s014.skeleton: My wife always worries too much.
b1-066-s014.whyLearn: always 与一般现在时连用表习惯性动作，too much 作程度状语修饰 worry，位置在句末。

b1-066-s018.skeleton: We have this problem every year.
b1-066-s018.gloss: 我们每年都遇到这个问题。
b1-066-s018.whyLearn: 一般现在时配合 every year 表达反复出现的常态，have this problem 是谈论困扰的简洁搭配。

b1-066-s019.skeleton: we stay at home and look after everything!
b1-066-s019.gloss: 结果我们留在家里照看一切。
b1-066-s019.whyLearn: 两个动词短语用 and 并列共用一个主语，in the end 引出最终结果，look after 是常用短语动词。

b1-067-s003.skeleton: Are you going to make another?
b1-067-s003.gloss: 记者问对方是否要再拍一部。
b1-067-s003.whyLearn: be going to do 谈计划中的将来动作，another 单独使用代替 another film，可学代词式省略。

b1-067-s012.skeleton: Miss Karen Marsh arrived at London Airport today.
b1-067-s012.gloss: 卡伦·马什小姐今天抵达伦敦机场。
b1-067-s012.whyLearn: arrive at 接具体地点小地点，today 置句末，是新闻报道叙述已发生事件的典型语序。

b2-093-s004.skeleton: a site had to be found for it and a pedestal had to be built

modifiers.text: Before it could be transported to the United States
and a pedestal had to be built

b2-093-s004.gloss: 自由女神像运美前，须先选址并建基座。
b2-093-s004.whyLearn: Before 从句先交代前提，主句两个 had to be 并列，可学被动加情态的搭配。

b2-093-s005.skeleton: The site chosen was an island

modifiers.text: at the entrance of New York Harbour

b2-093-s005.gloss: 所选地点是纽约港入口处的一座小岛。
b2-093-s005.whyLearn: 主干只是主系表，chosen 作后置定语，at 短语说明位置，句短但层次清楚。

b2-093-s006.skeleton: a statue which was 151 feet tall, had been erected in Paris
b2-093-s006.gloss: 1884年前，151英尺高的雕像已在巴黎立起。
b2-093-s006.whyLearn: by 加过去时间配过去完成时，定语从句插在主语后把主干切开，很典型。

b2-093-s008.skeleton: the statue had been put together again and it was officially presented to the American people by Bartholdi

modifiers.text: and it was officially presented to the American people by Bartholdi

b2-093-s008.gloss: 1886年10月底雕像重组，由巴托尔迪赠予美国。
b2-093-s008.whyLearn: 两个并列被动句，一个过去完成时一个一般过去时，时间层次对比很清楚。

b2-093-s009.skeleton: the great monument has been a symbol of liberty for the millions of people who have passed through New York Harbour to make their homes in America

modifiers.text: for the millions of people who have passed through New York Harbour to make their homes in America
who have passed through New York Harbour to make their homes in America
to make their homes in America

b2-093-s009.gloss: 此后纪念碑成为自由的象征，见证无数人来美安家。
b2-093-s009.whyLearn: 现在完成时加 ever since，再套 who 定语从句和 to do 目的状语，结构完整。

modifiers.text: that children can be instructed in swimming at a very early age

b2-094-s001.gloss: 实验证明幼儿很小就能学游泳。
b2-094-s001.whyLearn: prove 后接 that 宾语从句，从句用 can be done 的情态被动式，值得仿写。

b2-094-s004.skeleton: A game that is very popular with these young swimmers is the underwater tricycle race

modifiers.text: that is very popular with these young swimmers

b2-094-s004.gloss: 这些小学员最爱的项目是水下三轮车赛。
b2-094-s004.whyLearn: be popular with 是本课搭配，定语从句隔开主语和 is，读时先抓系动词。

modifiers.text: on the floor of the pool

b2-094-s005.gloss: 三轮车被排放在池底水下七英尺处。
b2-094-s005.whyLearn: are lined up 是现在时被动，地点短语由池底逐层缩小到水下七英尺。

b2-094-s006.skeleton: The children compete against each other

modifiers.text: to reach the other end of the pool

b2-094-s006.gloss: 孩子们互相比赛，看谁先到泳池另一端。
b2-094-s006.whyLearn: compete against 是固定搭配，to reach 作目的状语，句子短小但很完整。

modifiers.text: but most of them prefer to push or drag them

b2-094-s007.gloss: 许多人蹬三轮车，多数人却宁可推着或拖着。
b2-094-s007.whyLearn: but 连接两个分句，prefer to do 接动词原形，them 回指前面的三轮车。

b2-094-s008.skeleton: Some children can cover the whole length of the pool

modifiers.text: without coming up for breath even once
coming up for breath even once

b2-094-s008.gloss: 有些孩子能一口气游完整个泳池。
b2-094-s008.whyLearn: can 加动词原形表能力，without doing 说清完成动作的条件，很实用。

modifiers.text: Whether they will ever become future Olympic champions

b2-094-s009.gloss: 他们能否成为未来的奥运冠军，只有时间知道。
b2-094-s009.whyLearn: whether 从句提到句首，主句只剩主谓，这种悬置结构在英语里很常见。

b2-094-s010.skeleton: they should encourage those among us

modifiers.text: who cannot swim five yards before they are gasping for air
before they are gasping for air

b2-094-s010.gloss: 他们该鼓励我们中那些游几码就喘不上气的人。
b2-094-s010.whyLearn: those among us 后接 who 从句，从句里再套 before 从句，练多层断句。

modifiers.text: and his clothes were in a frightful state

b2-095-s002.gloss: 他脸色苍白，衣服也破得不成样子。
b2-095-s002.whyLearn: look 作系动词接形容词 pale，and 并列第二个分句，是最基本的描写句。

b2-095-s005.skeleton: How did your clothes get into such a mess
b2-095-s005.gloss: 你的衣服怎么弄成这么一团糟？
b2-095-s005.whyLearn: How 引导的特殊疑问句，get into a mess 是口语说弄脏弄乱的常用说法。

b2-095-s006.gloss: 大使干巴巴地回答：“灭火器，亲爱的。”
b2-095-s006.whyLearn: 引语提前、主语后置的叙述句，answered 后接头衔而非代词，注意语序。

b1-053-s006.whyLearn: 祈使句以动词原形开头，tell sb to do sth 后面接宾格 her 和不定式，at once 说明时间很急。

b1-053-s008.gloss: 老板应了一声，叫出辛普森小姐。
b1-053-s008.whyLearn: 口语短句省略了谓语，说话人标记 The Boss: 和逗号隔开的呼语 Miss Simpson 都不是句子成分。

b1-053-s013.gloss: 你打这个词只写了一个 L。
b1-053-s013.whyLearn: 现在完成时 You've typed 强调动作已完成并留下结果，with 短语补充说明错在哪里。

b1-053-s015.whyLearn: want sb to do sth 是高频结构，不定式作宾补，sb 用宾格 you，不能写成 you to type 之外的从句。

b1-053-s016.whyLearn: I'll 是 I will 的缩写表示将来，do that 代替前面整件事，避免重复动词。

b1-053-s018.gloss: 老板说这里有个小礼物给你。
b1-053-s018.whyLearn: here's 是 here is 的倒装口语形式，a little 后接单数名词，for you 说明礼物给谁。

b1-053-s021.whyLearn: hope 后接省略 that 的宾语从句，从句用 will 表将来，人称代词按语境替换即可。

b1-054-s002.gloss: 女士说很喜欢这个颜色。
b1-054-s002.whyLearn: like 表喜好是静态动词，用一般现在时，very much 放句尾修饰动词，不能插在动词和宾语之间。

modifiers.text: but it's too small for me

b1-054-s003.gloss: 裙子好看，但对她来说太小。
b1-054-s003.whyLearn: but 连接两个并列分句表转折，后一分句主语 it 不能省，too...for sb 表示对某人来说太怎样。

b1-054-s007.whyLearn: be in fashion 是表示流行的固定搭配，介词短语作表语，主语换成别的衣物句子照样成立。

b1-054-s011.whyLearn: 比较级 smaller 加 than 引出比较对象，one 代替前面的 dress，避免重复名词。

b1-054-s013.whyLearn: doesn't 构成一般现在时否定，suit sb 表示合身、适合，at all 放句尾加强否定语气。

modifiers.text: but it must be my size

b1-054-s016.gloss: 我想要那样的裙子，但必须是我的尺码。
b1-054-s016.whyLearn: like 作介词引出参照物而非动词，but 连接两个分句，must be 表必要，my size 用物主代词限定名词。

b1-054-s018.gloss: 这是店里最大的一条裙子。
b1-054-s018.whyLearn: 最高级 largest 前必须加 the，in the shop 限定比较范围，换掉范围就成了另一句。

b1-055-s001.gloss: 贝蒂问简要不要煮点咖啡。
b1-055-s001.whyLearn: Shall I...? 用于主动提议做事，some 用在期待对方答应的提议里，Jane 是句尾呼语。

b1-055-s002.whyLearn: That's a good idea 是回应对方提议的固定说法，Betty 作呼语放句尾并用逗号隔开。

b3-045-s031.skeleton: The town itself received so much attention

modifiers.text: that almost every one of the inhabitants was affected to a greater or less degree

b3-045-s031.gloss: 小镇备受关注，居民几乎都受到影响。
b3-045-s031.whyLearn: so...that 引出结果状语从句，that 不可省；was affected 是被动，说“受影响”比 affect 更常见。

b3-046-s002.skeleton: No one can plead ignorance of a subject any longer

modifiers.text: for there are countless do-it-yourself publications

b3-046-s002.gloss: 如今谁也不能再说自己对某事一无所知。
b3-046-s002.whyLearn: for 作并列连词表原因，比 because 书面；any longer 与否定连用表“不再”，可多套用。

modifiers.text: When lights fuse, furniture gets rickety, pipes get clogged, or vacuum cleaners fail to operate
that their husbands will somehow put things right

b3-046-s010.gloss: 家里东西一出毛病，妻子就认定丈夫能修好。
b3-046-s010.whyLearn: 四个小句用 when 统起，写“一……就……”的清单很省力；assume that 后接将来时，put things right 很地道。

b3-046-s011.skeleton: The worst thing about the do-it-yourself game is

modifiers.text: that sometimes husbands live under the delusion that they can do anything
even when they have been repeatedly proved wrong

b3-046-s011.gloss: 自己动手最大的问题是丈夫总自以为什么都会。
b3-046-s011.whyLearn: The worst thing is that... 是评价句式万能开头；delusion 后再套 that 从句，可见宾语从句能嵌套。

b3-046-s012.skeleton: It is a question of pride
b3-046-s012.gloss: 这与其说是别的，不如说是面子问题。
b3-046-s012.whyLearn: as much as anything else 是英式口语里常见的补充说明，放在句尾就不把话说死；换个名词即可评价别的事。

b3-046-s017.skeleton: it only needed a minor adjustment

modifiers.text: As far as I could see
a turn of a screw here, a little tightening up there, a drop of oil

b3-046-s017.gloss: 在我看来，只需几处小调整就能修好。
b3-046-s017.whyLearn: As far as I could see 是限定“在我看来”的现成引语；冒号后用三个 a+名词短语罗列小动作，可把任意修理清单这样铺开。

modifiers.text: that the machine still refusedto work after I had reassembled it
for the simple reason that I was left with several curiously shaped bits of metal
which did not seem to fit anywhere

b3-046-s024.gloss: 重装后机器仍不转，我毫不意外。
b3-046-s024.whyLearn: be surprised to find that... 串起不定式与宾语从句；for the simple reason that 收原因

modifiers.text: either I would have to buy a new mower or let the grass grow
When my wife nagged me to do something about it

b3-046-s027.gloss: 妻子催我修，我说要么买新机要么任草长。
b3-046-s027.whyLearn: tell sb. that 的宾语从句里嵌 either...or... 并列两个方案，既练从句又练并列，谈判、抱怨都用得上。

modifiers.text: which I have promised to repair

b3-046-s029.gloss: 深草里埋着一台我答应要修的割草机。
b3-046-s029.whyLearn: 过去分词 buried 摆在句首作状语，画面感强；there be 主句后接定语从句，是描写场景的常用组合。

b3-047-s010.skeleton: is driven by a turbine engine which is propelled by liquid mud pumped into it from the surface

modifiers.text: which is being tested at Leona Valley Ranch in Texas
which is propelled by liquid mud
pumped into it from the surface

b3-047-s010.gloss: 新钻机由泥浆推动的涡轮机驱动。
b3-047-s010.whyLearn: 一句话里嵌两个被动定语从句，还带过去分词短语，是科技说明文压缩信息的典型写法，学会就能读懂长句。

b3-047-s016.skeleton: scientists will have to overcome a number of problems

modifiers.text: Before it is possible to drill this deep hole

b3-047-s016.gloss: 钻这么深的井前，科学家得先解决许多问题。
b3-047-s016.whyLearn: Before 从句用 it is possible to do，主句用 will have to；写计划或难点照这个骨架来。

b3-047-s028.skeleton: Great care will therefore have to be taken

modifiers.text: to keep the platform steady and make it strong enough to withstand hurricanes

b3-047-s028.gloss: 因此必须格外小心，保持平台稳固抗飓风。
b3-047-s028.whyLearn: will have to be taken 是“将来必须被……”的完整被动式，后接不定式表目的。

b3-047-s029.skeleton: scientists will not only learn a great deal about the earth

modifiers.text: not only learn a great deal about the earth, but possibly about the nature of the universe itself

b3-047-s029.gloss: 若项目成功，科学家将大大了解地球乃至宇宙。
b3-047-s029.whyLearn: if 从句用现在时、主句用将来时，是条件句的基本配合；not only 与 but 并列两个 about 短语，可见并列可以省掉重复动词。

b3-048-s001.gloss: 在这个旅游发达的世界，仍有成千上万的地方。
b3-048-s001.whyLearn: there are 前加 In this...world 的地点状语，是开启介绍性段落的稳妥开头；thousands of 表示笼统的大量。

b3-048-s003.skeleton: people who are cut off not only from foreign tourists, but even from their own countrymen can be hostile to travellers

modifiers.text: who are cut off not only from foreign tourists, but even from their own countrymen
not only from foreign tourists, but even from their own countrymen

b3-048-s003.gloss: 与外界隔绝的人可能对旅行者怀有敌意。
b3-048-s003.whyLearn: can be 表“有时会”，比 are 缓和；who 从句里又套 not only...but even...，定语从句能装并列。

modifiers.text: for they were not only of great architectural interest, but contained alarge number of beautifully preserved frescoes as well

b3-048-s006.gloss: 这些因建筑价值和精美壁画吸引众多游客。
b3-048-s006.whyLearn: for 引出原因分句，not only...but...as well 把两个理由并列整齐，of great interest 更书面。

b2-032-s003.skeleton: A detective recently watched a well-dressed woman

modifiers.text: who always went into a large store on Monday mornings

b2-032-s003.gloss: 侦探近来盯着一位常逛大商店的女士。
b2-032-s003.whyLearn: who 从句紧跟 woman 后修饰人，是定语从句最典型的位置，go into 的搭配也值得记。

b2-032-s004.skeleton: there were fewer people in the shop than usual

modifiers.text: so it was easier for the detective to watch her

b2-032-s004.gloss: 周一店里人少，侦探更容易盯住她。
b2-032-s004.whyLearn: there be 表存在、fewer...than usual 表比较，再加 when 从句与 so 结果句。

b2-032-s005.gloss: 女士先买了几件小物品。
b2-032-s005.whyLearn: 句子只有主谓宾，a few 后接可数名词复数表“有几个”，可与 few（几乎没有）对照记忆。

b2-032-s006.skeleton: she chose one of the most expensive dresses in the shop and handed it to an assistant

modifiers.text: who wrapped it up for her as quickly as possible

b2-032-s006.gloss: 她挑了最贵的裙子之一，让店员包好。
b2-032-s006.whyLearn: one of the + 最高级 + 复数表“最……之一”，and 连接两个连续动作，who 从句补充店员做了什么。

b2-032-s007.skeleton: the woman simply took the parcel and walked out of the shop
b2-032-s007.gloss: 她拿起包裹，没付钱就走出了商店。
b2-032-s007.whyLearn: without + doing 表“没有做某事”，比否定从句简洁；两个过去动作由 and 串起，是叙事句的基本骨架。

b2-032-s009.skeleton: The girl' gave' her mother a free dress
b2-032-s009.gloss: 女孩每周白送母亲一条裙子。
b2-032-s009.whyLearn: give sb sth 的双宾语顺序在本句一目了然，once a week 表频率；原句撇号错位，可顺带复习所有格写法。

modifiers.text: before the girl was able to explain what had happened to her

b2-033-s001.gloss: 过了近一周，女孩才能说出自己的遭遇。
b2-033-s001.whyLearn: before 在此译“才”；be able to do 后接 what 从句作宾语，had happened 用过去完成时点明更早发生。

b2-033-s002.skeleton: she set out from the coast in a small boat and was caught in a storm
b2-033-s002.gloss: 一天下午她乘小船出海，遇上了风暴。
b2-033-s002.whyLearn: 主动的 set out 与被动的 was caught 由 and 并列，一句说清出发和遭遇；三个介词短语分别表起点、工具和处境。

b2-033-s003.skeleton: the boat struck a rock and the girl jumped into the sea
b2-033-s003.gloss: 傍晚小船触礁，女孩跳进海里。
b2-033-s003.whyLearn: 两个不同主语的分句用 and 并列，叙事一步推进；Towards evening 表“临近傍晚”，比 in the evening 更含糊。

modifiers.text: after spending the whole night in the water

b2-033-s004.gloss: 她在水里泡了一整夜才游到岸边。
b2-033-s004.whyLearn: after + doing 省略主语，比 after she spent 更紧凑，swam to the shore 搭配干净。

b2-033-s005.skeleton: she covered a distance of eight miles
b2-033-s005.gloss: 那段时间她游了八英里。
b2-033-s005.whyLearn: a distance of + 数量是表达“距离多少”的标准说法，cover 在此意为“走过、游过”，可整块记住。

b2-033-s006.gloss: 第二天清早，她看见前方有光。
b2-033-s006.whyLearn: Early next morning 用名词短语直接作时间状语，无需介词；saw a light ahead 是“看见前方有光”的地道说法。

b2-033-s008.skeleton: the girl struggled up the cliff towards the light
b2-033-s008.gloss: 一上岸，女孩就朝见过的灯光攀崖而上。
b2-033-s008.whyLearn: On + doing 表“一……就”，比从句紧凑；句尾省略关系词的定语从句 she had seen 用过去完成时，点明先看到后攀爬。

b2-034-s001.gloss: 泰德·罗宾逊整整一周都在担心。
b2-034-s001.whyLearn: has been worried 是现在完成时的被动形式，强调从过去持续到现在的状态，all the week 点明持续整周。

b2-034-s002.gloss: 上周二，他收到当地警方的一封信。
b2-034-s002.whyLearn: Last Tuesday 锁定一般过去时，from the local police 后置说明来源。

b2-034-s003.gloss: 信里通知他去一趟警局。
b2-034-s003.whyLearn: be asked to do 是“被要求做某事”的固定被动句式；call at 后接地点，要和 call on sb 区分开。

b4-012-s002.gloss: 这一点由外在的壮观场面得到补偿。
b4-012-s002.whyLearn: be compensated for 后用 by 引出补偿来源，可练抽象主语的被动表达。

b4-012-s003.skeleton: Such impressiveness usually takes the form
b4-012-s003.gloss: 这种壮观通常表现为宏大的写实主义。
b4-012-s003.whyLearn: take the form of 是抽象事物具体化的高频搭配，主干加介词短语即可成句。

modifiers.text: to make the setting, the costumes, all of the surface details correct

b4-012-s004.gloss: 为让布景、服装等表面细节准确，不惜工本。
b4-012-s004.whyLearn: Nothing is spared to do 是地道被动表达，宾语后形容词 correct 作补足说明。

modifiers.text: and the absurdities and trivialities of the plots

b4-012-s005.gloss: 这些努力有助于掩盖人物塑造的空洞与情节的荒谬琐碎。
b4-012-s005.whyLearn: help to do 后接两个并列宾语，展示不定式与并列结构如何承载多重信息。

b4-012-s006.skeleton: they are empty of humanity, credibility, and motivation

modifiers.text: The houses look like houses, the streets look like streets; the people look and talk like people; but

b4-012-s006.gloss: 外表处处逼真，内里却无人性、可信度与动机。
b4-012-s006.whyLearn: 四个并列分句先扬后抑，用 but 转折戳破虚假，可学排比与转折的节奏。

b4-012-s007.skeleton: the disgraceful censorship code is an important factor

modifiers.text: in predetermining the content of these pictures

b4-012-s007.gloss: 不言而喻，可耻的审查法规预先决定了影片内容。
b4-012-s007.whyLearn: 句首插入语 Needless to say 加介词 in 后动名词，可同时练插入与动名词。

b4-012-s008.skeleton: the code does not disturb the profits

modifiers.text: nor the entertainment value of the films
it merely helps to prevent them from being credible

b4-012-s008.gloss: 法规不影响利润和娱乐性，只让影片不可信。
b4-012-s008.whyLearn: nor 承接否定延伸并列，后句用 prevent sb from doing，可学否定与不定式搭配。

b4-012-s009.skeleton: It isn't too heavy a burden
b4-012-s009.gloss: 这负担对电影业来说并不算太重。
b4-012-s009.whyLearn: too heavy a burden 的语序与 for sb to do 的逻辑主语，是评价句的地道写法。

b4-013-s001.gloss: 牛津已被汽车工业毁掉了。
b4-013-s001.whyLearn: 现在完成时被动 has been ruined 强调结果延续至今，适合描述现状的恶化。

b4-013-s005.skeleton: the marriage of an old seat of learning and tradition with a new and wealthy industry might be expected to produce some interesting children

modifiers.text: of an old seat of learning and tradition with a new and wealthy industry

b4-013-s005.gloss: 理论上，古老学府与新兴工业的结合或能结出硕果。
b4-013-s005.whyLearn: might be expected to do 用推测情态加被动，把预期说得委婉克制，值得模仿。

modifiers.text: that the culture of the university would radiate out and transform the lives of the workers

b4-013-s006.gloss: 人们或曾以为大学文化会向外扩散，改变工人生活。
b4-013-s006.whyLearn: It might have been thought that 是推测性被动句式，让主观判断显得客观含蓄。

b4-014-s001.gloss: 有些老人被对死亡的恐惧所折磨。
b4-014-s001.whyLearn: 被动语态加 by 引出抽象施动者，把情绪写成施加于人的力量，很值得借鉴。

b4-014-s006.skeleton: An individual human existence should be like a river

modifiers.text: small at first, narrowly contained within its banks, and rushing passionately past boulders and over waterfalls
rushing passionately past boulders and over waterfalls

b4-014-s006.gloss: 人生应如河流，先窄小受限，后奔腾越过巨石与瀑布。
b4-014-s006.whyLearn: 以河喻人生，用并列形容词与分词短语层层延展比喻，可学比喻的铺陈写法。

b4-014-s008.skeleton: will not suffer from the fear of death

modifiers.text: who, in old age, can see his life in this way
since the things he cares for will continue

b4-014-s008.gloss: 能这样看待一生的老人不怕死，因其所爱仍在延续。
b4-014-s008.whyLearn: 定语从句把主语与谓语隔开，句末 since 补原因，可练分隔结构与从句衔接。

b4-014-s009.skeleton: the thought of rest will be not unwelcome
b4-014-s009.gloss: 精力衰退、疲惫渐增时，想到安息便不觉不受欢迎。
b4-014-s009.whyLearn: will be not unwelcome 用双重否定弱化语气，委婉表达对休息的接受。

b4-015-s003.skeleton: the bank and its customer owe a large number of obligations to one another

modifiers.text: in addition to that basically simple concept

b4-015-s003.gloss: 除这一基本概念外，银行与客户彼此还负有许多义务。
b4-015-s003.whyLearn: a large number of 修饰可数名词，配合 owe sth to sb 表达双方互负义务。

modifiers.text: that this would hardly be necessary
as the men were already under arrest

b3-040-s016.gloss: 警方讽刺说这没必要，人已被捕
b3-040-s016.whyLearn: point out 后接 that 宾语从句，as 引导原因状语；ironically 一词点明讽刺语气。

modifiers.text: if he might make a telephone call

b3-040-s017.gloss: 一名工人假装认真，请求打电话
b3-040-s017.whyLearn: 句首现在分词表伴随，if 引导间接疑问句，before being done 展示介词后被动 -ing，一句三重结构。

b3-040-s018.skeleton: Permission was granted and a policeman accompanied him
b3-040-s018.gloss: 获准后警察陪他去打电话
b3-040-s018.whyLearn: and 把被动句与主动句并列，was granted 与 accompanied 对照，可学两种语态如何衔接。

b3-041-s002.skeleton: I have always regarded the country

modifiers.text: as something you look at through a train window
you look at through a train window
or something you occasionally visit during the week-end

b3-041-s002.gloss: 城里长大的我，只在车窗里看乡村
b3-041-s002.whyLearn: regard...as 接两个并列 something，各带省略关系词的定语从句，句首独立结构极精炼。

b3-041-s003.skeleton: Most of my friends live in the city

modifiers.text: yet they always go into raptures at the mere mention of the country
at the mere mention of the country

b3-041-s003.gloss: 朋友们住城里却狂赞乡村
b3-041-s003.whyLearn: yet 连接前后对比分句，at the mere mention of 表示一提起就……，是写反差的实用句式。

b3-041-s004.skeleton: only one of them has ever gone to live in the country

modifiers.text: Though they extol the virtues of the peaceful life
and he was back in town within six months

b3-041-s004.gloss: 众人赞乡村，却无人真住下
b3-041-s004.whyLearn: Though 从句先扬后抑，go to live 表目的，末句过去时戳破幻想，落差靠时态切换完成。

modifiers.text: that country life is somehow superior to town life

b3-041-s005.gloss: 他仍幻想乡村生活更优越
b3-041-s005.whyLearn: illusion 后接 that 同位语从句说明内容，superior to 本身含比较义不加 more，两处易错点同句。

modifiers.text: about the friendly people, the clean atmosphere, the closeness to nature and the gentle pace of living

b3-041-s006.gloss: 他总念叨乡村的人与空气
b3-041-s006.whyLearn: be forever doing 表带情绪的反复动作，about 后四个并列名词铺陈细节，pace of living 是介词后 -ing。

modifiers.text: with the first cock crow, the twittering of birds at dawn, the sight of the rising sun glinting on the trees and pastures
glinting on the trees and pastures

b3-041-s007.gloss: 他说清晨乡村景象无可比拟
b3-041-s007.whyLearn: 插入语 he maintains 隔开主谓，被动 can be compared with 引出三个并列意象，末尾分词作后置修饰。

b3-041-s008.skeleton: This idyllic pastoral scene isonly part
b3-041-s008.gloss: 这田园景象只是画面一角
b3-041-s008.whyLearn: part of the picture 是地道比喻，为过度美化的描写降温，短句适合做段落转折的收束。

b3-041-s009.skeleton: My friend fails to mention the long and friendless winter evenings

modifiers.text: to mention the long and friendless winter evenings
which are interrupted only by an occasional visit to the local cinema
by an occasional visit to the local cinema

b3-041-s009.gloss: 朋友没提漫长寂寞的冬夜
b3-041-s009.whyLearn: fail to do 表未做到，which 从句用被动写冬夜单调，破折号同位语补出娱乐匮乏。

b3-041-s011.skeleton: Why people are prepared to tolerate a four hour journey each day for the dubious privilege of living in the country is beyond my ken

modifiers.text: to tolerate a four hour journey each day
for the dubious privilege of living in the country

b3-041-s011.gloss: 我不懂人们为何甘愿每日长途
b3-041-s011.whyLearn: Why 引导的主语从句整体作主语，谓语 is beyond my ken，长主语加系表结构是英语常见的平衡写法。

b3-041-s015.skeleton: They invariably live nearby and are always available

modifiers.text: for an informal chat or an evening's entertainment

b3-041-s015.gloss: 他们住得近，随时可闲聊消遣
b3-041-s015.whyLearn: and 连接两个并列谓语，available for 后接 or 并列名词，一句写出邻里随叫随到的便利。

b3-041-s016.skeleton: Some of my acquaintances in the country come up to town

modifiers.text: to visit the theatre as a special treat

b3-041-s016.gloss: 乡下熟人一年进城看一两回戏
b3-041-s016.whyLearn: Some of 表部分所属，come up to town 后接 to visit 交代目的，as a special treat 点出稀罕

modifiers.text: As the play draws to its close
whether they will ever catch that last train home

b3-041-s018.gloss: 散场时他们担心赶不上末班车
b3-041-s018.whyLearn: As 引导时间状语从句，wonder 后接 whether 间接疑问句加将来时 will catch，紧张感来自末班车。

b3-041-s020.skeleton: The latest exhibitions, films, or plays are only a short bus ride away
b3-041-s020.gloss: 最新展览影剧坐一小段车就到
b3-041-s020.whyLearn: the latest 是最高级作定语，a short bus ride away 用地道名词短语表距离，比 far 具体得多。

modifiers.text: Though Mr Thompson had turned the lights off before he went to bed,

b2-047-s005.gloss: 汤普森先生睡前关了灯，早上灯却亮着。
b2-047-s005.whyLearn: 让步从句放句首，主句只用 they were on 收尾，示范把重信息留到最后的对比写法。

modifiers.text: that he had found five empty whisky bottles which the ghost must have drunk the night before
which the ghost must have drunk the night before

b2-047-s006.gloss: 他说发现了五个空酒瓶，准是鬼夜里喝的。
b2-047-s006.whyLearn: 宾语从句里再套定语从句，用 must have done 推测过去，一句练两层嵌套。

modifiers.text: When I suggested that some villagers must have come in for a free drink,
that some villagers must have come in for a free drink

b2-047-s007.gloss: 我说可能有村民进来白喝一杯，汤普森先生摇头。
b2-047-s007.whyLearn: 时间状语从句内嵌宾语从句，suggest 后接 must have done 表示对过去的推测。

b2-048-s002.skeleton: My dentist had just pulled out one of my teeth and had told me to rest for a while

modifiers.text: and had told me to rest for a while

b2-048-s002.gloss: 牙医刚拔掉我一颗牙，让我休息一会儿。
b2-048-s002.whyLearn: 两个过去完成时靠 and 共用一个 had，顺带练 one of 与 tell sb to do 的搭配。

modifiers.text: but my mouth was full of cotton-wool

b2-048-s003.gloss: 我想说点什么，可满嘴都是药棉。
b2-048-s003.whyLearn: try to do 只能接不定式，but 连接的并列句把转折压得很短，口语里很常见。

modifiers.text: and asked me whether my collection was growing

b2-048-s004.gloss: 他知道我收集鸟蛋，问我藏品是否在增加。
b2-048-s004.whyLearn: 一个 knew 带两个宾语从句，第二个还是间接疑问句，语序不倒装值得记牢。

modifiers.text: and whether I liked my new job in London
whether I liked my new job in London

b2-048-s005.gloss: 他又问我哥哥近况，以及喜不喜欢伦敦的新工作。
b2-048-s005.whyLearn: 两个间接疑问句并列作宾语，how 与 whether 引导时都用陈述语序。

b2-048-s007.skeleton: my tongue was busy searching out the hole
b2-048-s007.gloss: 舌头忙着去找牙齿原来待过的那个洞。
b2-048-s007.whyLearn: be busy doing 接现在分词，后面再用 where 从句定位，动作和位置一句说清。

b2-048-s008.gloss: 我突然很担心，却什么也说不出来。
b2-048-s008.whyLearn: 并列句省略第二个主语，could not 表示当时实在无法做到，简洁又地道。

b2-049-s001.skeleton: a young man in Teheran saved up for years to buy a real bed

modifiers.text: Tired of sleeping on the floor

b2-049-s001.gloss: 德黑兰的年轻人睡地板睡腻了，攒钱买张真床。
b2-049-s001.whyLearn: 形容词短语前置作状语，主干里再塞介词短语和目的不定式，信息层次分明。

b2-049-s004.skeleton: He slept very well for the first two nights

modifiers.text: but on the third night, a storm blew up

b2-049-s004.gloss: 前两晚他睡得很好，可第三晚刮起了风暴。
b2-049-s004.whyLearn: 并列句对比两晚情形，用逗号加时间状语制造节奏，为后面的意外铺路。

b2-049-s005.skeleton: A gust of wind swept the bed off the roof

modifiers.text: and sent it crashing into the courtyard below

b2-049-s005.gloss: 一阵狂风把床从屋顶刮走，摔进了下面的院子。
b2-049-s005.whyLearn: 两个动词共用一个主语，send sth doing 的分词补语写清被刮落的轨迹。

modifiers.text: Although the bed was smashed to pieces,

b2-049-s007.gloss: 床被摔得粉碎，人却奇迹般毫发无伤。
b2-049-s007.whyLearn: 让步从句用被动语态，主句用 be unhurt 表态，前后反差一次到位。

b2-049-s009.skeleton: the man sadly picked up the mattress and carried it into his house

modifiers.text: Glancing at the bits of wood and metal that lay around him
at the bits of wood and metal that lay around him

b2-049-s009.gloss: 他扫了一眼身边的碎木烂铁，抱起床垫走进屋。
b2-049-s009.whyLearn: 现在分词短语开头交代背景，主干并列两个动作，长句也能读得顺。

b2-049-s010.skeleton: he promptly went to sleep again

modifiers.text: After he had put it on the floor,

b2-049-s010.gloss: 他把床垫放到地板上，随后很快又睡着了。
b2-049-s010.whyLearn: 时间从句用过去完成时标明先后，主句 went to sleep 收尾，时态对比清晰。

b2-050-s002.skeleton: I went on an excursion recently

modifiers.text: but my trip took me longer than I expected

b2-050-s002.gloss: 我最近去远足，路上花的时间比预想的长。
b2-050-s002.whyLearn: but 并列加 than 比较从句，示范 go on 与比较结构在口语叙事里的自然搭配。

b2-071-s003.skeleton: the great clock would never have been erected

modifiers.text: If the Houses of Parliament had hot been burned down in 1834

b2-071-s003.gloss: 若无1834年大火，大本钟便不会建成。
b2-071-s003.whyLearn: 虚拟条件句：if 从句用过去完成时，主句用 would have been done 的被动形式。

b2-071-s004.skeleton: Big Ben takes its name from Sir Benjamin Hall

modifiers.text: who was responsible for the making of the clock
when the new Houses of Parliament were being built

b2-071-s004.gloss: 大本钟得名于负责造钟的本杰明·霍尔。
b2-071-s004.whyLearn: 定语从句里再套时间状语从句，were being built 展示过去进行时的被动语态。

b2-071-s005.skeleton: It is not only of immense size

modifiers.text: but is extremely accurate as well

b2-071-s005.gloss: 它体积巨大，走时也极其精准。
b2-071-s005.whyLearn: not only...but...as well 连接两个谓语，后一分句重复 be 动词是固定用法。

b2-071-s006.skeleton: Officials from Greenwich Observatory have the clock checked
b2-071-s006.gloss: 格林尼治天文台官员每天两次校钟。
b2-071-s006.whyLearn: have sth done 表示请人做某事，checked 是过去分词作宾语补足语。

b2-071-s012.skeleton: A painter who had been working on the tower hung a pot of paint

modifiers.text: who had been working on the tower

b2-071-s012.gloss: 油漆工把油漆罐挂在指针上，让钟变慢。
b2-071-s012.whyLearn: who 从句修饰主语，hung 与 slowed 并列，过去完成进行时强调持续动作。

b2-072-s003.skeleton: Bluebird, the car he was driving, had been specially built
b2-072-s003.gloss: 他开的 Bluebird 是专为他打造的。
b2-072-s003.whyLearn: 同位语插在主语之后，had been built 是过去完成时被动，从句省略了关系词。

b2-072-s005.skeleton: he had great difficulty in controlling the car

modifiers.text: Although Campbell reached a speed of over 304 miles per hour
because a tyre burst during the first run

b2-072-s005.gloss: 虽时速超304英里，爆胎却让他难以控车。
b2-072-s005.whyLearn: Although 让步与 because 原因两个从句夹住主句，have difficulty in doing 是高频搭配。

b2-072-s011.skeleton: he was driving a car called Bluebird
b2-072-s011.gloss: 像父亲一样，他开的车叫 Bluebird。
b2-072-s011.whyLearn: 过去进行时描写当时情景，called Bluebird 是分词短语作后置定语。

b2-073-s002.skeleton: A quiet day's fishing, or eight hours in a cinema seeing the same film over and over again, is usually as far as they get

modifiers.text: or eight hours in a cinema seeing the same film over and over again
seeing the same film over and over again

b2-073-s002.gloss: 他们最多不过钓一天鱼或连看几场电影。
b2-073-s002.whyLearn: 长并列主语后接 is usually as far as they get，as far as 表程度的上限。

b2-073-s003.skeleton: They have all been put to shame by a boy

modifiers.text: who, while playing truant, travelled 1600 miles

b2-073-s003.gloss: 逃学的男孩用行动让他们汗颜。
b2-073-s003.whyLearn: 被动语态用 by 引出施动者，定语从句中又嵌入 while 引导的时间状语。

modifiers.text: When he woke up next morning
that the boat had, in the meantime, travelled to Calais

b2-073-s005.gloss: 他醒来发现船已到了加来。
b2-073-s005.whyLearn: 宾语从句用过去完成时表示更早发生，插入语 in the meantime 插在主谓之间。

modifiers.text: 'This is a wonderful place for a picnic,'

b2-074-s004.gloss: 格洛丽亚说这儿是野餐的好地方。
b2-074-s004.whyLearn: 直接引语在前、said + 人名在后，引语里的 is 与 said 时态形成对照。

b2-074-s007.whyLearn: Why don't we + 动词原形是提建议的固定问句，语序与否定形式要记牢。

modifiers.text: When they had all made themselves comfortable

b2-074-s009.gloss: 众人刚安顿好，一个陌生人出现了。
b2-074-s009.whyLearn: 从句用过去完成时表示先发生，主句用一般过去时，时态先后一目了然。

b2-074-s014.gloss: 牌子写着禁止露营，怕你不识字。
b2-074-s014.whyLearn: It says 后可直接引出标牌原文，in case 引导以防万一的状语从句。

b2-075-s009.skeleton: The woman kept as near as she could to the children

modifiers.text: and even tried to get into the case herself

b2-075-s009.gloss: 她尽量靠近孩子，还想钻进行李箱，可箱子太小。
b2-075-s009.whyLearn: as...as she could 表尽力，try to do 接不定式，三个分句由 and、but 并列。

b2-063-s008.skeleton: Geoffrey was a little disappointed by this but he did as his daughter asked

modifiers.text: but he did as his daughter asked

b2-063-s008.gloss: 杰弗里有点失望，但还是照女儿说的做了。
b2-063-s008.whyLearn: but 连接两个过去时小句，did 替代上文动词，a little 修饰形容词。

b2-063-s009.skeleton: he asked Jenny if she had enjoyed the speech

modifiers.text: if she had enjoyed the speech

b2-063-s009.gloss: 回家路上他问珍妮演讲听得是否开心。
b2-063-s009.whyLearn: 间接问句用 if 引导且退到过去完成时，语序回到陈述语序。

b2-063-s010.gloss: 出乎他意料，她说她并不喜欢。
b2-063-s010.whyLearn: to one's surprise 作句首评注，hadn't 后省略整个动词短语，避免重复。

b2-064-s001.skeleton: a French engineer, Aime Thome de Gamond, arrived in England

modifiers.text: with a plan for a twenty-one mile tunnel across the English Channel

b2-064-s001.gloss: 1858年法国工程师加蒙带隧道方案抵英。
b2-064-s001.whyLearn: 主语后插同位语补人名，再用一串介词短语层层定位，长句靠介词扩展。

b2-064-s003.skeleton: This platform would serve as a port and a railway station

modifiers.text: as a port and a railway station
a port and a railway station

b2-064-s003.gloss: 这个平台将兼作港口和火车站。
b2-064-s003.whyLearn: serve as 表充当，would 是过去语境中的将来，and 并列两个名词。

modifiers.text: if tall chimneys were built above sea-level

b2-064-s004.gloss: 若把高烟囱建到海平面以上，隧道通风会好。
b2-064-s004.whyLearn: 虚拟条件句：主句 would be，从句用过去时，还把被动语态塞进从句。

b2-064-s005.skeleton: a better plan was put forward
b2-064-s005.gloss: 1860年英国人威廉·洛提出更好方案。
b2-064-s005.whyLearn: 被动句把方案放句首，by 引出施动者，人名再作同位语补充。

modifiers.text: that a double railway tunnel should be built

b2-064-s006.gloss: 他建议修建一条双轨铁路隧道。
b2-064-s006.whyLearn: suggest 后从句用 should be built 这类 should+原形的虚拟形式。

b2-064-s008.gloss: 四十二年后，隧道才真正开工。
b2-064-s008.whyLearn: 时间名词短语直接作状语不用介词，副词 actually 插在 was 与分词之间。

modifiers.text: If, at the time, the British had not feared invasion

b2-064-s009.gloss: 当时英国人若不惧入侵，隧道早已建成。
b2-064-s009.whyLearn: 与过去相反的虚拟：从句 had not feared，主句 would have been completed。

b2-064-s010.skeleton: there has again been great interest

modifiers.text: in the idea of a Channel Tunnel

b2-064-s010.gloss: 近来人们对海峡隧道重燃兴趣。
b2-064-s010.whyLearn: there be 完成时里插进 again，真主语是抽象名词 interest，后接 in 表对象。

b2-065-s001.skeleton: the circus owner, Jimmy Gates, decided to take some presents

modifiers.text: to take some presents to a children's hospital

b2-065-s001.gloss: 去年圣诞，马戏团老板吉米决定送礼物给儿童医院。
b2-065-s001.whyLearn: decide to do 是高频不定式搭配，同位语夹在主语后，to 又引出赠送对象。

b2-065-s004.skeleton: A policeman approached Jimmy and told him

modifiers.text: and told him he ought to have gone along a side-street
he ought to have gone along a side-street
as Jumbo was holding up the traffic

b2-065-s004.gloss: 警察说他本该走小巷，因为大象堵了路。
b2-065-s004.whyLearn: 宾语从句内 ought to have done 表本该做而未做，as 从句交代原因。

modifiers.text: Though Jimmy agreed to go at once

b2-065-s005.gloss: 吉米答应马上走，大象却不肯动。
b2-065-s005.whyLearn: Though 从句表让步，主句不再用 but；agree 与 refuse 后都接不定式。

b2-065-s006.skeleton: Fifteen policemen had to push very hard

modifiers.text: to get him off the main street

b2-065-s006.gloss: 十五名警察只得使劲把他推离主街。
b2-065-s006.whyLearn: had to 表过去不得不，to get 表目的，get+宾语+off 表示使离开。

b2-065-s007.skeleton: The police had a difficult time
b2-065-s007.gloss: 警察很费劲，却也觉得十分好笑。
b2-065-s007.whyLearn: have a difficult time 表吃力，most 等于 very，but 连接两个过去时小句。

b4-057-s002.skeleton: this phase of our development is now finished
b4-057-s002.gloss: 我们发展的这一阶段现已结束。
b4-057-s002.whyLearn: our development 用所有格点明阶段归属，is finished 是 be 加过去分词表状态，now 插在两者之间。

b4-057-s003.skeleton: we lack practice and experience nowadays
b4-057-s003.gloss: 如今我们缺乏应对原始条件的经验。
b4-057-s003.whyLearn: in dealing with 是介词后接 -ing 的典型，deal with 意为应对；lack 直接跟宾语，不加 of。

b4-057-s005.skeleton: The last creature to compete with man was the mosquito
b4-057-s005.gloss: 最后与人类竞争的生物是蚊子。
b4-057-s005.whyLearn: to compete with man 作后置定语修饰 the last creature，主语被拉长后谓语 was 才出现，可照此写。

b4-057-s006.gloss: 连蚊子也因排水和化学喷剂被制服。
b4-057-s006.whyLearn: has been subdued 是现在完成时被动，两个 by 短语并列交代手段，even 让让步语气更重。

b4-057-s008.skeleton: the competition of man against man is not the simple process
b4-057-s008.gloss: 人与人的竞争并非生物学设想的简单过程。
b4-057-s008.whyLearn: envisioned in biology 是过去分词短语作后置定语，等于 which is envisioned；is not 直接否定表语。

b4-057-s010.gloss: 环境主要被我们相信的东西所决定。
b4-057-s010.whyLearn: the things we believe 省略了关系词 that，是典型定语从句；被动把施动者放到句末成为信息重点。

b4-057-s011.skeleton: Morocco and California are bits of the Earth

modifiers.text: both on the west coasts of continents with similar climates
and probably with rather similar natural resources

b4-057-s011.gloss: 摩洛哥与加州纬度相近、条件相似。
b4-057-s011.whyLearn: 主干只有 are 一个谓语，三个介词短语层层补足相似点，both 让并列第二项与前面的并列主语呼应。

b4-057-s013.gloss: 这正是我想强调的一点。
b4-057-s013.whyLearn: the point 后接省略 that 的定语从句 I wish to emphasize，任何名词都能这样加从句收尾。

b4-057-s014.skeleton: The most important factor in our environment is the state
b4-057-s014.gloss: 环境中最重要的是我们自己的心态。
b4-057-s014.whyLearn: 主语与表语各带一个介词短语形成对称，the most important 是最高级，可换词套用这一比较框架。

b4-057-s017.skeleton: The Holy office knew this full well

modifiers.text: when it caused heretics to be burned in days gone by
to be burned in days gone by

b4-057-s017.gloss: 当年宗教法庭对此十分清楚。
b4-057-s017.whyLearn: when 引导时间状语从句，cause sb to do 用不定式表被指使的动作，to be burned 又被动态省去施动者。

b4-057-s019.skeleton: It is only someone looking on from outside

modifiers.text: that can inject the dangerous thoughts

b4-057-s019.gloss: 只有外来旁观者才能注入危险思想。
b4-057-s019.whyLearn: It is...that... 强调主语 someone，looking on from outside 是分词后置定语，can 表能力。

b4-057-s022.skeleton: it will suffice to mention the nuclear bomb
b4-057-s022.gloss: 也许提一下核弹就够了。
b4-057-s022.whyLearn: it 是形式主语，真主语是后面的 to mention；suffice 后接不定式表足够做某事，写作中很实用。

b4-057-s024.skeleton: Twenty or thirty pages of information handed to any of the major world powers around the year 1925 would have been sufficient

modifiers.text: handed to any of the major world powers around the year 1925
to change the course of world history

b4-057-s024.gloss: 二三十页资料在当时就足以改写世界史。
b4-057-s024.whyLearn: 主语被 handed to... 分词短语和年份状语拉长，would have been 表对过去的推测，to change 表结果。

b4-058-s001.skeleton: A gifted American psychologist has said

modifiers.text: 'Worry is a spasm of the emotion; the m

b4-058-s001.gloss: 一位美国心理学家说忧虑是情绪的痉挛。
b4-058-s001.whyLearn: 引号原话直接作 has said 的宾语，逗号加引号即可引入；引文里的 is 保持一般现在时。

b4-058-s003.skeleton: The stronger the will, the more futile the task
b4-058-s003.gloss: 意志越强，任务越显得徒劳。
b4-058-s003.whyLearn: the 加比较级、the 加比较级的对应句式表越……越……，两个分句都能换词，简洁好用。

b1-047-s001.skeleton: Mr Hill is our new next-door neighbour
b1-047-s001.gloss: 希尔先生是我们的新邻居。
b1-047-s001.whyLearn: is后接身份名词，our和连字符形容词next-door依次修饰neighbour，位置不能换。

b1-047-s006.skeleton: He will fly to New York next month.
b1-047-s006.whyLearn: will加动词原形表将来，先说目的地to New York，时间next month放句尾。

b1-047-s007.gloss: 再下个月他将飞往东京。
b1-047-s007.whyLearn: 时间短语提到句首，主句仍是will加原形；after next即再下一个。

b1-047-s008.whyLearn: at the moment指此刻，是锁定现在时间轴的常用短语，可与now替换比较。

b1-047-s009.skeleton: He flew to Spain a week ago.
b1-047-s009.gloss: 他一周前飞去了西班牙。
b1-047-s009.whyLearn: 过去式flew要单独记，配a week ago说明动作发生在过去某点。

b1-047-s010.skeleton: He will return to London the week after next.
b1-047-s010.whyLearn: return to加地点，the week after next与will搭配，表示下下周的行程。

modifiers.text: and he has already been to nearly every country in the world.

b1-047-s011.gloss: 他年仅四十一岁却几乎走遍世界。
b1-047-s011.whyLearn: and连接两个并列事实，has been to表示去过某地，already插在has之后。

b1-047-s012.skeleton: Mr Hill is a very lucky man.
b1-047-s012.gloss: 希尔先生是个非常幸运的人。
b1-047-s012.whyLearn: 形容词lucky作定语，very直接前置，与下一句的否定评价形成对照。

b1-047-s013.gloss: 可他妻子就没那么幸运了。
b1-047-s013.whyLearn: his表所属，be动词后加not构成否定，与上句肯定句对照读更清楚。

b1-048-s001.skeleton: Two return tickets to London please.
b1-048-s001.gloss: 请给我两张去伦敦的往返票。
b1-048-s001.whyLearn: 买票只需名词短语加please，return tickets指可去可回的往返票。

b1-048-s002.skeleton: What time will the next train leave?
b1-048-s002.whyLearn: 问时刻用what time，will提到主语the next train前，动词leave用原形。

b1-048-s003.whyLearn: 报分钟用minutes past加钟点，语序与中文的八点十九分正好相反。

b1-048-s007.skeleton: What time will the next train leave?
b1-048-s007.whyLearn: 同一疑问句在对话里复现，适合跟读will疑问句的语调和重音。

b1-048-s009.whyLearn: have got相当于have，plenty of后面接不可数名词time，不加s。

b1-048-s010.skeleton: It's only three minutes to eight.
b1-048-s010.gloss: 现在离八点还差三分钟。
b1-048-s010.whyLearn: 差几分到几点用minutes to加钟点，It's后直接跟时间表达即可。

b1-048-s015.skeleton: We want to catch the eight nineteen to London.

modifiers.text: to catch the eight nineteen to London

b1-048-s015.gloss: 我们想赶八点十九分去伦敦的车。
b1-048-s015.whyLearn: want后接不定式to catch，车次eight nineteen直接当名词用，不加train。

b3-060-s013.skeleton: Some friends of my family had this irritating habit.
b3-060-s013.gloss: 我家的一些朋友有这种烦人的习惯。
b3-060-s013.whyLearn: 最基础的of所有格后置定语与一般过去时，短句也能看出主谓宾加修饰的层次。

b3-060-s014.skeleton: The only thing to do was ask them

modifiers.text: to come half an hour later than the other guests

b3-060-s014.gloss: 唯一的办法是让他们比其他客人晚半小时到。
b3-060-s014.whyLearn: was后接省to不定式作表语，配only thing to do后置定语和later than比较级，一句三考点。

b3-060-s015.gloss: 结果他们正好在我们需要的时候到了。
b3-060-s015.whyLearn: just when引导时间状语从句嵌在句尾，是表达正赶上时机的常用说法，语序也自然。

modifiers.text: to be on the platform in good time for a train and still to see it go off without you

b3-060-s018.gloss: 更难堪的是准时到站台却眼睁睁看车开走。
b3-060-s018.whyLearn: is后接并列的两个不定式作表语，把抽象处境写成具体画面，顺带记住go off。

b3-060-s021.skeleton: She gave her luggage to a porter and showed him her ticket.
b3-060-s021.gloss: 她把行李交给搬运工并出示了车票。
b3-060-s021.whyLearn: 一个主语带两个并列谓语，give sth to sb搭配与her所属格连用，动作推进很利落。

modifiers.text: that she was two hours too soon

b3-060-s022.gloss: 令她惊恐的是，他说她早到了两小时。
b3-060-s022.whyLearn: To one's horror开头交代意外，后接that宾语从句，是叙事文里高频的信息句式。

b3-060-s023.skeleton: She felt in her handbag for the piece of paper

modifiers.text: on which her father had written down all the details of the journey
and give it to the porter

b3-060-s023.gloss: 她在包里翻找写满行程细节的纸，要交给搬运工。
b3-060-s023.whyLearn: on which引导定语从句配过去完成时，交代更早的动作，是书面叙述的关键结构。

b3-060-s025.skeleton: The girl asked to see a timetable

modifiers.text: feeling sure that her father could not have made such a mistake
that her father could not have made such a mistake

b3-060-s025.gloss: 女孩要求看时刻表，确信父亲不会犯这种错。
b3-060-s025.whyLearn: 主句后接分词短语作伴随状语，内嵌sure that与could not have done推测，层次很密。

b3-060-s027.skeleton: the train came into the station
b3-060-s027.gloss: 就在那一刻，火车进站了。
b3-060-s027.whyLearn: 短句把时间状语前置，再用come into表进站，语序与动词搭配都值得积累。

b3-060-s028.skeleton: The girl, tears streaming down her face, begged

modifiers.text: to be allowed to slip into the guard's van

b3-060-s028.gloss: 女孩满脸泪水，恳求让她溜进列车员车厢。
b3-060-s028.whyLearn: 独立主格作插入描写，beg to be allowed又是双重被动不定式，画面与语法兼得。

b3-060-s029.gloss: 但站长态度坚决：规定不能破。
b3-060-s029.whyLearn: 冒号引出解释性分句，配could not be broken情态加被动，是写规矩的简洁句式。

b3-060-s030.skeleton: she had to watch that train disappear
b3-060-s030.gloss: 她只能看着火车驶向目的地，自己被留在站台。
b3-060-s030.whyLearn: had to加watch sb do省to结构，再接while被动从句，把无奈写得层层递进。

modifiers.text: where the remote ancestors of the Polynesian peoples now living in the Pacific Islands came from
now living in the Pacific Islands

b4-001-s005.gloss: 人类学家想知道波利尼西亚人的祖先来自何处。
b4-001-s005.whyLearn: wondered后接where间接疑问句，中间插入of所有格与现在分词后置定语，语序最易错。

b4-001-s006.skeleton: The sagas of these people explain

modifiers.text: that some of them came from Indonesia about 2,000 years ago

b4-001-s006.gloss: 这些人的传说说明他们约两千年前来自印尼。
b4-001-s006.whyLearn: explain后that宾语从句里塞进some of、come from与时间状语，是转述来源信息的写法。

b4-001-s010.skeleton: They may also have used wood and skins
b4-001-s010.gloss: 他们可能还用过木头和兽皮，但都已烂掉。
b4-001-s010.whyLearn: may have done表推测，have rotted away表结果，两个完成结构并列形成今昔对比。

b4-002-s001.skeleton: Why, you may wonder, should spiders be our friends
b4-002-s001.gloss: 你也许会问，蜘蛛为何该是我们的朋友？
b4-002-s001.whyLearn: 插入语you may wonder切断疑问句，情态should表应该，插入语与倒装共现值得注意。

b1-020-s010.gloss: 把东西放在这儿，这个架子上。
b1-020-s010.whyLearn: 祈使句先给动词 Put 加宾语 it，再用介词短语补充具体位置，指路放物最常用。

b1-021-s013.skeleton: A quarter of a pound of tea
b1-021-s013.whyLearn: 用 of 层层嵌套表达分量，点单买东西时报数量离不开这种说法。

b1-021-s015.skeleton: Is that tin of tobacco for me
b1-021-s015.whyLearn: Is 提到句首构成一般疑问句，名词 tin 后用 of 短语说明装的是什么。

b1-021-s016.whyLearn: certainly 插在 be 动词与否定词之间加强语气，口语里反驳别人很常用。

b1-022-s002.whyLearn: of course 被提到主语 I 前表示当然，句末省去重复的动词短语，答话轻快。

b1-022-s006.whyLearn: 先用 over there 给大方向，再用介词短语精确定位，指路顺序很清楚。

b1-023-s005.skeleton: Can she type this letter for me
b1-023-s005.gloss: 老板问：她能替我打这封信吗？
b1-023-s005.whyLearn: 情态动词 can 提问表示请求，type this letter for me 是职场高频搭配。

b1-023-s009.whyLearn: 用 Yes 加 of course 承接请求，省去重复的动词短语，回答干脆又有礼貌。

b1-025-s004.gloss: 伯德太太喜欢羊肉，丈夫却不喜欢。
b1-025-s004.whyLearn: 用 but 对比两人口味，后半句用 doesn't 代替重复的动词，避免啰嗦。

b1-025-s011.gloss: 我丈夫爱牛排，但不喜欢鸡肉。
b1-025-s011.whyLearn: likes 与 doesn't like 前后对照，第三人称否定的助动词用法一目了然。

b1-025-s012.whyLearn: to tell you the truth 作独立成分，开口前先表明坦诚态度，口语很地道。

b1-026-s003.skeleton: What's the climate like in your country
b1-026-s003.gloss: 汉斯问：你们国家气候如何？
b1-026-s003.whyLearn: What's ... like 是询问气候的固定句式，in your country 限定提问范围。

b1-026-s005.skeleton: What's the weather like in spring
b1-026-s005.gloss: 汉斯问：春天天气怎么样？
b1-026-s005.whyLearn: 同一句式把 climate 换成 weather，加 in spring 就问某个季节的天气。

b1-026-s006.gloss: 季米特里说：三月常刮风。
b1-026-s006.whyLearn: It's 加形容词描述天气，often 紧跟在 be 动词后，时间状语放句末。

b1-026-s007.gloss: 四五月总是暖和，但有时下雨。
b1-026-s007.whyLearn: 前半句用 be 加形容词，后半句换成实义动词 rain，同一话题两种句型对照。

b1-026-s008.whyLearn: it 指代前面谈的天气，What's it like 省略名词追问，承接上文很自然。

b3-044-s027.gloss: 你能真切地看清大地的轮廓。
b3-044-s027.whyLearn: really 插在实义动词前加强语气，of the land 后置修饰 shape，最基础的名词加介词短语结构。

modifiers.text: However you decide to spend your time
you will arrive at your destination fresh and uncrumpled

b3-044-s030.gloss: 无论怎样安排时间，你都会神清气爽地抵达目的地。
b3-044-s030.whyLearn: However 引出让步状语从句，冒号后分句解释 one thing，arrive 后接形容词作主语补足语。

b3-044-s031.skeleton: You will not have to spend the next few days

modifiers.text: recovering from a long and arduous journey

b3-044-s031.gloss: 你不必再花好几天从漫长艰辛的旅途中恢复。
b3-044-s031.whyLearn: spend 加时间加 doing 的搭配，have to 的不定式又嵌在将来时里，一句练两个结构。

b3-045-s001.gloss: 在民主国家，限制自由的各种努力（原文截断）。
b3-045-s001.whyLearn: efforts to do 是名词加不定式作后置定语，句首介词短语作地点状语，读报常见搭配。

b3-045-s002.skeleton: this freedom can easily be abused
b3-045-s002.gloss: 不过，这种自由很容易被滥用。
b3-045-s002.whyLearn: can be done 构成情态动词的被动式，副词 easily 夹在中间，短句最适合练被动语态。

b3-045-s003.skeleton: Stories about people often attract far more public attention than political events
