b3-006-s004.skeleton: Two of his assistants had been working busily
b3-006-s004.gloss: 两名助手从八点忙到现在
b3-006-s004.whyLearn: 完成进行时与过去完成时用and并列，since点明起点，学时间的持续与收束。

b3-006-s005.skeleton: Diamond necklaces and rings had been beautifully arranged

modifiers.text: on a background of black velvet

b3-006-s005.gloss: 钻戒项链摆在黑天鹅绒上
b3-006-s005.whyLearn: 并列主语提前，过去完成时被动语态后置，学陈列描写中的信息重心安排。

b3-006-s006.skeleton: Mr Taylor went back into his shop

modifiers.text: After gazing at the display for several minutes

b3-006-s006.gloss: 泰勒看了一会儿橱窗后回店
b3-006-s006.whyLearn: After加动名词短语作时间状语，因主语一致而省去主语，学逐层叠加的介词结构。

b3-006-s008.whyLearn: came to a stop是停下的固定搭配，后接outside介词短语点明位置，简练地道。

b3-006-s009.skeleton: One man stayed at the wheel

modifiers.text: while two others with black stockings over their faces jumped out and smashed the window of the shop with iron bars
with black stockings over their faces
and smashed the window of the shop with iron bars

b3-006-s009.gloss: 一人留守，两人蒙面砸橱窗
b3-006-s009.whyLearn: while对比留守与动手，with复合结构交代蒙面，学多动作场面的分层描写。

b2-050-s004.gloss: 售票员说会告诉我在哪儿下车。
b2-050-s004.whyLearn: tell sb where to do 是间接疑问句作宾语，注意 where+不定式结构以及 get off 的固定搭配。

modifiers.text: in the front of the bus
to get a good view of the countryside

b2-050-s005.gloss: 我坐在公交车前排，想好好看乡村景色。
b2-050-s005.whyLearn: 目的状语不定式 to get 直接跟在 sat 后说明坐前排的用意，是 to do 表目的最典型的语序。

b2-050-s006.gloss: 过了一会儿，公交车停了下来。
b2-050-s006.whyLearn: After some time 是叙事中推进时间的常用开头，用逗号与主句隔开，stopped 为规则动词过去式。

modifiers.text: that I was the only passenger left on the bus

b2-050-s007.gloss: 环顾四周，我震惊地发现车上只剩我一个乘客。
b2-050-s007.whyLearn: 句首 Looking round 与主句主语 I 逻辑一致，是分词作状语；名词后 left 又作后置定语，一句两用。

b2-050-s008.skeleton: You'll have to get off here
b2-050-s008.gloss: 售票员说：你得在这儿下车了。
b2-050-s008.whyLearn: have to 表客观必须，前面加 'll 说明将来的义务；引语后的 the conductor said 是叙事文的常见收尾。

b2-050-s012.whyLearn: 引语提前时主句用 said + 主语的倒装，suddenly 后置，是英语叙事中插入对话的标准写法。

b2-050-s013.whyLearn: forget to do 指忘记去做某事，与 forget doing 语义相反；put sb off 在此表示让某人下车。

b2-050-s016.gloss: 售票员说，我们现在要往回开了。
b2-050-s016.whyLearn: are going back 用现在进行时表已安排好的近期动作，引语后接 said + 主语，时态对比清楚。

b2-050-s017.skeleton: I prefer to stay on the bus
b2-050-s017.gloss: 我说，既然如此，我宁愿留在车上。
b2-050-s017.whyLearn: in that case 承接上文条件，prefer to do 是固定搭配，句末 I answered 保留了叙述视角。

b2-051-s002.whyLearn: a week ago 是触发一般过去时的典型时间标记，搭配所有格 his diet，句子虽短却规则齐全。

b2-051-s003.skeleton: he wrote out a long list of all the foods
b2-051-s003.gloss: 他先写下一长串被禁止的食物。
b2-051-s003.whyLearn: which 引导的定语从句修饰 foods，被动 were forbidden 省略施动者，写清单时非常实用。

b2-051-s004.skeleton: The list included most of the things

modifiers.text: butter, potatoes, rice, beer, milk, chocolate, and sweets

b2-051-s004.gloss: 清单里包括赫伯特爱吃的大部分东西。
b2-051-s004.whyLearn: things 后接省略关系词的定语从句，冒号后用并列名词列举作同位语，标点与并列都值得留意。

b2-051-s005.whyLearn: pay sb a visit 是地道的固定搭配，不能说 pay a visit sb；时间副词 Yesterday 置于句首同样自然。

b2-051-s007.skeleton: He led me into his room

modifiers.text: and hurriedly hid a large parcel under his desk

b2-051-s007.gloss: 他领我进屋，慌忙把大包裹藏到桌子下面。
b2-051-s007.whyLearn: and 连接两个过去式谓语，hurriedly 位于实义动词前，两处 his 所有格让动作连贯如镜头。

b2-051-s008.whyLearn: It was + 形容词 + that 从句 把真主语后移，避免头重脚轻；从句时态须与主句保持一致。

b2-051-s011.gloss: 然后他把包裹里的东西拿给我看。
b2-051-s011.whyLearn: show sb sth 的双宾语结构，这里宾语换成 the contents of the parcel，of 表所属的用法清楚。

modifiers.text: Sir, we welcome you to our city.

b2-016-s005.gloss: 我在瑞典度假时发现车上留的欢迎便条
b2-016-s005.whyLearn: 介词短语开头交代时间地点，主句用一般过去时叙事，是记叙文开头的典型写法

b2-016-s007.skeleton: You will enjoy your stay here

modifiers.text: if you pay attention to our street signs

b2-016-s007.gloss: 若注意路牌，你在此逗留会很愉快
b2-016-s007.whyLearn: 主句将来时配if条件从句，从句用现在时表将来，是提示语的高频句式

b2-016-s008.skeleton: This note is only a reminder
b2-016-s008.whyLearn: 主系表结构极短，only限定表语，适合体会简单句的收尾与语气

b2-017-s001.skeleton: My aunt Jennifer is an actress
b2-017-s001.whyLearn: 专有名词紧跟称谓作同位语，一句说明人物身份，是介绍人物的入门句型

b2-017-s002.skeleton: She must be at least thirty-five years old
b2-017-s002.whyLearn: must表推测而非义务，at least加年龄是估摸年龄的地道说法

b2-017-s003.skeleton: she often appears on the stage
b2-017-s003.gloss: 尽管如此，她常以少女形象登台
b2-017-s003.whyLearn: in spite of接名词表让步，as短语说明登台身份，让步与反差一学就会

b2-017-s004.skeleton: Jennifer will have to take part
b2-017-s004.gloss: 詹妮弗很快要参演一部新剧
b2-017-s004.whyLearn: will have to表将来必须，take part in后接活动，排演话题的高频搭配

b2-017-s005.gloss: 这次她将演一个十七岁的女孩
b2-017-s005.whyLearn: of加数字表示年龄，比seventeen years old更简洁，描写角色时常用

modifiers.text: in a bright red dress and long black stockings
a bright red dress and long black stockings

b2-017-s006.gloss: 剧中她须穿亮红裙和黑长袜出场
b2-017-s006.whyLearn: must表剧情规定，in加衣物描述穿着，两个并列名词短语可整体模仿

b2-017-s007.skeleton: she had to wear short socks and a bright, orange-coloured dress

modifiers.text: short socks and a bright, orange-coloured dress

b2-017-s007.gloss: 去年另一出戏里她得穿短袜和亮橙裙
b2-017-s007.whyLearn: had to wear表过去必须，与上句must appear对照，能看清时态与情态的差别

modifiers.text: After I had had lunch at a village inn

b2-018-s001.gloss: 在乡村小店吃完午饭，我去找包
b2-018-s001.whyLearn: after从句用过去完成时交代先发生的动作，主句用过去时，时序层次清楚

b2-018-s002.skeleton: I had left it on a chair beside the door

modifiers.text: on a chair beside the door

b2-018-s002.gloss: 我把它放在门边椅子上，现在却不见了
b2-018-s002.whyLearn: 过去完成时说更早的动作，and连接转折，否定句写物品失踪很自然

b2-018-s008.gloss: 店主笑了笑便立刻出去了
b2-018-s008.whyLearn: 两个过去式动词用and并列，immediately插中间，动作衔接紧凑利落

modifiers.text: and gave it back to me

b2-018-s009.gloss: 几分钟后他拿着我的包回来还给我
b2-018-s009.whyLearn: in a few minutes表短时之后，并列两个过去动作叙述归还过程，条理清楚

modifiers.text: ' My dog had taken it into the garden.

b2-018-s010.gloss: 他说很抱歉，狗把包叼进了花园
b2-018-s010.whyLearn: 引语前置、he said居中，过去完成时说明狗先叼走，语序与时序都典型

modifiers.text: 'The play may begin at any moment,'

b2-019-s001.whyLearn: may表可能，at any moment表随时，转述台词时引语加I said很实用

modifiers.text: at the end of a long piece of string

b4-052-s019.gloss: 把重物系在长绳的一端
b4-052-s019.whyLearn: 祈使句直接下达操作指令，at the end of 是交代位置最常用的介词短语

modifiers.text: With the hand held high in the air
so that the weight nearly touches the ground

b4-052-s020.gloss: 手举高，抖动绳子让重物几乎触地
b4-052-s020.whyLearn: with 复合结构作伴随状语前置，so that 引出目的，两个状语把短主句夹在中间

b4-052-s021.gloss: 手要前后左右移动，但不要上下移动
b4-052-s021.whyLearn: to and fro 与 up and down 成对使用，but not 把禁止的动作排除在外

modifiers.text: that the weight moves but slightly or not at all
but slightly or not at all

b4-052-s022.gloss: 会发现重物几乎不动，或完全不动
b4-052-s022.whyLearn: It will be found that 是形式主语的被动句式，把观察结论说得客观，but slightly 表微弱程度

modifiers.text: shaking the floor, the paper, you and your hand

b4-052-s024.gloss: 想象地震晃动地板、纸张、你和你的手
b4-052-s024.whyLearn: 现在分词 shaking 作后置定语，带出四个并列宾语，把地震的摇动具象化

b4-052-s025.skeleton: the weight and the pen would be still

modifiers.text: In the midst of all this movement

b4-052-s025.gloss: 在这一切运动中，重物和笔却静止不动
b4-052-s025.whyLearn: In the midst of 引出背景，would 在此表推测性判断，与前面的运动形成静动对比

modifiers.text: as the paper moved from side to side under the pen point

b4-052-s026.gloss: 纸一移动，笔尖就用墨水把运动记在纸上
b4-052-s026.whyLearn: as 引导时间状语从句，主句用被动 would be recorded，句末两个介词短语补出方式与位置

b4-052-s027.skeleton: the first instruments were made, but the paper was wrapped round a drum

modifiers.text: It was upon this principle that

b4-052-s027.gloss: 最早的仪器据此制成，纸绕在缓慢转动的鼓上
b4-052-s027.whyLearn: It was ... that 强调状语 upon this principle，后接 but 并列的被动句与 which 定语从句

b4-052-s029.skeleton: The apparatus thus described, however, records only the horizontal component

modifiers.text: which is, in fact, much more complicated

b4-052-s029.gloss: 然而该装置只记录波动的水平分量
b4-052-s029.whyLearn: 主干被 thus described 与 however 插在中间，句末 which 从句又说明其实更复杂

b4-052-s032.skeleton: the graphic record shows three waves

modifiers.text: When the instrument is situated at more than 700 miles from the earthquake centre
arriving one after the other at short intervals

b4-052-s032.gloss: 七百多英里外，记录仪显示三道波先后到达
b4-052-s032.whyLearn: When 从句用被动交代距离，主句 shows 后接 arriving 分词，写出三波先后抵达

b4-052-s033.gloss: 第一道波记录纵波的到达
b4-052-s033.whyLearn: The first 后省略了 wave，of 短语作后置定语，是学术说明里常见的简省写法

modifiers.text: which travel more slowly and arrive several minutes after the first

b4-052-s034.gloss: 第二道波记录横波，其速度更慢、到达更晚
b4-052-s034.whyLearn: which 定语从句内并列 travel 与 arrive 两个动词，把横波速度慢、到得晚一并说清

b4-052-s035.gloss: 这两种波已穿过地球内部
b4-052-s035.whyLearn: 现在完成时 have travelled 强调波已穿过地球这一结果，through 点明路径

modifiers.text: It was from the study of these that
about the interior of the earth

b4-052-s036.gloss: 正是研究这些波，才了解了地球内部
b4-052-s036.whyLearn: It was ... that 强调状语 from the study of these，被动 was learnt 让结论更客观

b4-052-s037.skeleton: The third, or main wave, is the slowest and has travelled
b4-052-s037.gloss: 第三道即主波最慢，沿地表岩层绕行地球
b4-052-s037.whyLearn: 同位语 or main wave 插在主语后，is the slowest 用最高级，and 后完成时说明传播结果

b4-053-s001.skeleton: The French Foreign Legion was founded
b4-053-s001.gloss: 法国外籍军团由一道皇家法令建立
b4-053-s001.whyLearn: 被动语态 was founded by 交代建立者，句尾 written 分词短语补充法令的书写情况

b3-042-s025.skeleton: they could hear an insistent booming sound

modifiers.text: In this part of the cave
which they found was caused by a small water-spout shooting down into a pool from the roof of the cave
from the roof of the cave

b3-042-s025.gloss: 洞中他们听见水柱击水的轰鸣
b3-042-s025.whyLearn: which 从句里嵌入 they found 主谓，再套被动语态，一句示范多层嵌套的读法。

b3-042-s029.skeleton: the only sound that could be heard was made by water

modifiers.text: In the eerie silence of the cavern
which dripped continuously from the high dome above them
from the high dome above them

b3-042-s029.gloss: 寂静洞窟里唯一声响来自滴水
b3-042-s029.whyLearn: 主语被 that 被动从句拉长，谓语 was made by 后置，考验主干定位能力。

b3-043-s004.skeleton: the higher the premium you will have to pay

modifiers.text: the bigger the risk an insurance company takes

b3-043-s004.whyLearn: the+比较级,the+比较级表正比，risk 后省略关系词的定语从句也要识别。

b3-043-s005.skeleton: It is not uncommon to hear

modifiers.text: that a ship-ping company has made a claim for the cost of salvaging a sunken ship
for the cost of salvaging a sunken ship

b3-043-s005.whyLearn: 双重否定 not uncommon 弱化肯定，宾语从句内再套现在完成时与动名词。

b3-043-s016.skeleton: The sides of the dish were so smooth

modifiers.text: that it was almost impossible to attach hawsers and chains to the rim without damaging it
to attach hawsers and chains to the rim

b3-043-s016.whyLearn: so...that 引结果从句，without+动名词说明无法回避的连带后果。

modifiers.text: that it set up a huge wave in the canal

b3-043-s025.whyLearn: such...that 表结果，程度由 with such force 铺垫，写水势凶猛可直接套用。

modifiers.text: that the wave would rebound off the other side of the bank and send the dish plunging into the water again
and send the dish plunging into the water again
off the other side of the bank

b3-043-s026.gloss: 危险在于浪会把盘子再掀下水
b3-043-s026.whyLearn: danger 后同位语从句说明内容，would 表过去将来，and 并列两个谓语。

modifiers.text: to take your mind off the journey

b3-044-s004.whyLearn: It 作形式主语，真主语是不定式，take one's mind off 是固定搭配。

modifiers.text: If you are lucky enough to get a couchette
staring at the small blue light in the ceiling
or fumbling to find your passport

b3-044-s008.gloss: 夜行车上要么盯着灯要么找护照
b3-044-s008.whyLearn: spend 后接两个并列 -ing 短语，条件与时间从句前后夹住，句式对称。

b3-044-s011.skeleton: the greater part of the journey is spent on narrow, bumpy roads

modifiers.text: you can, at least, travel fairly safely at high speeds

b3-044-s011.gloss: 高速安全，但多数路段拥挤颠簸
b3-044-s011.whyLearn: but 并列两分句，被动 be spent 与 which 从句叠加，插入语拉开口语节奏。

modifiers.text: even when such refinements are not available

b3-044-s024.gloss: 即便无这些设施也够你忙
b3-044-s024.whyLearn: even when 从句带让步意味，后接 there be 存在句，不定式后置修饰 plenty。

b3-044-s028.skeleton: you can enjoy the extraordinary sight

modifiers.text: If the landscape is hidden from view
that stretch out for miles before you
while the sun shines brilliantly in a clear sky

b3-044-s028.gloss: 地面被遮时反能看云海
b3-044-s028.whyLearn: 条件从句用被动，主句情态动词后接 that 从句，while 从句形成明暗对照。

modifiers.text: that there is nothing to prevent you from reading or sleeping
to prevent you from reading or sleeping

b3-044-s029.gloss: 旅程平稳无人打扰阅读睡眠
b3-044-s029.whyLearn: so...that 引出 there be 存在句，不定式 prevent sb from doing 表阻止。

b3-045-s010.skeleton: They were expecting their sixth child

modifiers.text: and faced with even more pressing economic problems
with even more pressing economic problems

b3-045-s010.gloss: 他们迎来第六胎且经济更拮据
b3-045-s010.whyLearn: 过去进行时铺背景，and 连接被动式 faced with，两层困境并列呈现。

modifiers.text: not only from unknown people, but from baby food and soap manufacturers
from baby food and soap manufacturers
who wished to advertise their products

b3-045-s019.gloss: 礼物从陌生人和厂商涌来
b3-045-s019.whyLearn: not only...but 并列两个介词短语，who 从句补充厂商动机，层层递进。

b3-045-s029.skeleton: It would never again be possible
b3-045-s029.gloss: 他们再也无法过正常生活
b3-045-s029.whyLearn: would 表过去将来，never again 插在助动词与 be 之间，不定式是真主语。

b4-049-s009.skeleton: Hot-air balloons date back to the year 1783

modifiers.text: and within a few months of the first flight a French scientist, Charles, went up two miles in a free balloon
within a few months of the first flight

b4-049-s009.gloss: 热气球始于1783年，法国科学家查尔斯乘自由气球升空两英里。
b4-049-s009.whyLearn: date back to 与 went up 都是地道搭配，两个动作靠 and 串成时间线，适合叙事开头仿写。

b4-049-s011.skeleton: The main development has been carried out
b4-049-s011.whyLearn: 现在完成时被动 has been carried out 把施事放到 by 之后，是科技文常见的客观表述。

modifiers.text: at Princeton University in the United States
in collaboration with the United States Navy, the National Science Foundation, and the National Aero-nautics and Space Administration
the United States Navy, the National Science Foundation, and the National Aero-nautics and Space Administration

b4-049-s012.gloss: 施瓦茨柴尔德与普林斯顿团队，会同美国海军等机构。
b4-049-s012.whyLearn: 全句只有主语而无谓语，靠介词短语层层追加机构名，可学用并列名词堆叠身份与背景。

b4-049-s015.skeleton: The telescope, plus its controls weighs three-and-a-half tons
b4-049-s015.gloss: 望远镜连同控制装置重三点五吨。
b4-049-s015.whyLearn: plus 引出插入成分，真正主语仍是单数 telescope，因此谓语用 weighs 而非 weigh。

b4-049-s016.skeleton: Two large parachutes arc also carried

modifiers.text: the instruments and their records can be separated from the main balloon system

b4-049-s016.gloss: 另备两个大降落伞；紧急时仪器与记录可脱离主气球缓降。
b4-049-s016.whyLearn: 分号后 can be separated 与 brought down 共用情态动词，是省略式并列被动结构的好例子。

b4-049-s017.skeleton: Many of the radio and electronic devices used are similar
b4-049-s017.gloss: 所用无线电与电子设备与人造卫星上的相似。
b4-049-s017.whyLearn: those 代替前面的 devices 避免重复，used 作后置定语，是科技文比较句的省力写法。

b4-050-s003.skeleton: the people of that time depended for food, power and transport
b4-050-s003.gloss: 当时人们靠河流取得食物、动力和运输。
b4-050-s003.whyLearn: 把 Upon rivers 提到句首形成强调，正常语序是 depended upon rivers for…，可练语序还原。

b4-050-s006.skeleton: Every abbey and great man's house had its fish pond

modifiers.text: and across the rivers great and small stretched the fish weirs, usually made of stakes and nets or basket-work
across the rivers great and small
usually made of stakes and nets or basket-work

b4-050-s006.gloss: 每座修道院和大户人家都有鱼塘，河上横着大小鱼梁。
b4-050-s006.whyLearn: 后一分句把介词短语提到句首，主语 fish weirs 却排在 stretched 之后，是完全倒装。

b4-050-s008.skeleton: Rivers were also the most important source
b4-050-s008.gloss: 河流也是最重要的动力来源。
b4-050-s008.whyLearn: 最高级 the most important 作表语，主语复数 Rivers 与表单数的 source 搭配需留意。

modifiers.text: not only for grinding corn, but for all the other industrial processes of the time
for all the other industrial processes of the time
such as fulling* cloth or driving the hammers of ironworks

b4-050-s009.gloss: 每条溪流都有磨坊，不仅磨谷，还用于缩绒、锻铁等工序。
b4-050-s009.whyLearn: not only…but… 搭起两个 for 短语，后面再用 such as 举例，是列举用途的经典句式。

b4-051-s001.skeleton: Two main techniques have been used
b4-051-s001.gloss: 训练大象主要用过两种技术，我们可以称之为……。
b4-051-s001.whyLearn: which 引导非限制性定语从句补充说明 techniques，被动完成时 have been used for 也值得记。

b4-051-s002.skeleton: The former method simply consists of setting an elephant to work and beating him

modifiers.text: until he does what is expected of him

b4-051-s002.gloss: 前一种方法是让象干活，干不好就打，直到它照做为止。
b4-051-s002.whyLearn: consist of 后接两个并列 -ing，until 从句里再套 what 宾语从句，层次清楚。

b4-051-s003.skeleton: this is a stupid method of training

modifiers.text: for it produces a resentful animal who at a later stage may well turn man-killer
who at a later stage may well turn man-killer

b4-051-s003.gloss: 撇开道德不谈，这方法很蠢，会养出日后可能伤人的怨象。
b4-051-s003.whyLearn: for 作并列连词表原因，后接 who 定语从句，may well 表“很可能”，一句三得。

b4-051-s004.skeleton: The gentle method requires more patience in the early stages

modifiers.text: but produces a cheerful, good-tempered elephant who will give many years of loyal service
who will give many years of loyal service

b4-051-s004.gloss: 温和方法早期更需耐心，却能养出多年忠诚效劳的大象。
b4-051-s004.whyLearn: but 连接两个谓语形成前抑后扬，who 定语从句用将来时说明回报，对比清晰。

b1-035-s005.skeleton: Our friends, Julie and Jack were there
b1-035-s005.gloss: 我们的朋友朱莉和杰克当时也在那儿。
b1-035-s005.whyLearn: 用同位语给主语补充具体人名，再用 too 表示“也”，是看照片叙旧的常用句式。

b1-035-s007.whyLearn: 用现在进行时描述照片里正在发生的动作，配 on the left 说明方位，看图说话最实用。

b1-035-s012.whyLearn: was 加介词短语说明过去所处的位置，号码放在名词后是英语习惯，与汉语语序相反。

b1-035-s013.gloss: 另外五辆车紧跟在他后面。
b1-035-s013.whyLearn: other 加复数名词表示“另外的”，behind him 交代相对位置，描述比赛或车队时很好用。

b1-036-s001.gloss: 简问：罗恩·马斯顿这人怎么样，波琳？
b1-036-s001.whyLearn: What's sb like 问的是人品性格而不是外貌，句末还要用称呼语 Pauline 直接喊人。

modifiers.text: and three times the day before yesterday

b1-036-s003.gloss: 他昨天给我打了四次电话，前天又打了三次。
b1-036-s003.whyLearn: and 并列两组“次数+时间”，动词只出现一次，讲打电话次数这类事实时既省字又清楚。

b1-036-s004.gloss: 波琳：他昨天上午和下午都往办公室打了电话。
b1-036-s004.whyLearn: 同一个动词带两个时间状语时只出现一次 telephoned，靠 and 连接时间，句子因此很紧凑。

b1-036-s006.gloss: 简问：你老板对他说了什么？
b1-036-s006.whyLearn: 特殊疑问句里 did 后面的动词要用原形 say，your boss 作主语，是转述对话最常用的问法。

b1-036-s007.gloss: 波琳：他说：“怀特小姐正在打信。”
b1-036-s007.whyLearn: 主句用过去时 said 引出引语，引语内部却保留现在进行时，可体会时态不必强求一致。

b1-036-s009.gloss: 波琳：然后我昨晚六点到家。
b1-036-s009.whyLearn: arrive home 后面不加介词，再叠加 at six 与 yesterday evening，可练习时间状语由小到大排列。

b1-036-s011.whyLearn: 一般过去时的否定用 didn't 加动词原形，answer the phone 是“接电话”的地道搭配。

b1-036-s016.gloss: 波琳：我说：“我是波琳的母亲。”
b1-036-s016.whyLearn: 电话里自报身份用 This is...，said 引出的引语仍用现在时，可直接引语时态相对自由。

b1-037-s001.gloss: 上周米尔斯太太去了伦敦。
b1-037-s001.whyLearn: 时间状语 Last week 提到句首，主语带称谓 Mrs，是叙事开头交代时间地点的典型写法。

b1-037-s002.gloss: 她对伦敦不太熟，结果迷了路。
b1-037-s002.whyLearn: 一句里对照 does not know 的一般现在时和 lost 的一般过去时，讲清“不熟所以迷路”的因果。

b1-037-s003.gloss: 突然，她在一个公交站附近看见一个男人。
b1-037-s003.whyLearn: Suddenly 放句首迅速推进情节，near 引出的介词短语后置修饰 a man，叙事文里出现率极高。

b1-037-s012.gloss: 然后他把手伸进口袋，掏出一本短语手册。
b1-037-s012.whyLearn: put...into 与 take out 两个动作靠 and 串起来，his 回指主语，是叙述连续动作的好样板。

b4-043-s009.skeleton: The bulk and weight of coal required in the majority of manufacturing industries is large

modifiers.text: of coal required in the majority of manufacturing industries
in comparison with the bulk and weight of other raw materials

b4-043-s009.gloss: 多数制造业所需煤炭的体积与重量远大于其他原料。
b4-043-s009.whyLearn: 主干被两个长篇后置介词短语夹住，学会先锁定主语再找谓语 is，长句立刻解体。

b4-043-s011.skeleton: Coal being a solid must be distributed mainly by rail or water
b4-043-s011.gloss: 煤是固体，所以只能主要靠铁路或水路运输。
b4-043-s011.whyLearn: 独立主格“Coal being a solid”表原因，夹在主语与情态被动之间，是识别非谓语作状语的典型样本。

b4-043-s012.skeleton: By way of contrast oil can be transported large distances by pipeline but overseas movement has involved building of large numbers of tankers

modifiers.text: but overseas movement has involved building of large numbers of tankers, including nowsome of the largest vessels afloat
including nowsome of the largest vessels afloat

b4-043-s012.gloss: 石油可管道远距离输送，但海运需建造大量油轮。
b4-043-s012.whyLearn: but 前是情态被动、but 后是现在完成时主动，同一句里对比两种语态，还带最高级与分词收尾。

b4-043-s015.skeleton: Natural gas can also be transported large distances
b4-043-s015.gloss: 天然气也能通过管道远距离输送。
b4-043-s015.whyLearn: 最短的情态被动句，distances 直接作状语而非加 for，可照搬为同类能源运输的表达模板。

b4-043-s016.skeleton: Early in 1959 Britain received the first ship cargo of natural gas

modifiers.text: liquefied for the purpose of transport

b4-043-s016.gloss: 1959年初英国收到首批液化天然气船运货物。
b4-043-s016.whyLearn: 破折号后过去分词补出货物被液化的状态，说明事件句如何用分词追加关键信息而不另起一句。

modifiers.text: Where the cost of government is high

b4-044-s003.gloss: 政府成本高的地方，可用于发展的资源就相应少。
b4-044-s003.whyLearn: Where 引导的是条件化的地点状语从句，主句用 correspondingly 呼应，是“越……就越……”式论证的骨架。

modifiers.text: by comparing the position of a nation with that of a private business enterprise

b4-044-s004.gloss: 这一点可用国家与私营企业的处境对比来说明。
b4-044-s004.whyLearn: by + 动名词是学术写作最常用的“如何说明”句式，且内含 that of 的替代用法，值得整块背下。

b4-044-s006.skeleton: we are concerned only with one kind of cost

modifiers.text: the cost of managing and administering the business

b4-044-s006.gloss: 就我们的目的而言，只关注管理企业这一种成本。
b4-044-s006.whyLearn: 双破折号引出同位语给抽象名词下定义，是说明文界定术语的标准写法，还能顺手记住 of + 动名词。

b4-044-s007.skeleton: Such administrative overhead in a business is analogous to the cost of government in a nation

modifiers.text: to the cost of government in a nation

b4-044-s007.gloss: 企业中的这种管理开支类似于一个国家的政府成本。
b4-044-s007.whyLearn: be analogous to 是学术类比的高频搭配，句内两个 in 短语平行对称，可整句替换内容后复用。

b4-044-s009.skeleton: then administrative overhead will be low

modifiers.text: If they can each be trusted to take such responsibilities, and to exercise such initiative as falls within their sphere

b4-044-s009.gloss: 若人人可信地担责并发挥职权内的主动性，管理成本就低。
b4-044-s009.whyLearn: 长条件句由两个并列不定式撑开，内含 as 引导的定语从句，主句仅四词，专练在 if 从句里找回主干。

b4-044-s013.skeleton: It is precisely the same with a nation
b4-044-s013.gloss: 一个国家的情况也完全相同。
b4-044-s013.whyLearn: It is the same with... 是承接上文作类比的极简过渡句，读论证文时能快速认出作者的转向。

b4-044-s016.skeleton: A disunited nation therefore has to incur unduly high costs of government
b4-044-s016.gloss: 因此分裂的国家不得不承担过高的政府成本。
b4-044-s016.whyLearn: have to incur 加 therefore 构成因果收束句，简洁又有力，适合放在段尾作结论。

b4-045-s001.skeleton: the human body is at its most vigorous

modifiers.text: At the age of twelve years

b4-045-s001.gloss: 人到十二岁时，身体正处于最富活力的阶段。
b4-045-s001.whyLearn: at one's most + 形容词 是表达“处于最……状态”的紧凑结构，比用最高级修饰名词更地道。

b4-045-s002.skeleton: It has yet to reach its full size and strength

modifiers.text: and its owner his or her full intelligence
but at this age the likelihood of death is least

b4-045-s002.gloss: 身体尚未发育完全，但此年龄死亡可能性最小。
b4-045-s002.whyLearn: has yet to 表“尚未”，后半句用 his or her 省略重复谓语，是省略与并列压缩的实战范例。

b4-045-s004.skeleton: This decline in vigour with the passing of time is called ageing
b4-045-s004.gloss: 这种随时间推移而出现的活力衰退叫做衰老。
b4-045-s004.whyLearn: 主语中心词 decline 被两个介词短语层层限定后才出现被动谓语，是学术定义句的经典构造。

b4-045-s006.skeleton: Some of us will die sooner, a few will live longer

modifiers.text: on into a ninth or tenth decade

b4-045-s006.gloss: 我们中有人早逝，少数人则能活到第九或第十个十年。
b4-045-s006.whyLearn: 两个 will 分句对比不同寿命，破折号后用介词短语延伸寿命长度，写人口统计类句子可直接套用。

modifiers.text: Though the doctor did his best

b3-029-s016.gloss: 尽管医生尽了力，病人恢复得仍很慢。
b3-029-s016.whyLearn: Though 引导让步从句置前，主句用过去时；do one's best 与所有格 his 一并记住。

b3-029-s017.skeleton: the man still had his right leg in plaster
b3-029-s017.gloss: 圣诞那天，那人右腿仍打着石膏。
b3-029-s017.whyLearn: 时间状语可置句首，have + 宾语 + in plaster 表状态，his right leg 练所有格。

modifiers.text: that his chances of being able to leave hospital in time for New Year celebrations were good
of being able to leave hospital in time for New Year celebrations

b3-029-s019.gloss: 医生安慰他，说他仍有望及时出院过年。
b3-029-s019.whyLearn: 一句串起介词加动名词、宾语从句和不定式，学写 chances of doing sth. are good。

b3-029-s020.skeleton: he was able to hobble along to a party
b3-029-s020.gloss: 他振作起来，除夕果然能一瘸一拐去赴会。
b3-029-s020.whyLearn: and 连接两个过去动作，sure enough 作插入语，be able to 后接不定式表做到。

b3-029-s021.skeleton: the man drank a little more than was good for him

modifiers.text: To compensate for his unpleasant experiences in hospital
more than was good for him

b3-029-s021.gloss: 为补偿住院的不快，他喝得有点过量。
b3-029-s021.whyLearn: 目的不定式开头，drank a little more than 引出比较从句，than 后省略了主语 it。

b3-029-s023.skeleton: He was still mumbling something about hospitals

modifiers.text: at the end of the party
when he slipped on a piece of ice and broke his left leg

b3-029-s023.gloss: 聚会结束时他正念叨医院，却滑倒摔断左腿。
b3-029-s023.whyLearn: 过去进行时铺背景，when 引出突发动作，滑倒与摔断两个过去式并列。

b3-030-s001.skeleton: villagers believed that Endley farm was haunted
b3-030-s001.gloss: 多年来村民都相信恩德利农场闹鬼。
b3-030-s001.whyLearn: believed that 引出宾语从句，haunted 是被动，可学村民传说的表达方式。

b3-030-s002.skeleton: The farm was owned by two brothers
b3-030-s002.gloss: 农场归两兄弟乔和伯特·考克斯所有。
b3-030-s002.whyLearn: 被动语态 was owned by 交代归属，句末同位语 Joe and Bert Cox 补充说明是谁。

b3-030-s003.skeleton: They employed a few farm hands

modifiers.text: but no one was willing to work there long

b3-030-s003.gloss: 他们雇了几个帮工，但没人愿意久留。
b3-030-s003.whyLearn: but 连接转折并列句，a few 与 be willing to do 都是高频搭配。

modifiers.text: Every time a worker gave up his job

b3-030-s004.gloss: 每当有工人辞职，他就讲同一套故事。
b3-030-s004.whyLearn: Every time 作连词引出时间状语从句，主句用过去时讲反复发生的事。

b3-030-s005.skeleton: Farm labourers said that they always woke up to find the work had been done overnight

modifiers.text: that they always woke up to find the work had been done overnight
to find the work had been done overnight
the work had been done overnight

b3-030-s005.gloss: 农夫说醒来总发现活儿夜里已经干完。
b3-030-s005.whyLearn: 宾语从句里套不定式和过去完成时被动，一句练三层结构。

modifiers.text: and cow sheds had been cleaned

b3-030-s006.gloss: 干草已割好，牛棚也已打扫干净。
b3-030-s006.whyLearn: 两个并列被动句用过去完成时，说明更早完成的动作，简短适合套用。

b3-030-s007.skeleton: A farm worker, who stayed up all night, claimed to have seen a figure

modifiers.text: to have seen a figure cutting corn in themoonlight

b3-030-s007.gloss: 一名熬通宵的农工称见过月下割麦的人影。
b3-030-s007.whyLearn: 定语从句插在主语后，claim to have done 表更早的动作，cutting 分词作定语。

b3-030-s011.skeleton: villagers were astonished to learn that the ghost of Endley had died

modifiers.text: to learn that the ghost of Endley had died
that the ghost of Endley had died

b3-030-s011.gloss: 不久前村民惊闻恩德利的鬼魂已经死去。
b3-030-s011.whyLearn: be astonished to learn that 是固定句式，that 从句用过去完成时讲更早的事。

modifiers.text: for the 'ghost' was none other than Eric Cox, a third brother who was supposed to have died as a young man
a third brother who was supposed to have died as a young man
who was supposed to have died as a young man
to have died as a young man

b3-030-s012.gloss: 大家都去了葬礼，因为鬼魂正是三弟埃里克。
b3-030-s012.whyLearn: for 引出原因并列句，none other than 表正是，同位语加定语从句补身份。

modifiers.text: which they had kept for over forty years

b3-030-s013.gloss: 葬礼之后，乔和伯特说出保守四十余年的秘密。
b3-030-s013.whyLearn: After 短语作时间状语，which 定语从句用过去完成时强调持续四十多年。

b3-055-s002.skeleton: Radio telescopes have one big advantage over conventional telescopes

modifiers.text: in that they can operate in all weather conditions and can pick up signals coming from very distant stars
and can pick up signals coming from very distant stars

b3-055-s002.gloss: 射电望远镜比普通望远镜有优势。
b3-055-s002.whyLearn: in that 引导原因状语从句说明优势在哪；两个 can 并列 operate 与 pick up，情态动词只出现一次。

modifiers.text: by colliding stars or nuclear reactions in outer space

b3-055-s003.gloss: 这些信号由恒星碰撞或核反应产生。
b3-055-s003.whyLearn: are produced 是被动语态一般现在时；by 后接动名词 colliding，or 并列两个来源，可整体替换。

b3-055-s005.skeleton: A better understanding of these phenomena may completely alter our conception of the nature of the universe

modifiers.text: of the nature of the universe

b3-055-s005.gloss: 更好的理解可能改变我们的宇宙观。
b3-055-s005.whyLearn: may alter 表可能性；连续 of 短语层层限定名词，如 the nature of the universe。

b3-055-s006.skeleton: The radio telescope at Jodrell Bank in England was for many years the largest in the world
b3-055-s006.gloss: 英格兰焦德雷尔班克的射电望远镜曾长期世界最大。
b3-055-s006.whyLearn: 主语后和 was 后各插一个介词短语，先跳过状语抓住 was the largest 的骨架，最高级前用 the。

b3-055-s007.skeleton: A new telescope, over twice the size, was recently built

modifiers.text: at Sugar Grove in West Virginia

b3-055-s007.gloss: 西弗吉尼亚新建了一台两倍大的望远镜。
b3-055-s007.whyLearn: over twice the size 是同位语，补充说明尺寸；was built 是被动语态，过去分词在此不作定语。

b3-055-s009.skeleton: This possibility gives rise to interesting speculations
b3-055-s009.gloss: 这种可能性引出有趣的猜测。
b3-055-s009.whyLearn: give rise to 是固定搭配，这里的 to 是介词而非不定式，后接名词，别按 want to do 去理解。

b3-055-s010.skeleton: Highly advanced civilizations may have existed on other planets

modifiers.text: long before intelligent forms of life evolved on the earth

b3-055-s010.gloss: 高度发达的文明可能早于地球生命存在。
b3-055-s010.whyLearn: may have existed 用情态动词加完成式推测过去；long before 引导时间状语从句，对比两条时间线。

b3-055-s012.skeleton: Such speculations no longer belong to the realm of science fiction

modifiers.text: for astronomers are now exploring the chances of communicating with living creatures (if they exist) on distant planets
of communicating with living creatures (if they exist) on distant planets

b3-055-s012.gloss: 这类猜测已不再属于科幻。
b3-055-s012.whyLearn: no longer 表今昔对比的否定；for 引出原因分句；of 后接动名词 communicating，括号里是插入条件。

b3-055-s013.skeleton: This undertaking which has been named Project Ozma was begun

modifiers.text: which has been named Project Ozma
, but it may take a great many years before results are obtained

b3-055-s013.gloss: 该项目1960年启动，但要多年才有结果。
b3-055-s013.whyLearn: which 引导定语从句并用现在完成时被动；主句 was begun 是过去被动；but 后 before 引出时间状语从句。

b3-055-s016.skeleton: we would have to wait twenty-two years

modifiers.text: If signals from the earth were received by intelligent creatures on a planet circling thisstar
by intelligent creatures on a planet circling thisstar

b3-055-s016.gloss: 若外星人收到地球信号，回信要等22年。
b3-055-s016.whyLearn: 虚拟条件句：if 从句用过去被动 were received，主句用 would 加动词；circling 作后置定语修饰 planet。

b3-055-s017.skeleton: The Green Bank telescope in West Virginia has been specially designed

modifiers.text: to distinguish between random signals and signals which might be in code
between random signals and signals which might be in code

b3-055-s017.gloss: 绿岸望远镜专门用来分辨两种信号。
b3-055-s017.whyLearn: has been designed 是现在完成时被动，to distinguish 表目的，between 的宾语还带 which 从句。

modifiers.text: as this is theonly truly universal language

b3-055-s019.gloss: 他们会用数学，因为数学是通用语言。
b3-055-s019.whyLearn: would use 在过去语境里表推测的将来；as 此处等于 because，引导原因状语从句，别读成“作为”。

b3-055-s020.skeleton: Numbers have the same value anywhere
b3-055-s020.gloss: 数字在任何地方含义都相同。
b3-055-s020.whyLearn: the same value anywhere 用最简结构讲普遍真理；anywhere 把范围扩大到所有地方，可换 everywhere。

b3-055-s021.skeleton: intelligent creatures in any part of the universe would be able to understand a simple arithmetical sequence

modifiers.text: in any part of the universe
to understand a simple arithmetical sequence

b3-055-s021.gloss: 因此外星智慧也能看懂简单数列。
b3-055-s021.whyLearn: would be able to 加动词原形表能力；in any part of the universe 把主语范围放到最大。

b3-055-s022.skeleton: They would be able to reply to our signals
b3-055-s022.gloss: 他们能用类似方法回复我们的信号。
b3-055-s022.whyLearn: using similar methods 是分词短语作方式状语，相当于 by using；reply to 是固定搭配。

b3-055-s023.skeleton: The next step would be to try to develop means

modifiers.text: to try to develop means for sending television pictures

b3-055-s023.gloss: 下一步是设法传送电视图像。
b3-055-s023.whyLearn: would be to do 用不定式作表语说明下一步打算；try to develop 之后又用 for 加动名词 sending。

b3-012-s012.skeleton: They quickly loaded a small rubber dinghy with food, matches, and tins of beer and rowed for a few miles across the Caribbean

modifiers.text: with food, matches, and tins of beer
until they arrived at a tiny coral island

b3-012-s012.gloss: 他们带上食物划船数英里，直到抵达小珊瑚岛。
b3-012-s012.whyLearn: 看清 and 连接 loaded 与 rowed 两个谓语，中间夹 with 短语，until 从句收尾。

b3-012-s014.skeleton: The men collected rain-water in the rubber dinghy.
b3-012-s014.gloss: 男人们用橡皮艇收集雨水。
b3-012-s014.whyLearn: 主谓宾加地点介词短语的干净骨架，in the dinghy 说明接雨水的容器。

modifiers.text: As they had brought a spear gun with them

b3-012-s015.gloss: 因带了鱼枪，他们有充足食物可吃。
b3-012-s015.whyLearn: as 引导原因状语从句用过去完成时，主句 had plenty to eat 中不定式作后置定语。

b3-012-s016.skeleton: They caught lobster and fish every day

modifiers.text: as one of them put it

b3-012-s016.gloss: 他们每天捕龙虾和鱼，自称吃得像国王。
b3-012-s016.whyLearn: 插入语 as one of them put it 把并列谓语隔开，是英语引述的常见写法。

b3-013-s001.skeleton: Mrs Richards sent her children t

modifiers.text: After her husband had gone to work

b3-013-s001.gloss: 丈夫上班后，理查兹太太打发孩子们出门。
b3-013-s001.whyLearn: after 从句用过去完成时表示更早动作，her 所有格与不定式 to work 同句出现。

b3-013-s002.skeleton: She was too excited to do any housework that morning

modifiers.text: for in the evening she would be going to a fancy dress party with her husband

b3-013-s002.gloss: 她太兴奋做不了家务，晚上要去化装舞会。
b3-013-s002.whyLearn: too...to 表否定结果，for 引出并列原因分句，would be going to 表过去将来。

b3-013-s003.skeleton: she was impatient to try it on

modifiers.text: She intended to dress up as a ghost
to dress up as a ghost
as she had made her costume the night before

b3-013-s003.gloss: 她打算扮鬼，因前夜做好戏服，急着试穿。
b3-013-s003.whyLearn: 两个并列分句都由不定式收尾，as 从句用过去完成时交代更早的准备。

modifiers.text: Though the costume consisted only of a sheet

b3-013-s004.gloss: 戏服虽只是一条床单，效果却很好。
b3-013-s004.whyLearn: though 引导让步从句，主句用 it 指代 costume，前后对比简洁有力。

b3-013-s005.gloss: 穿上戏服后，理查兹太太下楼。
b3-013-s005.whyLearn: after 后接动名词短语代替从句，put on 的宾语 it 须放中间。

b3-013-s008.skeleton: She knew that it must be the baker.

modifiers.text: that it must be the baker

b3-013-s008.gloss: 她知道那准是面包师傅。
b3-013-s008.whyLearn: 宾语从句用 must be 表肯定推测，注意从句保持陈述语序。

b3-013-s009.skeleton: She had told him to come straight in

modifiers.text: if ever she failed to open the door
and to leave the bread on the kitchen table

b3-013-s009.gloss: 她事先嘱咐他若开不了门就进屋，把面包放厨房桌。
b3-013-s009.whyLearn: told sb to do 接两个并列不定式，条件从句插在中间，信息层次清楚。

b3-013-s010.skeleton: Mrs Richards quickly hid in the small store-room under the stairs

modifiers.text: Not wanting to frighten the poor man
in the small store-room under the stairs

b3-013-s010.gloss: 为免吓到那人，理查兹太太躲进楼梯下储藏室。
b3-013-s010.whyLearn: 否定分词短语作原因状语，主句 hid 与 in/under 两个介词短语层层定位。

b3-013-s011.skeleton: She heard the front door open and heavy footsteps in the hall.

modifiers.text: the front door open and heavy footsteps in the hall

b3-013-s011.gloss: 她听见前门开了，门厅里响起沉重的脚步声。
b3-013-s011.whyLearn: hear 后接宾语加裸不定式 open 表动作全过程，与并列宾语结构对照。

b3-013-s012.skeleton: the door of the store-room was opened and a man entered
b3-013-s012.gloss: 储藏室门突然被打开，一个男人走了进来。
b3-013-s012.whyLearn: 并列句中主动被动对照：门用被动 was opened，人用主动 entered。

modifiers.text: that it must be the man from the Electricity Board who had come to read the meter
who had come to read the meter

b3-013-s013.gloss: 理查兹太太意识到那准是来抄表的电力局男子。
b3-013-s013.whyLearn: 宾语从句内嵌 who 定语从句，must be 表推测，had come 早于 realized。

b3-013-s014.skeleton: She tried to explain the situation
b3-013-s014.gloss: 她想解释情况，喊了句'是我'，但为时已晚。
b3-013-s014.whyLearn: saying 分词短语补充伴随动作，but 分句收束情节，节奏由缓变急。

b2-008-s001.skeleton: Joe Sanders has the most beautiful garden
b2-008-s001.gloss: 乔·桑德斯有我们镇上最美的花园
b2-008-s001.whyLearn: the most beautiful 前加the、后接in our town限定范围，是最高级完整框架的典型样板

b2-008-s002.skeleton: Nearly everybody enters for 'The Nicest Garden Competition' each year
b2-008-s002.gloss: 每年几乎人人参赛，但乔每次都赢
b2-008-s002.whyLearn: 最高级藏进比赛专名，but连接两个对照分句，一次看到两种常见写法

b2-008-s003.skeleton: Bill Frith's garden is larger than Joe's.
b2-008-s003.whyLearn: 比较级后用Joe's代替Joe's garden，名词所有格省去重复名词，是地道省略

b2-008-s004.skeleton: Bill works harder than Joe and grows more flowers and vegetables

modifiers.text: but Joe's garden is more interesting

b2-008-s004.gloss: 比尔干得更勤、种得更多，园子却不如乔的有趣
b2-008-s004.whyLearn: 同句连用副词比较级harder与名词比较级more flowers，还靠but转折，位置看得清

b2-008-s005.skeleton: He has made neat paths and has built a wooden bridge
b2-008-s005.gloss: 他修了小径，还在池塘上搭了座木桥
b2-008-s005.whyLearn: has made与has built并列，第二个has可省，完成时并列写法的实用样本

b2-008-s007.skeleton: Every year I enter for the garden competition too

modifiers.text: and I always win a little prize for the worst garden in the town!
for the worst garden in the town

b2-008-s007.gloss: 我每年也参赛，还总拿最差花园的小奖
b2-008-s007.whyLearn: the worst与a little prize同句出现，看清最高级与数量修饰语怎样自然搭在一起

b2-009-s001.skeleton: we went to the Town Hall
b2-009-s001.gloss: 周三晚上我们去了市政厅
b2-009-s001.whyLearn: 时间状语提到句首加逗号，主干仍是主谓状，叙事文里状语位置的常见变体

b2-009-s002.skeleton: It was the last day of the year

modifiers.text: and a large crowd of people had gathered under the Town Hall clock

b2-009-s002.gloss: 那天是当年最后一天，市政厅钟下聚了很多人
b2-009-s002.whyLearn: was写背景、had gathered写更早动作，一句内体会过去两段时间的先后层次

b2-009-s003.skeleton: It would strike twelve in twenty minutes' time.
b2-009-s003.gloss: 它再过二十分钟就要敲响十二点
b2-009-s003.whyLearn: would加动词原形表过去将来，配in twenty minutes' time交代从现在起算的时间

b2-009-s004.gloss: 十五分钟过去，十一点五十五分时，钟停了
b2-009-s004.whyLearn: and then连接先后动作，时间状语插在中间加逗号，叙事节奏由此控制

b2-009-s005.skeleton: The big minute hand did not move.
b2-009-s005.whyLearn: did not后接动词原形构成过去否定，容易误加-ed，这句正好当反例记

b2-009-s006.gloss: 我们等了又等，却什么也没发生
b2-009-s006.whyLearn: 动词重复表持续等待，but nothing happened短促收尾，叙事张力一下就出来

b2-009-s007.gloss: 突然有人喊：十二点过两分了
b2-009-s007.whyLearn: 直接引语紧跟shouted，逗号后引号内独立成句，是引述话语的基本格式

b2-009-s011.skeleton: The big clock refused to welcome the New Year.
b2-009-s011.whyLearn: refuse后只接不定式作宾语，拟人写法让搭配记得牢，也顺便认识refuse用法

b2-009-s012.skeleton: everybody began to laugh and sing
b2-009-s012.gloss: 那一刻，大家开始又笑又唱
b2-009-s012.whyLearn: begin后接不定式，两个动词用and并列共用一个to，状语前置点出转折时刻

b2-010-s001.skeleton: We have an old musical instrument.
b2-010-s001.gloss: 我们有一件古老的乐器
b2-010-s001.whyLearn: 这里的have是实义动词表拥有，别和完成时的have加过去分词混起来

b2-053-s010.skeleton: A bird had snatched up the snake
b2-053-s010.gloss: 一只鸟抓起蛇，又把它丢到电线上。
b2-053-s010.whyLearn: 过去完成时 had snatched 交代更早的动作，与 dropped 形成先后顺序，是叙事事件链的典型句。

b2-053-s011.whyLearn: 反身代词 itself 表明动作回到主语，wound 与 round 搭配写蛇缠线，简单句也很有画面感。

b2-054-s001.skeleton: I sent the children to school and then I went to market
b2-054-s001.gloss: 早饭后我送孩子上学，然后去市场。
b2-054-s001.whyLearn: After breakfast 前置时间，两个一般过去时并列句按顺序推进，是写日常行程最省力的句式。

b2-054-s002.whyLearn: when 从句后置说明时间，主句用 it 指时间，still 强调早，比直接写 I returned home early 更自然。

b2-054-s003.skeleton: The children were at school, my husband was at work and the house was quiet
b2-054-s003.gloss: 孩子上学、丈夫上班，家里很安静。
b2-054-s003.whyLearn: 三个并列分句用逗号和 and 铺开，把全家去向一次交代完，是描写场景背景的实用排比。

b2-054-s004.gloss: 于是我决定做些茶点用的果馅饼。
b2-054-s004.whyLearn: decide to do 用不定式作宾语，for tea 点明用途，so 承接上文，因果衔接自然。

b2-054-s005.skeleton: I was busy mixing butter and flour

modifiers.text: and my hands were soon covered with sticky pastry

b2-054-s005.gloss: 很快我忙着和面，两手沾满黏面团。
b2-054-s005.whyLearn: be busy doing 省略介词，be covered with 表状态，and 把动作与结果串成一句，信息密度高。

b2-054-s006.whyLearn: At exactly that moment 用 exactly 强化时间点，短促主句制造转折，是引入意外的好开头。

b2-054-s007.skeleton: Nothing could have been more annoying.
b2-054-s007.gloss: 再没有比这更烦人的了。
b2-054-s007.whyLearn: 否定词加比较级表达最高级含义，could have been 表推测语气，比一般过去时更有情绪。

modifiers.text: when I recognized the voice of Mrs Bates

b2-054-s008.gloss: 我用沾满黏糊的手指接电话，听出是贝茨太太就慌了。
b2-054-s008.whyLearn: was dismayed 用形容词表被动感受，when 从句揭出原因，手指黏糊的细节让狼狈更真实。

b2-054-s010.whyLearn: At last 收束一段麻烦，hang up 是电话场景固定短语，短句给出叙事终点。

modifiers.text: and he wanted me to sign for a registered letter
to sign for a registered letter

b2-054-s014.gloss: 这次是邮差，他要我签收挂号信！
b2-054-s014.whyLearn: want sb to do 复合结构，sign for 表签收，并列分句加感叹号写出被打扰两次的无奈。

b2-055-s001.skeleton: Dreams of finding lost treasure almost came true
b2-055-s001.whyLearn: of 后接动名词 finding 作宾语，主语被介词短语拉长，come true 是固定搭配。

b2-055-s004.skeleton: The pirates would often bury gold

modifiers.text: and then fail to collect it

b2-055-s004.gloss: 海盗常把金子埋在洞里，后来却没收走。
b2-055-s004.whyLearn: would 表过去习惯，bury 与 fail to collect 用 and 并列，then 点出徒劳的结局。

b2-055-s005.skeleton: a search party went into the cave
b2-055-s005.gloss: 考察队带着新机器进洞，期望找到宝藏。
b2-055-s005.whyLearn: 句首过去分词 Armed 作状语表状态，句尾现在分词 hoping 表伴随目的，首尾呼应。

b2-055-s007.gloss: 大家非常兴奋，挖了个两英尺深的洞。
b2-055-s007.whyLearn: 形容词短语 Very excited 前置说明状态，two feet deep 用名词表度量，比从句更简洁。

b3-046-s007.skeleton: Such things provide an excellent outlet for pent-up creative energy

modifiers.text: but unfortunately not all of us are born handymen

b3-046-s007.gloss: 这类爱好给无处释放的创造力提供出口。
b3-046-s007.whyLearn: but 并列两个分句，前句肯定爱好的价值，后句用 not all of us 部分否定转折，写法实用。

b3-046-s009.skeleton: Even husbands who can hardly drive a nail in straight are supposed to be born electricians, carpenters, plumbers and mechanics.

modifiers.text: who can hardly drive a nail in straight
to be born electricians, carpenters, plumbers and mechanics

b3-046-s009.gloss: 连钉子都钉不直的丈夫也被当成天生多面手。
b3-046-s009.whyLearn: who 定语从句插在主语后，be supposed to 表公认看法，句尾名词并列铺陈，讽刺语气靠结构撑起。

b3-046-s013.skeleton: my wife suggested that I call in a man

modifiers.text: that I call in a man to look at our lawn-mower

b3-046-s013.gloss: 去年春天，妻子建议我请人看割草机。
b3-046-s013.whyLearn: suggest that 后从句用原形 call，不随主句时态变化；call in 与 look at 两个短语动词顺带记住。

b3-046-s015.skeleton: I would not hear of the suggestion

modifiers.text: and said that I would fix it myself
that I would fix it myself

b3-046-s015.gloss: 我不听这个建议，说我自己能修好。
b3-046-s015.whyLearn: would not hear of 是坚决不答应的固定说法；said 后从句用 would fix 表过去将来，注意时态呼应。

b3-046-s016.skeleton: I hauled the machine into the garden

modifiers.text: and had a close look at it

b3-046-s016.gloss: 周六下午我把机器拖进花园仔细查看。
b3-046-s016.whyLearn: haul 写出费力搬动，have a close look at 比 look at 更有仪式感，and 并列两个过去式谓语推进情节。

b3-046-s018.skeleton: the repair job was not quite so simple.
b3-046-s018.gloss: 结果这项修理工作远没有那么简单。
b3-046-s018.whyLearn: not quite so simple 是委婉否定，暗示麻烦远超预期；Inevitably 放句首预告坏结果。

b3-046-s019.skeleton: The mower firmly refused to mow

modifiers.text: so I decided to dismantle it

b3-046-s019.gloss: 割草机死活不肯割，我决定拆了它。
b3-046-s019.whyLearn: refuse to do 把割草机拟人化，firmly 更添幽默；so 引出结果，decide to do 交代下一步动作。

b3-046-s020.skeleton: The garden was soon littered with chunks of metal

modifiers.text: which had once made up a lawn-mower

b3-046-s020.gloss: 花园很快散落着一堆金属零件。
b3-046-s020.whyLearn: be littered with 生动写出满地狼藉；which 从句用过去完成时点明这些零件原本是一台割草机。

b3-046-s021.skeleton: But I was extremely pleased with myself

modifiers.text: I had traced the cause of the trouble

b3-046-s021.gloss: 我为自己找到了故障原因而得意。
b3-046-s021.whyLearn: be pleased with 表自我得意；后半句省略 that 的宾语从句用过去完成时交代已查明的故障原因。

b3-046-s023.skeleton: I was faced with the insurmountable task of putting the confusing jigsaw puzzle together again

modifiers.text: of putting the confusing jigsaw puzzle together again

b3-046-s023.gloss: 换了新链条后，我要把拆散的零件装回去。
b3-046-s023.whyLearn: be faced with 表面临难题；after 与 of 后都接动名词，insurmountable 一词点出任务之难。

b3-046-s026.gloss: 几个星期过去，草越长越高。
b3-046-s026.whyLearn: 两个极短分句并列，时间流逝与问题积累同时推进，越简单越显无奈，是叙事收束的好句式。

b3-046-s028.skeleton: our house is now surrounded by a jungle.
b3-046-s028.gloss: 不用说，我家现在被丛林包围了。
b3-046-s028.whyLearn: Needless to say 是惯用插入语放句首；is surrounded by 被动语态把荒草夸张成 jungle，自嘲幽默。

b3-047-s001.skeleton: Satellites orbiting round the earth have provided scien
b3-047-s001.gloss: 绕地飞行的卫星为科学提供了大量信息。
b3-047-s001.whyLearn: orbiting 是现在分词作后置定语，等于 which orbit；have provided 用现在完成时强调至今积累的成果。

b3-047-s002.skeleton: relatively little is known about the internal structure of the earth.

modifiers.text: about the internal structure of the earth

b3-047-s002.gloss: 相比之下，人们对地球内部结构了解很少。
b3-047-s002.whyLearn: By comparison 引出对比对象；little 作主语本身带否定意味，is known 用被动，是典型的学术表述。

modifiers.text: to go up than to go down

b3-047-s003.gloss: 事实证明，往上走比往下走容易。
b3-047-s003.whyLearn: it 作形式主语，真正主语是后面的不定式；than 连接两个平行不定式构成比较，结构紧凑。

b3-047-s004.skeleton: The deepest hole ever to bebored on land went down 25,340 feet-- considerably less than the height of Mount Everest.

modifiers.text: considerably less than the height of Mount Everest

b3-047-s004.gloss: 陆上最深钻孔深25340英尺，不及珠峰高。
b3-047-s004.whyLearn: 最高级后用不定式作后置定语；破折号引出比较短语，把抽象数字与珠峰对比，数据句写法值得模仿。

modifiers.text: and it was fitted with great difficulty

b3-025-s014.gloss: 船员在船上用备用木板临时做了舵，装上十分费力。
b3-025-s014.whyLearn: 一句里两个被动句由 and 并列，介词短语补充材料与地点，可学被动语态连用的写法。

b3-025-s017.skeleton: the captain called in at a port to have a new rudder fitted

modifiers.text: but by now the Thermopylae was over five hundred miles ahead

b3-025-s017.gloss: 过赤道后船长靠港装新舵，对手已领先五百多英里。
b3-025-s017.whyLearn: After + doing 作时间状语，have sth done 表请人装舵，再用 but 转折点出对手领先，是比赛叙事的典型句。

b3-025-s019.gloss: 她抵达英国比 Thermopylae 号晚了一周。
b3-025-s019.whyLearn: arrive in 后接大地点，a week after + 名词表示比对方晚一周，是比赛结果对照的简洁表达。

modifiers.text: considering that she had had so many delays

b3-025-s020.gloss: 考虑到她曾多次延误，这成绩已很了不起。
b3-025-s020.whyLearn: considering that 引出理由，主句用过去时、从句用过去完成时 had had，可看清两个时点的时间层次。

b3-026-s001.gloss: 没有人能避免被广告影响。
b3-026-s001.whyLearn: avoid 后只能接动名词，这里用 being influenced 把动名词与被动语态叠在一起，是常考搭配要点。

b3-026-s002.skeleton: we are no longer free to choose the things we want

modifiers.text: Much as we may pride ourselves on our good taste
for advertising exerts a subtle influence on us

b3-026-s002.gloss: 尽管自以为品味高，我们选什么已受广告左右。
b3-026-s002.whyLearn: Much as 引导让步状语从句相当于 although，主句用 be free to do，for 再引出原因，一句含三层逻辑。

b3-026-s003.skeleton: advertisers have made a close study of human nature and have classified all our little weaknesses

modifiers.text: In their efforts to persuade us to buy this or that product

b3-026-s003.gloss: 广告商为劝人买东西，研究人性并归类我们的弱点。
b3-026-s003.whyLearn: In one's efforts to do 表目的，后面两个现在完成时并列谓语共用一个主语，可学多谓语并列的写法。

modifiers.text: that all of us love to get something for nothing

b3-026-s004.gloss: 广告商早就发现人人都爱白得好处。
b3-026-s004.whyLearn: discover 后接 that 宾语从句，从句里 love to do 再接 for nothing 表不花钱，是层层嵌套的典型。

modifiers.text: which begins with themagic word FREE

b3-026-s005.gloss: 带“免费”字样的广告几乎不会失败。
b3-026-s005.whyLearn: 定语从句插在主语与谓语之间，去掉从句即可看出 can rarely go wrong 的主干，可练还原主干。

modifiers.text: which will enable us to win huge sums of money

b3-026-s007.gloss: 他们设计许多比赛，让我们有机会赢得大钱。
b3-026-s007.whyLearn: which 从句里再套 enable sb to do 与一般将来时，可学定语从句内带复合结构的写法。

b3-026-s010.skeleton: They offered to pay $2 a pound for the biggest biscuit
b3-026-s010.gloss: 他们出价两美元一磅收购听众烤的最大饼干。
b3-026-s010.whyLearn: offer 后接不定式，最高级 the biggest biscuit 后用过去分词短语作后置定语，考试中容易漏看。

b3-026-s011.whyLearn: response to 是固定搭配，介词短语作后置定语把主语与系动词隔开，可练主系表结构的辨认。

b3-026-s012.gloss: 不久各种形状大小的饼干开始送到工厂。
b3-026-s012.whyLearn: Before long 是“不久”而非“很久以前”，begin doing 表开始做，介词短语插在主语后作定语。

b3-026-s013.skeleton: One lady brought in a biscuit
b3-026-s013.gloss: 一位女士用独轮车推来一块饼干。
b3-026-s013.whyLearn: bring in 表带进来，句末介词短语说明方式，是用词简单却画面感强的叙述句。

b3-026-s015.skeleton: a man came along with a biscuit

modifiers.text: which occupied the whole boot of his car

b3-026-s015.gloss: 稍后一位男士带来占满后备箱的饼干。
b3-026-s015.whyLearn: come along with 表带着某物出现，定语从句里用 the whole boot of his car 的说法表所属。

b3-026-s016.gloss: 所有寄来的饼干都被仔细称重。
b3-026-s016.whyLearn: 先行词是 all 时定语从句用 that 而非 which，配合被动语态与副词修饰，属易错考点。

modifiers.text: she had just made a new film.

b1-067-s014.gloss: 她说自己刚拍完一部新电影。
b1-067-s014.whyLearn: told 后接宾语从句，从句用过去完成时表示早于 told 的动作，正好练会"过去的过去"这一层时态。

modifiers.text: she felt very tired and didn't want to make another film for a long time.

b1-067-s017.gloss: 她告诉记者自己很累，很久不想再拍片。
b1-067-s017.whyLearn: 一个宾语从句里并列两个谓语，didn't want 后接不定式 to make，还带 for a long time 后置，一句练三样。

b1-068-s001.skeleton: Are you really going to retire
b1-068-s001.gloss: 记者问马什小姐是否真打算退休。
b1-068-s001.whyLearn: be going to + 动词原形表打算，一般现在时提问把 are 提前，句尾称呼语用逗号隔开，是采访提问的常见语序。

b1-068-s004.skeleton: I shall have to ask my future husband.
b1-068-s004.gloss: 我得问问我未来的丈夫。
b1-068-s004.whyLearn: shall have to 表示将来不得不，比 must 更口语；my future husband 这个所有格短语也很实用，值得整句记下。

b1-068-s005.skeleton: He won't let me make another film.
b1-068-s005.whyLearn: won't let sb do sth 是高频使役搭配，let 后接不带 to 的动词原形，可与 allow sb to do 对比记忆。

b1-068-s006.gloss: 记者反问：你未来的丈夫？
b1-068-s006.whyLearn: 名词所有格 your future husband 点明关系，这里只用名词短语加问号构成省略式追问，是口语里最省力的回应方式。

b1-068-s008.whyLearn: 祈使句 Let me do sth 用于当场介绍，introduce A to B 的介词搭配固定，是社交场合最常用的一句。

b1-068-s012.gloss: 这有一篇关于卡伦·马什的报道。
b1-068-s012.whyLearn: Here's 是 Here is 的缩写，用来引出新信息；about 短语后置修饰 report，可对比中文定语的语序差异。

b1-068-s014.gloss: 今天在伦敦的酒店，马什小姐告诉记者她可能退休。
b1-068-s014.whyLearn: 地点时间状语整块提到句首，主句后接宾语从句，might retire 用情态动词表不确定，一句覆盖三个考点。

modifiers.text: she would have to ask her future husband

b1-068-s016.gloss: 她说她得问问她未来的丈夫。
b1-068-s016.whyLearn: 间接引语把 will have to 改成 would have to，从句里再套 have to 加不定式，时态后移一步就能听懂新闻转述。

modifiers.text: her future husband would not let her make another film

b1-068-s017.gloss: 她说她未来的丈夫不让她再拍电影。
b1-068-s017.whyLearn: 转述时 won't 变 would not，从句中 let sb do sth 仍用原形，是间接引语里"情态动词后移"的标准样板。

b1-068-s018.skeleton: she introduced us to Carlos and told us

modifiers.text: they would get married next week

b1-068-s018.gloss: 她把我们介绍给卡洛斯，还说他们下周结婚。
b1-068-s018.whyLearn: introduced 与 told 两个并列谓语共用一个主语，后一宾语从句用过去将来时，练叙事里的并列与时态呼应。

b1-068-s019.gloss: 米莉说：那真是轰动的新闻，对吧，凯特？
b1-068-s019.whyLearn: 反意疑问句 isn't it 用来求认同，前面肯定陈述配后面否定短问，称呼 Kate 置尾，是闲聊八卦的典型口气。

b1-069-s001.skeleton: Are you doing the football pools
b1-069-s001.gloss: 琼问：你在玩足球彩票吗？
b1-069-s001.whyLearn: 现在进行时提问眼下正在做的事，football pools 是英国文化词，口语里说 the football pools 才算地道。

b1-069-s003.gloss: 布赖恩说：是的，我快做完了，琼。
b1-069-s003.whyLearn: 现在完成时 I've finished 加 nearly 表接近完成，副词插在助动词与过去分词之间，位置放错就变味。

modifiers.text: we will win something this week

b1-069-s004.gloss: 我相信我们这周会赢点什么。
b1-069-s004.whyLearn: I'm sure 后接省略 that 的从句，will win 表将来，something 与 this week 搭配，是预测的常用框架。

b2-039-s004.skeleton: Mr Gilbert said he was inquiring about a certain patient

modifiers.text: When the doctor answered the phone

b2-039-s004.gloss: 医生接电话时，吉尔伯特先生说他在询问一位病人。
b2-039-s004.whyLearn: 主句said后接宾语从句，从句用过去进行时表当时正在进行的动作，句末同位语补充病人身份。

b2-039-s006.skeleton: He then asked when Mr Gilbert would be allowed to go home and the doctor told him

modifiers.text: when Mr Gilbert would be allowed to go home
that he would have to stay in hospital for another two weeks

b2-039-s006.gloss: 他问吉尔伯特何时能出院，医生答需再住院两周。
b2-039-s006.whyLearn: 一句里连用两个宾语从句，间接疑问句用陈述语序，被动与情态表达许可，是转述对话的好范例。

b2-040-s015.skeleton: I asked her whether she was enjoying her dinner

modifiers.text: whether she was enjoying her dinner

b2-040-s015.gloss: 绝望中我问她晚饭吃得是否开心。
b2-040-s015.whyLearn: 介词短语In despair前置点出心情，whether引导的间接疑问句保持陈述语序，是转述疑问的典范。

b2-042-s003.skeleton: he picked up a long pipe

modifiers.text: As soon as he saw us
and opened one of the baskets

b2-042-s003.gloss: 他一见我们就拿起镶满硬币的长管并打开篮子。
b2-042-s003.whyLearn: as soon as引导时间状语从句，主句用and连接两个连续动作，中间插入被动定语从句，叙事节奏清晰。

b2-043-s003.skeleton: Byrd, successfully flew over the South Pole
b2-043-s003.gloss: 伯德成功飞越南极，这是第一次。
b2-043-s003.whyLearn: 逗号隔开主语与谓语，successfully直接修饰动词，for the first time点明首次，句式简洁有力。

b2-043-s004.skeleton: they soon ran into serious trouble

modifiers.text: Though, at first, Byrd and his men were able to take a great many photographs of the mountains that lay below

b2-043-s004.gloss: 起初他们还能拍下群山照片，很快就遇上麻烦。
b2-043-s004.whyLearn: Though引导让步从句置前，主句soon ran into形成转折；a great many与that定语从句叠加，信息密度高。

modifiers.text: that he would be able to reach the South Pole which was 300 miles away
for there were no more mountains in sight

b2-043-s009.gloss: 伯德知道能到南极了，前方再无山影。
b2-043-s009.whyLearn: knew后接that宾语从句表心理活动，从句内嵌which定语从句与for原因分句，展示多层从句的挂接方式。

b2-044-s001.skeleton: Mrs Anne Sterling did not think of the risk

modifiers.text: when she ran through a forest after two men

b2-044-s001.gloss: 斯特林太太没想风险，就穿过森林追那两人。
b2-044-s001.whyLearn: think of后用省略关系词的定语从句she was taking，句尾when从句交代追赶背景，一次看清嵌套与时间状语。

b2-044-s004.gloss: 斯特林太太气得追了上去。
b2-044-s004.whyLearn: so...that结构把愤怒与追赶的结果一线串起，that从句前不加逗号，是描述因果结果的常用口语句式。

modifiers.text: When she caught up with them
that they had sat down and were going through the contents of the bag
so she ran straight at them

b2-044-s006.gloss: 她追上后见他们翻包，便直冲过去。
b2-044-s006.whyLearn: when从句先设场景，saw后宾语从句用过去完成与过去进行并列，句末so引出果断动作，长句层次分明。

b2-044-s007.skeleton: The men got such a fright

modifiers.text: that they dropped the bag and ran away

b2-044-s007.gloss: 那两人吓坏了，丢下包就跑。
b2-044-s007.whyLearn: such a fright that与so...that同源却接名词，that从句用两个并列动词写出一连串动作，口语感强。

modifiers.text: that the wallet must have been found by one of the villagers
but it was not returned to him

b2-045-s003.gloss: 萨姆确信钱包是被村民捡到的，却没人还他。
b2-045-s003.whyLearn: be sure that接宾语从句，must have been found是情态推测加被动，but转折点出钱包未还。

b2-045-s005.skeleton: It had been wrapped up in newspaper and it contained half the money

modifiers.text: together with a note which said: 'A thief, yes, 'but only 5o per cent a thief!'
which said: 'A thief, yes, 'but only 5o per cent a thief!'

b2-045-s005.gloss: 钱包用报纸包着，还回一半钱和一张字条。
b2-045-s005.whyLearn: and连接两个并列分句，前句用过去完成被动交代状态，后句以together with引出字条，which定语从句点出留言内容。

b2-046-s006.skeleton: He was so surprised at being discovered

modifiers.text: that he did not even try to run away

b2-046-s006.gloss: 发现自己被认出，他惊得连逃跑都没试。
b2-046-s006.whyLearn: so...that结果句；at后接被动动名词being discovered，从句用did not even try to强化否定。

b2-047-s003.skeleton: He told me that he could not go to sleep one night

modifiers.text: because he heard a strange noise coming from the bar

b2-047-s003.gloss: 他说有天夜里睡不着，因为听见酒吧传来怪声。
b2-047-s003.whyLearn: told me后that宾语从句表转述，because从句交代原因，现在分词coming from the bar后置修饰noise。

modifiers.text: when it is impossible for you to answer

b2-048-s001.gloss: 牙医总在你无法作答时提问。
b2-048-s001.whyLearn: when状语从句后置，it is impossible for you to answer用it作形式主语，说出看牙的无奈。

modifiers.text: As its composition and line reminded him of an Italian painting he knew well,

b3-034-s019.gloss: 画作构图与线条让他想起熟悉的意大利画，他决定买下
b3-034-s019.whyLearn: As 引导原因状语从句，remind sb of sth 引出联想，decided 后用不定式表决定；可换主语与指代物

b3-034-s020.gloss: 画商匆匆一瞥，告知他这画值五英镑
b3-034-s020.whyLearn: Glancing 分词短语作状语表伴随动作，told 后接 that 宾语从句，be worth 后直接加金额

b3-034-s021.skeleton: Frank could hardly conceal his excitement

modifiers.text: for he knew that he had made a real discovery.
that he had made a real discovery

b3-034-s021.gloss: 弗兰克难掩兴奋，因为他知道自己有了重大发现
b3-034-s021.whyLearn: could hardly 表几乎不能，for 引并列分句说原因，knew 后用过去完成时表更早的动作

b3-034-s022.skeleton: The tiny painting proved to be an unknown masterpiece by Correggio

modifiers.text: and was worth thousands of pounds.

b3-034-s022.gloss: 小画竟是科雷乔的佚名杰作，值数千英镑
b3-034-s022.whyLearn: proved to be 表结果是，与 was worth 并列共享过去时，worth 后直接接金额

b3-035-s001.skeleton: The word justice is usually associated with courts of law
b3-035-s001.gloss: 正义一词通常与法院联系在一起
b3-035-s001.whyLearn: be associated with 是固定被动搭配表关联，usually 插在 be 与过去分词之间

modifiers.text: when a man's innocence or guilt has been proved beyond doubt.

b3-035-s002.gloss: 我们可说，当罪行或清白被证实，正义便已实现
b3-035-s002.whyLearn: might say 弱化断言，that 从句内嵌 when 时间从句，两处都用现在完成时被动

b3-035-s003.skeleton: Justice is part of the complex machinery of the law.

modifiers.text: of the complex machinery of the law

b3-035-s003.gloss: 正义是法律复杂机器的一部分
b3-035-s003.whyLearn: be part of 表所属的一部分，of 介词短语层层后置界定 machinery

b3-035-s005.skeleton: Judges, however wise or eminent, are human
b3-035-s005.gloss: 法官无论多贤明，也是人，也会犯错
b3-035-s005.whyLearn: however 加形容词构成让步插入语插在主语后，are human 与 can make mistakes 并列

b3-035-s007.gloss: 奖惩的实施不受人的干预
b3-035-s007.whyLearn: or 连接并列主语配复数谓语 are，be out 表公布实施，independent of 说明不受影响

b3-035-s008.skeleton: justice acts like a living force.
b3-035-s008.gloss: 此时，正义像一股活生生的力量
b3-035-s008.whyLearn: act like 表表现得像，At such times 作时间状语点出语境，可换成其他比喻

b3-035-s011.skeleton: The shop was an old-fashioned one

modifiers.text: with many large, disused fireplaces and tall, narrow chimneys.
many large, disused fireplaces and tall, narrow chimneys

b3-035-s011.gloss: 那家店很老派，有许多废弃壁炉和细高烟囱
b3-035-s011.whyLearn: one 代指 shop 避免重复，with 短语补充陈设，内部并列形容词加名词

b3-035-s013.skeleton: she ran to tell the manager

modifiers.text: As the cry was repeated several times,
who promptly rang up the fire-brigade.

b3-035-s013.gloss: 叫声一再响起，她跑去告诉经理，经理立刻报火警
b3-035-s013.whyLearn: As 引导时间状语从句用被动，to tell 表目的，who 定语从句接续经理的动作

b3-035-s014.skeleton: The cry had certainly come from one of the chimneys

modifiers.text: but as there were so many of them, the firemen could not be certain which one it was.
as there were so many of them,

b3-035-s014.gloss: 叫声来自某个烟囱，但烟囱太多，消防员无法确定是哪个
b3-035-s014.whyLearn: had come 表更早发生，but 转折分句内嵌 as 原因从句与 which 宾语从句，could not be certain 表无法确定

modifiers.text: by tapping at the walls and listening for the man's cries.
tapping at the walls and listening for the man's cries

b3-035-s015.gloss: 他们敲墙并听呼救声，确定了正确的烟囱
b3-035-s015.whyLearn: by 加动名词表方式，两个 -ing 并列共用 by，located 后接具体宾语

modifiers.text: After chipping through a wall which was eighteen inches thick,
that a man had been trapped in the chimney.

b3-035-s016.gloss: 凿穿十八英寸厚的墙后，他们发现有人被困烟囱
b3-035-s016.whyLearn: After 加动名词表时间，内含 which 定语从句补充墙厚，found 后从句用过去完成时被动

b3-035-s017.skeleton: the man was unable to move

modifiers.text: but the firemen were eventually able to free him by cutting a huge hole in the wall.
by cutting a huge hole in the wall.

b3-035-s017.gloss: 烟囱极窄他动不了，消防员最终凿洞救出他
b3-035-s017.whyLearn: As 引导原因从句解释受困理由，was unable to 与 were able to 对比，by 加动名词表解救方式

b2-086-s003.skeleton: Both men had hardly had time to realize what was happening

modifiers.text: when they were thrown violent1y into the sea

b2-086-s003.gloss: 两人才刚明白发生了什么就被抛入海中。
b2-086-s003.whyLearn: had hardly…when 表「刚……就……」，里面还嵌宾语从句和被动语态，一句练三个点。

b2-086-s009.skeleton: they swam on as quickly as they could

modifiers.text: because they knew that the boat would soon return
that the boat would soon return

b2-086-s009.gloss: 船过去后他们拼命快游，因为知道船还会回来。
b2-086-s009.whyLearn: 时间、原因两个状语从句夹一个宾语从句，还有 as…as one could 表「尽力」的写法。

modifiers.text: At the time the murder was committed

b2-087-s001.gloss: 凶案发生时我正坐在8路车上。
b2-087-s001.whyLearn: at the time 交代时间背景，被动语态说事件、过去进行时说自己在场，是不在场证明的经典句式。

b2-089-s007.skeleton: Those who failed to get in need not have felt disappointed

modifiers.text: as many of the artistes who should have appeared did not come

b2-089-s007.gloss: 没进场的人本不必失望，很多演员根本没来。
b2-089-s007.whyLearn: need not have done 表「本来不必做」，配两个定语从句和 as 原因从句，可辨虚拟与推测。

modifiers.text: As soon as he opened his mouth

b2-089-s010.gloss: 他一开口，大家就哄堂大笑。
b2-089-s010.whyLearn: as soon as 表「一……就……」，主句用 burst out doing 写瞬间反应，讲故事可直接套用。

b2-090-s002.skeleton: the Brazilian government decided to have a new city built

modifiers.text: It was mainly for this reason that
to have a new city built 600 miles north-west of Rio de Janeiro
600 miles north-west of Rio de Janeiro

b2-090-s002.gloss: 正因如此，巴西政府决定另建新都。
b2-090-s002.whyLearn: It was…that 强调句把原因状语提到焦点，have sth done 表「让人建造」，适合仿写强调原因。

b2-091-s002.skeleton: He informed the station at once

modifiers.text: but no one there was able to explain the mystery

b2-091-s002.gloss: 他立刻报告车站，却没人能解释这谜团。
b2-091-s002.whyLearn: but 并列两个分句形成对比，be able to do 强调过去某一次的具体能力，比 can 更实。

b2-091-s003.skeleton: The officer in the control tower was very angry

modifiers.text: because balloons can be a great danger to aircraft

b2-091-s003.gloss: 控制塔官员听到消息很生气，因气球危及飞机。
b2-091-s003.whyLearn: 主句先立态度，再挂时间、原因两个状语从句交代来龙去脉，描写加说理一步到位。

b2-092-s002.skeleton: I got a ladder from the shed in the garden, put it against the wall, and began climbing towards the bedroom window

modifiers.text: I tried to wake up my wife by ringing the door-bell
from the shed in the garden

b2-092-s002.gloss: 叫不醒妻子，我搬来梯子爬向卧室窗。
b2-092-s002.whyLearn: but…so…串起三个并列谓语，by doing 表方式，动作链一气呵成，可学叙事节奏。

b2-092-s008.skeleton: I hate to interrupt a man

modifiers.text: but would you mind coming with me to the station ?'

b2-092-s008.gloss: 本不想打扰，但能请你跟我去趟警局吗？
b2-092-s008.whyLearn: would you mind doing 是礼貌请求的固定句式，前面用 when 从句铺垫，客气又不失执法的分寸。

b2-093-s007.skeleton: it was taken to pieces and sent to America
b2-093-s007.gloss: 第二年它被拆成零件运往美国。
b2-093-s007.whyLearn: 两个被动谓语共用一个主语，第二个省略 was，学「被拆开又运走」这类并列被动的省略写法。

b2-094-s003.skeleton: Babies of two months old do not appear to be reluctant to enter the water

modifiers.text: to be reluctant to enter the water
so accustomed to swimming that they can pick up weights from the floor of the pool
from the floor of the pool

b2-094-s003.gloss: 两月大婴儿不怕水，很快能潜水捡物。
b2-094-s003.whyLearn: appear to be reluctant to do 层层套接表「似乎不愿」，后半 so…that 写成长之快，信息密度很高。

b2-095-s018.skeleton: And how can you explain that
b2-095-s018.gloss: 那这件事你又怎么解释呢？
b2-095-s018.whyLearn: how can you 开头的反问句，情态动词 can 带出质问语气，是口语里追问归因的短句模板。

b2-096-s006.skeleton: the food that had been laid out for the dead is thrown into a river or into the sea

modifiers.text: that had been laid out for the dead
as it is considered unlucky for anyone living to eat it
for anyone living to eat it

b2-096-s006.gloss: 清晨为亡者摆的食物被倒进河或海里。
b2-096-s006.whyLearn: 主语被定语从句撑开，句末 as 从句交代原因，被动加过去完成时讲清先后，很有说明文味道。

b2-096-s007.skeleton: the tiny lanterns which had been hung in the streets the night before, are placed into the water

modifiers.text: In towns that are near the sea
which had been hung in the streets the night before

b2-096-s007.gloss: 海边城镇的灯笼在节后放入水中。
b2-096-s007.whyLearn: 两个定语从句分别修饰 towns 和 lanterns，主句用被动，句末再挂 when 从句，长句分层清楚。

modifiers.text: When reports came into London Zoo that a wild puma had been spotted forty-five miles south of London
that a wild puma had been spotted forty-five miles south of London

b3-001-s002.gloss: 有关美洲狮的报告送到动物园，却没人当真。
b3-001-s002.whyLearn: 同位语从句和时间状语从句套在一起，主句被动加否定，学新闻式「先铺背景再落结果」。

b4-058-s004.skeleton: One can only gently insinuate something else
b4-058-s004.gloss: 只能把别的东西轻塞进它痉挛的手心。
b4-058-s004.whyLearn: 十一词里 can 后连挂 gently 和 into 短语，宾语是 something else；看这点就懂 can only 的无奈。

b4-058-s006.skeleton: The cultivation of a hobby and new forms of interest is therefore a policy of first importance to a public man

modifiers.text: of a hobby and new forms of interest
of first importance to a public man

b4-058-s006.gloss: 培养爱好与新兴趣，对公众人物极重要。
b4-058-s006.whyLearn: 主语被 and 并列的两个 of 短语撑长，谓语仍是 is；这是阅读里最常见的长主语陷阱。

modifiers.text: that can be undertaken in a day or swiftly improvised by a mere command of the will

b4-058-s007.gloss: 这事不是一天能成或凭意志硬凑的。
b4-058-s007.whyLearn: 定语从句内套被动语态和 or 并列的第二谓语，学会用从句给抽象名词 business 补足判断。

b4-058-s008.skeleton: The growth of alternative mental interests is a long process
b4-058-s008.gloss: 另一种精神兴趣的养成是个漫长过程。
b4-058-s008.whyLearn: 十词短句交代全篇论断；of 短语限定 growth，说明英文说理不必靠长句，主系表即可定调。

b4-058-s010.skeleton: one ought to have at least two or three hobbies

modifiers.text: To be really happy and really safe
and they must all be real

b4-058-s010.gloss: 想真正快乐安全，至少要有两三种真爱好。
b4-058-s010.whyLearn: 句首不定式表目的置于主语前，ought to 表应然，and 后用 must 加码，三层推进。

b4-058-s012.skeleton: Such an attempt only aggravates the strain of mental effort
b4-058-s012.gloss: 这种尝试只会加重精神上的紧张。
b4-058-s012.whyLearn: only 卡在谓语前把徒劳语气压进句心；of 短语后置限定 strain，是名词后介词短语作定语的样板。

b4-058-s013.skeleton: A man may acquire great knowledge of topics unconnected with his daily work, and yet hardly get any benefit or relief
b4-058-s013.gloss: 人可懂很多与工作无关的知识，却无益。
b4-058-s013.whyLearn: may 与 and yet hardly 对撞出「能得却没得」；topics 后接过去分词短语作定语，比从句紧凑。

b4-058-s016.skeleton: It is no use offering the manual labourer, tired out with a hard week's sweat and effort, the chance of playing a game of football or baseball on Saturday afternoon

modifiers.text: tired out with a hard week's sweat and effort

b4-058-s016.gloss: 让劳累的体力工人周六踢球毫无用处。
b4-058-s016.whyLearn: It is no use doing 是高频无用句型，offering 后带双宾语；插入的分词短语解释工人为何不领情。

b4-058-s019.skeleton: In vain they rush frantically round from place to place

modifiers.text: trying to escape from avenging boredom by mere clatter and motion

b4-058-s019.gloss: 他们徒然四处狂奔，想用喧闹逃避无聊。
b4-058-s019.whyLearn: In vain 提句首定下徒劳基调；现在分词 trying 表伴随，再套 to escape 说目的，三层动作一气呵成。

b4-058-s020.skeleton: discipline in one form or another is the most hopeful path
b4-058-s020.gloss: 对他们而言，某种形式的纪律最有希望。
b4-058-s020.whyLearn: For them 提前划出视角，主句用最高级收束判断；适合模仿「对某人而言……最……」的短句。

b4-058-s022.whyLearn: 仅五词完成归类；Of these 划范围，the former 与前文 the latter 成对，是二分后下判断的经济写法。

b4-058-s025.skeleton: fortune's favoured children belong to the second class
b4-058-s025.gloss: 命运的宠儿属于第二类人。
b4-058-s025.whyLearn: 所有格加过去分词压出一个称号，belong to 表归属；名词前的信息密度是这句的看点。

b4-058-s026.skeleton: Their life is a natural harmony
b4-058-s026.gloss: 他们的生活是天然和谐的。
b4-058-s026.whyLearn: 主系表只六词，Their 把话题拉回上句的第二类人；短句作总结靠的是指代清楚、表语精准。

b4-058-s028.skeleton: Each day is a holiday, and ordinary holidays when they come are grudged as enforced interruptions in an absorbing vocation

modifiers.text: as enforced interruptions in an absorbing vocation

b4-058-s028.gloss: 天天像假日，真假日反被嫌为打扰。
b4-058-s028.whyLearn: and 并列两句，后句嵌 when 从句并转被动 are grudged as...；假日与被嫌的反差全靠 as 短语点出。

b4-058-s029.skeleton: the need of an alternative outlook, of a change of atmosphere, of a diversion of effort, is essential

modifiers.text: of an alternative outlook, of a change of atmosphere, of a diversion of effort

b4-058-s029.gloss: 两类人都需要另一种眼光与消遣。
b4-058-s029.whyLearn: 三个 of 短语用逗号并列挂在 need 后，of 内容作补充说明；句首 to both classes 前置收拢两类人。

b4-059-s001.skeleton: Economy is one powerful motive for camping

modifiers.text: since after the initial outlay upon

b4-059-s001.gloss: 省钱是露营的一大动机。
b4-059-s001.whyLearn: 主句先给判断，再用 since 引出原因，只是原文到此截断；可注意 for camping 用动名词限定 motive。

modifiers.text: Though we all got out to examine the fissure

b3-039-s015.gloss: 尽管我们都下车查看裂缝，他却留在车里。
b3-039-s015.whyLearn: Though 引导让步从句与主句形成对比；got out to do sth 表示下车去做某事，注意主句 remained 的拼写。

b3-039-s018.skeleton: Bruce engaged low gear and drove at a terrifying speed

modifiers.text: keeping the front wheels astride the crack
as he followed its zig-zag course

b3-039-s018.gloss: 布鲁斯挂低挡高速行驶，前轮跨在裂缝两侧。
b3-039-s018.whyLearn: 现在分词 keeping 表伴随状态，as 从句交代同时发生的动作，一句写清速度、位置与路线。

b3-039-s019.skeleton: we were back on the plain again

modifiers.text: Before we had time to worry about what might happen
to worry about what might happen

b3-039-s019.gloss: 还没等我们担心会出什么事，就又回到了平原上。
b3-039-s019.whyLearn: Before 加 have time to do 表示还没来得及；what might happen 作介词宾语，复习情态动词表推测。

b3-039-s020.skeleton: Bruce consulted the map once more and told us

modifiers.text: that the village was now only fifteen miles away

b3-039-s020.gloss: 布鲁斯再次看地图，说村子只剩十五英里了。
b3-039-s020.whyLearn: 一个主语带两个并列谓语，told us that 引宾语从句；once more 是叙事中常用的“再一次”。

b3-039-s021.skeleton: Our next obstacle was a shallow pool of water
b3-039-s021.gloss: 下一个障碍是宽约半英里的浅水洼。
b3-039-s021.whyLearn: 主系表结构介绍新障碍；about + 数量 + across 表示跨度，是描述面积的常用表达。

b3-039-s022.skeleton: Bruce charged at it, but in the middle, the car came to a grinding halt
b3-039-s022.gloss: 布鲁斯冲了过去，但车到中间戛然而止。
b3-039-s022.whyLearn: but 连接两个并列分句形成转折；come to a grinding halt 是形象又地道的“骤然停下”。

b3-040-s002.skeleton: Students specialize in a particular type of practical joke

modifiers.text: in a particular type of practical joke

b3-040-s002.gloss: 学生们专门搞一种恶作剧——骗局。
b3-040-s002.whyLearn: 冒号引出同位语 the hoax 给前面的名词下定义，specialize in 表示专门从事，值得模仿。

modifiers.text: that a student had dressed up as a policeman and was playing all sorts of silly jokes on people

b3-040-s006.gloss: 他补充说，有个学生扮成警察，正四处跟人开蠢玩笑。
b3-040-s006.whyLearn: 宾语从句里过去完成时与过去进行时并用，分清先后与正在发生；play jokes on sb 是固定搭配。

b3-040-s007.skeleton: Both the police and the workmen were grateful to the student

modifiers.text: for this piece of advance information

b3-040-s007.gloss: 警察和工人都感谢学生提供的这条预先消息。
b3-040-s007.whyLearn: both...and 连接并列主语，be grateful to sb for sth 是表示道谢的完整句型，实用度很高。

b3-040-s009.skeleton: a policeman arrived on the scene and politely asked the workmen to go away
b3-040-s009.gloss: 果然，一名警察到场，客气地叫工人走开。
b3-040-s009.whyLearn: Sure enough 作插入语承接前文的预判；ask sb to do sth 的复合宾语结构在叙事中很常用。

modifiers.text: The workmen told him to do as he pleased

b3-040-s011.gloss: 工人让他随意处置，警察则打电话求援。
b3-040-s011.whyLearn: and 连接两个独立分句推进对比；tell sb to do 与 do as one pleases 都是口语中常见的说法。

b3-040-s012.skeleton: four more policemen arrived and remonstrated with the workmen
b3-040-s012.gloss: 不久之后，又来了四名警察，与工人理论起来。
b3-040-s012.whyLearn: Shortly afterwards 放在句首衔接时间；remonstrate with sb 比 argue 更书面，适合提升用词。

b3-040-s013.skeleton: the police attempted to seize the pneumatic drill

modifiers.text: As the men refused to stop working

b3-040-s013.gloss: 由于工人们拒绝停工，警察试图夺下风钻。
b3-040-s013.whyLearn: As 引导原因状语从句；refuse 与 attempt 后面都接不定式，可以一起记住这两个搭配。

modifiers.text: one of them lost his temper

b3-040-s014.gloss: 工人们拼命挣扎，其中一个人发了脾气。
b3-040-s014.whyLearn: and 连接两个对等分句层层推进；one of them 与 lose one's temper 都是叙事高频表达。

b3-040-s015.skeleton: He threatened to call the police
b3-040-s015.whyLearn: threaten to do sth 用不定式作宾语，短句却推动情节，很适合拿来模仿造句。
